article_content: President Bola Tinubu on Friday urged his ministers to put aside their personal ambitions and focus on efforts to lift 50 million Nigerians out of poverty. Tinubu, in his closing remarks at the end of a three-day cabinet retreat for ministers, presidential aides, permanent secretaries, and senior officials at the State House Conference Centre in Abuja, stated: 'You are not here to make excuses, neither am I. You must put aside personal ambitions and focus on the progress of our nation.' He told participants they owed Nigerians the responsibility of changing the country’s narrative and called for resolving discrepancies through constructive dialogue. He noted, 'The renewed hope agenda is more than economic growth. As I said at the opening, we can spend money but we cannot spend the people. We have a responsibility to change completely the narrative about Nigeria. If we have problems, let’s talk to one another and engage in thoughtful conversations about our country.' Tinubu highlighted the importance of healthcare and poverty reduction, stating that while poverty is not shameful, it is unacceptable. He urged greater collaboration between ministers and permanent secretaries to ensure Nigeria recovers from its challenges—using the term 'elephantiasis' metaphorically for the country’s problems. He added, 'The responsibility we bear is not just about titles, it’s about the hopes and aspirations of millions of Nigerians. Let’s bond together and make sure our country is fully recovered.' Tinubu also expressed pride in the ministers and the outcomes of the retreat, sharing, 'I ran for election and won, then went to court and won again.' He called for a team commitment: 'I want a promise that we will work as a team for Nigerians. If you agree, stand up and say: I am a Nigerian.' All participants stood and repeated the phrase three times. The President outlined priority areas from the retreat: reform the economy for sustained and inclusive growth; strengthen security for peace and prosperity; boost agriculture for food security; unlock energy and natural resources for sustainable development; enhance infrastructure and transportation; focus on education, health, and social investment; and accelerate diversification through industrialisation, digitization, creative industry, manufacturing, and technology. Special Adviser Hadiza Usman presented plans for tracking Key Performance Indicators through a presidential delivery tracker. Secretary to the Government George Akume announced recommendations, including early memo submission (Wednesdays ahead of Monday’s council meetings), permanent secretaries accompanying ministers to Federal Executive Council meetings, restoring the FCT master plan, reducing port operators from 11 to 4, prioritizing solid minerals, providing technical training (including welders and technicians), emphasizing artificial intelligence, and developing performance bonds for civil servants to reward good conduct and address misconduct. A highlight of the retreat was the symbolic signing of a performance bond by Minister of Agriculture and Food Security, Abubakar Kyari, with other ministers signing at their seats.
translated_content: President Bola Tinubu oppfordret fredag sine ministre til å legge egne ambisjoner til side og fokusere på arbeidet med å løfte 50 millioner nigerianere ut av fattigdom. I avslutningstalen på et tre dager langt regjeringsretreat for ministre, presidentrådgivere, departementsråder og toppledere i State House Conference Centre i Abuja, sa Tinubu: «Dere er ikke her for å komme med unnskyldninger, det er ikke jeg heller. Dere må legge til side personlige ambisjoner og konsentrere dere om fremgangen for nasjonen vår.» Han fortalte deltagerne at de har et ansvar overfor det nigerianske folket om å endre fortellingen om landet, og oppfordret dem til å løse uenigheter gjennom konstruktiv dialog. Han sa: «Agendaen om nytt håp handler om mer enn bare økonomisk vekst. Som jeg sa ved åpningen, vi kan bruke penger men vi kan ikke bruke befolkningen. Vi har et ansvar for å endre Nigerias fortelling fullstendig. Har vi problemer, la oss snakke sammen og ha gode samtaler om landet vårt.» Tinubu understreket viktigheten av helsetjenester og redusert fattigdom, og påpekte at fattigdom ikke er skammelig, men heller ikke akseptabelt. Han oppfordret til tettere samarbeid mellom ministrene og departementsrådene for å hjelpe Nigeria med å takle utfordringene sine—og brukte «elefantiasis» metaforisk om landets problemer. Han fortsatte: «Ansvarene vi bærer handler ikke bare om titler, men om håpene og ambisjonene til millioner av nigerianere. La oss stå sammen og sørge for at landet vårt blir helt friskmeldt.» Tinubu uttrykte også stolthet over ministrene og resultatene fra retreaten, og sa: «Jeg stilte til valg og vant, gikk til retten og vant igjen.» Han ba om et løfte om lagarbeid: «Jeg vil ha et løfte om at vi skal jobbe som et lag for hele Nigeria. Hvis dere er enige, reis dere og si: ‘Jeg er en nigerianer’.» Alle reiste seg og gjentok setningen tre ganger. Presidenten løftet frem områdene som ble vektlagt under retreaten: reformere økonomien for bærekraftig og inkluderende vekst; styrke sikkerheten for fred og velstand; styrke landbruket for å oppnå matsikkerhet; utnytte energi og naturressurser for bærekraftig utvikling; bedre infrastruktur og transport; satse på utdanning, helse og sosial investeringspolitikk; og fremme diversifisering gjennom industrialisering, digitalisering, kreative næringer, produksjon og ny teknologi. Spesialrådgiver Hadiza Usman la frem planer for å spore nøkkelindikatorer gjennom et eget presidentsystem. Regjeringssekretær George Akume leste opp anbefalingene, inklusive tidlig innlevering av notater (onsdager før regjeringsmøtene på mandager), at departementsråder skal følge ministrene på møte, gjenoppretting av FCTs masterplan, reduksjon av havneoperatører fra 11 til 4, mer fokus på mineralutvikling, teknisk opplæring (blant annet for sveisere og teknikere), satsing på kunstig intelligens, samt utvikling av prestasjonskontrakter for statsansatte for å belønne god adferd og håndtere avvik. Et høydepunkt på retreaten var da landbruks- og matsikkerhetsminister Abubakar Kyari symbolsk signerte en prestasjonskontrakt, mens øvrige ministre signerte ved sine plasser.

article_content: An increase in laser attacks on airplanes in the United States has reached what officials call an 'epidemic level.' According to an FBI blog post, the number of incidents is expected to reach 3,700 by the end of the year, compared to just 283 in 2005—an increase of more than 1,100%. Last year, the FAA reported 3,592 laser incidents. The FBI noted that the Internet has made it easier to purchase inexpensive, handheld laser devices about the size of a fountain pen. These devices have become more powerful in recent years, and some lasers, costing as little as a dollar, can reach up to two miles. Authorities are concerned about the rising trend and are seeking tougher penalties. Supervisory federal air marshal George Johnson, who works with the FBI, said that this issue has reached 'epidemic level.' Pointing a laser at an aircraft can cause pilots temporary blindness for several seconds, which is particularly dangerous during takeoff and landing. 'Aiming a laser pointer at an aircraft is dangerous and reckless. Just don't do it,' Johnson said. Individuals who intentionally target aircraft with lasers can be prosecuted under two federal laws. A recently enacted law allows for up to five years in prison and an $11,000 fine per violation, without a warning. Another existing law carries penalties of up to 20 years in prison and a $250,000 fine. Michael Huerta, the acting FAA administrator, said his department will 'aggressively' prosecute violators. Laser incident reports have increased since 2005, when the FAA established a formal system for pilots to report them. The FBI said that those responsible for 'lasing' aircraft typically fit one of two profiles: minors without criminal records, or adult males with criminal histories. In some cases, traffickers and smugglers have used lasers to try to disrupt airborne surveillance.

FBI bemerket at Internett har gjort det enklere å kjøpe billige, håndholdte lasere på størrelse med fyllepenner. Disse enhetene har blitt kraftigere de siste årene, og noen lasere som koster så lite som én dollar kan rekke opptil to mil. Myndighetene er bekymret for den økende trenden og ønsker strengere straffer. George Johnson, overvåkende føderal flymarshal som samarbeider med FBI, sier at dette problemet har nådd et 'epideminivå.' Å peke en laser mot et fly kan føre til midlertidig blindhet for piloter i flere sekunder, noe som er spesielt farlig under avgang og landing. 'Å sikte en laser mot et fly er farlig og hensynsløst. Ikke gjør det,' sa Johnson. Personer som med vilje retter lasere mot fly kan tiltales etter to føderale lover. En nylig vedtatt lov gir opptil fem års fengsel og en bot på 11 000 dollar per overtredelse, uten advarsel. En annen eksisterende lov gir straff på opptil 20 års fengsel og en bot på 250 000 dollar. Michael Huerta, fungerende FAA-administrator, sier at hans avdeling vil 'følge opp' overtredelsene aggressivt. Rapporter om laserhendelser har økt siden 2005, da FAA etablerte et formelt system for piloter til å rapportere dem. FBI sier at de som står bak 'lasering' av fly vanligvis passer inn i to profiler: mindreårige uten rulleblad eller voksne menn med kriminell bakgrunn. I noen tilfeller har menneskesmuglere og narkotikasmuglere brukt lasere for å forstyrre overvåkning fra lufta.

article_content: At least six individuals related to the Fulton County, Georgia, investigation into former President Donald Trump’s actions to overturn the 2020 election have been either offered plea deals or are in negotiations, according to CNN sources. Details of these deals remain undisclosed. Those approached reportedly include attorney Robert Cheeley, former county elections supervisor Misty Hampton, and ex-White House aide Michael Roman. No responses to media requests were received from their legal teams. Cheeley’s lawyer, Richard Rice, stated that although a plea agreement was proposed by the district attorney’s office some time ago, his client turned it down, and there are no current discussions underway. In mid-August, Trump and 18 co-defendants were indicted by a Fulton County grand jury, charged under Georgia’s Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (RICO) Act, which allows prosecutors to address related criminal activity as part of a coordinated effort. Four defendants—Kenneth Chesebro, Jenna Ellis, Sidney Powell, and bail bondsman Scott Hall—have accepted plea agreements from the district attorney so far. Observers believe District Attorney Fani Willis aims to encourage cooperation from as many defendants as possible to strengthen the prosecution’s case, possibly isolating Trump and senior co-defendants. Legal experts commented to Insider that a larger pool of co-defendants increases the chances that some may collaborate with investigators to reduce their sentences. Former deputy district attorney Melissa Redmon also noted it’s possible prosecutors simply seek to expedite case resolutions, as any confessions by defendants can be valuable, even if they don’t directly implicate others. Accepted plea deals so far have resulted in dismissals or reductions of charges: for example, Sidney Powell admitted to six misdemeanors and was sentenced to probation. None of the four have pleaded guilty to RICO violations or were given prison time. As prosecutors focus on the higher-profile co-defendants, Redmon suggested they are less likely to dismiss or reduce charges. CNN reported that Rudy Giuliani, Trump’s previous personal lawyer and a major co-defendant, has not been offered a plea deal. Redmon indicated Giuliani might only be given an agreement if it includes a guilty plea to the RICO charge. Ted Goodman, Giuliani’s political adviser, told Insider that Giuliani remains committed to 'telling the truth' and accused the Georgia prosecutors of having politically motivated intentions designed to keep Trump out of office.

Detaljene i avtalene er ikke offentliggjort. Blant dem som skal ha blitt kontaktet, er advokat Robert Cheeley, tidligere valgansvarlig Misty Hampton og tidligere medarbeider i Det hvite hus Michael Roman. Deres juridiske team har ikke svart på mediehenvendelser. Cheeleys advokat, Richard Rice, uttalte at statsadvokatens kontor foreslo en avtale for en tid tilbake, men at denne ble avslått, og at det ikke foregår noen samtaler nå. I midten av august ble Trump og 18 medtiltalte tiltalt i Fulton County under Georgias Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (RICO)-lov, som gir påtalemyndigheten mulighet til å føre flere relaterte lovbrudd i én samlet sak. Tidligere assisterende distriktsadvokat Melissa Redmon påpekte at påtalemyndigheten også kan ønske å avgjøre sakene raskt, siden enhver innrømmelse fra tiltalte kan være verdifull, selv uten direkte å belaste andre. De inngåtte tilståelsesavtalene har så langt ført til at siktelser enten er blitt redusert eller frafalt: For eksempel erkjente Sidney Powell skyld i seks forseelser og fikk prøvetid. Ingen av de fire har erkjent straffskyld for RICO-tiltalen eller fått fengselsstraff. Ted Goodman, Giulianis politiske rådgiver, fortalte Insider at Giuliani kun vil 'fortelle sannheten' og anklaget påtalemyndigheten i Georgia for politisk motivasjon og forsøk på å holde Trump utenfor Det hvite hus.

article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron's proposal to legalize same-sex marriage has attracted warnings that churches could face legal action under human rights laws if they refuse to conduct same-sex marriages. Legal advice given to government officials suggests that faith groups refusing to host gay weddings might lose access to public facilities like village halls. A report written by Aidan O’Neill, a human rights lawyer from Matrix Chambers, also states that Christian teachers who refuse to teach about same-sex marriage could lawfully be dismissed. The government is moving ahead with legalizing same-sex marriage, except for the Church of England, which is planned to remain exempt. The report further warns that parents supporting traditional marriage could be prevented from fostering or adopting children, and they would not be able to stop their children from learning about same-sex marriage at school. Controversially, the legal argument maintains that the exemption for the Church of England in the proposed bill—which aims to prevent the church from performing gay marriages—could be challenged in the European Court of Human Rights. This is because the church has a legal duty to marry anyone living in their parish. Protections for other religious groups who do not wish to perform same-sex marriages might also be challenged under evolving European human rights law. These findings were brought to light as government sources confirmed a House of Commons vote is planned before mid-February. The concerns were detailed in a letter from former Archbishop of Canterbury, Lord Carey, to the Prime Minister, referring to O’Neill’s legal opinion. Lord Carey argued that the proposals could cause significant conflicts between religious groups and authorities and described the law as divisive and poorly conceived. O’Neill’s legal opinion, commissioned by the Coalition for Marriage, highlights that local authorities are bound by the Equalities Act, which could require them to deny services or facilities to churches or individuals holding traditional marriage views. A government source responded that the Church of England’s obligation to marry parishioners led to creating a legal safeguard to ensure it would not be forced to conduct same-sex weddings. Nonetheless, Downing Street has signaled that the Prime Minister will continue with plans for the legislation, citing their own legal advice.

article_content: Monica Winton, 50, from Perthshire, Scotland, described the frightening moment when she almost fell into an eight-foot-deep hole that appeared overnight outside her front door. She was heading to the shops when the ground suddenly gave way, revealing a stream running beneath her home. The collapses affected a tunnel carrying the underground stream, which gradually eroded the soil above and caused the path outside the Winton's house to cave in. The hole has now expanded to several meters wide. Monica and her husband, Graham Winton, 51, are concerned that the hole could grow larger and threaten their front porch. They placed sandbags around the area to try to protect the property. The Wintons, who have lived in their house for 11 years, were unaware of the presence of a stream (known as a burn) running under their property. Local authorities reported that the heavy rainfall in December likely contributed to the tunnel's collapse. Because of the hole, the couple are now unable to use the front of the house. The concrete base of their porch is now unsupported. Graham Winton contacted their insurance company, but there is uncertainty as to which insurer is responsible for the damage, since he recently changed his policy. The insurance assessment is due soon. A spokesperson for Perth and Kinross Council said the responsibility for repairs rests with property owners. The council assisted by surveying the damaged barrel drain and will share the findings with those affected, so homeowners have the necessary information to arrange repairs.

Hun var på vei til butikken da bakken plutselig ga etter, og avslørte en bekk som renner under huset. Raset rammet en tunnel som førte den underjordiske bekken, og dette har gradvis tæret bort jorden over og fått stien utenfor Wintons hus til å rase sammen. Hullet har nå utvidet seg til flere meter bredt. Monica og hennes ektemann, Graham Winton, 51, er bekymret for at hullet kan bli større og true dems veranda. De har lagt ut sandsekker rundt området for å beskytte eiendommen. Winton-paret, som har bodd i huset i 11 år, visste ikke at det gikk en bekk (burn) under eiendommen. Lokale myndigheter mener at det kraftige regnværet i desember sannsynligvis bidro til tunnelens kollaps. På grunn av hullet kan paret nå ikke bruke inngangspartiet. Betongsokkelen under verandaen har ikke lenger støtte. Graham Winton tok kontakt med forsikringsselskapet, men det er usikkert hvilket selskap som har ansvaret, siden han nylig byttet forsikring. Skadevurdering fra forsikringen ventes snart. En talsperson for Perth and Kinross Council sier at ansvaret for reparasjoner ligger hos huseierne. Kommunen har hjulpet til ved å undersøke den skadede kulverten og vil dele funnene med de berørte, slik at de får den informasjonen de trenger for å ordne reparasjoner.

article_content: At The Citadel, a cherished hub in Beit Sahour’s old city, locals gather amid growing tension as violence forces most tourists and foreigners to leave. The restaurant’s patio is adorned with murals of prominent Palestinians like journalist Shireen Abu Akleh and activist Khader Adnan, as well as stirring quotes. Baha Hilu, who leads cultural and political events at The Citadel, began his day assisting anxious Swiss tourists in escaping the conflict. Facing near-total checkpoint closures due to the war in Gaza, he arranged for their passage on a Palestinian bus, then onto an Israeli one bound for Jordan, seeing the checkpoint close right after them. After learning that a friend in Gaza had lost her home to bombing, Baha joined regulars at The Citadel, expressing exhaustion and sadness as the world's gaze turns to Palestine. He observed that although capturing Israeli soldiers was unprecedented, the despair and hardship remain all too familiar, shaped by the ongoing occupation. Maryam, 19, shared that, contrary to some beliefs, Palestinians are not used to this conflict. Her aspirations to attend university in Haifa were disrupted by the unrest. Nearby, friends picked over snacks and cigarettes, joking that tobacco was the one supply they wouldn't run out of, even as other essentials became scarce. They planned a game night as a simple comfort. Anxiety is ever-present: live TikTok videos and urgent notifications on phones brought scenes of gunfire and unrest just a short distance away, fueling concerns that violence might escalate further in the West Bank. Despite these challenges, the community’s resilience shows in shared jokes, support, and small attempts to keep life going amid turmoil.

article_content: Oil prices eased on Tuesday, relinquishing most of the previous day’s gains, amid concerns over weak demand in China. Investors were watching for trade data expected later in the day to assess demand from the world’s second-largest oil consumer. Brent crude futures fell 23 cents, or 0.3%, to $84.95 a barrel by 0127 GMT. U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude dropped 23 cents, also 0.3%, to $80.59 a barrel. Both benchmarks had risen about 30 cents on Monday after top exporters Saudi Arabia and Russia reaffirmed their commitment to additional voluntary oil supply cuts through year-end. ‘Oil prices were supported by continued output cuts from Saudi Arabia and Russia yesterday, but investor focus has shifted to demand, especially in China,’ said Toshitaka Tazawa, analyst at Fujitomi Securities. All eyes are on data from China this week, he added. China is set to release October’s import and export figures on Tuesday at 0300 GMT, while bank lending, credit, and key consumer price inflation (CPI) data will follow on Thursday. ‘We expect a tug-of-war at current price levels moving forward, as markets absorb both supply and demand news,’ said Tazawa, noting the trend could change if Middle East tensions increase. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that Israel would consider ‘tactical little pauses’ in Gaza fighting to facilitate aid or hostage release, but rejected calls for a general ceasefire despite rising international pressure. Saudi Arabia announced Sunday it would maintain its additional voluntary cut of 1 million barrels per day—resulting in December production of about 9 million bpd, a source at the energy ministry said. Moscow also stated it would continue its voluntary supply cut of 300,000 bpd from crude oil and petroleum product exports through December. Separately, Venezuela’s state oil company PDVSA is in talks with local and foreign oilfield firms to hire equipment and services needed to increase production, sources said, following a relaxation of U.S. sanctions. Elsewhere, India is working to expedite approvals for Tesla by January 2024 to encourage the company’s entry. Rising luxury sales in India, including desserts, bags, and jewelry, are being driven by a strong economy, retailers and companies report. However, salary hikes for technology professionals switching jobs in India have fallen nearly 50% from last year, as IT exporters curb hiring due to slowing global demand.

Brentolje falt med 23 cent, eller 0,3 %, til 84,95 dollar fatet kl. 01.27 GMT. Amerikansk West Texas Intermediate falt også 23 cent, eller 0,3 %, til 80,59 dollar fatet. Begge referansepriser steg omtrent 30 cent mandag etter at Saudi-Arabia og Russland bekreftet at de vil fortsette med frivillige oljekutt ut året. – Oljeprisene ble støttet av fortsatte kutt fra Saudi-Arabia og Russland i går, men investorene fokuserer nå mer på etterspørselen, spesielt i Kina, sier Toshitaka Tazawa, analytiker i Fujitomi Securities. Alle følger med på tall fra Kina denne uken. Kina skal offentliggjøre import- og eksporttall for oktober tirsdag kl. 03.00 GMT, mens tall for bankutlån, kreditt og konsumprisindeks (KPI) kommer torsdag. – Vi forventer en dragkamp rundt dagens prisnivå fremover, ettersom markedet tar inn nyheter om både tilbud og etterspørsel, sier Tazawa og bemerker at trenden kan endre seg dersom spenningene i Midtøsten øker. Israels statsminister Benjamin Netanyahu sa at Israel vil vurdere ‘taktiske korte pauser’ i kampene på Gaza for å lette nødhjelp eller frigivelse av gisler, men han avviste igjen krav om generell våpenhvile til tross for økt internasjonalt press. Saudi-Arabia kunngjorde søndag at de vil opprettholde et ekstra frivillig kutt på én million fat per dag, noe som betyr en produksjon på rundt ni millioner fat per dag i desember, opplyste en kilde i energidepartementet. Moskva sa også at de vil fortsette sitt frivillige kutt på 300 000 fat per dag fra råolje- og petroleumsprodukter ut desember. Samtidig har Venezuelas statlige oljeselskap PDVSA samtaler med lokale og utenlandske leverandører om å få tak i utstyr og tjenester for å øke produksjonen, ifølge kilder, etter at USA lettet på sanksjonene. I tillegg jobber India med å få godkjent Tesla innen januar 2024 for å tilrettelegge for selskapets inntreden. Økende luksussalg i India – blant annet av desserter, vesker og smykker – drives av sterk økonomi, melder forhandlere og selskaper. Lønnsøkningen for teknologiarbeidere som bytter jobb i India, har derimot falt med nesten 50 % fra i fjor, ettersom ledende IT-selskaper bremser ansettelsene på grunn av svakere global etterspørsel.

article_content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated at a press conference on Saturday that the Israel-Gaza war is diverting attention away from Russia's invasion of Ukraine, according to the BBC. Incremental updates about the war in Ukraine have become less prominent in the media. Stephen Walt, professor at Harvard and author of 'The Israel Lobby and U.S. Foreign Policy,' told Insider that this shift in focus could benefit Russia. Walt explained that the ongoing conflict in Gaza is likely to have significant effects on other global conflicts, including the war in Ukraine. He highlighted that the United States and its allies have limited resources and time to support multiple crises simultaneously. Walt noted, 'There's only so much attention leaders like President Biden can devote to different issues. Increased focus on the Middle East means less attention for other problems, causing some countries to feel neglected.' This neglect could manifest for Ukraine as shortages in munitions. The US and its partners are already struggling to meet Ukraine's demand for 155mm artillery shells, which are vital in a war of attrition. The US currently produces just over 14,000 rounds a month, which Ukrainian forces can use up in about two days, Insider previously reported. Walt said that as the US helps rearm Israel, some equipment that might have gone to Ukraine may now be redirected to the Middle East. He added that Ukraine's situation has become a political issue in the US Congress, with Republicans involved in ongoing debates. A recent Gallup Poll found that 41% of Americans now believe the US is giving too much aid to Ukraine, up from 29% earlier in the year. 'This increase in skepticism about aid to Ukraine, combined with other factors, does not bode well for Ukraine,' Walt said. Walt pointed out that as the US supports multiple conflicts, conditions could worsen for Ukraine without significant effort from Russia. He suggested that Russia can focus on the Ukraine conflict while criticizing others and does not need to directly intervene in Middle Eastern affairs. The US also contends with tensions with China and its economic rivalry, on top of managing the conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East. Walt concluded that only a major setback for Ukraine would likely push the conflict back to the forefront of international attention, a scenario no one hopes for. However, if Russia appears to make major gains, renewed international focus on Ukraine would force the Biden administration to make tough decisions on further support.
translated_content: Ukrainas president Volodymyr Zelenskyj uttalte på en pressekonferanse lørdag at krigen mellom Israel og Gaza tar oppmerksomheten bort fra Russlands invasjon av Ukraina, melder BBC. Oppdateringer om krigen i Ukraina har fått mindre mediedekning. Stephen Walt, professor ved Harvard og forfatter av «The Israel Lobby and U.S. Foreign Policy», fortalte Insider at denne endringen i fokus kan være en fordel for Russland. Walt forklarte at den pågående konflikten i Gaza sannsynligvis vil ha betydelige konsekvenser for andre globale konflikter, inkludert krigen i Ukraina. Han påpekte at USA og dets allierte har begrensede ressurser og tid til å støtte flere kriser samtidig. Walt bemerket: «Det er bare så mye oppmerksomhet ledere som president Biden kan gi til ulike problemer. Økt fokus på Midtøsten betyr mindre tid til andre utfordringer, og noen land kan føle seg tilsidesatt.» Denne tilsidesettelsen kan for Ukraina bety mangel på ammunisjon. USA og dets partnere sliter allerede med å møte Ukrainas behov for 155 mm artillerigranater, som er avgjørende i en utmattelseskrig. USA produserer for tiden litt over 14 000 granater i måneden, noe ukrainske styrker kan bruke opp på rundt to dager, rapporterte Insider tidligere. Walt sa at etter hvert som USA hjelper til med å bevæpne Israel, kan noe utstyr som ellers ville havnet i Ukraina, bli omdirigert til Midtøsten. Han la til at Ukrainas situasjon har blitt et politisk tema i den amerikanske Kongressen, der republikanerne er involvert i løpende debatter. En fersk Gallup-undersøkelse fant at 41 % av amerikanere nå mener at USA gir for mye støtte til Ukraina, opp fra 29 % tidligere i år. «Denne økningen i skepsis til bistand til Ukraina, sammen med andre faktorer, lover ikke godt for Ukraina,» sa Walt. Walt påpekte at når USA støtter flere konflikter, kan forholdene forverres for Ukraina uten mye innsats fra Russland. Han antydet at Russland kan fokusere på Ukraina-konflikten, kritisere andre, og slipper å gripe direkte inn i Midtøsten. USA må også håndtere spenninger med Kina og en økonomisk rivalisering, i tillegg til å håndtere konfliktene i Ukraina og Midtøsten. Walt konkluderte med at kun et betydelig tilbakeslag for Ukraina sannsynligvis vil sette konflikten tilbake i sentrum for internasjonal oppmerksomhet, noe ingen håper på. Men dersom Russland ser ut til å gjøre store fremskritt, kan ny internasjonal oppmerksomhet tvinge Biden-administrasjonen til å ta vanskelige avgjørelser om videre støtte.

article_content: Natasha Barnett, a 29-year-old mother from Newport Pagnell, Buckinghamshire, was instructed by a lifeguard at Middleton Pool that breastfeeding her five-month-old daughter Olive on the poolside was not allowed, as it was seen as ‘eating and drinking.’ A regular visitor at the pool, Barnett was sitting near her children enjoying the water when she asked if she could feed Olive discreetly with a towel for cover. She was refused, leaving her shocked and upset. Afterwards, she brought her children out of the pool and went to the changing rooms to feed her baby in private. Barnett, joined by her children Dominic, Millie, and Theo, and her partner Daniel Robinson, felt embarrassed and said the situation shook her confidence in breastfeeding in public. She posted about her experience on Facebook, receiving numerous supportive replies from mothers, many of whom encouraged her to organize a protest at the pool. Places for People Leisure, which operates Middleton Pool, explained that while they are supportive of breastfeeding, it is not permitted in the pool, spa, or areas where food and drink are banned. General manager Sean O’Connor stated that breastfeeding is welcomed on the poolside (not in the water) but safety concerns for Barnett’s other young child also played a role in their decision. O’Connor said he reached out to Barnett and explained the reasons for the request, after which she accepted their explanation. This event brings attention to the Equality Act 2010, which makes it illegal to ask breastfeeding women to leave most public places in the UK. Businesses must not discriminate against breastfeeding mothers, and government guidelines urge staff to be aware of these rights to ensure women feel comfortable feeding their children in public.

Hun delte historien sin på Facebook, hvor hun mottok mange støttende meldinger fra andre mødre—flere oppfordret henne til å arrangere en protest ved bassenget. Places for People Leisure, som drifter Middleton Pool, forklarte at de støtter amming, men at det ikke er tillatt i bassenget, spaet eller områder hvor mat og drikke er forbudt. Bedrifter kan ikke diskriminere mot ammende mødre, og myndighetene anbefaler at ansatte kjenner til disse rettighetene, slik at kvinner føler seg trygge på å amme offentlig.

article_content: Coworkers often share ideas, and many people are grateful for family, friends, community, home, health, and good fortune. However, gratitude for one’s job, colleagues, or workplace culture isn't always top of mind. As Thanksgiving approaches, people reflect on what and who they appreciate in their lives. While the holiday has a complex and painful colonial history for many, it still serves as an annual reminder of the importance of gratitude. Leaders should consider bringing the spirit of gratitude back to the workplace, even after the Thanksgiving festivities end. Organizational psychologists have found strong connections between workplace appreciation and business success. Research from Gallup and Workhuman shows that when employees feel recognized and valued, organizations benefit in productivity, retention, and profitability. For example, a Gallup/Workhuman report from 2023 estimates that a 10,000-person company with a strong culture of gratitude could see nearly $92 million in increased productivity. Organizations could also save $16.1 million through improved retention. Deloitte found that 47% of employees are most motivated by growth opportunities—another form of recognition—compared to 23% who are motivated primarily by raises. Among Millennials, 51% prefer growth opportunities over pay increases. Research by Blueboard and Wakefield Research found that employees in companies with strong recognition cultures are more than four times as likely to feel fully engaged at work. Conversely, employees reporting a weak culture of appreciation are more likely to be disengaged. Yet, about two-thirds of employees feel underappreciated. Managers and leaders can do a lot to address this. A simple 'thank you,' whether spoken or written, would satisfy 84% of employees. Appreciation from managers is especially impactful, but recognition from peers also motivates people. When managers demonstrate gratitude consistently, it helps embed the habit within organizational culture. Recognition is typically formal, tied to rewards such as raises and promotions, and is often within the purview of managers or HR. Appreciation, in contrast, can be informal and widely practiced, helping it become a cultural norm. Examples include shout-outs, thank-yous, or spotlighting achievements. Leadership behavior greatly influences an organization’s values. When leaders express appreciation both publicly and privately, it encourages others to do the same. A University of Colorado study found that coworkers practicing gratitude journaling are kinder to each other. Structured appreciation exercises or dedicated recognition channels, such as a Slack group, can have similar effects. Organizations with strong interpersonal trust and safety also report higher levels of appreciation. Expressing gratitude helps create and reinforce this trust. Appreciation is particularly important now, as year-end stress, deadlines, budgets, and holiday demands can create challenges in the workplace. Showing team members how much they are valued can offset stress and promote positive practices that last beyond the holiday season. While Thanksgiving is a season for gratitude, appreciation can positively impact the workplace all year.
translated_content: Kollegaer deler ofte ideer, og mange takker for familie, venner, nærmiljø, hjem, helse og flaks. Likevel er det ikke alltid jobben, kollegaene eller arbeidsmiljøet kommer øverst på listen når vi tenker på hva vi er takknemlige for. Når Thanksgiving nærmer seg, reflekterer folk ofte over hva og hvem de setter pris på i livet. Selv om høytiden har en kompleks og smertefull kolonial historie for mange, fungerer den fortsatt som en årlig påminnelse om viktigheten av takknemlighet. Ledere bør vurdere å ta med seg takknemligheten tilbake til arbeidsplassen, selv etter at festlighetene er over. Organisasjonspsykologer har funnet sterke sammenhenger mellom takknemlighet på jobb og suksess i virksomheten. Forskning fra Gallup og Workhuman viser at når ansatte føler seg sett og verdsatt, øker både produktivitet, trivsel og lønnsomhet. For eksempel anslår en rapport fra Gallup/Workhuman fra 2023 at et selskap med 10 000 ansatte og sterk takknemlighetskultur kan få en produktivitetsøkning på nesten 920 millioner kroner. Bedrifter kan også spare 161 millioner kroner på bedre medarbeiderbeholdning. Deloitte fant at 47 % av ansatte er mest motivert av muligheter for utvikling – en form for anerkjennelse – mot 23 % som holder lønnsøkning som største motivasjon. Blant Millennials foretrekker 51 % utviklingsmuligheter fremfor høyere lønn. Forskning fra Blueboard og Wakefield Research viste at ansatte i selskaper med god anerkjennelseskultur er mer enn fire ganger så tilbøyelige til å føle fullt engasjement på jobb. På motsatt side er ansatte i selskaper med svak takknemlighetskultur ofte lite engasjerte. Likevel føler rundt to tredjedeler seg lite verdsatt. Ledere og mellomledere kan gjøre mye for å forbedre dette. Et enkelt 'takk', enten muntlig eller skriftlig, vil tilfredsstille 84 % av de ansatte. Verdsetting fra ledere har størst innvirkning, men raushet fra kollegaer motiverer også. Når ledere viser takknemlighet jevnlig, sprer vanen seg i kulturen. Anerkjennelse er ofte formell, knyttet til lønn og opprykk, og skjer typisk fra ledere eller HR. Takknemlighet kan derimot være uformell og bredt praktisert, noe som gjør det lettere å bygge en positiv kultur. Eksempler er å gi ros, si takk eller fremheve prestasjoner. Lederes adferd former organisasjonens verdier. Når de takker ansatte offentlig og privat, inspirerer det også andre til å gjøre det samme. En studie fra University of Colorado viste at kollegaer som førte takknemlighetsdagbok, ble snillere mot hverandre. Strukturerte øvelser eller egne kanaler, som en Slack-gruppe, kan gi samme effekt. Selskaper med sterke bånd, tillit og trygghet, rapporterer også høyere grad av takknemlighet. Å vise takknemlighet styrker og forsterker denne tilliten. Takknemlighet er ekstra viktig akkurat nå, når årsavslutning, budsjetter, frister og høytidspress kan skape stress på jobb. Å vise ansatte at de blir sett og satt pris på, kan dempe stress og legge grunnlaget for gode rutiner langt utover høytiden. Selv om Thanksgiving handler om takknemlighet, skaper en kultur for takknemlighet positive ringvirkninger på jobb – hele året.

article_content: A man has been arrested after allegedly throwing an object at Manchester City striker Erling Haaland during Sunday's derby at Old Trafford. The 34-year-old was detained on suspicion of throwing a missile after Haaland, the Norwegian forward, scored the first of his two goals against United. Police reported that the man was arrested shortly after 17:00 GMT and has since been released on bail. The object, which was thrown from the Stretford End, did not reach Haaland. Manchester City went on to deliver a dominant performance, defeating United 3-0. Haaland opened the scoring with a penalty in the 26th minute, even as United supporters chanted 'Keano' in an effort to distract him. This chant references the historical rivalry between Haaland's father, Alf-Inge Haaland, and former United captain Roy Keane. After the match, Haaland told the BBC that he used the crowd's taunts as motivation. As part of his bail conditions, the arrested man is barred from attending football matches. For more updates, follow BBC North West on Facebook, X, and Instagram. Story ideas can be sent to northwest.newsonline@bbc.co.uk.

article_content: Director Yemi Bamiro, acclaimed for his work on 'Fight the Power', will direct 'Black Is Beautiful: The Kwame Brathwaite Story'. This documentary is being developed by Wayfarer Studios in partnership with Misfits Entertainment, The Creative Coalition, and The Kwame Brathwaite Archive to showcase the life and enduring impact of Kwame Brathwaite—prominent activist, visual artist, and photojournalist. The film will explore Brathwaite’s ascent to influence during the second Harlem Renaissance, the Civil Rights era, and his effect on modern art. An important force behind the 'Black is Beautiful' movement, Brathwaite co-founded Grandassa Models—a group of Black women elevating Afrocentric standards of beauty and rejecting mainstream Eurocentric trends with a focus on natural hair and African-inspired fashion. Brathwaite’s photography documented dynamic scenes of music, poetry, theatre, and art, creating visuals that reshaped perceptions of Black beauty and identity. Grandassa Models continues this heritage with regular gatherings that celebrate these ideals. Over his six-decade career, Brathwaite’s portraits featured notable figures such as Muhammad Ali, The Jackson 5, Nelson Mandela, and Grace Jones, alongside everyday people. His powerful images appeared in major outlets including Vogue, The New Yorker, The New York Times, Essence, and National Geographic. The filmmakers have also gained access to extensive, previously unseen materials from Brathwaite’s estate, enriching the film’s narrative. Executive producers include Steve Sarowitz (Wayfarer Studios) and Andee Ryder (Misfits Entertainment), with producers Justin Baldoni and Andrew Calof (Wayfarer Studios), Ian Bonhôte and Lizzie Gillett (Misfits Entertainment), Robin Bronk (The Creative Coalition), and Kwame S. Brathwaite for The Kwame Brathwaite Archive. Kwame S. Brathwaite, the artist's son, expressed excitement about sharing the significance and depth of his father’s work. Bamiro, a long-time admirer of Brathwaite, noted it was an honor to tell the story of such an influential figure in art, beauty, and activism. Andrew Calof, Wayfarer Studios’ President of Production and Development, emphasized that Brathwaite’s achievements are still underappreciated and that the film aims to bring greater recognition to his critical role in shaping Black cultural aesthetics and narratives. Yemi Bamiro’s documentary experience includes the PBS series 'Fight the Power: How Hip Hop Changed the World' and 'One Man and His Shoes', examining the history of Air Jordan sneakers. He is represented by Jenny Parker at Mint & Co.
translated_content: Regissør Yemi Bamiro, kjent for sitt arbeid med 'Fight the Power', skal regissere 'Black Is Beautiful: The Kwame Brathwaite Story'. Dokumentaren utvikles av Wayfarer Studios i samarbeid med Misfits Entertainment, The Creative Coalition og The Kwame Brathwaite Archive, og skal vise livet og den varige innflytelsen til Kwame Brathwaite—en innflytelsesrik aktivist, visuell kunstner og fotojournalist. Filmen utforsker Brathwaites vei til påvirkning under den andre Harlem-renessansen, borgerrettighetsbevegelsen og hans rolle i moderne kunst. Som en viktig drivkraft bak 'Black is Beautiful'-bevegelsen var Brathwaite med på å stifte Grandassa Models—en gruppe svarte kvinner som fremmet afrosentriske skjønnhetsidealer og tok avstand fra de rådende euro-sentriske trendene ved å fremheve naturlig hår og afrikainspirert mote. Brathwaite dokumenterte møter fulle av musikk, poesi, teater og kunst gjennom fotografiene sine, og påvirket synet på svart skjønnhet og identitet. Grandassa Models viderefører denne tradisjonen med ukentlige samlinger. I løpet av sine seks tiår som fotograf portretterte Brathwaite kjente navn som Muhammad Ali, The Jackson 5, Nelson Mandela og Grace Jones, i tillegg til vanlige mennesker. De sterke bildene hans har vært på trykk i store medier som Vogue, The New Yorker, The New York Times, Essence og National Geographic. Filmskaperne får tilgang til et omfattende og hittil upublisert arkivmateriale fra Brathwaites bo, som gir dokumentaren et rikt innhold. Blant utøvende produsenter er Steve Sarowitz (Wayfarer Studios) og Andee Ryder (Misfits Entertainment). Producerteamet inkluderer Justin Baldoni og Andrew Calof (Wayfarer Studios), Ian Bonhôte og Lizzie Gillett (Misfits Entertainment), Robin Bronk (The Creative Coalition) og Kwame S. Brathwaite for The Kwame Brathwaite Archive. Kwame S. Brathwaite, fotografens sønn, uttrykte glede over å vise bredden og betydningen av farens verk. Bamiro, en stor beundrer av Brathwaite, sier det er et privilegium å fortelle historien om en slik innflytelsesrik skikkelse innen kunst, skjønnhet og aktivisme. Andrew Calof, produksjons- og utviklingssjef i Wayfarer Studios, understreker at Brathwaites innsats ikke er fullt ut anerkjent, og at filmen vil fremheve hvilken viktig rolle han har spilt i utviklingen av svart estetikk og kultur. Yemi Bamiro har tidligere laget 'Fight the Power: How Hip Hop Changed the World' for PBS samt 'One Man and His Shoes' om Air Jordan-skoene. Han er representert av Jenny Parker i Mint & Co.

article_content: Musician Robert Aaron, 57, who is suspected by police of supplying the heroin that led to the death of Oscar-winning actor Philip Seymour Hoffman, has stated that he feels he is being made a scapegoat. In an interview with The New York Times, Aaron said a ‘witch hunt’ is occurring as authorities are under pressure to prosecute someone for Hoffman’s death in early February. Aaron, a multi-instrumentalist who has performed with artists such as David Bowie and Wyclef Jean, described himself as ‘unlucky’ to have been singled out by police. During his arraignment in New York on February 5, 2014—three days after Hoffman was found dead in his West Village home—Aaron faced charges related to possession and supplying heroin. Canadian-born Aaron could face up to 25 years in prison if convicted. The article noted Aaron’s struggles with drugs, as he outlined an on-and-off habit spanning nearly 40 years. Aaron stated he would not apologize for his drug use, claiming it hadn’t harmed anyone else. He explained, ‘Honestly, I don’t think anybody I know romanticized it as much as they liked it. It’s got good qualities.’ Aaron was arrested in his Manhattan apartment two nights after Hoffman’s death, after police found nearly 300 bags of heroin. Aaron said most of the drugs were for personal use and explained that he identifies as a drug addict. ‘A lot of times you have a deadline and you need to work for 24 hours. This lets you do it without pain, without tiredness… If I have to write a book, get me high — I’ll have it written in two weeks. You’re lucid. And emotions don’t affect you as much — your anger — it bottles up your feelings. It makes you more rational, or so you think. You sleep wonderfully. I’ve been a lifelong insomniac,’ Aaron explained. Aaron denied acting as a dealer for Hoffman, though he admitted to occasionally selling drugs to friends, stating, ‘I was my own best customer. I always say, a monkey can’t sell bananas.’ Friends described Aaron as a consummate professional, insisting his drug habit hadn’t affected his work. Aaron said he knew Hoffman for just over a year, and they often discussed their drug use. ‘People make choices in life, and they should be allowed to do whatever they want. And if that’s his choice, I’m really sad but I respect his choice. He was an adult. He’d been doing it a while, he knew what he was up against. Nobody killed him. If you’re looking for the person who killed him, you know who it was. Him. Nobody else. It’s really sad, though. And more horrible is the way he’s portrayed in death. Who needs that?’ While NYPD sources claimed Aaron supplied drugs to Hoffman, the actor was not mentioned in Aaron’s official indictment. Last month, a judge denied Aaron’s request for treatment instead of jail time.

I et intervju med The New York Times sa Aaron at en ‘heksejakt’ pågår fordi myndighetene er under press for å rettsforfølge noen i forbindelse med Hoffmans død i begynnelsen av februar. Aaron, en multiinstrumentalist som har opptrådt med artister som David Bowie og Wyclef Jean, beskrev seg selv som ‘uheldig’ som har blitt utpekt av politiet. Under sin rettshøring i New York 5. februar 2014—tre dager etter at Hoffman ble funnet død i sitt hjem i West Village—ble Aaron tiltalt for besittelse og distribusjon av heroin. Kanadiskfødte Aaron kan risikere opptil 25 års fengsel hvis han blir dømt. Artikkelen påpekte Aarons kamp mot rus, idet han beskrev et av-og-på-forhold til narkotika over nesten 40 år. Aaron uttalte at han ikke vil be om unnskyldning for sitt rusbruk, og hevdet at det ikke har skadet andre. Han forklarte: ‘Ærlig talt, jeg tror ingen jeg kjenner romantiserte det så mye som de likte det. Det har sine gode sider.’ Aaron ble arrestert i sin leilighet på Manhattan to netter etter Hoffmans død, etter at politiet fant nesten 300 poser med heroin. Aaron sa at det meste var til eget bruk, og forklarte at han identifiserer seg som narkotikamisbruker. ‘Ofte har du en tidsfrist og må jobbe i 24 timer. Dette lar deg gjøre det uten smerte, uten trøtthet… Hvis jeg må skrive en bok, få meg høy — jeg har boka ferdig på to uker. Du er klar i hodet. Og følelser påvirker deg ikke så mye — sinnet ditt — det kapsler inn følelsene dine. Det får deg til å føle deg mer rasjonell, eller du tror det i alle fall. Du sover fantastisk. Jeg har vært søvnløs hele livet,’ forklarte Aaron. Aaron nektet for å være dealer for Hoffman, selv om han innrømmet å ha solgt narkotika til venner av og til, og sa: ‘Jeg var min egen beste kunde. Jeg pleier å si, en ape kan ikke selge bananer.’ Venner beskrev Aaron som en profesjonell utøver og insisterte på at rusvanene hans ikke hadde påvirket jobben hans. Aaron sa at han hadde kjent Hoffman i litt over ett år, og at de ofte snakket om rusbruk. ‘Folk tar valg i livet, og de bør få lov til å gjøre hva de vil. Og hvis det var hans valg, er jeg veldig lei meg, men jeg respekterer det. Han var voksen. Han hadde gjort det en stund, han visste hva han gikk til. Ingen drepte ham. Hvis du vil vite hvem som drepte ham, så vet du hvem det var. Han. Ingen andre. Det er veldig trist. Enda verre er hvordan han blir fremstilt i døden. Hvem trenger det?’ Selv om NYPD hevdet at Aaron leverte narkotika til Hoffman, er ikke skuespilleren nevnt i Aarons formelle tiltale. Forrige måned avslo en dommer Aarons anmodning om behandling i stedet for fengsel.

A 2008 study found that 17 out of every 1,000 women of childbearing age in the UK had an abortion. Across Europe, nearly one in three pregnancies ends in abortion, according to international research led by Dr. Gilda Sedgh of the Guttmacher Institute in the United States. Revealed in The Lancet medical journal, the study observes that global abortion rates, after years of decline, plateaued by 2008. At the same time, the proportion of unsafe abortions—those performed by unqualified providers or in inadequate medical settings—rose from 44% in 1995 to 49% in 2008.

Between 1995 and 2003, the global abortion rate fell from 35 to 29 per 1,000 women of reproductive age (15 to 44 years). However, in 2008, it remained almost unchanged at 28 per 1,000.

There are significant regional differences. In 2008, Eastern Europe had an abortion rate of 43 per 1,000 women, compared to 12 per 1,000 in Western Europe and 17 per 1,000 in Northern Europe, which includes the UK and Scandinavia. North America also had 17 abortions per 1,000 women. In Europe, about 30% of pregnancies end in abortion, but the rate is notably higher in Eastern Europe.

The study emphasizes concerns about a lack of progress in reducing abortion rates and a worrying increase in unsafe procedures in developing countries. Dr. Sedgh notes that this trend aligns with a slowdown in contraceptive use and stresses the need for greater investment in quality family planning services to reverse it.

Despite the stable abortion rate, the number of abortions increased from 41.6 million in 2003 to 43.8 million in 2008, which researchers attribute to global population growth. Latin America recorded the highest regional abortion rate in 2008 (32 per 1,000 women), with Africa and Asia following at 29 and 28 per 1,000, respectively.

The findings reveal strong links between abortion rates and both access to effective contraception and abortion laws. Dr. Sedgh explains, 'Abortion rates are clearly lower in places where abortion laws are more liberal,' with Africa and Latin America as examples of regions with restrictive laws and high rates. She also warns that family planning services worldwide are not meeting increased demands due to desires for smaller families and more control over birth timing. An estimated 215 million women in developing countries still lack access to needed contraceptives.

On the other hand, John Smeaton, Director of the Society for the Protection of Unborn Children, argues that stricter abortion laws are linked to lower maternal mortality, citing Ireland's strong maternal health outcomes despite a ban on abortion, and asserting that legalizing abortion does not improve medical care.

Ofgem, the UK's energy watchdog, has announced new proposals to simplify the confusing array of energy tariffs available to consumers. The plan stops short of Prime Minister David Cameron's earlier promise to require companies by law to place customers on the cheapest available deal. Instead, energy suppliers would be obliged to inform customers about the best deals on offer, even if those deals are provided by a rival. Ofgem also wants to reduce the number of tariffs each supplier offers from the current 558 to just four, aiming to address rising energy bills, which now average £1,300 per year for dual-fuel users.

A Downing Street spokesperson sought to minimize the difference between Ofgem's proposals and the Prime Minister's earlier statements, emphasizing that both approaches aim to simplify bills and benefit consumers. They stated that forthcoming legislation would take Ofgem's proposals into account.

Ian Marlee, Ofgem's communications director, commented that competition remains the best way to protect consumers. However, Joe Malinowski, from price comparison site TheEnergyShop.com, warned that while some customers stand to benefit, others may see their bills increase if everyone is moved to a standard tariff. Currently, about one in four customers shop around and can save up to £190 per year. According to Malinowski, those who actively seek deals might see their bills rise by just over £100, while most on standard tariffs could see a decrease of £34.

Major energy companies were reportedly confused by the regulator’s plan. Angela Knight, CEO of Energy UK, said further details were needed before companies could properly respond but confirmed that suppliers would work with Ofgem to act in customers' best interests. The government’s announcement also appeared to catch some ministers off guard, with Energy Secretary Ed Davey distancing himself from Cameron's initial proposal. Nevertheless, Davey welcomed Ofgem's plan, calling it a significant step forward in reforming the energy market.

article_content: India has, for the first time, surpassed Mainland China to become the most represented country in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024, marking a significant milestone for its higher education sector. According to Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), this year’s edition lists 148 Indian universities, followed by 133 from China and 96 from Japan. The Indian Institutes of Technology—Bombay, Delhi, and Madras—lead the pack at positions 40, 46, and 53 in Asia respectively. IISc Bangalore and IIT-Kharagpur fill out the national top five. QS experts credit India’s ascent to the strong academic credentials and research productivity of its university staff. Indian faculties have a higher than average proportion of PhDs and a robust output in terms of research papers per faculty member. Nonetheless, Indian institutions currently fall short in ‘Academic Reputation’ and ‘Employer Reputation’ categories, and their citation counts per paper remain lower than the regional norm. Publishing in English provides Indian universities with a global platform, unlike some Chinese institutions that publish in Mandarin, which limits wider accessibility. This linguistic advantage aids in expanding India’s global research reach. Despite these achievements, Indian universities need to boost their performance in internationalisation—by attracting more overseas students and staff and forging global partnerships. Student mobility is also notable: for the first time in 15 years, more Indian than Chinese students are heading to the US for higher studies. On the Asian university leader board, Peking University claims the top spot, with the University of Hong Kong and the National University of Singapore coming second and third. In other related business news, the Tata Group’s takeover of Wistron’s manufacturing facilities marks it as the first Indian company to assemble iPhones, while corporate governance issues are highlighted in the Religare-Burman takeover dispute.

Indian Institutes of Technology—Bombay, Delhi og Madras—leder an med henholdsvis plasseringene 40, 46 og 53 blant asiatiske universiteter. Indiske læresteder har en større andel doktorgrader og flere forskningsartikler per ansatt enn snittet i regionen. Samtidig scorer indiske universiteter lavere på ‘Academic Reputation’ og ‘Employer Reputation’, og har færre siteringer per artikkel enn snittet. Publisering på engelsk gjør indisk forskning mer tilgjengelig internasjonalt, i motsetning til kinesiske institusjoner som i større grad publiserer på mandarin—noe som kan begrense rekkevidden. Dette gir India en fordel når det gjelder global synlighet. Selv med fremgangen peker QS på behovet for at indiske universiteter forbedrer internasjonaliseringen, inkludert tiltrekning av internasjonale studenter, ansatte og samarbeid. Et annet trend er økende studentmobilitet: For første gang på 15 år reiser flere indiske enn kinesiske studenter til USA for høyere utdanning. Peking University topper listen over asiatiske universiteter, etterfulgt av University of Hong Kong og National University of Singapore. Andre relevante nyheter: Tata Groups kjøp av Wistrons fabrikk gjør dem til første indiske iPhone-produsent, samt styringskonflikter i forbindelse med Burman-familiens planlagte oppkjøp av Religare Enterprises.

article_content: The Nnamdi Azikiwe Stadium in Enugu, known as 'The Cathedral', will be in the spotlight on Sunday as Enugu Rangers take on Heartland in a Nigeria Premier Football League (NPFL) matchday seven encounter. This fixture is renowned as the oldest oriental derby in the league, with both teams sharing 12 league titles. Both teams are eager for victory to gain bragging rights. Heartland, known as the Naze Millionaires, have struggled to find form since being promoted unbeaten last season, and they currently sit at the bottom of the table with just four points and no wins. Heartland are the only NPFL team yet to register a victory this season, and have not beaten Rangers at home in their last 10 meetings—their last win against Rangers was in 2016. Rangers boast a perfect home record this season, so Heartland may have to wait longer for their first win. The Flying Antelopes (Enugu Rangers) will also look to secure their first clean sheet, having conceded eight goals—the highest among the top three teams—even as they lead in goals scored with 11. Elsewhere, Akwa United are hoping to earn a second consecutive win as they host Plateau United in Eket after a recent narrow victory over Gombe United. This match will test Fatai Osho and his squad's progress after a challenging start to the season. Remo Stars, who have been impressive on the road, will visit Bendel Insurance, who drew their last match against Akwa United. Last season, Bendel Insurance earned four points from two matches against Remo Stars, but Remo eventually got their revenge in the Super Six championship. Other NPFL fixtures this weekend include Shooting Stars hosting Niger Tornadoes, Abia Warriors facing Katsina United, Enyimba up against Kwara United, and Rivers United taking on Sunshine Stars. Meanwhile, Gombe United will meet Doma United for their first top-flight northern derby clash. A notable trend between some teams, such as Akwa United and Plateau United, is a low total goal tally in their previous 14 matches, with only 28 goals scored.

Dette oppgjøret er kjent som det eldste orientalske derbyet i ligaen, med totalt 12 ligatitler mellom lagene. Begge lag ønsker å vinne for å sikre seg skryterettigheter. Heartland, også kalt Naze Millionaires, har slitt etter opprykket uten tap i fjor, og ligger nå sist på tabellen med kun fire poeng og ingen seire. Heartland er det eneste laget i NPFL uten seier denne sesongen, og har ikke vunnet mot Rangers på hjemmebane på de siste 10 møtene—sist seier over Rangers var i 2016. Rangers har en perfekt hjemmebane-statistikk i år, så Heartland må trolig vente fortsatt på sin første seier. Flying Antelopes (Enugu Rangers) vil også forsøke å holde nullen for første gang, etter å ha sluppet inn åtte mål—flest av topp-tre lagene—samtidig som de har scoret flest mål, 11. Ellers håper Akwa United å sikre seg sin andre seier på rad når de tar imot Plateau United i Eket etter en knepen seier over Gombe United. Dette blir en test for Fatai Osho og laget etter en vanskelig sesongstart. Remo Stars, som har imponert på bortebane, møter Bendel Insurance, som spilte uavgjort sist mot Akwa United. Forrige sesong tok Bendel Insurance fire poeng over to oppgjør mot Remo Stars, men Remo fikk revansj i Super Six-mesterskapet. Andre NPFL-kamper denne helgen: Shooting Stars tar imot Niger Tornadoes, Abia Warriors møter Katsina United, Enyimba spiller mot Kwara United, og Rivers United tar imot Sunshine Stars. Samtidig skal Gombe United møte Doma United til sin første nord-derby i toppdivisjonen. En trend mellom lag som Akwa United og Plateau United er få mål; kun 28 mål totalt på de siste 14 oppgjørene.

A powerful earthquake with a magnitude of 6.8 struck Sarangani in the Philippine province of Davao Occidental on Friday afternoon, sending shockwaves through Davao City and surrounding areas. The quake's impact extended through various parts of the Davao region and neighboring areas, resulting in several incidents. Notably, the seismic activity caused a crane to topple from a multi-story building under construction in Barangay Gravahan, New Matina, Davao City.

A short video of the incident posted on Facebook received many concerned comments from netizens, including messages such as "Praying for your safety" and "Keep safe everyone!" The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) initially reported the earthquake's magnitude as 7.2 before revising it to 6.8 in an updated bulletin at 5:40 pm. The epicenter was recorded 34 kilometers northwest of Sarangani Island or Sarangani town in Davao Occidental, at a depth of 72 kilometers, and was attributed to tectonic activity.

Earlier in the day, classes were suspended in both public and private schools, and government offices implemented work-from-home arrangements due to anticipated severe weather, including heavy rain and thunderstorms. However, the city was caught off guard when the earthquake struck at 4:14 pm, affecting numerous parts of the region. Local authorities have launched ongoing rescue and relief operations to assess the situation and provide assistance.

Skjelvet påvirket flere deler av Davao-regionen og områdene rundt, og førte til flere hendelser. Spesielt fikk de seismiske rystelsene en kran til å velte fra et fleretasje-bygg under oppføring i Barangay Gravahan, New Matina, Davao City.

En kort video av hendelsen lagt ut på Facebook fikk mange bekymrede kommentarer fra nettbrukere, med meldinger som «Ber for deres sikkerhet» og «Ta vare på dere!». Det filippinske instituttet for vulkanologi og seismologi (Phivolcs) rapporterte først at jordskjelvet hadde en styrke på 7,2, men reviderte dette til 6,8 i en oppdatert kunngjøring kl. 17:40. Episenteret ble registrert 34 kilometer nordvest for Sarangani-øya eller -byen i Davao Occidental, på 72 kilometers dybde, og skjelvet skyldtes tektonisk aktivitet.

Tidligere på dagen ble undervisning avlyst på både offentlige og private skoler, og myndighetskontorer innførte hjemmekontor på grunn av varslet ekstremvær, inkludert kraftig regn og tordenvær. Byen ble imidlertid overrasket da jordskjelvet inntraff kl. 16:14 og påvirket store deler av regionen. Lokale myndigheter har igangsatt rednings- og hjelpeaksjoner for å vurdere situasjonen og bistå der det trengs.

article_content: A devastating incident struck the Maccalube nature reserve in southern Sicily when a mud geyser suddenly erupted. During the event, a seven-year-old girl tragically lost her life and her nine-year-old brother remains unaccounted for. The siblings were out walking with their father—who works as a police officer—celebrating the boy’s birthday. While the father was not physically harmed, search efforts failed to locate his missing son, though his daughter's body was recovered soon after the eruption on Saturday. The Maccalube reserve is famous for its unusual terrain filled with mud geysers that occasionally and unpredictably burst forth from the ground. After heightened below-ground activity, the park had briefly shut down earlier in August, as reported by the media. Geysers, which are hot springs that intermittently shoot water or mud skyward, are considered among Earth's rarest natural features, requiring a special combination of geothermal heat and groundwater. Only about 1,000 active geysers exist across the globe, concentrated in places like Yellowstone in the USA, the Valley of Geysers in Russia, El Tatio in Chile, New Zealand’s Taupo area, and various sites in Iceland. Because these natural eruptions are so rare, accidents such as the one in Sicily are exceptionally unusual, adding to the sorrow surrounding this event.
translated_content: En tragisk hendelse rammet naturreservatet Maccalube i det sørlige Sicilia da en gjørmegeysir plutselig fikk utbrudd. Under hendelsen mistet en sju år gammel jente livet, mens hennes ni år gamle bror fortsatt er savnet. Søsknene var ute og gikk sammen med faren sin – en politimann – for å feire guttens bursdag. Faren kom uskadd fra hendelsen, men redningsmannskaper har ikke klart å finne sønnen, mens datterens kropp ble funnet kort tid etter utbruddet lørdag. Maccalube-reservatet er kjent for sitt unike landskap med gjørmegeysirer som av og til og uforutsigbart bryter gjennom bakken. Etter økt underjordisk aktivitet var parken kortvarig stengt tidligere i august, ifølge medieoppslag. Geysirer, som er varme kilder som av og til skyter vann eller gjørme til værs, regnes som noen av jordens sjeldneste naturfenomener og krever en spesiell kombinasjon av geotermisk varme og grunnvann. Det finnes bare rundt 1 000 aktive geysirer i verden, konsentrert på steder som Yellowstone i USA, Geysir-dalen i Russland, El Tatio i Chile, Taupo-området i New Zealand og ulike steder på Island. Fordi slike naturutbrudd er så sjeldne, er ulykker som den på Sicilia ekstremt uvanlige, noe som gjør hendelsen spesielt trist.

Former Chairman of Nigeria’s Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), Ibrahim Magu, has reiterated that fighting corruption in Nigeria is a challenging task. Magu, who was suspended in 2020 by then-President Muhammadu Buhari and investigated by a panel led by retired Justice Ayo Salami, spoke on Saturday after being conferred as a doctoral fellow by the Institute for Governance and Leadership Studies in Africa at the African University of Science & Technology, Abuja.

Magu described the recognition as an honor not just for himself, but as a testament to the collective efforts of dedicated EFCC staff and stakeholders striving to combat corruption. ‘With the benefit of hindsight and having led the foremost anti-graft agency in Nigeria, I can state that fighting corruption is not an easy task. It is a patriotic and selfless duty to one’s country, given how pervasive corruption is. To confront this issue, everyone must contribute,’ Magu stated.

He stressed that the battle against corruption must remain vigorous, calling it the main obstacle to Nigeria’s national progress. Magu argued that corruption is responsible for the lack of adequate dividends from democracy, and urged the government to persist: ‘A corruption-free nation is the bedrock of sustainable economic growth and positive development.’

He also commended President Bola Tinubu for his ‘informed and dynamic leadership’ and for the Renewed Hope Agenda guiding his administration.

Magu, som ble suspendert i 2020 av daværende president Muhammadu Buhari og ble gransket av en komité ledet av pensjonert dommer Ayo Salami, uttalte seg lørdag etter å ha blitt tildelt et doktorstipendiat fra Institute for Governance and Leadership Studies in Africa ved African University of Science & Technology i Abuja.

Magu beskrev denne anerkjennelsen som en ære, ikke bare for seg selv, men som et bevis på den kollektive innsatsen til engasjerte EFCC-ansatte og andre aktører i kampen mot korrupsjon. ‘Med tiden og erfaringen som leder av landets fremste antikorrupsjonsbyrå kan jeg si at det ikke er enkelt å bekjempe korrupsjon. Det er en patriotisk og uselvisk tjeneste for fedrelandet, spesielt siden korrupsjon er så utbredt. For å møte denne utfordringen må alle bidra,’ uttalte Magu.

Han understreket at kampen mot korrupsjon må føres energisk og kalte det den største hindringen for Nigerias framgang. Magu mente korrupsjon er grunnen til manglende demokratiske fordeler og oppfordret myndighetene til å fortsette innsatsen: ‘Et korrupsjonsfritt land er grunnlaget for bærekraftig økonomisk vekst og positiv utvikling.’

Han ga også ros til president Bola Tinubu for hans ‘kunnskapsrike og dynamiske lederskap’ og for den Fornyet Håp-agendaen som styrer hans administrasjon.

article_content: Sophie King, a 26-year-old primary school teacher from Newquay, Cornwall, documented her impressive body transformation after losing four stone in just 100 days. Once an active person, Sophie stopped participating in sports after a series of illnesses, which caused her weight to rise to 14 stone. Determined to regain control, Sophie devised her own 100-day plan focused on healthy, balanced meals and daily exercise, consciously avoiding supplements and diet pills. She closely tracked her journey on her blog, sharing photos of her meals and workouts. Her honest posts attracted over 10,000 followers. Sophie faced multiple health setbacks, including a broken ankle at 17, glandular fever during university, and a nine-month struggle with a painful leg abscess. After moving to Cornwall to pursue a healthier lifestyle, she completed her '100 Healthy Days' challenge, inspired by the '100 Happy Days' trend, and saw her weight drop dramatically to a size 10. Reflecting on her journey, Sophie shared, 'I broke my ankle at 17 and had pins inserted. I used to play sports, but that incident marked the beginning of my weight gain. At university, I was quite unhealthy and developed glandular fever. The prolonged abscess was a real wake-up call.' 'I moved to Cornwall to enjoy the outdoors and become healthier. This challenge was a way for me to hold myself accountable and share my progress with others.' Her blog showcased her daily meals and outdoor workouts in Cornwall. 'So much has changed in just 100 days. It might not sound like long, but you can accomplish a lot in that time. I feel fitter, healthier, and far more confident now.' Sophie has continued her blog beyond the 100 days, encouraged by supportive feedback from her followers. She's also using her passion for fitness to support the RNLI by participating in events like the Big Swim Cornwall and Castle2Castle Swim. 'The blog was about honesty and sharing everything about diet and fitness. Moving forward, I want to focus more on well-being and maintaining a healthy mindset and spirit,' she said. 'I've received so much positive feedback, and people have asked me to keep going, so I don't plan to stop. The challenge taught me the importance of balance—while exercise is important, so is a happy, well-rounded life.' 'Swimming in the sea used to scare me, but setting challenges helped me overcome that fear. Now I swim regularly and even ran 10k recently, something I hadn't done in 10 years. Next up is a triathlon. It's amazing what small steps each day can achieve—in 100 days, you can become a whole new you.'
translated_content: Sophie King, en 26 år gammel barneskolelærer fra Newquay i Cornwall, dokumenterte sin imponerende kroppsendring etter å ha gått ned fire steiner på bare 100 dager. Sophie var tidligere veldig aktiv, men sluttet med idrett etter flere sykdommer, noe som førte til at vekten hennes økte til 14 steiner. Fast bestemt på å ta kontroll, lagde Sophie sin egen 100-dagers plan med fokus på sunne, balanserte måltider og daglig trening. Hun holdt seg bevisst unna kosttilskudd og slankepiller. På bloggen sin delte hun bilder av måltidene og treningen, og fikk over 10 000 følgere. Sophie opplevde flere helseproblemer, blant annet en brukket ankel da hun var 17, kyssesyke på universitetet og en ni måneder lang kamp mot en smertefull byll på beinet. Etter å ha flyttet til Cornwall for å få en sunnere livsstil, fullførte hun sin «100 Sunne Dager»-utfordring, inspirert av trenden «100 Happy Days», og gikk ned til størrelse 38. Sophie fortalte: 'Jeg brakk ankelen da jeg var 17 og fikk satt inn pinner. Jeg drev med idrett før, men det var starten på vektoppgangen. På universitetet levde jeg ganske usunt og fikk kyssesyken. Den lange perioden med byll var en virkelig vekker.' 'Jeg flyttet til Cornwall for å være mer ute i naturen og bli sunnere. Denne utfordringen hjalp meg å holde meg ansvarlig og dele fremgangen min med andre.' Bloggen hennes viste frem daglige måltider og utetrening i Cornwall. 'Så mye har endret seg på bare 100 dager. Det føles ikke så lenge, men du kan oppnå utrolig mye på den tiden. Nå er jeg i mye bedre form, sunnere og har fått mye mer selvtillit.' Sophie har fortsatt å blogge etter de 100 dagene, motivert av støtten fra følgerne. Hun bruker også treningsgleden til å samle inn penger til RNLI, blant annet gjennom Big Swim Cornwall og Castle2Castle Swim. 'Bloggen handlet om å være ærlig og dele alt om kosthold og trening. Nå vil jeg fokusere mer på velvære, et sunt sinn og et godt liv,' sier hun. 'Jeg har fått så mye positiv tilbakemelding fra folk, så jeg har ingen planer om å stoppe. Utfordringen lærte meg hvor viktig balanse er—trening er viktig, men det er lykke og livsglede også.' 'Havet var en stor frykt for meg før, men utfordringer hjalp meg å overvinne det. Nå svømmer jeg ofte og har til og med løpt 10 kilometer, noe jeg ikke hadde gjort på ti år. Nå prøver jeg meg på triatlon. Små steg hver dag gir store endringer—på 100 dager kan du skape en helt ny versjon av deg selv.'
post_content: Sophie King went from 14 to 10 stone in just 100 days by eating healthy and working out daily – and shared it all on her blog! Her story proves big change is possible with small daily steps. #100HealthyDays #Transformation #Inspiration

article_content: Former First Lady Rosalynn Carter, wife of former President Jimmy Carter and a dedicated advocate for mental health care, died peacefully at home on Sunday at the age of 96, according to the Carter Center. Jimmy Carter described Rosalynn as his equal partner in all his achievements, crediting her with wisdom and steadfast support. She is survived by her four children—Jack, Chip, Jeff, and Amy—plus 11 grandchildren and 14 great-grandchildren. Her son, Chip Carter, said his mother was not only a loving parent and exceptional First Lady but also a devoted humanitarian whose service benefited many, especially in the field of mental health. Rosalynn Carter entered hospice care at her home last week, six months after a dementia diagnosis, the Carter Center reported. Jimmy Carter has also been receiving hospice care at home since earlier that year. Throughout her life, Rosalynn Carter became a leading voice for mental health advocacy, working from the Georgia Governor's Mansion to the White House and The Carter Center to improve mental health care and reduce stigma. She served as First Lady of the United States during Jimmy Carter’s presidency from 1977 to 1981, taking on important roles such as diplomatic envoy and advisor. Rosalynn Carter raised four children and had a large extended family. In 1982, after Jimmy Carter lost his reelection bid, the Carters founded The Carter Center to advance human rights and alleviate suffering. Born Eleanor Rosalynn Smith in Plains, Georgia, on August 18, 1927, she was the eldest of four siblings. After her father died when she was 13, Rosalynn helped care for her family while excelling at school. Her friendship with Ruth Carter eventually led to her marriage to Jimmy Carter. They wed in 1946 soon after Rosalynn graduated from college. Due to Jimmy Carter's Navy career, the family moved often, and Rosalynn grew independent while caring for their children. After the death of Jimmy Carter’s father in 1953, the Carters returned to Plains to manage the family peanut farm, where Rosalynn managed the finances. Jimmy Carter entered politics in 1962, later becoming Georgia's governor. Rosalynn contributed as First Lady by managing the mansion and supporting mental health initiatives. Rosalynn took an active role in Jimmy Carter’s presidential campaign, and in the White House, attended Cabinet and National Security Council meetings. Her diplomacy included international trips, and she was involved in key events like the Camp David Accords. During the 1980 presidential campaign, she campaigned for her husband while he addressed the Iran Hostage Crisis. After leaving the White House in 1981, Rosalynn Carter continued her advocacy, publishing books and co-authoring works with her husband. The Carter Center has promoted peace, improved health, and advanced human rights worldwide, leading disease eradication programs and supporting Habitat for Humanity. Rosalynn led the Carter Center’s Mental Health Task Force, held a yearly mental health policy symposium, and collaborated with Michelle Obama to improve PTSD treatment for veterans. Rosalynn and Jimmy Carter have reflected on their long marriage and meaningful service, sharing that their life together was an adventure filled with purpose.
