article_content: China has surpassed the United States as home to the world's fastest supercomputer. The new machine, called Tianhe-1A, was unveiled on Wednesday at a conference in Beijing. Tianhe-1A is capable of performing calculations faster than the previous record holder, the Cray XT5 Jaguar supercomputer housed at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in Tennessee. Tianhe-1A set a new performance benchmark by processing data at 2.507 petaflops, significantly outpacing the Cray XT5 Jaguar's 1.75 petaflops. Analysts say this achievement highlights China's rising status as a leader in global technology. According to Nvidia, the computer technology company, Tianhe-1A will operate as an open-access system for large-scale scientific computations. Supercomputers, which are essentially networks of many computers, can fill entire rooms or even small warehouses. They are commonly used for processing vast amounts of scientific data, such as the climate models run in U.S. national laboratories.

Tianhe-1A kan utføre beregninger raskere enn den forrige rekordholderen, superdatamaskinen Cray XT5 Jaguar ved Oak Ridge National Laboratory i Tennessee. Tianhe-1A satte en ny ytelsesrekord ved å prosessere data med 2,507 petaflops, noe som klart overgår Cray XT5 Jaguars 1,75 petaflops. Analytikere mener denne prestasjonen understreker Kinas økende posisjon som global teknologileder. Ifølge Nvidia, teknologiselskapet, skal Tianhe-1A fungere som et åpent system for storskala vitenskapelige beregninger. Superdatamaskiner, som i praksis er nettverk av mange koblede datamaskiner, kan fylle hele rom eller til og med små lagerbygninger. De brukes ofte til å håndtere enorme mengder vitenskapelige data, som for eksempel klimamodeller fra amerikanske nasjonale laboratorier.

article_content: Germany coach Joachim Löw has named newcomer Karim Bellarabi in the squad for the upcoming European Championship qualifiers against Poland and Ireland. Bellarabi, an attacking midfielder for Bayer Leverkusen, was born in Berlin and was also eligible to play for Morocco. He is enjoying a standout season, catching attention when he scored the fastest goal in Bundesliga history—just nine seconds into a 2-0 win over Borussia Dortmund in the opening match of the season. Löw has included 16 players from the squad that won the World Cup in Brazil. Regarding Bellarabi's first call-up, Löw said, 'Karim Bellarabi has earned the opportunity through outstanding performances for his club. He is incredibly strong in one-on-one situations and is a great attacking option for us.' Defender Mats Hummels returns after missing the opening European qualifier (a 2-1 win over Scotland) due to injury. However, key players Bastian Schweinsteiger, Sami Khedira, Benedikt Höwedes, Marco Reus, and Mario Gomez are all sidelined with injuries. Kevin Grosskreutz has been left out of the 20-man squad. Arsenal's Mesut Özil and Lukas Podolski are included in the squad. Goalkeeper Manuel Neuer, who lifted the World Cup trophy after Germany’s victory over Argentina in 2014, is also part of the team. article_content: Frankfurt: Hamburg Airport remained closed on Sunday as authorities managed an ongoing hostage situation, which police believe is connected to a custody dispute. The airport suspended all takeoffs and landings on Saturday evening after a man drove through a barrier onto the airport grounds with a child in his car. According to police, the 35-year-old man and a 4-year-old girl were parked under an aircraft. On Sunday, police stated on social media platform X: 'The operation continues. Our negotiators are in contact with the person in the car.' Negotiations were being conducted in Turkish with the help of a translator, a police spokesperson said. Police reported that the child’s mother informed them the father had been in touch with her. Authorities have not confirmed earlier statements that the man was armed or had fired shots. Airport officials reported that 286 flights, affecting approximately 34,500 passengers, were scheduled for Sunday.

article_content: Bray Studios, once the hub for iconic Hammer Horror films, may soon be replaced by luxury housing. The studio’s owner cites a lack of feasibility for continued film production and plans to construct up to seven executive homes on the site. This proposal has drawn strong opposition from notable industry figures such as director Terry Gilliam and Richard O’Brien, creator and star of ‘The Rocky Horror Picture Show,’ who are backing a campaign to preserve the studios. Critics argue that the decline of Bray Studios is due to neglect from owner Neville Hendricks. Supporters have launched a Facebook group and an online petition to save this historic studio. Famous for a 15-year association with Hammer Films, Bray Studios was the backdrop for horror classics starring Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing, including 'The Curse Of Frankenstein' (1957) and 'Dracula: Prince Of Darkness' (1966). The studio, established on a 16th-century estate near Windsor, also contributed to the ‘Hammer House Of Horror’ TV series. Simon Oakes, CEO of Hammer Films (now at Ealing Studios), highlighted Bray’s significance in Hammer’s legacy but acknowledged that the facilities had become dilapidated in recent years. Although campaigners continue to resist, the plans for redevelopment received local government approval last summer, and demolition could begin soon. Neville Hendricks has not commented on the situation.

Planen har møtt sterk motstand fra kjente personer i filmbransjen, som regissør Terry Gilliam og Richard O'Brien, skaper og stjerne i ‘The Rocky Horror Picture Show’, som begge støtter en kampanje for å bevare studioet. article_content: The Norse god of thunder, Thor, makes his first big-screen appearance in Marvel's latest film, the first of three slated for release this summer. The outlook is promising for future installments, but director Kenneth Branagh does struggle a bit with setting up the backstory. If you’re unfamiliar with Norse mythology, Thor is known for his mighty hammer and quick temper. In Stan Lee’s Marvel take, Thor's father, Odin, disciplines him by sending him to Earth as Dr. Donald Blake, a physician who transforms to defend humanity. The movie blends these aspects into a new vision of the character. The film alternates between Thor's exile after crash-landing in New Mexico—where he's immediately run over by Jane Foster, an astrophysicist played by Natalie Portman—and the celestial realm of Asgard. There, Thor must face his half-brother Loki (Tom Hiddleston) and the Ice Giants in a quest to earn his father Odin's (Anthony Hopkins) approval. Hopkins delivers a performance with gravitas, donning eyepatches and elaborate helmets. Asgard is depicted as a stunning, CG metropolis—a blend of a Vegas suite and a Disney palace, complete with golden details and spectacular cosmic vistas. A massive waterfall empties into space, and a cosmic bridge allows gods to visit the nine realms, including Earth. While the special effects impress, the dialogue aims for mythic gravitas but sometimes lands awkwardly between epic drama and superhero flair. This might be why Marvel chose Branagh, famed for Shakespeare on screen. His dramatic camera angles and boisterous direction are on full display, especially during the busy opening act. The movie finds firmer footing during the Earth scenes. The mood shifts to something more relaxed and comedic as Jane and her team (Kat Dennings, Stellan Skarsgard) debate whether Thor is delusional or something special. Deprived of his hammer Mjolnir, Thor navigates his new life on Earth with a mix of determination and humor. Chris Hemsworth brings a youthful, eager energy to Thor. While not the most subtle performance, it serves the film well, with his co-stars playing effectively off his presence. The fun tone often shines through. Yet much of the major plot unfolds in Asgard, with the New Mexico segments feeling secondary by comparison. Ultimately, 'Thor' lays the groundwork for 'The Avengers.' Although it sometimes lacks narrative focus, the movie delivers impressive visuals and family-friendly entertainment. Its light tone is likely to engage a broad audience, setting up more adventures for Thor to come.

Utsiktene for flere oppfølgere er lovende, men regissør Kenneth Branagh sliter litt med å introdusere bakgrunnshistorien. Dersom du ikke kjenner til norrøn mytologi, er Thor kjent for sin mektige hammer og sitt hissige temperament. I Stan Lees Marvel-versjon blir Thor straffet av faren Odin og sendt til jorden som Dr. Donald Blake, en lege som forvandler seg for å beskytte menneskeheten. Filmen kombinerer disse delene til en ny versjon av figuren. Filmen veksler mellom Thors eksil etter at han har krasjlandet i New Mexico—hvor han straks blir påkjørt av Jane Foster, en astrofysiker spilt av Natalie Portman—og den kosmiske verdenen Asgard. Der kjemper Thor mot halvbroren Loke (Tom Hiddleston) og Iskjempene for å vinne respekt fra faren Odin (Anthony Hopkins). Hopkins leverer en rolle med tyngde, iført øyelapp og forseggjorte hjelmer. Asgard er vist som en imponerende digital metropol—en blanding av et Vegas-luksusrom og et Disney-slott, med gullfargede detaljer og spektakulær utsikt over universet. En diger foss renner ut i rommet, og en magisk bro lar gudene besøke de ni riker, inkludert jorden. Mens spesialeffektene imponerer, prøver dialogen å være storslått, men lander noen ganger mellom episk drama og superhelt-sjargong. Dette kan ha vært årsaken til at Marvel valgte Branagh, kjent for sine Shakespeare-filmer. Hans markante kameravinkler og energiske regi merkes spesielt i filmens travle åpning. Filmen fungerer bedre i scenene på jorden. Stemningen blir mer avslappet og morsom når Jane og kollegene hennes (Kat Dennings og Stellan Skarsgård) diskuterer om Thor er gal eller noe utenom det vanlige. Likevel skjer mesteparten av handlingen i Asgard, og New Mexico-delen oppleves som et sideinnslag. Alt i alt legger 'Thor' grunnlaget for 'The Avengers'. Selv om filmen til tider mangler fortellerfokus, byr den på imponerende visuelle effekter og underholdning for hele familien. Den lette stemningen vil trolig fenge mange og lover flere Thor-opplevelser i årene som kommer.

article_content: In the growing world of eCommerce, marketing is not just an option—it is a vital element that can significantly boost growth and sales. A well-planned and executed marketing strategy can set your online store apart, attracting customers and increasing revenue. Today, using plugins and platforms to streamline and strengthen marketing efforts is crucial for any eCommerce business. These tools, both free and premium, help target, reach, and convert potential customers more efficiently. This article explores some of the best eCommerce marketing plugins and platforms available in 2023. While there are many free tools, leading eCommerce stores often choose to invest in powerful plugins. Important note: some products mentioned here are developed by me and my co-founders, but recommendations are based on real demand and user needs, not just personal interest. A decade ago, there was a noticeable lack of tools for lead generation and email marketing. We addressed this gap by building top-quality products, some of which are discussed below. Lead generation is key: Most people don’t buy right away when they land on a product page. For eCommerce sites, using an opt-in popup form—like OptinMonster—can help capture leads exactly when someone is about to leave. OptinMonster is designed for small businesses, offering advanced lead capture functions once reserved for large companies. Social proof is crucial: Customers are influenced by what others do. Plugins like TrustPulse help display real-time notifications (e.g., 'Eileen from NYC bought this product') to boost confidence and create a sense of urgency (FOMO) with features like timers or low-stock alerts. Personalization matters: Understanding customers’ histories and preferences helps you tailor offers more effectively. Using a CRM tool like HubSpot provides key insights, enabling personalized marketing campaigns and offer tracking. HubSpot’s plugin also integrates seamlessly with WordPress. Funnel conversion: Moving a customer from awareness to purchase is essential for sales growth. FunnelKit is a user-friendly funnel builder that offers ready-made templates, upsells, thank you pages, and clear performance dashboards—no coding needed. Push notifications for engagement: Email marketing can have delays, but tools like PushEngage deliver instant notifications directly to customers, keeping them informed about offers and events. It allows automated, segmented messages, helping increase retention and sales. Payment solutions: Stripe is a popular payment gateway, but it can be complex to set up. WP Simple Pay Pro is a straightforward plugin for integrating Stripe payments, subscriptions, and donations into your site, reducing friction for customers and decreasing cart abandonment. Landing pages for conversions: A strong landing page is essential to turn visitors into customers. SeedProd lets users choose from hundreds of templates, easily customizing them without design experience. SEO matters: Schema markup helps search engines understand your products, improving visibility and search ranking. AIOSEO simplifies adding schema tags, making it easier to optimize your store for search engines. Affiliate marketing: Building an in-house affiliate program can help grow your business while maintaining control and profit margins. AffiliateWP enables easy setup and management of affiliate programs with intuitive features and support. Stepping into eCommerce can feel challenging, but with the right setup and tools, success is within reach. Disse verktøyene, både gratis og betalte, gjør det lettere å målrette, nå ut til og konvertere potensielle kunder. Denne artikkelen tar for seg noen av de beste e-handelspluginene og plattformene i 2023. Selv om mange gratis verktøy finnes, velger ledende nettbutikker ofte å investere i sterke plugins. Viktig å merke seg: noen av produktene som nevnes her er utviklet av meg og mine medgründere, men anbefalingene baseres på reelle brukerbehov – ikke kun personlig interesse. For ti år siden manglet det gode verktøy for leadgenerering og e-postmarkedsføring. Vi jobbet for å fylle dette gapet ved å lage kvalitetsprodukter, hvor noen omtales nedenfor. Leadgenerering er avgjørende: De fleste kjøper ikke med en gang de lander på en produktside. For nettbutikker betyr et opt-in popup-skjema – som OptinMonster – at du kan fange opp leads akkurat idet noen er på vei ut. OptinMonster er skreddersydd for småbedrifter og tilbyr avanserte funksjoner som tidligere kun var forbeholdt større selskaper. Sosialt bevis betyr mye: Kunder påvirkes av hva andre gjør. Plugins som TrustPulse viser varsler i sanntid (f.eks. «Eileen fra NYC kjøpte dette produktet») for å gi tillit og skape FOMO (frykt for å gå glipp av noe) gjennom nedtellinger eller lagerstatus. Personalisering er viktig: Ved å forstå kundenes historikk og preferanser kan du skreddersy tilbud. Med et CRM-verktøy som HubSpot får du innsikt og kan lage personlige kampanjer og spore tilbud. Integrasjonen fungerer sømløst med WordPress. Salgstrakter (funnels): Det er avgjørende å flytte kunden fra bevissthet til kjøp. FunnelKit er brukervennlig, byr på ferdige maler, upsells, takkesider og tydelige dashbord – uten behov for koding. Push-varsler for engasjement: E-postmarkedsføring kan gi forsinkelser, men PushEngage sender varsler direkte, slik at kundene får tilbud og påminnelser i sanntid. Det gir automatisk og segmentert kommunikasjon for økt lojalitet og salg. Betalingsløsninger: Stripe er en populær betalingsløsning, men kan være krevende å integrere. WP Simple Pay Pro gjør det enkelt å få Stripe på plass for betalinger, abonnement og donasjoner – noe som senker terskelen for kjøp og reduserer frafall i handlekurven. Landingssider for konvertering: En god landingsside er sentral for å gjøre besøkende til kunder. SeedProd gir tilgang til mange maler som kan skreddersys enkelt uten at du trenger desigenerfaring. SEO er viktig: Schema-markup hjelper søkemotorer å forstå produkter og gir bedre synlighet. AIOSEO gjør det enkelt å legge til riktige tags, så butikken din er optimalisert for søk. Affiliate-markedsføring: Et eget affiliate-program gir deg vekst og mer kontroll over fortjenesten. AffiliateWP gjør det lett å sette opp og administrere affiliate-aktiviteter med brukervennlige funksjoner og god støtte. Oppstart i e-handel kan virke utfordrende, men med riktig oppsett og riktige verktøy er suksess innen rekkevidde. Plugins og plattformer i denne guiden gir deg et fleksibelt økosystem. article_content: NEW YORK – When families thank Marlo Thomas for the medical care they received at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, she graciously corrects them. 'I always say, "Well, you know, I’m not a scientist; I’m a wheelbarrow,"' says the actress, producer, and activist, known for her role in 'That Girl.' 'I take the wheelbarrow, put the money in it, and bring it to the scientists.' As St. Jude’s National Outreach Director, Thomas plays a crucial role in fundraising. This year, the St. Jude Thanks and Giving campaign celebrates its 20th anniversary and the achievement of raising $1 billion to support the hospital’s mission of providing free care to children with cancer. The campaign, which began earlier this month and runs through the holiday season, also raises awareness for the Memphis-based hospital. St. Jude was founded by Marlo’s father, the late Danny Thomas, star of 'Make Room for Daddy,' who pledged that families would never be billed for treatment, travel, housing, or food. ‘That’s an amazing promise,’ Marlo Thomas said. ‘And we’ve kept it.’ According to Fidelity Charitable’s annual report, St. Jude is the second most popular nonprofit supported by its donor-advised funds, behind Doctors Without Borders USA. Charity Navigator ranks St. Jude third among its most-followed charities, following Doctors Without Borders and the American Red Cross. Charity Navigator also awards St. Jude a rare 100% score for trustworthiness and transparency. ‘It’s a household name and they’ve built a reputation over many years,’ said Kevin Scally, chief relationship officer at Charity Navigator. 'Taking care of children with cancer and supporting their families so they never have to pay truly resonates with people.' Marlo Thomas attributes the Thanks and Giving campaign — an idea developed with her siblings, Terre and Tony — as making this success possible. In 2003, they launched the campaign to raise about $100 million annually. ‘We thought, “What about a national campaign? Nothing like that had ever been done for a charity,”’ Thomas recalled. ‘Thanksgiving was the perfect time because it's about family and togetherness, not tied to any religion. It’s my favorite holiday because it’s about food and family.’ Her sister, Terre, created the name Thanks and Giving, and together they updated their father’s approach to fundraising and awareness. 'My dad brought in stars like Frank Sinatra and Nat King Cole. Our generation brought in Robin Williams, Jennifer Aniston, Michael Strahan, Jon Hamm, and many other celebrities who have helped us.' The campaign also partners with retailers like Target, Best Buy, Williams-Sonoma, and Domino’s Pizza, who encourage customers to donate at checkout during the holidays. ‘It’s exciting because it’s a family-driven campaign. My dad would be proud that we created it together,’ Thomas said. Unlike most hospitals, which rely on payments from patients and insurance, St. Jude covers around 80% of its treatment costs with donations — approximately $2 billion each year. Thomas believes that the generosity of the American public is a key factor in the hospital’s continued success. ‘That’s why they call it “America’s hospital.” Children come from across the country, and people everywhere donate. Without those donors, we couldn't exist,’ she said. Since a $200 million investment in St. Jude Global in 2021, the hospital has aimed to extend its cancer treatments to children worldwide. Outside the U.S., more than half of children with cancer do not survive, while in the U.S., the survival rate has reached 80%, up from 20% when St. Jude first opened. St. Jude Global, in partnership with the World Health Organization, helped rescue over 1,000 children with cancer from Ukraine after the Russian invasion began, Thomas said. Bombings made it impossible for those children to receive care in Ukraine, so St. Jude and its partners coordinated their care in other countries including Switzerland and Egypt. ‘We even welcomed eight families ourselves,’ Thomas said, adding that one Ukrainian child was found to have been misdiagnosed. ‘We ensured these children and their families were received by countries all over the world willing to help.’ Thomas believes this global outreach continues St. Jude’s foundational mission. ‘My father said no child should die in the dawn of life. He didn’t just mean no American child, he meant no child anywhere.’ _____ Associated Press coverage of philanthropy and nonprofits receives support through the AP’s collaboration with The Conversation US, funded by Lilly Endowment Inc. translated_content: NEW YORK – Når familier takker Marlo Thomas for den medisinske behandlingen de fikk på St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, korrigerer hun dem vennlig. 'Jeg sier alltid: "Vet du, jeg er ikke en forsker; jeg er en trillebår,"' sier skuespilleren, produsenten og aktivisten, kjent fra 'That Girl.' 'Jeg tar trillebåren, legger penger oppi og bringer dem til forskerne.' Som St. Jude sin nasjonale kontaktperson, spiller Thomas en avgjørende rolle i innsamlingsarbeidet. I år feirer St. Jude Thanks and Giving-kampanjen sitt 20-årsjubileum og har samlet inn over 1 milliard dollar til sykehusets arbeid med å gi gratis behandling til barn med kreft. Kampanjen, som startet tidligere denne måneden og varer ut feriesesongen, øker også bevisstheten om sykehuset i Memphis. St. Jude ble grunnlagt av Marlos far, avdøde Danny Thomas fra 'Make Room for Daddy,' som lovet at familier aldri skulle få regninger for behandling, reise, bolig eller mat. 'Det er et utrolig løfte,' sa Marlo Thomas. 'Og vi har holdt det.' Ifølge Fidelity Charitables årlige rapport er St. Jude nest mest populære veldedige organisasjon blant deres donor-adviserte fond – kun slått av Leger Uten Grenser USA. Charity Navigator rangerer St. Jude som nummer tre blant de mest etterfulgte veldedige organisasjonene, etter Leger Uten Grenser og Røde Kors. Charity Navigator gir også St. Jude sjeldne 100 % i poengsum for tillit og åpenhet. 'Det er et navn alle kjenner til, og de har bygget et godt rykte gjennom mange år,' sa Kevin Scally, ansvarlig for relasjoner i Charity Navigator. 'Å ta vare på barn med kreft og støtte familiene deres så de aldri må betale, treffer folk rett i hjertet.' Marlo Thomas mener Thanks and Giving-kampanjen – en idé utviklet sammen med søsknene sine, Terre og Tony – er mye av grunnen til denne suksessen. I 2003 lanserte de kampanjen for å samle inn rundt 100 millioner dollar i året. 'Vi tenkte: "Hva med en nasjonal kampanje? Ingen veldedighet hadde gjort det før,"' husker Thomas. 'Thanksgiving var det perfekte tidspunktet fordi det handler om familie og fellesskap, ikke tilknyttet religion. Det er min favorittferie fordi det handler om mat og familie.' Søsteren Terre kom opp med navnet Thanks and Giving, og sammen fornyet de farens innsamlingsstil. 'Min far hentet inn stjerner som Frank Sinatra og Nat King Cole. Vår generasjon har fått med Robin Williams, Jennifer Aniston, Michael Strahan, Jon Hamm og mange andre kjendiser.' Kampanjen samarbeider også med butikker som Target, Best Buy, Williams-Sonoma og Domino’s Pizza, som oppfordrer kunder til å donere når de betaler i ferietiden. 'Det er spennende fordi det er en familieide kampanje. Pappa hadde vært stolt av oss for at vi fikk det til sammen,' sa Thomas. I motsetning til de fleste sykehus, som får betalt av pasienter og forsikring, dekker St. Jude rundt 80 % av behandlingskostnadene med donasjoner – omtrent 2 milliarder dollar i året. Thomas mener amerikanernes giverglede er en viktig suksessfaktor. 'Derfor kalles det "Amerikas sykehus." Barn kommer fra hele landet, og folk overalt bidrar. Uten disse giverne kunne vi ikke eksistert,' sier hun. Etter at St. Jude Global fikk en investering på 200 millioner dollar i 2021, har sykehuset som mål å tilby kreftbehandling til barn over hele verden. Utenfor USA overlever mer enn halvparten av barna med kreft ikke, mens i USA har overlevelsesraten steget til 80 %, opp fra 20 % da St. Jude åpnet. St. Jude Global, i samarbeid med Verdens helseorganisasjon, hjalp over 1 000 barn med kreft ut av Ukraina etter at den russiske invasjonen begynte, sier Thomas. Bombene gjorde det umulig for barna å få behandling, så St. Jude og samarbeidspartnere ordnet behandling i blant annet Sveits og Egypt. 'Vi tok selv imot åtte familier,' fortalte Thomas, og la til at ett av de ukrainske barna fikk stilt riktig diagnose først etter ankomst. 'Vi sørget for at barna og familiene deres ble ønsket velkommen i land over hele verden.' Thomas mener dette internasjonale engasjementet viderefører St. Jude sitt grunnleggende budskap. 'Min far sa at intet barn skal dø i livets morgengry. Han mente ikke bare amerikanske barn – han mente alle barn, overalt.' _____ Associated Press sin dekning av filantropi og ideell sektor støttes via samarbeid med The Conversation US, finansiert av Lilly Endowment Inc. article_content: A humanitarian aid convoy operated by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) delivering lifesaving medical supplies to health facilities in Gaza City came under fire, resulting in damage to two trucks and minor injuries to a driver. According to the ICRC, the convoy was transporting essential supplies to medical sites, including Al Quds Hospital, managed by the Palestinian Red Crescent Society. The organization expressed deep concern over the attack and reiterated that all warring parties are obligated under international humanitarian law to respect and protect humanitarian workers. The ICRC's statement did not specify who was responsible for the gunfire. Comprising five trucks and two ICRC vehicles, the convoy altered its route following the incident and successfully delivered supplies to Al-Shifa Hospital. The convoy also assisted by accompanying six ambulances carrying critically wounded patients to the Rafah crossing for transfer from Gaza to Egypt. William Schomburg, head of the ICRC sub-delegation in Gaza, emphasized, 'These are not the conditions under which humanitarian personnel can work,' underscoring the necessity of unimpeded aid access as a legal requirement. The ICRC, a neutral organization based in Geneva, regularly escorts patients and facilitates transfers out of Gaza. Since October 7, over 10,000 Palestinians have been killed, approximately 40 percent of them children, according to Gaza’s health officials. Nearly two-thirds of the territory's 2.3 million residents are now internally displaced, based on United Nations data, with thousands seeking refuge in hospitals and makeshift shelters. Many hospitals in Gaza have come under attack and are struggling to operate amid severe shortages of fuel and supplies. The United Nations warns that Gaza's health, sanitation, water, and food services are nearing collapse.

Former Massachusetts Governor Paul Cellucci, who also served as U.S. ambassador to Canada, passed away Saturday at age 65 after battling ALS, according to the University of Massachusetts Medical School. Cellucci died at his home in Hudson, the small town where his career began as a selectman and ultimately led to governor and diplomat. He was surrounded by his family at the time of his death.

A graduate of Boston College and Boston College Law School, Cellucci served in the U.S. Army Reserves, practiced law, and worked at his family’s car dealership before entering politics. He was first elected in 1976 to the Massachusetts Legislature, serving 14 years as both a state representative and later a state senator. In 1990, Cellucci became lieutenant governor. When Governor William Weld resigned in 1997 after being nominated for U.S. Ambassador to Mexico—a position ultimately denied by GOP opposition—Cellucci ascended to the governorship. The next year, Massachusetts voters elected him as governor.

In 2001, following nomination by President George W. Bush, Cellucci became the U.S. ambassador to Canada, a post he held for five years. Former Presidents George H.W. Bush and George W. Bush issued a joint statement calling Cellucci "a close and loyal friend, a superb public servant and a devoted family man." They praised his support for the elder Bush’s 1980 presidential campaign and grouped him among Bay Staters such as Andrew Card and Andrew Natsios who also served in their administrations.

Cellucci announced in January 2011 that he had been diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), also known as Lou Gehrig’s Disease. Working with UMass Medical School, he helped raise nearly $2 million for ALS research. The disease causes nerve deterioration and leads to loss of muscle function in the lungs, with most patients succumbing to respiratory failure within three to five years of symptom onset, according to the National Institutes of Health. About 10% of ALS patients live beyond 10 years.

UMass Medical School Chancellor Michael Collins commented, “The governor refused to allow his challenging diagnosis to prevent him from continuing his lifetime’s work of serving and helping others. Instead, he made a conscious and inspiring decision to use his illness to raise awareness, galvanize action, and spread hope.”

article_content: Leaders of the G7 countries have reaffirmed that their support for Ukraine "will never waver", even as tensions rise in the Middle East. At a G7 meeting in Japan, the bloc’s foreign ministers acknowledged that Russia is prepared for a prolonged conflict. They emphasized their ongoing commitment to providing economic and military assistance to Kyiv. Since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in 2022, the G7 group has played a key role in imposing sanctions on Moscow. In Tokyo, officials from the G7 nations—Britain, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Canada, and the US—along with EU representatives, stated that the conflict between Israel and Gaza should not divert attention from supporting Ukraine. A statement from Japan’s foreign ministry noted that the leaders agreed on the importance of imposing tough sanctions on Russia and upholding support for Ukraine despite the current international situation. US Secretary of State Antony Blinken stated the bloc remains "united in its condemnation of Russia’s war." However, despite this strong rhetoric, there are growing concerns about Western fatigue as the conflict endures. Kyiv is worried that diminishing enthusiasm among Western allies could undermine its defenses. Additional US funding for Ukraine—about $60 billion, requested by President Joe Biden—remains stalled due to opposition from Republican members of Congress. American officials warn that without this aid, support for Ukrainian forces could run out within weeks, with potentially severe consequences. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni recently drew attention after telling Russian pranksters posing as African Union officials that fatigue with the Ukraine war was increasing. "We are close to a point where everyone understands a solution is needed," she said. Slovakian Prime Minister Robert Fico, who took office last month, has halted Slovakia’s weapons deliveries to Ukraine. Meanwhile, there are also strains within Ukraine’s leadership: this month, public disagreements surfaced between President Volodymyr Zelensky and the commander of Ukraine’s armed forces, General Valery Zaluzhny, after Zaluzhny remarked in an interview that the war had reached a "stalemate." Zelensky subsequently urged Ukrainians to avoid internal divisions. On Wednesday, a Russian collaborator, Mikhail Filiponenko—a former head of a separatist militia—was killed in a car bomb explosion in the city of Luhansk, in Russian-occupied Ukraine. Ukrainian military intelligence claimed responsibility, working in conjunction with local resistance fighters. Filiponenko had previously survived an attack in February last year, according to Russian media.

Siden Russlands invasjon av Ukraina i 2022 har G7 spilt en nøkkelrolle i å innføre sanksjoner mot Moskva. I Tokyo uttalte representanter for G7-landene—Storbritannia, Frankrike, Tyskland, Italia, Japan, Canada og USA—sammen med EU-representanter, at Israel-Gaza-konflikten ikke må ta fokuset bort fra støtten til Ukraina. En uttalelse fra Japans utenriksdepartement sa at lederne var enige om behovet for strenge sanksjoner mot Russland og å opprettholde støtten til Ukraina til tross for dagens internasjonale situasjon. USAs utenriksminister Antony Blinken uttalte at blokken forblir «forent i sin fordømmelse av Russlands krig». Likevel er det økende bekymring for vestlig «Ukraina-tretthet» mens konflikten fortsetter. Kyiv frykter at lavere entusiasme blant vestlige allierte kan svekke forsvaret. Ytterligere amerikansk støtte til Ukraina—rundt 60 milliarder dollar, forespurt av president Joe Biden—er fortsatt forsinket på grunn av motstand fra republikanske kongressmedlemmer. Amerikanske tjenestemenn advarer om at uten denne støtten kan hjelpen til de ukrainske styrkene ta slutt i løpet av uker, med potensielt alvorlige konsekvenser. Italias statsminister Giorgia Meloni fikk nylig oppmerksomhet da hun sa til russiske spøkefugler som utga seg for å være afrikanske toppledere, at trettheten over Ukraina-krigen vokste. «Vi nærmer oss et punkt der alle forstår at en løsning er nødvendig,» sa hun. Slovakias statsminister Robert Fico, som tiltrådte i forrige måned, har stanset Slovakias våpenleveranser til Ukraina. Det er også spenninger i Ukrainas lederskap: denne måneden ble det åpent uenighet mellom president Volodymyr Zelenskyj og general Valery Zaluzhny, etter at Zaluzhny sa i et intervju at krigen hadde blitt en «fastlåst situasjon». Zelenskyj ba etterpå ukrainere om å unngå interne konflikter. Onsdag ble en russisk kollaboratør, Mikhail Filiponenko—tidligere leder for en separatistmilits—drept i en bilbombeeksplosjon i byen Luhansk i russisk-okkupert Ukraina. Ukrainsk militær etterretning hevdet ansvar i samarbeid med lokale motstandskjempere. Filiponenko var tidligere mål for et angrep i februar i fjor, ifølge russiske medier.

article_content: Homosexuality should not be a criminal offense, and people should be helped to understand the issue better, says a leading cardinal from Ghana. Cardinal Peter Turkson expressed these views while Ghana's parliament considers a bill that would impose harsh penalties on LGBT people. His perspective contrasts with some Roman Catholic bishops in Ghana, who describe homosexuality as 'despicable.' Last month, Pope Francis indicated some openness to the Catholic Church blessing same-sex couples but emphasized that the Church still considers same-sex relationships 'objectively sinful' and does not recognize same-sex marriage. In July, Ghanaian MPs approved measures in a bill, not yet passed in parliament, that would make identifying as LGBT punishable by a three-year prison sentence. Advocating for LGBT rights could result in up to 10 years' imprisonment under the proposed law. Same-sex relations are already illegal in Ghana and can result in up to three years in prison. In August, Ghanaian bishops, together with several other Christian groups, urged Western nations to 'stop the incessant attempts to impose unacceptable foreign cultural values on us,' according to the Catholic Herald. Cardinal Turkson, sometimes mentioned as a possible future pope, told BBC's HARDtalk programme that 'LGBT people may not be criminalized because they've committed no crime.' He highlighted the need for education to help people distinguish between what is and is not a crime. He noted that an expression in the Akan language—'men who act like women and women who act like men'—suggests homosexuality is not completely foreign to Ghanaian culture. Turkson explained that the existence of such terms in local languages means the phenomenon is not entirely alien to the society. He added that recent pushes for strict anti-gay laws in several African countries often follow attempts to tie foreign aid or support to specific stances on LGBT rights. 'Nor should such positions be imposed on cultures that are not ready to accept these changes,' he said. In May, Uganda's parliament passed a law proposing life imprisonment for those convicted of homosexuality, and the death penalty in aggravated cases, such as sex with minors or transmission of a life-long illness like HIV. Following this, the World Bank halted new loans to Uganda, and in October, President Joe Biden announced the US would remove Uganda from a preferential trade agreement over 'gross violations of internationally recognized human rights.' Cardinal Turkson became Ghana’s first cardinal in 2003 when he was appointed by Pope John Paul II. He currently serves as the chancellor of the Pontifical Academies of Sciences.

Kardinal Peter Turkson ga uttrykk for dette mens Ghanas parlament vurderer et lovforslag som vil gi strenge straffer for LHBT-personer. Hans synspunkt står i kontrast til noen katolske biskoper i Ghana, som beskriver homofili som 'avskyelig.' I forrige måned signaliserte pave Frans en viss åpenhet for at den katolske kirken kan velsigne likekjønnede par, men han understreket at kirken fortsatt mener at likekjønnede forhold er 'objektivt syndige' og ikke anerkjenner likekjønnet ekteskap. I juli godkjente ghanesiske parlamentsmedlemmer tiltak i et lovforslag, som ennå ikke er vedtatt i parlamentet, som vil gjøre det straffbart med tre års fengsel å identifisere seg som LHBT. Å arbeide for LHBT-rettigheter kan gi opptil ti års fengsel i henhold til det foreslåtte lovverket. Likekjønnet seksuelt samvær er allerede ulovlig i Ghana og kan føre til opptil tre års fengsel. I august oppfordret ghanesiske biskoper, sammen med flere andre kristne grupper, vestlige land til å 'slutte de stadige forsøkene på å påtvinge oss uakseptable fremmede kulturelle verdier,' ifølge Catholic Herald. Kardinal Turkson, som noen ganger blir nevnt som en mulig fremtidig pave, sa til BBCs HARDtalk-program at 'LHBT-personer ikke bør kriminaliseres fordi de ikke har begått noen forbrytelse.' Han understreket behovet for utdanning slik at folk kan skille mellom hva som er og ikke er en forbrytelse. Turkson forklarte at slike begreper i lokale språk betyr at fenomenet ikke er helt ukjent i samfunnet. Han la til at skjerpelser i anti-LHBT-lover i flere afrikanske land ofte kommer som reaksjon på forsøk på å knytte utenlandsk bistand til bestemte posisjoner om LHBT-rettigheter. 'Slike synspunkter bør heller ikke påtvinges kulturer som ikke er klare for slike endringer,' sa han. I mai vedtok Ugandas parlament en lov som gir livsvarig fengsel for personer dømt for homofili, og dødsstraff i skjerpende tilfeller, som sex med mindreårige eller overføring av livsvarig sykdom som hiv. Etter dette stanset Verdensbanken nye lån til Uganda, og i oktober kunngjorde president Joe Biden at USA ville fjerne Uganda fra en gunstig handelsavtale på grunn av 'grove brudd på internasjonalt anerkjente menneskerettigheter.' Kardinal Turkson ble Ghanas første kardinal i 2003 da han ble utnevnt av pave Johannes Paul II. Han er nå kansler for de pavelige vitenskapsakademiene.

article_content: The Kirkus Prize, one of the country’s most prestigious literary honors, has named its 2024 winners: Ariel Aberg-Riger, Héctor Tobar, and James McBride. Awarded annually in the categories of fiction, nonfiction, and young readers’ literature, the prize is selected from nearly 11,000 books reviewed by Kirkus Reviews, an influential pre-publication book journal. Each winner receives a $50,000 cash award. This year marks the prize’s 10th anniversary. In a statement, Kirkus Reviews publisher Meg Kuehn highlighted 'history and community' as central themes in this year’s celebrated books, noting how each author brings these themes to life in unique ways. James McBride, bestselling author of The Color of Water and National Book Award-winner The Good Lord Bird, captured the fiction prize for The Heaven & Earth Grocery Store. Set in 1930s Chicken Hill, Pottstown, Pennsylvania, the novel was praised by judges for its depiction of community, justice, and humanity. Héctor Tobar won the nonfiction prize for Our Migrant Souls: A Meditation on Race and the Meanings and Myths of 'Latino.' The book, which judges called a vital blend of autobiography and cultural commentary, examines Latinx identity in America through interviews and personal reflection. Tobar is also known for Deep Down Dark, chronicling the story of trapped Chilean miners, which was adapted into the film The 33. Ariel Aberg-Riger earned the young readers’ award for her debut, America Redux: Visual Stories From Our Dynamic History. Combining archival images, maps, and handwritten text, her book offers an illustrated look at lesser-known and often overlooked chapters of American history. Judges praised its thought-provoking, inclusive approach to history for young audiences. Together, the winning works highlight diverse perspectives and powerful storytelling rooted in themes of history and community.

article_content: Psychologists at RUDN University have developed one of Russia's first questionnaires to evaluate how students feel about digital educational technologies (DET). Their results were published in the journal Computers. The effective implementation of digital tools in education depends on the attitudes of both students and teachers. Assessment tools like questionnaires help understand these attitudes, identify challenges, and inform educational policy. RUDN psychologists designed the first Russian scale for this purpose, based on a three-component model of social attitudes, to determine university students' attitudes towards DET. 'Students' attitudes toward digital educational technologies are crucial psychological factors—they can either hinder or support the adoption of digital tools. While many tools exist internationally, such methods are scarce in Russia,' noted Irina Novikova, Ph.D., Associate Professor of Psychology and Pedagogy at RUDN University. The team began researching this issue in 2018, even before the pandemic. However, the shift to remote learning during quarantine required significant updates to their method. The resulting scale draws on established psychological models and international experience and has been named ATDETS-US (Attitudes Towards DET Scale for University Students). RUDN psychologists tested the scale with 680 undergraduate and graduate students from Russian universities. To ensure its reliability and validity, they used recognized statistical methods such as Cronbach's alpha, McDonald's omega, correlation analysis, and factor analysis. The ATDETS-US consists of three parts—emotional, cognitive, and behavioral—containing 36 to 45 statements rated from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree). Results showed notable gender differences: female students generally had a more positive emotional response to digital education compared to male students. Therefore, the researchers standardized and normalized the data separately for each group. These norms can guide future studies comparing DET attitudes among students from various fields and universities. Future research using this methodology will examine factors affecting students' attitudes toward DET, such as academic motivation, personality traits, psychological well-being, and other individual characteristics. It will also be important to explore links between how students feel about DET and their academic performance. The findings could help form recommendations for improving the digitalization of higher education. The researchers intend to develop a similar scale for university teachers.

Vurderingsverktøy som spørreskjema hjelper til å forstå disse holdningene, identifisere utfordringer og å utforme utdanningspolitikk. RUDN-psykologene utarbeidet den første russiske skalaen for dette, basert på en trekomponentsmodell av sosiale holdninger, for å kartlegge universitetsstudenters syn på DET. 'Studentenes holdninger til digitale utdanningsteknologier er viktige psykologiske faktorer—de kan enten hindre eller fremme innføringen av digitale verktøy. Selv om det finnes mange slike verktøy internasjonalt, er slike metoder sjeldne i Russland,' sier Irina Novikova, Ph.d., førsteamanuensis i psykologi og pedagogikk ved RUDN-universitetet. Teamet startet arbeidet med dette i 2018, før pandemien. Men overgangen til fjernundervisning under karantene krevde omfattende oppdateringer av metoden. Den ferdige skalaen er basert på anerkjente psykologiske modeller og internasjonal erfaring, og har fått navnet ATDETS-US (Attitudes Towards DET Scale for University Students). RUDN-psykologene testet skalaen på 680 bachelor- og masterstudenter fra russiske universiteter. For å sikre pålitelighet og gyldighet brukte de anerkjente statistiske metoder, som Cronbachs alfa, McDonalds omega, korrelasjonsanalyse og faktoranalyse. ATDETS-US består av tre deler—emosjonell, kognitiv og atferdsmessig—og inneholder 36 til 45 utsagn som vurderes fra 1 (helt uenig) til 5 (helt enig). Resultatene viste tydelige kjønnsforskjeller: kvinnelige studenter hadde i gjennomsnitt en mer positiv emosjonell respons på digital utdanning enn mannlige studenter. Det blir også viktig å undersøke sammenhengen mellom studentenes holdninger til DET og deres akademiske prestasjoner. Funnene kan brukes til å utvikle anbefalinger for å forbedre digitaliseringen av høyere utdanning. Forskerne har også planer om å utvikle en tilsvarende skala for universitetslærere.

article_content: Laurent Koscielny has lifted Arsenal's defensive prospects by rejoining training after overcoming an Achilles issue. The French international exited at halftime during the Gunners’ 3-0 Community Shield win over Manchester City, but he may now be available for the season’s opening match against Crystal Palace. Arsene Wenger will welcome Koscielny’s return, especially considering his limited choices in central defense. Per Mertesacker just resumed pre-season training after Germany’s triumph at the World Cup, reducing his match readiness. Calum Chambers, a recent £16 million acquisition from Southampton, has played center-back throughout the pre-season and appears set to start in that position against Crystal Palace. If Wenger decides to rest either Koscielny or Mertesacker with the Champions League qualifier against Besiktas approaching, Nacho Monreal, typically a left-back, could be called upon to fill the gap in central defense. Koscielny’s knack for scoring important goals, such as his equalizer in last season’s FA Cup final, adds further value to his likely return.

article_content:
In an innovative effort to serve anglers enduring freezing conditions, Lakemaid Beer, a brewery from Wisconsin, tested delivering beer by drone to ice fishermen on frozen lakes. Customers could call in their orders and provide exact GPS coordinates, allowing a drone to fly a twelve-pack directly to their fishing spot. A video demonstration on Lake Waconia quickly went viral, racking up over 85,000 views in one week.

But the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has now ordered Lakemaid to suspend its drone delivery operations, highlighting safety and regulatory issues. Planned test flights at Minnesota’s Lake Mille Lacs and the Twin Pines resort have also been canceled as a result.

Jack Supple, the brewery’s managing partner, shared surprise at the FAA’s involvement, noting that the drone flights stayed below the 400-foot altitude limit and were conducted over expansive, unpopulated frozen lakes. Supple compared this to Amazon’s plans for commercial drone deliveries revealed by Jeff Bezos, suggesting their approach posed less risk.

Current FAA rules don't allow commercial deliveries via drones, though the agency is reviewing its policies. The FAA informed Lakemaid that it had violated several regulations, including operator certification and appropriate use of airspace. Supple acknowledged the need for regulation, saying drones shouldn’t be operated without necessary oversight.

Practical challenges remain unresolved, such as verifying that customers receiving beer are of legal age and developing drones capable of flying greater distances with heavier loads. Despite the project's halt, supporters have started a White House petition, hoping to persuade regulators to allow such deliveries in the future.

Lakemaid and its enthusiasts remain hopeful that with regulatory changes, drone deliveries could one day make bringing chilled beer to remote locations a reality.

En demonstrasjonsvideo fra Lake Waconia ble raskt viral og fikk over 85 000 visninger på én uke.

Men nå har Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) pålagt Lakemaid å stoppe droneleveringene, med henvisning til sikkerhets- og regelverksutfordringer. Planlagte testflyginger ved Lake Mille Lacs og Twin Pines resort i Minnesota er også avlyst av samme grunn.

Jack Supple, daglig leder i bryggeriet, uttrykte overraskelse over FAA sin inngripen, og påpekte at droneflyvningene ble holdt under høydegrensen på 400 fot og utført over store, ubebodde, frosne innsjøer. Supple sammenlignet denne tilnærmingen med Amazons planer om kommersielle droneleveranser fremstilt av Jeff Bezos, og mente deres egen løsning var mindre risikabel.

De gjeldende FAA-reglene tillater ikke kommersielle dronleveranser, selv om myndigheten vurderer regelendringer. FAA informerte Lakemaid om at de brøt flere regler, inkludert operatørsertifisering og riktig bruk av luftrommet. Supple anerkjente behovet for regulering og understreket at droner bør opereres med nødvendige sikkerhetsforanstaltninger.

Andre praktiske utfordringer gjenstår, som å kontrollere at mottakere er over aldersgrensen, samt å utvikle droner som kan frakte tyngre last over lengre avstander. Til tross for dronestansen har støttespillere startet et White House-opprop i håp om å påvirke myndighetene til å åpne for slike leveranser i fremtiden.

Lakemaid og deres tilhengere er fremdeles optimistiske til at dronelleveranser en dag kan bringe iskald øl til folk på avsidesliggende steder.

article_content: Cyrus Kabiru, a Kenyan artist, has been fascinated with transforming discarded objects into art since childhood. Growing up in Nairobi, his family home faced a large garbage dump, inspiring him to find creative ways to repurpose waste. "I used to tell my dad that when I grew up, I wanted to give trash a second chance," Kabiru remembers. Today, as a self-taught sculptor and painter, he collects refuse from Nairobi's streets and crafts compelling works of art, most famously his "C-Stunners"—unique, handmade spectacles constructed from items like bolts, wires, spoons, and bottle tops. Kabiru reimagines these materials, turning them into imaginative, steampunk-inspired creations that challenge conventional ideas about waste and art. His fascination with glasses began early in the small, crowded home he shared with his parents and siblings. Kabiru wanted glasses like his father, but was told he must make them himself. Motivated by this challenge, he began fashioning his own frames using found materials. School did not interest Kabiru—he preferred to trade his art for help with exams and homework. Although his family wanted him to pursue engineering, he followed his artistic passion, despite disapproval. Kabiru's determination eventually brought him international recognition, with invitations to events like TED2013 in California and Milan Fashion Week, and exhibitions worldwide. Closer to home, his work has shifted perspectives, and even his father has come to admire his accomplishments. Still, Kabiru reflects on the challenges artists face in Kenya. He laments that many focus on 'selling poverty' instead of creativity and hopes to change this narrative. Through his "Outreach" initiative, Kabiru visits rural Kenyan communities, teaching workshops on making environmentally-friendly art from readily available materials. He believes in reaching elders, who can pass lessons about conservation and creativity to younger generations. While Kabiru's art has many admirers at home and abroad, he humorously notes that his grandmother still hopes he will find a more traditional job.
translated_content: Cyrus Kabiru, en kenyansk kunstner, har vært fascinert av å forvandle kasserte gjenstander til kunst siden barndommen. Da han vokste opp i Nairobi, lå familiens hjem rett ved en stor søppelfylling, noe som inspirerte ham til å finne kreative måter å gjenbruke avfall på. «Jeg pleide å si til pappa at når jeg ble stor, ville jeg gi søppel en ny sjanse», husker Kabiru. I dag er han en selvlært skulptør og maler som samler søppel fra gatene i Nairobi og lager imponerende kunstverk. Mest kjent er han for sine «C-Stunners» – unike, håndlagde briller laget av gjenstander som bolter, ledninger, skjeer og korker. Kabiru gir disse materialene nytt liv ved å forvandle dem til fantasifulle, steampunk-inspirerte kreasjoner som utfordrer tradisjonelle forestillinger om søppel og kunst. Fascinasjonen for briller begynte tidlig i det lille, overfylte hjemmet han delte med foreldre og søsken. Han ville ha briller som faren, men fikk beskjed om at han måtte lage dem selv. Inspirert av dette begynte han å lage sine egne innfatninger av det han hadde for hånden. Skolearbeid fenget ham lite – han byttet gjerne kunsten sin mot hjelp med prøver og lekser. Selv om familien helst ville at han skulle bli ingeniør, fulgte Kabiru kunstnerdrømmen sin, på tross av familiens misnøye. Til slutt ga viljestyrken hans internasjonal anerkjennelse, med invitasjoner til arrangementer som TED2013 i California, Milan Fashion Week og utstillinger verden rundt. Hjemme har arbeidet hans bidratt til holdningsendring, og til og med faren har begynt å beundre sønnens prestasjoner. Kabiru reflekterer fortsatt over utfordringene kunstnere møter i Kenya, og mener for mange fokuserer på å «selge fattigdom» i stedet for kreativitet. Gjennom sitt «Outreach»-initiativ reiser han til landsbygda i Kenya, holder verksteder og lærer bort hvordan man kan lage miljøvennlig kunst av det man har rundt seg. Han mener det er viktig å nå de eldre, som kan gi kunnskapen videre til yngre generasjoner. Selv om Kabirus kunst har mange beundrere både i inn- og utland, nevner han med glimt i øyet at bestemoren fortsatt håper han skal finne en mer tradisjonell jobb.

article_content: Yes, you read that right—a cat fountain. It’s well-known that cats are attracted to running water. If you check most social media platforms, you’ll find plenty of videos showing cats curiously playing with faucets. This instinct comes from their preference for fresh, moving water. In the wild, cats get much of their hydration from the animals they hunt. Domesticated cats, however, often eat dry food, which contains little to no water. Because of this, many house cats may develop urinary tract or kidney issues if they don’t drink enough water, especially if the only option is a bowl of still water that’s been sitting out. Cat fountains, as quirky as they may seem, address this issue by encouraging cats to drink more. The downside? Most require frequent cleaning and maintenance. Pumps need to be taken apart, filters must be replaced or cleaned regularly, and the interior must be wiped down to avoid buildup. For fountains with wired pumps, there’s even concern about electrical faults mixing with water, although this hasn’t been conclusively proven. The Elfin Fountain was created to tackle these problems. Unlike conventional fountains, it’s wireless, pumpless, and easier to maintain. Instead of a traditional water pump, it uses a magnetic stirrer based on basic physics principles—the spinning element in the base moves a widget that pushes water up the tower, creating continuous movement. This reduces the number of parts that can fail and simplifies cleaning. You still need to replace the filter every month or so, but the other components come apart easily for a quick wash. The base has a rechargeable battery lasting up to 30 days, and it can be set to cycle automatically or activate with a motion sensor. There is no continuous-flow mode, but motion activation runs the fountain long enough for most cats to use when nearby. The only noticeable difference is the sound. Unlike nearly silent pumps, the Elfin Fountain’s magnetic mechanism creates a light clattering noise, which may take your cat a little time to get used to. However, most cats seem to adapt quickly. The Elfin Fountain Kickstarter campaign has already exceeded its funding goal and is in its final hours. The company’s website will offer replacement filters and parts, and components will also be available on Amazon once production increases. The Kickstarter price for the fountain with four filters is $65, much less than the $109 expected retail price. It’s a notable deal for an item that could significantly benefit your cat’s hydration and health.

article_content: Police in eastern Germany are investigating a borehole found in a cemetery in Bad Schlema, Saxony, containing the remains of concentration camp victims. Authorities suspect the hole was dug by treasure hunters seeking the legendary Amber Room, a renowned masterpiece of baroque art still lost since World War II. Interest in the Amber Room has grown since the release of 'The Puzzle of Poppen Wood' by Mario Ulbrich, who interviewed foresters, police, miners, and former Nazis to document decades of mostly unreported excavations in woods near Zwickau. The Amber Room, made from amber, gold, and precious stones, was gifted to Peter the Great in 1716 by the King of Prussia. Catherine the Great later had it moved to Tsarskoye Selo and further embellished by craftsmen. During the Nazi invasion of Russia in 1941, the room was seized and transported to Koenigsberg Castle in East Prussia under the supervision of Prussian count Sommes Laubach, an art historian. After intense warfare and bombings in January 1945, the Amber Room vanished, with some believing it was destroyed. Several theories remain about the Amber Room's fate: destruction by fire, sinking in the Baltic Sea, or removal by Soviet troops. Although searchers have found wooden crates from World War II in the area, the alleged cave entrance where the treasure might be hidden has not been located. Mayor Jens Mueller criticized the actions of the treasure hunters, noting the disrespect to a cemetery for 42 victims of the Nazis. Among those involved in the legacy of the Amber Room, author Georges Simenon founded a club dedicated to its search. Despite numerous expeditions, including a 2010 dig by a Russian treasure hunter, the location of the Amber Room remains unknown, continuing to attract hopeful treasure hunters.
translated_content: Politiet i Øst-Tyskland etterforsker nå et borehull funnet på en kirkegård i Bad Schlema, Sachsen, der ofre for konsentrasjonsleirer er begravet. Myndighetene mistenker at hullet er gravd av skattejegere på jakt etter det legendariske Ravrommet, et berømt mesterverk fra barokken som fortsatt er savnet siden andre verdenskrig. Interessen for Ravrommet har økt etter utgivelsen av 'The Puzzle of Poppen Wood' av Mario Ulbrich, som intervjuet skogsarbeidere, politi, gruvearbeidere og tidligere nazister for å dokumentere tiår med nesten ukjente utgravinger i skogene nær Zwickau. Ravrommet, laget av rav, gull og edelstener, ble gitt til Peter den store i 1716 av kongen av Preussen. Katarina den store flyttet det senere til Tsarskoye Selo og fikk det ytterligere utsmykket av håndverkere. Under nazistenes invasjon av Russland i 1941 ble rommet beslaglagt og sendt til Koenigsberg slott i Øst-Preussen under oppsyn av grev Sommes Laubach, en kunsthistoriker. Etter harde kamper og bombing i januar 1945 forsvant Ravrommet, og noen tror det ble ødelagt. Det finnes flere teorier om Ravrommets skjebne: at det ble ødelagt i brann, sank i Østersjøen, eller ble tatt med av sovjetiske soldater. Selv om skattejegere har funnet trekasser fra andre verdenskrig i området, er ikke den påståtte hulen der skatten kan være skjult, funnet. Ordfører Jens Mueller har kritisert skattejegernes handlinger og påpekt manglende respekt for kirkegården, hvor 42 naziofre er gravlagt. Forfatteren Georges Simenon var også engasjert i jakten på Ravrommet og grunnla en egen klubb for formålet. Til tross for mange ekspedisjoner, inkludert et russisk forsøk i 2010, er Ravrommets beliggenhet fortsatt ukjent, og mysteriet tiltrekker seg fremdeles håpefulle skattejegere.

article_content: The long-standing goal of building robots that resemble and assist humans remains a driving force in technology, fueled further by advancements in artificial intelligence and resulting investments. Despite most current humanoid robots being unrefined outside staged conditions, several startups persist in advancing this frontier. Agility Robotics, co-founded by Jonathan Hurst, prioritizes making robots that function in shared spaces with people, rather than simply mirroring human form. Their flagship robot, Digit, is described as 'human-centric,' excelling at practical tasks like picking up and transporting bins. Amazon began testing Digit in its warehouses in 2023, while Agility opened a factory in Oregon to produce these robots at scale. Digit is equipped with arms, bird-like legs that bend backward, and a head fitted with cameras, sensors, and moving eyes, enabling agile movement reminiscent of animals that walk on their toes. Other robotics firms such as Figure AI maintain that a fully humanoid design is essential for integrating into environments made for humans. Starting with simple roles in warehouses, Figure AI aims for their robots to eventually handle diverse jobs. CEO Brett Adcock sees the potential for a massive market if robots can step into roles humans are unable or unwilling to fill. To date, Figure AI has only unveiled early prototype footage. Industry leaders like Tesla, under Elon Musk, are also working on humanoid robots—releasing the Optimus model, although its public demonstrations have received mixed reviews. Meanwhile, Apptronik in Austin has demonstrated its Apollo humanoid via online video. Marc Raibert, co-founder of Boston Dynamics, notes that pursuing humanoid robots for certain tasks led them to create more effective machines with some human-like traits, resulting in faster, longer-lasting, and more adaptable robots, even if not strictly humanoid. Sanctuary AI, based in Canada and led by Geordie Rose, has concentrated on solving complex manipulation tasks. Rose states that teaching robots to understand and physically interact with their environment is more challenging than teaching them to walk. The latest robot, Phoenix, can stock shelves, unload vehicles, and run checkouts, demonstrating early progress toward versatile, intuitive machines. Amazon was attracted to Digit’s mobility and versatility, which complement its other warehouse robots. At present, Digit performs repetitive tasks, sparking ongoing debates about the impact of automation on employment. Agility Robotics CEO Damion Shelton describes warehouse use as the beginning, envisioning robots that enhance, rather than replace, the human workforce. The consensus among these developers is that within the next 10-20 years, human-compatible robots may become a routine presence, delivering meaningful assistance in many settings.
translated_content: Drømmen om å bygge roboter som både ligner på og hjelper mennesker, fortsetter å drive teknologisk utvikling – spesielt med fremskritt innen kunstig intelligens og økende investeringer. Selv om de fleste nåværende humanoide roboter fungerer dårlig utenfor kontrollerte omgivelser, jobber flere oppstartsbedrifter videre med å løse utfordringene. Agility Robotics, medgrunnet av Jonathan Hurst, fokuserer på å lage roboter som kan operere sammen med mennesker i felles rom, ikke bare på å kopiere menneskelig form. Deres flaggskiprobot, Digit, beskrives som ‘menneskesentrisk’ og er utviklet for praktiske oppgaver som å plukke opp og flytte kasser. Amazon startet testing av Digit i sine lagre i 2023, mens Agility åpnet en fabrikk i Oregon for masseproduksjon. Digit er utstyrt med armer, fuglelignende ben med bakoverbøyde knær, og et hode med kameraer, sensorer og bevegelige øyne – egenskaper som gir den smidige bevegelser lik dyr som går på tærne. Andre selskaper som Figure AI mener en fullverdig humanoid design er avgjørende for å passe inn i miljøer laget for mennesker. Med en start i enkle lagerjobber er målet at robotene etter hvert kan utføre mange ulike oppgaver. CEO Brett Adcock ser et enormt marked dersom roboter kan ta over jobbene som mennesker ikke ønsker eller klarer å gjøre. Så langt har Figure AI kun vist frem tidlige prototyper. Store aktører som Tesla, under ledelse av Elon Musk, utvikler også humanoide roboter – de har vist fram Optimus-roboten, men fått blandede tilbakemeldinger. Apptronik i Austin har demonstrert sin Apollo-humanoid på nett. Marc Raibert, medgründer av Boston Dynamics, påpeker at arbeidet med humanoide roboter førte til utvikling av mer effektive maskiner med enkelte menneskelignende trekk. Disse viste seg å være raskere, holde lengre, og fungere i trange områder – selv om de ikke var helt humanoide. Sanctuary AI i Canada, ledet av Geordie Rose, har fokusert på utfordringer med manipulasjon og forståelse. Rose mener det er vanskeligere å lære roboter å forstå og takle fysiske omgivelser enn å lære dem å gå. Den nyeste roboten, Phoenix, kan fylle hyller, losse biler og jobbe i kassen – tidlige skritt mot allsidighet og menneskelig samspill. Amazon la merke til Digits smidighet og fleksibilitet, og ser roboten som et tilskudd til sine andre lagerroboter. Per nå gjør Digit enkle, repetitive oppgaver, noe som skaper debatt om teknologiens betydning for arbeidsplasser. Agility Robotics’ CEO Damion Shelton ser bruken på lageret som bare starten på roboter som skal hjelpe – ikke erstatte – oss. Utviklere mener at i løpet av de neste 10-20 årene vil menneskeorienterte roboter kunne bli en naturlig del av hverdagen og gi nyttig støtte i mange situasjoner.

article_content: This year’s Techtober—a term used due to the number of new devices launching in October—is already busy with the anticipated release of Google’s Pixel 8 series. Samsung has also revealed several new devices, including its latest affordable wireless earbuds, the Galaxy Buds Fan Edition (FE). The Galaxy Buds FE succeed previous Galaxy Buds models and offer a welcome addition to Samsung’s lineup of audio wearables. Each earbud features three microphones and a new one-way speaker for immersive sound quality, enhanced with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) and Ambient Sound modes. Notable features include Bluetooth 5.2, Auto Switch, SmartThings Find connectivity, and IPX2 water resistance. The Galaxy Buds FE are compatible with Android (via the Galaxy Wearable App), iOS (via Bluetooth), Windows (through the Galaxy Buds App), and Samsung TVs from 2022 or later. A standout feature is the long battery life: up to 8.5 hours of playback from the earbuds, and up to 30 hours total including the charging case. With ANC enabled, users get 6 hours of playback, or 21 hours with the case. The ergonomic design includes three sizes of ear tips and two sizes of wingtips for a comfortable, secure fit, similar to previous Galaxy Buds and Buds Pro models. The Galaxy Buds FE come in two colors—graphite and white—with matching charging cases that resemble the Galaxy Buds case shape and size. Samsung has set the price at $99. The earbuds will be available from select carriers on October 5, and from Samsung’s website starting October 10. In addition to the Galaxy Buds FE, Samsung introduced the Galaxy S23 FE and the Galaxy Tab S9 FE series. While the launch coincides with Google’s Pixel 8 series, Samsung’s new Fan Edition devices are expected to be popular, especially with the holidays approaching.

Et trekk som skiller seg ut er den lange batteritiden: opptil 8,5 timers avspilling fra øreproppene, og opptil 30 timer totalt med ladeetuiet. article_content: In an exciting match on Monday, Nigeria's Super Eagles secured a 3-2 win over Mozambique, marking their first friendly victory in five years. Mozambique took an early lead seven minutes in when Geny Catamo scored, raising concerns that Nigeria's winless streak in friendlies would continue. However, Terem Moffi of OGC Nice equalized just 13 minutes later with a close-range finish. Nigeria kept up the pressure, and Frank Onyeka from Brentford put them ahead with a strike from the edge of the box at the 30-minute mark. Mozambique then conceded a penalty after a handball in the 18-yard box. Moses Simon scored from the spot to make it 3-1. The first half ended with a comfortable lead for Jose Peseiro’s team, signaling a long-awaited friendly match victory. Mozambique managed to score again in the second half, but Nigeria held on for the win.

Nigeria fortsatte presset, og Frank Onyeka fra Brentford ga dem ledelsen med et skudd fra kanten av boksen etter 30 minutter. Mosambik pådro seg deretter en straffe etter en hands i 16-meteren. article_content: Amid the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict in Gaza, European Union High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Josep Borrell announced plans to visit several Middle Eastern countries to discuss humanitarian access and assistance. Borrell emphasized that a two-state solution is needed and achievable only through dialogue. Writing on X, Borrell stated, “I will travel to Israel, Palestine, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Jordan this week to discuss humanitarian access, assistance, and political issues with regional leaders. We need a political horizon focused on a two-state solution, which can only be achieved through dialogue.” The European Union has called for immediate pauses in fighting and the establishment of humanitarian corridors, expressing grave concern over the deepening humanitarian crisis in Gaza. Borrell noted, “The EU joins calls for immediate pauses in hostilities and for the creation of humanitarian corridors, including enhanced capacity at border crossings and a dedicated maritime route, to ensure aid safely reaches Gaza’s population.” The EU condemned Hamas for reportedly using hospitals and civilians as human shields and called for the immediate release of all hostages. Borrell also stressed the importance of allowing the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) access to the hostages. Borrell said, “Civilians must be allowed to safely leave the combat zone. These hostilities are severely impacting hospitals, civilians, and medical staff.” The EU reiterated its support for Israel’s right to self-defense in accordance with international law and humanitarian law. Borrell called for continued, rapid, safe, and unhindered humanitarian access and aid via all necessary measures, including humanitarian corridors and pauses. He stressed that under international humanitarian law, hospitals, medical supplies, and civilians must be protected, and that urgent medical supplies should reach hospitals while patients needing critical care should be safely evacuated. The EU urged Israel to exercise restraint to protect civilians. Additionally, Israel’s Defense Forces reported that troops delivered 300 liters of fuel to Gaza’s Shifa Hospital for urgent medical purposes, but claimed Hamas prevented the hospital from accepting it. Gaza’s health ministry has warned that hospitals are critically low on fuel.

Vi trenger et politisk perspektiv med fokus på en tostatsløsning, som bare kan oppnås gjennom dialog.» Den europeiske union har bedt om umiddelbare stopp i kampene og etablering av humanitære korridorer, og uttrykker dyp bekymring for den forverrede humanitære krisen på Gaza. article_content: Nadine Arslanian was relatively unknown until she became a central figure in the political corruption case involving US Senator Bob Menendez, whom she met in 2018 at a New Jersey IHOP. In late 2018, Arslanian was involved in a car accident in Bogota, New Jersey, that resulted in the death of 49-year-old Richard Koop. Police reports state that Arslanian claimed the victim 'jumped onto the hood of the car,' and she was allowed to leave the scene without drug or alcohol testing. After the accident, Arslanian communicated her need for a new vehicle to Menendez and later obtained a black 2019 Mercedes-Benz convertible. Arslanian frequently appeared in photos with local celebrities and socialites. She is now at the center of a federal indictment that has brought renewed scrutiny to Menendez’s political career. Federal prosecutors allege that Arslanian and Menendez, along with three businessmen, accepted bribes in cash, gold, a luxury car, and other benefits in exchange for political influence. On October 12, 2023, prosecutors filed additional charges of conspiracy for Menendez to act as a foreign agent. Authorities are examining how local police handled the 2018 crash, especially after recent public release of dashcam footage that showed officers treating Arslanian sympathetically at the scene. Menendez has previously faced corruption investigations, including a 2017 mistrial. Arslanian, who married Menendez in 2020, is experiencing increased public attention. Her background includes a prior marriage, financial difficulties, and legal disputes. Arslanian attended New York University, has two children, and reportedly maintained ties to Bergen County’s social circles. She also briefly worked as a restaurant hostess. Arslanian’s social life and former relationships with public figures, as well as legal issues involving traffic violations and litigation with an ex-husband, have been part of public records. Reports about Arslanian and Menendez’s introduction differ in timing, but they met at IHOP in Union City, introduced by the owner. Their relationship progressed quickly, leading to their marriage in 2020. Following her marriage to Menendez, Arslanian’s public profile increased. The couple lived in Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey, but neighbors report rarely seeing them. Police records show that Menendez accompanied Arslanian after the fatal crash. Officers did not file charges against her, later ruling she was not at fault. However, the victim’s family questions how the investigation was handled. Federal prosecutors claim Menendez used his Senate position for favors in exchange for bribes, including actions benefiting Egyptian interests. Arslanian allegedly established a consulting company through which payments were received. A 2022 search of the couple’s home uncovered cash, gold bars, and the Mercedes convertible linked to alleged bribes. Attorneys for the implicated parties, including Arslanian and Menendez, declined to comment. Both have pleaded not guilty, with the next court appearance set for October 24. Additional reporting was provided by Aaron Short. The article was updated on October 12, 2023, to reflect new charges.

Ifølge politirapporter hevdet Arslanian at offeret 'hoppet opp på panseret', og hun fikk reise fra stedet uten å bli testet for rus eller alkohol. Etter ulykken fortalte Arslanian Menendez at hun trengte ny bil, og hun skaffet seg senere en svart 2019 Mercedes-Benz cabriolet. Arslanian ble ofte sett på bilder sammen med lokale kjendiser og sosietetsfolk. Nå er hun midtpunktet i en føderal tiltale som har ført til fornyet gransking av Menendez’ politiske karriere. Føderale aktorer hevder at Arslanian og Menendez, sammen med tre forretningsmenn, mottok bestikkelser i form av kontanter, gull, en luksusbil og andre fordeler i bytte mot politisk innflytelse. 12. oktober 2023 la aktorer til nye anklager om konspirasjon for at Menendez skulle opptre som utenlandsk agent. Myndighetene undersøker også hvordan lokalt politi håndterte ulykken i 2018, spesielt etter offentliggjøring av dashcam-opptak som viser at politibetjenter behandlet Arslanian med sympati på stedet. Menendez har tidligere vært under etterforskning for korrupsjon, inkludert en rettssak i 2017 som endte med feilrett. Arslanian, som giftet seg med Menendez i 2020, opplever nå økt offentlig oppmerksomhet. Hun har bakgrunn med et tidligere ekteskap, økonomiske vanskeligheter og rettslige tvister. Arslanian har to barn, studerte ved New York University og har tilknytning til Bergen Countys sosiale miljø. Hun jobbet også kort som restaurantvertinne. Arslanians sosiale liv og tidligere forhold til offentlige personer, samt rettslige saker som involverer trafikkbøter og uenigheter med eks-mannen, har vært offentlig kjent. Det ble ikke reist tiltale mot henne, og hun ble senere funnet ikke skyldig. Offerets familie stiller likevel spørsmål ved etterforskningen. Føderale aktorer hevder at Menendez brukte sin senatsrolle til å utføre tjenester mot bestikkelser, blant annet til fordel for egyptiske interesser. Arslanian skal ha etablert et konsulentselskap for å motta betalinger. Et razzia i parets hjem i 2022 avdekket kontanter, gullbarrer og Mercedesen knyttet til de påståtte bestikkelsene. Advokatene til de impliserte, inkludert Arslanian og Menendez, har ikke ønsket å kommentere. Begge har erklært seg ikke skyldig, og neste rettsmøte er satt til 24. oktober. Ytterligere rapportering er levert av Aaron Short. Artikkelen ble oppdatert 12. oktober 2023, for å inkludere nye tiltaler.

article_content: Archbishop of Canterbury, Justin Welby, traded his mitre and cassock for a baseball cap and high-visibility jacket to connect with late-night clubbers in Bristol and even pose for selfies. Over the weekend, Welby, 58, made an official visit to the city, but also spent Saturday night observing with Bristol's street pastors, meeting revellers, and speaking with police officers outside bars. Later, he led a service at Bristol Cathedral, where he shared his faith to a backdrop of film and live music. During his visit, Welby remarked on Bristol’s strong sense of community and clear direction within the Church. He praised Bishop Mike Hill and emphasized the city's purposeful approach to church life. Addressing criticism about the Church of England's future, Welby dismissed the notion that it's in decline, calling such claims 'claptrap.' Welby, a married father of six and former oil industry executive, became head of the Church of England last year. He rejected suggestions that his professional background gives him an edge over his predecessors, praising the work of former Archbishop Rowan Williams and saying he's built on the foundations laid by those who came before him. Street Pastors is an inter-denominational volunteer organization providing a Christian presence on local streets. Founded in Brixton, south London in January 2003 by Reverend Les Isaac, who directs the Ascension Trust, the initiative now involves 9,000 volunteers in more than 225 locations across Britain.
