article_content: The devastating tsunami that struck Japan in March 2011 triggered a series of events that have long intrigued scientists. The tsunami was so powerful that it swept 5 million tons of debris into the Pacific Ocean—1.5 million tons of which remained afloat and began drifting with the currents. A year later, debris began washing ashore on the west coast of North America. Remarkably, more than 280 Japanese coastal species, including mussels, barnacles, and even some fish, had hitched a ride and completed an extraordinary journey across the ocean. Many were still alive, with the potential to establish new populations. How animals cross major barriers, such as oceans and mountain ranges, to contribute to Earth's biodiversity is a fascinating subject. A new study published in Nature Ecology & Evolution, co-authored by myself and colleagues, sheds light on this process. Our research reveals how animal traits like body size and life history can influence their global dispersal. We know such dispersal events happen among terrestrial species, too. For instance, in 1995, at least 15 green iguanas traveled over 200 km (124 miles) from Guadeloupe to Anguilla in the Caribbean, arriving on mats of logs and trees likely uprooted by a hurricane, some over 9 meters (20 feet) long. When animals move across major barriers, the impact on both the new and original environments can be significant. Invasive species, for example, may compete with native species for resources, with long-term ecological consequences. The movement of monkeys from Africa to South America about 35 million years ago led to the evolution of over 90 species of New World monkeys, including tamarins, capuchins, and spider monkeys. Similarly, a few chameleons rafting to Madagascar from Africa explains why half of all living chameleon species are found there today. These events were once thought to occur by chance—like some chameleons being on the right tree at the right time. However, some scientists have proposed that certain animal characteristics might make successful dispersal more likely. For example, could species with larger bodies and more fat reserves travel farther? Do reproductive traits, such as laying many eggs or maturing early, give species a better chance to establish populations in new places? Though this topic has sparked much debate, rare dispersal events and the lack of statistical tools made it difficult to test these ideas until recently. Thanks to advancements in biogeographical models and increased data availability, we can now study how tetrapod species (amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals) have moved across the globe over the last 300 million years, and whether successful dispersers share certain traits. These models enable us to estimate movements of species' ancestors and examine their characteristics. In our study, we analyzed 7,009 species across 56 tetrapod groups. Our findings showed that for 91% of the animal groups studied, models incorporating species characteristics were better supported than those that did not. This suggests that body size and life history are closely tied to successful dispersal and establishment. Large-bodied animals and those with fast life histories (breeding early and often, like water voles) tended to be more successful at dispersing. Yet, there were notable exceptions. In some groups, smaller animals or those with average traits dispersed more successfully. For instance, small hummingbirds dispersed better than larger ones, and poison dart frogs with intermediate life histories outperformed those with very fast or very slow ones. We explored this variation further, noting that the relationship between body size and dispersal depended on the group's average size and life history. The link between these factors and dispersal cannot be considered separately. Typically, groups where small size was an advantage already consisted mainly of small, quick-reproducing species, such as the rodent families Muridae and Cricetidae. Conversely, groups with intermediate-sized dispersers generally had slow life histories—low reproductive rates but long lifespans. Thus, the combination of small size and a slow life history is unlikely to aid dispersal across major barriers like oceans. It's fascinating to learn that rare dispersal events, which can give rise to new species, are not completely random. Intrinsic species traits can shape entire animal group histories, although chance remains a factor. Today, two of the biggest environmental challenges—biological invasions and species' responses to climate change—are linked to animal movement across major barriers. In a changing world, understanding how animals cross these barriers is crucial.
translated_content: Den ødeleggende tsunamien som rammet Japan i mars 2011 utløste en serie hendelser som lenge har fascinert forskere. Tsunamien var så kraftig at den skylte 5 millioner tonn vrakgods ut i Stillehavet—1,5 millioner tonn ble liggende flytende og drev med havstrømmene. Et år senere begynte vrakgods å skylle i land på vestkysten av Nord-Amerika. Overraskende nok hadde mer enn 280 japanske kystarter, inkludert blåskjell, rur og til og med noen fisk, haiket med og gjennomført en utrolig reise over havet. Mange var fortsatt i live med potensial til å etablere nye bestander. Hvordan dyr krysser store barrierer, som hav og fjellkjeder, og bringer nytt mangfold til kloden, er et fascinerende tema. En ny studie publisert i Nature Ecology & Evolution, co-forfattet av meg og kolleger, belyser denne prosessen. Vår forskning viser hvordan trekk som kroppsstørrelse og livshistorie påvirker deres globale spredning. Vi vet at slike spredninger også skjer på land. For eksempel reiste minst 15 grønne iguaner over 200 km fra Guadeloupe til Anguilla i Karibia i 1995, på tømmermatter og trær sannsynligvis revet løs av en orkan, noen av dem over 9 meter lange. Når dyr krysser store barrierer, kan det få betydelig betydning både for de nye og opprinnelige økosystemene. Invasive arter kan konkurrere med stedegne arter om ressurser, med langsiktige økologiske følger. Apenes ferd fra Afrika til Sør-Amerika for rundt 35 millioner år siden førte til over 90 arter av ‘nye verdensaper’, for eksempel tamariner, kapusiner og edderkoppaper. På lignende måte forklarer noen kameleoners flåtetokt til Madagaskar hvorfor halvparten av alle nålevende kameleonarter finnes der. Tidligere trodde man slike hendelser skyltes ren flaks—som kameleoner som tilfeldigvis var på rett tre til rett tid. Noen forskere mener likevel at visse trekk kan øke sjansen for å spre seg vellykket. Kan større dyr med mer fettreserver reise lengre? Gir høy eggproduksjon eller tidlig kjønnsmodning bedre sjanser for å etableres i nye områder? Selv om mye av diskusjonen lenge var teoretisk, har det vært vanskelig å teste disse ideene fordi slike hendelser er sjeldne og det manglet gode analyseverktøy—frem til nå. Takket være nye biogeografiske modeller og mer data kan vi nå studere hvordan firebeinte arter (amfibier, reptiler, fugler og pattedyr) har spredd seg de siste 300 millioner år, og se etter trekk hos artene som har lykkes. Disse modellene gjør det mulig å anslå forflytningene til artenes forfedre og se på karaktertrekk. I studien vår analyserte vi 7 009 arter fordelt på 56 tetrapodgrupper. Vi fant at for 91 % av gruppene ga modeller som inkluderte artskarakteristikker bedre forklaring enn de uten, noe som tyder på at kroppsstørrelse og livshistorie henger tett sammen med vellykket spredning og etablering. Store dyr og arter med rask livshistorie—de som formerer seg tidlig og ofte, som vannrotter—sprer seg generelt mer vellykket. Men det finnes unntak. I enkelte grupper spredte små dyr eller de med gjennomsnittlige trekk seg best. For eksempel spredte små kolibrier seg bedre enn større, og pilgiftfrosker med middels livshistorie klarte seg bedre enn de med ekstremt rask eller sakte livshistorie. Vi undersøkte variasjonen nærmere, og så at sammenhengen mellom kroppsstørrelse og spredning avhenger av gjennomsnittlig størrelse og livshistorie i gruppen. Man må derfor se disse egenskapene i sammenheng. Grupper hvor små størrelser var fordelaktig, besto i utgangspunktet av mange små, hurtigreproduserende arter, som gnagerfamiliene Muridae og Cricetidae. I motsatt fall hadde gruppene med middels store spredertyper ofte langsom livshistorie—lav reproduksjon men lang levetid. Dermed gir liten kroppsstørrelse kombinert med langsom livshistorie sjelden noen fordel for å krysse store barrierer. Det er fascinerende å tenke på at sjeldne spredningshendelser, som faktisk kan gi opphav til nye arter, ikke er helt tilfeldige. Arters egenskaper former historiene til hele dyregrupper, selv om flaks fortsatt spiller inn. To av vår tids største utfordringer—biologiske invasjoner og arters respons på klimaendringer—er direkte knyttet til hvordan dyr forflytter seg over barrierer. I en verden i endring er kunnskap om dette viktigere enn noen gang.

article_content: Working as a climate scientist, I became the subject of intense scrutiny and attacks after publishing research in 1998 showing that the world is much warmer now than in the past. These findings attracted public attention and made me one of many climate researchers targeted by well-funded campaigns aiming to undermine climate science. As my research became more widely known, I received hostile emails, was criticized online and in the media, and had politicians call for access to my personal emails. My experience is not unique; history shows that industries, such as tobacco and lead, have targeted scientists whose work threatened vested interests. A particularly infamous incident involved the theft of thousands of emails and documents from leading climate researchers, including myself. Select phrases were taken out of context and widely distributed to create a manufactured controversy, especially just before important international climate negotiations. Saudi Arabia was the first nation to call for an investigation. Subsequent independent investigations—over a dozen in total—all found the accusations against us to be baseless. However, these findings garnered much less media coverage than the initial scandal. Despite being cleared by the National Science Foundation's inspector general, and a legal victory in Virginia's Supreme Court over the release of my documents, the controversy has persisted. The significant time, money, and energy spent on defending against these attacks could have been used to address the real impacts of climate change, such as protecting coastal communities. These challenges compelled me to share my story in my book, 'The Hockey Stick and the Climate Wars: Dispatches from the Front Lines.' Even before its release, industry groups attempted to discredit me and my work with campaigns and public stunts. In response, climate scientists continue their research and are doing more to communicate with the public and defend against legal challenges. Initiatives like the Climate Science Rapid Response Team, the Climate Science Legal Defense Fund, and the work of organizations like the Union of Concerned Scientists aim to protect scientists and promote better understanding of climate change. I entered climate science seeking meaningful work, not public controversy. As both a scientist and father, I want to ensure a healthy, livable planet for the next generation. We owe our children political and business debates based on scientific reality. The views expressed here are mine alone—Michael Mann.

Disse funnene fikk stor offentlig oppmerksomhet og gjorde meg til en av mange klimaforskere som har blitt mål for godt finansierte kampanjer som forsøker å undergrave klimavitenskapen. Etter hvert som forskningen min ble mer kjent, mottok jeg fiendtlige e-poster, ble kritisert på nettet og i media, og politikere krevde innsyn i mine personlige e-poster. Min erfaring er ikke unik; historien viser at industrier som tobakk og bly har gått etter forskere hvis arbeider truet etablerte interesser. Et spesielt beryktet tilfelle omhandlet tyveri av tusenvis av e-poster og dokumenter fra ledende klimaforskere, inkludert meg selv. Utvalgte fraser ble tatt ut av sammenheng og bredt distribuert for å skape en konstruert kontrovers, spesielt rett før viktige internasjonale klimaforhandlinger. Saudi-Arabia var første land til å kreve etterforskning. Senere uavhengige undersøkelser—over et dusin totalt—fant at anklagene mot oss var grunnløse. Likevel fikk disse resultatene langt mindre mediedekning enn den opprinnelige 'skandalen'. Selv etter å ha blitt renvasket av National Science Foundations generalinspektør og fått medhold i Virginias høyesterett når det gjelder utlevering av mine dokumenter, har kontroversen vedvart. Betydelige ressurser, tid og energi brukt på å forsvare seg kunne heller vært brukt på å takle de reelle konsekvensene av klimaendringer, som å beskytte kystsamfunn. Disse utfordringene førte til at jeg delte min historie i boken «The Hockey Stick and the Climate Wars: Dispatches from the Front Lines». Allerede før boken kom ut prøvde industrigrupper å diskreditere meg og mitt arbeid gjennom kampanjer og offentlige stunt. Som svar fortsetter klimaforskere med forskningen sin og øker innsatsen for å kommunisere med publikum og forsvare seg mot juridiske utfordringer. Initiativer som Climate Science Rapid Response Team, Climate Science Legal Defense Fund og arbeidet til Union of Concerned Scientists har som mål å beskytte forskere og fremme bedre forståelse for klimaendringer. Jeg begynte med klimaforskning for å gjøre noe meningsfylt, ikke for å havne i offentlig kontrovers. Som både forsker og far ønsker jeg å sikre en sunn, levelig planet for neste generasjon. Vi skylder barna våre en politisk og næringslivsdebatt basert på vitenskapelig virkelighet. Synspunktene som uttrykkes her er mine alene—Michael Mann.

article_content: Debbie McCann, a 48-year-old grandmother from Glasgow, unexpectedly developed an Italian-sounding accent after suffering a minor stroke—even though she has never visited Italy. Before her stroke in November last year, she spoke with a strong Glaswegian accent. In the following weeks, she lost her ability to speak entirely, then later regained her speech with a voice she did not recognize. Debbie was diagnosed with Foreign Accent Syndrome (FAS), a rare neurological condition thought to affect around 60 people worldwide. FAS can alter an individual’s speech patterns after a brain injury, stroke, or migraine, causing them to sound as if they have a foreign accent. Initially, Debbie’s new accent was described as Chinese, but over time it shifted and now sounds more Italian to people around her. She says, 'For the first two weeks, I couldn't speak, which was extremely frustrating. When my voice returned, I sounded Chinese. Now, people tell me I sound Italian, but I've never even been to Italy or China.' Her unusual speech has left her embarrassed and anxious in social situations. Debbie shares, 'I'm undergoing speech therapy and every day I hope my old voice will return. At first we laughed, but now it’s a nightmare.' Now, she only shops where she is known, and avoids speaking on the phone because she has to explain her condition. Debbie’s daughter, Julieanne, recalls the onset: her mother’s hands started shaking, her speech became slurred, and she slumped to one side before being taken to hospital. Although MRI scans and tests were inconclusive, doctors suspect a minor stroke. Debbie has lingering weakness on her right side, difficulty moving parts of her face, and sometimes omits words when writing. Julieanne observes: 'A year ago, she was outgoing and loved to talk. Her Glaswegian accent was a big part of her identity. Now, I often need to speak for her when we're out.' Foreign Accent Syndrome was first identified in the 1940s, after a Norwegian woman began speaking with a German accent following a shrapnel injury. Dr. Anja Lowitt from Strathclyde University, an expert in FAS, explains, 'FAS is extremely rare and usually follows brain injuries like strokes. The disorder alters speech to mimic features of foreign accents—often those listeners recognize best. Unfortunately, there is no known cure. For some, it fades over time, but for others, it may be permanent depending on the severity and the brain’s recovery.'

Debbie ble diagnostisert med Foreign Accent Syndrome (FAS), en sjelden nevrologisk tilstand som antas å ramme rundt 60 personer på verdensbasis. FAS kan endre en persons talemønster etter en hodeskade, et slag eller migrene, slik at de høres ut som om de snakker med en utenlandsk aksent. I begynnelsen ble Debbies nye aksent beskrevet som kinesisk, men etter hvert oppfatter folk henne som mer italiensk. Hun sier: 'De to første ukene klarte jeg ikke å snakke, noe som var utrolig frustrerende. Da stemmen kom tilbake, hørtes jeg kinesisk ut. Nå sier folk at jeg høres italiensk ut, men jeg har aldri vært i verken Italia eller Kina.' Den uvanlige aksenten har gjort henne flau og nervøs i sosiale sammenhenger. Debbie forteller: 'Jeg går til taleterapi, og hver dag håper jeg at min gamle stemme kommer tilbake. I begynnelsen lo vi av det, men nå er det et mareritt.' Nå handler hun bare på steder hvor hun er kjent, og unngår å snakke i telefonen fordi hun stadig må forklare tilstanden. Debbies datter, Julieanne, husker starten: Morens hender begynte å skjelve, talen ble sløret og hun falt til siden før hun ble tatt med til sykehuset. Selv om MR og tester var uklare, mistenker legene at hun hadde et mildt slag. Debbie har fortsatt svakhet i høyre side, vanskeligheter med ansiktsbevegelser, og utelater ofte ord når hun skriver. Taleforstyrrelsen gir trekk fra utenlandske aksenter—ofte de lytteren gjenkjenner best. Dessverre finnes det ingen kjent kur. For noen går det over med tiden, men for andre kan det være varig, avhengig av hvor alvorlig skaden er og hvordan hjernen leges.'

article_content: In a series of high-profile votes reflecting partisan divides, the U.S. Senate rejected both Democratic and Republican proposals aimed at bolstering infrastructure development. The Democratic bill proposed approximately $50 billion for infrastructure projects and an additional $10 billion to establish an infrastructure bank, funded through a surtax on individuals earning over $1 million annually. Republicans opposed the surtax, arguing it would negatively impact small businesses and result in reduced hiring. Democrats have repeatedly promoted the surtax to emphasize their position that Republicans favor wealthy constituents over addressing unemployment. Republicans dispute this narrative, maintaining that the tax would hurt small businesses most. The White House criticized Senate Republicans, describing their position as 'out of touch with Americans from all ends of the political spectrum.' The administration emphasized that the bill was fully funded and similar to proposals previously supported by many senators, enjoying strong public support across party lines. In a parallel move, Senate Democrats rejected a GOP infrastructure measure that aimed to expedite projects by loosening regulations. Democrats opposed the plan's funding approach, which relied on rescinding $40 billion in previously approved spending—a move they said violated budget agreements made during recent debt-ceiling talks. Both bills failed to achieve the 60 votes required for passage. The Democratic proposal was defeated 51-49, with Democrats Joe Lieberman (Connecticut) and Ben Nelson (Nebraska) joining Republicans in opposition. The Republican proposal was rejected 53-47, with Democrat Joe Manchin (West Virginia) supporting it and Republican Olympia Snowe (Maine) voting against. Notably, both Manchin and Snowe are facing challenging re-election campaigns. Separately, House Speaker John Boehner introduced plans for another infrastructure bill in the House. This GOP-led measure would tie infrastructure funding to expanded domestic energy production, using new revenue from energy development to finance infrastructure projects nationwide. Boehner framed the approach as an alternative to traditional stimulus, focusing on lasting job growth through energy reform and infrastructure investment. Although specifics of the bill were not yet available, Boehner expressed optimism about advancing the legislation before year’s end and invited presidential cooperation. CNN Congressional Correspondent Kate Bolduan contributed to this report.

Det demokratiske forslaget innebar rundt 50 milliarder dollar til infrastrukturprosjekter og ytterligere 10 milliarder dollar for å etablere en infrastruktur-bank, finansiert gjennom en ekstraskatt på personer som tjener over 1 million dollar årlig. Republikanerne motsatte seg ekstraskatten og hevdet den ville ramme småbedrifter negativt og redusere ansettelser. Demokratene har gjentatte ganger foreslått ekstraskatten for å understreke sitt syn om at republikanerne prioriterer velstående velgere over å bekjempe arbeidsløshet. Republikanerne avviser dette, og hevder at skatten først og fremst ville skade småbedrifter. Det hvite hus kritiserte senatets republikanere og beskrev deres holdning som 'ute av takt med amerikanere fra hele det politiske spekteret.' Administrasjonen fremhevet at forslaget var fullt finansiert og lik tidligere støttede forslag med bred folkelig oppslutning på tvers av partilinjer. I et parallelt trekk avviste senatets demokrater et republikansk infrastrukturinitiativ som tok sikte på å fremskynde prosjektene ved å lette på reglene. Demokratene motsatte seg finansieringsplanen, som var basert på å trekke tilbake 40 milliarder dollar i tidligere godkjente utgifter – noe de mente brøt avtaler inngått under de siste forhandlingene om gjeldstaket. Ingen av forslagene nådde de nødvendige 60 stemmene for vedtak. Det demokratiske forslaget falt med 51 mot 49 stemmer, hvor demokratene Joe Lieberman (Connecticut) og Ben Nelson (Nebraska) stemte sammen med republikanerne. Det republikanske forslaget ble forkastet med 53 mot 47 stemmer, hvor demokraten Joe Manchin (West Virginia) stemte for og republikaneren Olympia Snowe (Maine) stemte mot. Både Manchin og Snowe står foran krevende gjenvalgskampanjer. Uavhengig av dette introduserte speaker i Representantenes hus, John Boehner, planer om et nytt infrastrukturforslag. Dette republikanske forslaget vil knytte infrastrukturfinansiering til økt innenlandsk energiproduksjon, og bruke nye inntekter fra energisektoren til å finansiere prosjekter over hele landet. Boehner presenterte tiltaket som et alternativ til tradisjonelle stimuleringspakker – med vekt på varig jobbskaping gjennom energireform og investeringer i infrastruktur. Det foreligger ennå få detaljer, men Boehner uttrykte optimisme for å få loven videreført før årets slutt og inviterte presidenten til samarbeid. CNNs kongresskorrespondent Kate Bolduan har bidratt til denne rapporten.

article_content: McDonald's Australia is releasing bottled versions of its famous Big Mac Special Sauce for charity, sparking big demand online. Fans and opportunistic buyers are reselling small 25ml sealed tubs, which cost only 50 cents in-store, for nearly $8 each on Ebay. Some sellers are even offering entire cases for bids above $49 with international shipping available. A single official bottle of the sauce, one of only 200 being made, has drawn bids over $23,000 AUD on Ebay. None of these bottles will be available in restaurants, which adds to their rarity. Money raised from these auctions supports Ronald McDonald House Charities to help children and families in need. Although the special sauce’s recipe was a secret for years, McDonald’s revealed a homemade version in 2012, using common condiments like mayonnaise, mustard, relish, vinegar, and spices. With growing competition from chains like Chipotle and Shake Shack and recent setbacks, McDonald’s is employing charity efforts and exclusive products to boost customer interest and address declining profits.

article_content: Jimmy Leeward, a 74-year-old stunt pilot and aviation community leader, is presumed dead after crashing during a Nevada air show. Leeward owned Leeward Ranch, a 500-acre gated community for pilots in Ocala, Florida, where residents build custom homes with hangars and can fly directly from their houses. Inspired by his father, Leeward began developing the community in the 1980s with his sons; it now has over 170 homes. After the tragic crash, condolences were posted to Leeward's Facebook page. His family expressed their grief, asking for prayers for all those affected. Leeward was piloting a P-51 Mustang in the Reno air race on Friday when he lost control and crashed. Witnesses credited his skillful flying with helping to limit injuries on the ground. Fred Scholz, a witness, commented that Leeward narrowly avoided the crowd, steering into a less populated area. The son of a pilot, Leeward worked as a stunt pilot on films such as 'Amelia' and 'The Tuskegee Airmen', and was a regular participant in the Reno air races since 1975. Mike Houghton, president of the Reno Air Racing Association, remembered Leeward as a respected aviator and great family man.

Inspirert av sin far startet Leeward utviklingen av området på 1980-tallet sammen med sønnene sine; i dag har det over 170 boliger. article_content:
Ukraine's military is focused on disrupting Russian military logistics throughout the winter, aiming to make Russian troops so uncomfortable that their will to fight weakens. Volodymyr Fitio, spokesperson for Ukraine's Ground Forces Command, told television audiences—per the Kyiv Post—that the principal objective is to leave Russian forces in Ukraine cold, hungry, and demotivated. Fitio noted that "the enemy should expect surprises from the sky" and emphasized that all efforts should assist Ukraine's armed forces while hindering Russian occupiers.

Earlier this month, Fitio described Ukraine's winter strategy as cutting off Russian supply chains to "freeze them out." Typically, colder weather slows down conflicts; last winter, neither Ukraine nor Russia made major advances as Ukraine resisted Russia's invasion. Still, Fitio highlighted plans to capitalize on the period, despite challenges such as snow, mud, and ice affecting troop movement.

Last winter, Russia strengthened its defensive networks and deployed extensive landmines, making Ukraine one of the most heavily mined countries and hampering Ukraine’s counteroffensive, which started in June. Russia also attacked Ukraine's energy infrastructure last winter with missiles and drones, leading to civilian deaths and forcing Ukraine to establish heating stations. Ukraine and its allies anticipate similar attacks this winter.

Dr. Jack Watling, a land warfare expert at the Royal United Services Institute, explained that winter offers Ukraine a chance to "maximize Russian losses," noting high Russian casualties last season despite having firepower superiority. He warned that if Ukraine does not maintain pressure on Russian positions during winter, Russia could expand its defensive lines.

Ukrainas militære styrker fokuserer denne vinteren på å forstyrre russisk militær logistikk, med mål om å gjøre russiske soldater så ukomfortable at viljen til å kjempe svekkes. Volodymyr Fitio, talsperson for Ukrainas bakkestyrkekommando, sa på TV – ifølge Kyiv Post – at hovedmålet er å gjøre russiske styrker i Ukraina kalde, sultne og demotiverte. Fitio uttalte at «fienden bør forvente overraskelser fra himmelen», og understreket at alle tiltak skal støtte Ukrainas forsvar samtidig som de skader russiske okkupanter.

Tidligere denne måneden beskrev Fitio Ukrainas vinterstrategi som å kutte Russlands forsyningslinjer for å «fryse dem ut». Vanligvis bremser kaldt vær konflikter; forrige vinter gjorde verken Ukraina eller Russland noen store fremskritt, mens Ukraina motsatte seg Russlands invasjon. Fitio fremhevet at Ukraina fortsatt vil utnytte vinterperioden, selv om snø, gjørme og is kan gjøre troppemanøvrer vanskeligere.

Forrige vinter styrket Russland sine forsvarslinjer og la ut omfattende minefelt, noe som gjorde Ukraina til et av verdens mest gjennomminerte land og hemmet Ukrainas motoffensiv som startet i juni. Russland angrep også ukrainsk energiinfrastruktur med missiler og droner, noe som førte til sivile dødsfall og gjorde det nødvendig å etablere varmestasjoner. Ukraina og allierte forventer lignende angrep denne vinteren.

Dr. Jack Watling, ekspert på landkrigføring ved Royal United Services Institute, påpekte at vinteren gir Ukraina mulighet til å «maksimere russiske tap», og bemerket at de russiske tapene var store i fjor, selv med ildoverlegenhet. Han advarte om at dersom Ukraina ikke fortsetter å presse russiske linjer gjennom vinteren, kan Russland utvide sitt forsvar ytterligere.

Imran Khan, the former prime minister of Pakistan and current opposition leader, continues to be held in jail, despite court rulings that favor him in some cases. Recently, the Islamabad High Court ruled that holding Khan’s trial in prison for allegedly leaking state secrets—the so-called 'cypher case'—was unlawful. Nonetheless, Khan stays in custody due to multiple pending charges, including a conviction over the sale of state gifts after his removal from office by a parliamentary vote in 2022.

At age 71, Khan leads the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party. He was arrested in August and sentenced to three years, but although he received bail after several weeks, he was swiftly rearrested as new charges surfaced. Khan maintains the cases against him are part of a coordinated political campaign to keep him from returning to power, blaming figures within the military and hinting at foreign interference—claims vehemently denied by both the US and Pakistani authorities.

Legal experts note the High Court called for greater transparency in the legal process, emphasizing that even if security concerns justify a trial inside jail, the proceedings must follow the principles of a public or open trial. There are also concerns for Khan’s well-being since he has faced two assassination attempts since 2022.

The Supreme Court has accepted Khan’s bail application but has yet to announce a hearing date. Observers expect delays in Khan’s release since overlapping legal charges could continuously enable his detention. Experts suggest authorities may still appeal recent court rulings, ensuring that legal, political, and public interest in the case remains high.

Likevel forblir Khan i varetekt på grunn av flere pågående saker, inkludert en dom for salg av statlige gaver etter at han ble avsatt ved et mistillitsvotum i nasjonalforsamlingen i 2022.

Khan, som er 71 år gammel og leder partiet Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), ble arrestert i august og dømt til tre års fengsel. Selv etter at han fikk innvilget kausjon noen uker senere, ble han umiddelbart arrestert igjen da nye anklager dukket opp. Khan hevder at sakene mot ham er ledd i en koordinert politisk kampanje for å hindre ham i å komme tilbake til makten, og han beskylder personer i militæret samt antyder utenlandsk innblanding – påstander både amerikanske og pakistanske myndigheter avviser.

Juridiske eksperter påpeker at High Court har understreket behovet for økt åpenhet, og at en eventuell rettssak i fengsel må oppfylle kriteriene for en offentlig rettshøring. Det er også uro rundt Khans sikkerhet, ettersom han har vært utsatt for to attentatforsøk siden 2022.

Høyesterett har tatt imot Khans kausjonssøknad, men har foreløpig ikke satt noen dato for behandling. Observatører tror det fortsatt vil gå tid før Khan eventuelt løslates, siden pågående rettssaker gjør det mulig å holde ham fengslet. Eksperter mener myndighetene kan komme til å anke de siste rettsavgjørelsene, noe som gjør at både politisk og offentlig interesse i saken forblir høy.

article_content: Parents often rely on playful acts like peek-a-boo, tickling, or blowing raspberries to make their babies laugh, but rarely do they pause to consider why these actions are so amusing to infants. Dr. Caspar Addyman, a research fellow at Birkbeck University's BabyLab, is leading an extensive investigation into what triggers laughter in babies—and why. Dr. Addyman, formerly a banker and now a psychologist, is so dedicated to this field that he is self-funding his research despite not having children himself. At the heart of his study are comprehensive questionnaires for parents, along with requests for them to share videos and anecdotes of their babies laughing. The project has already gathered input from 1,400 parents across 25 countries. These parents answered questions about when their babies are most likely to laugh, which toys and nursery rhymes amuse them, and even whether their children find their mother or father funnier. Researchers are also examining if there’s a link between babies who laugh easily and those with a calm temperament. Interestingly, Dr. Addyman reports that laughter appears much earlier in infants than commonly thought—about 90% have smiled by two months old and many begin to laugh not long after. Some infants even laugh unmistakably within just a few weeks of birth, though a small number reportedly did not laugh at all in their first year. This variation might speak to inborn differences in temperament. Mothers and fathers seem equally likely to make their child laugh, but boys are reported to have slightly more frequent laughs, with some data showing boys laugh up to 50 times daily compared to 37 times for girls. Dr. Addyman notes parental interaction may reinforce this difference. He explains that while crying signals a need for change, laughter and smiling instead encourage parents to continue what they’re doing. For babies, these are their primary forms of communication in the first year. Touch, particularly tickling, is one of the earliest and most effective ways to make babies laugh, having deep evolutionary roots tied to social bonding and pleasure. Even anticipation before being tickled can amuse infants. Babies often burst into giggles when seeing themselves in mirrors, though research shows they don’t recognize their own reflection until about 18 months. Instead, they find humor in the playful mimicry that defies normal social interaction. Bathtime is another common trigger for laughter, likely because of the caregiver’s focused attention and the comforting, sensory aspects of warm water. Peek-a-boo consistently remains a top favorite game for baby laughter worldwide. It engages babies due to its interactive nature and the element of surprise, which over time develops into joyful anticipation. As they grow, children begin to adapt the game themselves, reflecting cognitive and social development. Toys such as dolls and puppets are particularly funny to babies, perhaps because of the amusing way these objects mimic real-life behavior when parents are involved in the play. Simple toys like rattles also delight infants, whether they’re making the noise themselves or watching someone else do it, providing a sense of cause-and-effect as well as sensory stimulation. According to Dr. Addyman, these early laughter experiences help foster stronger bonds between parents and children while offering valuable insight into early childhood cognitive and social development.
translated_content: Foreldre bruker ofte lekne aktiviteter som tittebø, kiling eller å lage morsomme lyder for å få babyen til å le, men de færreste tenker over hvorfor akkurat dette er så morsomt for små barn. Dr. Caspar Addyman, forsker ved BabyLab på Birkbeck University, leder en omfattende studie som undersøker hva som får babyer til å le—og hvorfor. Dr. Addyman, som tidligere jobbet i bank og nå er psykolog, er så engasjert i feltet at han finansierer forskningen selv, til tross for at han ikke har egne barn. Forskningen involverer detaljerte spørreskjemaer til foreldre, samt at de blir bedt om å sende inn videoer og beskrivelser av situasjoner hvor babyen ler. Prosjektet har samlet inn data fra 1 400 foreldre fra 25 land. Foreldrene har svart på spørsmål om når babyene deres oftest ler, hvilke leker og sanger de synes er morsomst, og om de oppfatter mor eller far som mer morsom. Forskerne ser også på om det er en sammenheng mellom babyer som ler lett og de som har et rolig lynne. Interessant nok har Dr. Addyman funnet at latter dukker opp mye tidligere enn mange tror—omtrent 90 % smiler innen to måneder og mange begynner å le ikke lenge etter. Noen babyer ler tydelig allerede etter noen få uker, mens et fåtall ikke ler det første året. Dette kan tyde på medfødte forskjeller i temperament. Mødre og fedre har omtrent like store sjanser for å få barnet sitt til å le, men gutter sies å le litt oftere—opptil 50 ganger om dagen mot jenters 37 ganger daglig. Dr. Addyman påpeker at foreldres adferd kan påvirke dette. Han forklarer at mens gråt signaliserer et behov for endring, oppmuntrer latter og smil foreldre til å fortsette det de gjør. Disse uttrykksformene er barnas viktigste kommunikasjon det første året. Berøring, spesielt kiling, er en av de tidligste og mest effektive måtene å få babyer til å le på, og har dype evolusjonære røtter koblet til sosial tilhørighet og glede. Selv forventningen om å bli kilt kan gjøre små barn lattermilde. Babyer ler ofte når de ser seg selv i speilet, selv om forskning viser at de ikke gjenkjenner sitt eget speilbilde før de er rundt 18 måneder gamle. De synes det er morsomt fordi den leende speilbildet bryter vanlige sosiale forventninger. Badeøyeblikk er også ofte kilde til latter, trolig fordi omsorgspersonen gir full oppmerksomhet og fordi varmt vann gir en trygg og sanselig opplevelse. Tittebø er fortsatt en klar favoritt for å fremkalle babylatter verden over. Det fenger fordi det er interaktivt og overraskende, og etter hvert utvikler det seg til forventningsfylt glede. Når babyen blir eldre, kan de ta rollen selv, noe som viser utvikling både kognitivt og sosialt. Bamser og dukker er særlig morsomme for småbarn, kanskje fordi de oppfatter dukkene som levende i lek med foreldrene. Også enkle leker som rangler gir stor glede, enten babyen lager lyden selv eller ser noen andre gjøre det; her opplever barnet både årsak-virkning og sansemessig stimulans. Ifølge Dr. Addyman bidrar tidlige opplevelser av latter til å styrke båndet mellom foreldre og barn, samtidig som det gir verdifull innsikt i barns tidlige kognitive og sosiale utvikling.

article_content: Security guards rescued a family of dogs that became stranded on a 180-meter-high glass bridge at the renowned Shiniuzhai Scenic Spot in Hunan Province, China. The dogs, including several puppies, were frightened while attempting to cross a 10-meter section of the bridge covered with newly installed glass panels. The animals had followed tourists onto the suspension bridge, which has recently gained popularity due to its unique glass flooring. Security guard Xiong Yin, 35, reported that while some dogs were unfazed, others refused to cross the glass out of fear. Because the dogs were small and there was a risk they could fall, the guards decided to safely remove them. The dogs had attracted significant attention from visitors, who took photos with them, but their presence on the bridge was deemed dangerous. Xiong Yin suggested that the dogs followed tourists who had been feeding them and hoped to receive more food. The Shiniuzhai Footbridge, measuring 300 meters in length and 180 meters in height, is among the tallest glass bridges in the world. The glass floor was installed earlier this year, with plans for further expansion. The area is known for its stunning rock formations and has additional attractions, including a cable car introduced in 2009 and extensive cliffwalks. In 2012, tightrope walker Aisikaier survived a fall while attempting a 600-meter walk across the valley blindfolded and walking backward; his fall was cushioned by trees, allowing him to escape unharmed.

Dyrene hadde fulgt turister ut på hengebroen, som har blitt stadig mer populær på grunn av det spesielle glassgulvet. article_content: Police chiefs are dedicating approximately 3,000 hours and £64,000 to gather statements from 800 officers as part of the Plebgate investigation. Every member of the elite SO6 diplomatic protection group will be questioned about their knowledge of the incident, which led to the resignation of Conservative Chief Whip Andrew Mitchell. According to the Daily Mirror, a team of 30 officers from the Metropolitan Police's Directorate of Professional Standards is investigating whether a conspiracy was formed against Mr. Mitchell. Metropolitan Police Commissioner Bernard Hogan-Howe returned from holiday to oversee the inquiry amid claims that Mr. Mitchell was the victim of a police set-up. The investigation, named Operation Alice, will ask officers whether they fabricated evidence or leaked details to the press. The controversy began when an officer told Mr. Mitchell to dismount his bicycle as he left Downing Street. Officers allege Mr. Mitchell called them 'plebs', using offensive language, a charge he denies. Last month, 52-year-old Keith Wallis, a diplomatic protection officer, was arrested on suspicion of misconduct for allegedly sending an email to an MP, falsely claiming to be a member of the public who witnessed the incident. Labour MP Steve McCabe criticized the probe, arguing that resources could be better spent and suggesting Mr. Mitchell should clarify matters himself, especially during an era of police budget cuts and security concerns. CCTV footage reportedly raised questions regarding officer Toby Rowland’s account of the incident, showing Mr. Rowland escorting Mr. Mitchell from a side gate but not evidencing a heated confrontation. Another source quoted in the media described the investigation as a 'witch hunt.' The Metropolitan Police say the purpose of Operation Alice is to examine the circumstances of the incident, determine whether there is evidence of conspiracy among officers or others, and identify any possible criminal or misconduct offenses. A police spokesperson stated that, given the seriousness of the allegations, a thorough and proportionate investigation is essential, that the inquiry continues with urgency and objectivity, and declined to specify individuals involved in interviews. Comments on this case are not being accepted due to legal reasons.
translated_content: Politiledelsen bruker omtrent 3 000 timer og £64 000 på å innhente forklaringer fra 800 betjenter som del av Plebgate-etterforskningen. Alle medlemmer av den eksklusive SO6 diplomatiske beskyttelsesgruppen blir avhørt om deres kunnskap om hendelsen, som førte til at den konservative Chief Whip Andrew Mitchell måtte gå av. Ifølge Daily Mirror etterforsker et team på 30 tjenestemenn fra Metropolitan Police's Directorate of Professional Standards om det fantes en konspirasjon mot Mitchell. Politimester Bernard Hogan-Howe i Metropolitan Police avbrøt ferien sin for å lede etterforskningen, etter påstander om at Mitchell ble utsatt for en felle iscenesatt av politiet. Etterforskningen, kalt Operation Alice, vil undersøke om betjenter har fabrikkert bevis eller lekket detaljer til pressen. Kontroversen startet da en betjent ba Mitchell stige av sykkelen da han forlot Downing Street. Betjentene påstår at Mitchell kalte dem «plebs» og brukte grovt språk, noe han selv benekter. I forrige måned ble 52 år gamle Keith Wallis, en offiser i den diplomatiske beskyttelsesenheten, arrestert mistenkt for tjenestefeil etter at han skal ha sendt en e-post til en parlamentsmedlem der han uriktig hevdet å være et vitne til hendelsen. Labour-parlamentsmedlem Steve McCabe har kritisert etterforskningen, mente ressursene kunne vært brukt bedre, og foreslo at Mitchell selv burde oppklare saken — spesielt med tanke på politibudsjettkutt og bekymringer rundt sikkerhet. CCTV-opptak skal ha stilt spørsmål ved betjent Toby Rowlands forklaring, og viser at Rowland fulgte Mitchell ut av en sideport, uten tegn til noen hissig konfrontasjon. En annen kilde omtaler etterforskningen som en «heksejakt». Metropolitan Police sier formålet med Operation Alice er å undersøke omstendighetene rundt hendelsen, finne ut om det finnes bevis for sammensvergelse mellom tjenestemenn eller andre, og om mulige straffbare eller kritikkverdige forhold er til stede. En polititalsmann sier at det er avgjørende med en grundig og proporsjonal etterforskning, at arbeidet pågår med styrke og objektivitet, men at de ikke vil kommentere hvem som eventuelt skal avhøres. Kommentarer til denne saken godtas ikke av juridiske årsaker.

article_content: In Leicestershire, a series of attacks have left cyclists injured after a silver BMW was seen intentionally pushing riders off their bikes. Within a week, three cyclists have fallen victim to these incidents, each reporting that a passenger in the car shoved them while passing. The most recent case involved 55-year-old Andy Limb, a lorry driver from Stoney Stanton, who suffered a broken collarbone after being forced off the road at speed. His injuries will keep him from work for three months, disrupting both his job and holiday plans. Limb shared how the car pulled up beside him with no warning before a passenger caused his crash. Just days before, Martin Webster, who owns a bike shop in Wigston, was also targeted. While riding quickly, he was pushed onto a verge, sustaining bruises and scrapes. Webster voiced concerns about the potential for serious harm. Earlier that week, Colin Haynes, 48, from North Kilworth, endured the same threat. The pattern involved a silver BMW approaching and a passenger reaching out to shove the cyclist. As a result, many in the cycling community have grown anxious, with some openly fearing for their safety. Victims warn that the attackers could easily cause fatal injuries. Leicestershire Police are investigating, highlighting the similarities between the attacks, and urging witnesses to assist. Authorities have stressed they are treating the series of incidents with utmost seriousness.

article_content: Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs describes ties with China as 'extremely important,' but firmly dismisses China's demands for both an apology and compensation over the recent detention of a Chinese fishing boat captain. Issuing a statement on Saturday, Japanese officials emphasized their jurisdiction over the disputed islands where the incident occurred, stressing that the case was managed according to Japanese law. Zhan Qixiong, captain of the Chinese trawler involved, was detained earlier this month following a collision with Japanese patrol vessels near disputed islands in the East China Sea. Zhan was freed on Friday. Japanese Foreign Ministry spokesman Satoru Sato gave similar comments to Kyodo News regarding China's call for an apology. Despite the friction, China's Foreign Ministry expressed, through state media, that all issues should be settled via dialogue and consultation. Xinhua News Agency reported that Zhan faced accusations of interfering with Japanese officials in the line of duty and confirmed his safe return on Saturday. Japanese prosecutors stated that the charges were dropped in light of the Japan-China diplomatic relationship. The episode has heightened tensions, with Beijing denouncing Japan's detention of the captain and crew as unlawful and invalid, according to Xinhua. China claims sovereignty over the Diaoyu Islands and significant parts of the South China Sea, while Japan calls the islands Senkaku. This ongoing territorial dispute over lands and resources remains a flashpoint. Shortly after Zhan's release, four Japanese citizens were detained in China for unauthorized entry into a restricted military zone and recording military sites, per Chinese media. Authorities from both nations insist these cases are not connected. Kyung Lah of CNN added reporting on this developing story.
translated_content: Japans utenriksdepartement beskriver forholdet til Kina som 'svært viktig', men avviser bestemt Kinas krav om både en unnskyldning og kompensasjon etter den nylige pågripelsen av en kinesisk fiskebåtkaptein. I en uttalelse lørdag understreket japanske myndigheter sitt jurisdiksjonsområde over de omstridte øyene der hendelsen skjedde, og presiserte at saken ble håndtert i samsvar med japansk lov. Zhan Qixiong, kaptein på den kinesiske tråleren som var involvert, ble pågrepet tidligere denne måneden etter en kollisjon med japanske patruljebåter nær de omstridte øyene i Østkinahavet. Zhan ble løslatt fredag. Talsmann for det japanske utenriksdepartementet, Satoru Sato, ga lignende kommentarer til Kyodo News angående Kinas krav om en unnskyldning. Til tross for spenningene uttrykte Kinas utenriksdepartement via statlige medier at alle problemer bør løses gjennom dialog og konsultasjoner. Nyhetsbyrået Xinhua rapporterte at Zhan ble anklaget for å ha hindret japanske tjenestemenn i utførelsen av arbeid, og bekreftet at han kom trygt hjem lørdag. Japanske påtalemyndigheter uttalte at siktelsene ble frafalt med hensyn til Japan-Kina-forholdet. Episoden har forsterket spenningene mellom landene. Beijing fordømmer Japans pågripelse av kapteinen og mannskapet som ulovlig og ugyldig, ifølge Xinhua. Kina gjør krav på Diaoyu-øyene og store deler av Sørkinahavet, mens Japan kaller øyene Senkaku. Den langvarige territorielle konflikten om landområder og ressurser er fortsatt et betent tema. Kort tid etter Zhans løslatelse ble fire japanske statsborgere arrestert i Kina for ulovlig inntrenging i et militært begrenset område og for filming av militære anlegg, ifølge kinesiske medier. Myndighetene i begge land hevder at sakene ikke er knyttet til hverandre. Kyung Lah fra CNN bidro med ytterligere rapportering om saken.

The U.S. Department of Education has expressed worry that student-loan borrowers could seek legal remedies if ongoing issues with their accounts remain unsolved. In an internal memo from Federal Student Aid, officials requested Under Secretary James Kvaal’s approval for steps to fix errors that have affected borrowers as repayment resumes.

On October 29, the memo was issued—just a day before the department announced plans to withhold payment from loan servicer MOHELA, which had failed to deliver billing statements on time to 2.5 million borrowers. The memo detailed several servicing mistakes: about 78,000 borrowers received inaccurate monthly bills during the switch to the new SAVE income-driven repayment plan; 153,000 did not receive their new payment information until after payments were already due; and roughly 21,000 people got incorrect or excessively high billing statements, with a few exceeding $100,000 per month.

FSA’s memo cautioned that, unless these problems are thoroughly corrected, harmed borrowers could file lawsuits against both the servicers and the Department. Federal and state regulators are already examining servicers and could order more remedies or impose fines if they find the issues haven’t been handled, potentially citing violations of consumer protection laws.

While certain types of claims against the Department are legally barred, lawsuits against servicers could still disrupt future loan servicing. The department’s remedy steps include putting affected borrowers into administrative forbearance with zero interest accrual, crediting those months toward loan forgiveness, and requiring servicers to refund payments made on incorrect statements and reprocess repayment plan applications.

Some borrowers have reported being charged more than expected or being billed after their debt was paid off, considering legal action because of these errors. The Department of Education has committed to maintaining strict oversight of loan servicers to prevent further borrower harm.

FSA Director Richard Cordray emphasized that protecting borrowers and fixing the student loan system is a priority. He asserted that FSA’s monitoring detected the errors and enabled quick corrective actions, reaffirming their intent to hold servicers accountable and correct borrower issues.

Det amerikanske utdanningsdepartementet har uttrykt bekymring for at studielåns-mottakere kan gå til rettslige skritt dersom pågående problemer med kontoene deres ikke blir løst. I et internt notat fra Federal Student Aid ba tjenestemenn undersekretær James Kvaal om å godkjenne tiltak for å rette opp feil som har rammet låntakere nå som tilbakebetalingen starter opp igjen.

Notatet ble sendt 29. oktober, dagen før departementet kunngjorde at de ville holde tilbake betaling til låneselskapet MOHELA, som hadde unnlatt å sende ut regninger til 2,5 millioner låntakere i tide. Notatet beskrev flere feil: Omtrent 78.000 låntakere mottok feilaktige månedlige regninger under overgangen til den nye inntektsbaserte SAVE-ordningen; 153.000 fikk ikke betalingsinformasjon før etter forfallsdatoen; og rundt 21.000 fikk enten gale eller ekstremt høye regninger, noen på over 100.000 dollar per måned.

FSA advarte i notatet at dersom disse problemene ikke blir rettet opp, kan berørte låntakere saksøke både låneservicerne og departementet. Føderale og statlige tilsynsmyndigheter gransker allerede servicerne og kan kreve flere tiltak eller gi bøter dersom de finner at problemene ikke er løst—kanskje med henvisning til brudd på forbrukerbeskyttelseslover.

Selv om enkelte krav mot departementet er juridisk avskjermet, kan søksmål mot servicerne fortsatt komplisere fremtidig låneforvaltning. Tiltakene inkluderer å sette berørte låntakere i administrativ betalingsutsettelse uten renter, gi måneder med betalingsutsettelse tellende mot gjeldslette, samt å kreve at servicerne tilbakebetaler uriktige innbetalinger og behandler søknader om inntektsbasert tilbakebetaling på nytt.

Noen låntakere har rapportert å ha blitt belastet mer enn forventet eller fakturert etter at lånet var nedbetalt, og vurderer søksmål som følge av feilene. Utdanningsdepartementet har forpliktet seg til streng oppfølging av servicerne for å unngå ytterligere skade for låntakerne.

FSA-direktør Richard Cordray understreket at det å beskytte låntakere og forbedre studielånsystemet er en topp prioritet. Han sa at FSAs hurtige overvåking gjorde det mulig å avdekke feilene og iverksette rask håndtering, og fastholder at servicerne skal holdes ansvarlige og låntakernes problemer rettes opp.

article_content: The conflict in Ukraine has seen a remarkable rise in the use of affordable hobby drones, which now threaten not only armored vehicles but also individual soldiers. These drones, packed with explosives, have made almost any movement on the battlefield hazardous. Experts warn that this growing reliance on drone warfare marks a grim shift in combat. Social media is increasingly filled with footage depicting drones targeting everything from tanks and supply trucks to dugouts and soldiers in trenches. These images underscore both the mounting human cost and the dramatic changes modern technology is bringing to the war. As the number of drones grows and more operators receive training, casualties have risen, and the frontlines have become more static. The drones' abilities to directly enter vulnerable points in vehicles or chase down soldiers cannot be matched by traditional weapons like missiles or shells. Samuel Bendett, a leading authority on military robotics, points out that the tactics involving these drones have evolved. Previously, FPV drone missions relied on surveillance to identify targets, but operators now often send drones out to autonomously locate and strike enemy positions. These drones, which may cost only a few hundred dollars and are armed with explosives, combine the functions previously fulfilled by snipers, missiles, and artillery. The success of these drones is heightened by the lack of air support close to the battlefront; if one drone fails, operators quickly launch another. The technology allows for extremely precise attacks, enabling pilots to direct drones into vulnerable spots like hatches and dugouts. While the videos publicly available capture just a portion of drone strikes, they frequently show significant destruction of valuable military assets. Ukraine and Russia are now both targeting each other’s drone operators—often using explosive drones themselves. The expansion of unmanned and FPV drones is bringing about a fundamental change in how fighting occurs. Although artillery fire remains vital, some Ukrainian troops admit to using drones far more than their rifles. This reliance signals a shift toward future warfare shaped by technology, where drones substitute for conventional arms. This new form of combat—with drones constantly observing and threatening movement—makes large-scale maneuvers exceedingly dangerous. Analysts say that both sides recognize that almost anything visible can quickly become a target for an FPV drone. This now appears to be the reality of war in Ukraine.

Sosiale medier er fylt med videoer som viser droner som angriper alt fra stridsvogner og forsyningsbiler til skyttergraver og soldater. Disse bildene understreker både de økende menneskelige tapene og de dramatisk nye teknologiske endringene i krigen. Antallet droner øker stadig, og flere operatører får opplæring. Dette fører til høyere tapstall og mer statiske frontlinjer. Dronenes evne til å trenge gjennom svake punkter på kjøretøy eller forfølge soldater kan ikke matches av tradisjonelle våpen som missiler eller granater. Samuel Bendett, en anerkjent ekspert på militærrobotikk, påpeker at taktikken har utviklet seg. Før ble FPV-droneslag utført etter overvåkning, men nå sendes droner ut for å finne og angripe mål på egen hånd. Disse dronene, som kan koste noen hundre dollar og er utstyrt med sprengstoff, fungerer både som snikskytter, missil og artilleri. Teknologien gir svært presise angrep, der piloten styrer dronen mot eksponerte punkter som luker og dekningsrom. Tilgjengelige videoer viser bare noe av dronebruken, men de dokumenterer ofte store tap av verdifullt utstyr. Ukraina og Russland prøver nå aktivt å eliminere hverandres droneoperatører—ofte med tilsvarende droner med sprengstoff. Spredningen av ubemannede og FPV-droner endrer grunnleggende hvordan slagene utkjempes. Denne typen krigføring, der droner kontinuerlig overvåker og truer enhver bevegelse, gjør større militære bevegelser ekstremt farlige. Analytikere mener begge sider nå vet at alt og alle som beveger seg, raskt kan bli mål for en FPV-drone. Dette er virkeligheten i Ukraina-krigen akkurat nå.

article_content: PC Richard Seymour, a police officer, is suing shop owner Stuart Lambley for £10,000 after injuring himself during a callout to the owner's business. Seymour claims he tore his Achilles tendon when he fell into an uncovered drain while investigating a break-in at Lambley's shop at 4 a.m. in March last year, resulting in four months in a cast and a total six-month absence from work. Despite remaining on full pay, Seymour alleges he lost overtime and missed opportunities for special duties during the London 2012 Olympics, which he describes as a 'bitter disappointment.' Lambley, owner of Maidenhead Aquatics in West Horsley, Surrey, expressed shock upon receiving the legal notice, stating that as a victim of repeated burglaries, he now hesitates to call the police for help for fear of being sued. He criticized the lawsuit as 'ridiculous' and 'disgusting,' noting that police officers accept certain risks as part of their job. This case follows another similar incident where WPC Kelly Jones sued a petrol station owner for injuries sustained during a break-in investigation—an action that also drew public criticism. Surrey Police Chief Constable Lynne Owens stated that the force does not support Seymour’s private claim and will launch an investigation, noting that most officers would not consider taking such legal action against a crime victim. Seymour’s lawyers, Slater & Gordon, argue that Lambley’s business presented a foreseeable risk due to the uncovered drain. Seymour’s rehabilitation included NHS, charity-funded, and private chiropractic treatment. The Police Federation and Seymour’s lawyers assert that officers injured in the line of duty while protecting the public should not be criticized for seeking compensation. It is estimated that police officers collectively receive £20 million a year in personal injury claims.

article_content: Ivan is an independent ad tech advisor who provides professional guidance to the CEO and executive team of SmartyAds Inc. According to Jounce Media's August 2023 RTB Supply-Path Benchmarking report, the average publisher monetizes inventory across at least 24 supply-side platforms (SSPs) simultaneously. Additionally, about 11 technology vendors typically have access to resell publishers’ ad inventory in real-time bidding (RTB) auctions. This fragmentation creates a favorable environment for MFA (made-for-advertising) websites to thrive, fueled further by ad fraud and questionable advertising practices. Currently, at least 49 'news' websites generate content using artificial intelligence, with over 140 brands paying to display ads on such sites. Often, brands are unaware that their advertising budgets are spent on these sites—especially those considered MFA. In today's digital landscape, media buyers must be cautious and recognize the gray areas of digital advertising to ensure they purchase only high-quality inventory. Programmatic advertising—automated ad buying—now accounts for 90% of total ad spend. This process enables advertisers to set campaign criteria and automatically buy suitable placements in real-time auctions, optimizing cost per impression and targeting relevant audiences. However, advertisers may not know exactly what inventory their ads run on, increasing the risk of advertising on MFA websites or AI-driven content farms designed purely for ad revenue. The Association of National Advertisers reports that in the U.S. alone, 21% of ad impressions come from MFA sources, translating to $13 billion in wasted global spend annually. MFA sites often feature poor design and low-quality, keyword-stuffed content but have become more sophisticated with the use of AI. NewsGuard recently identified 537 AI-generated sites operating with minimal human oversight. Jounce Media's report details four common signals for identifying MFA inventory, such as highly variable bid requests and the use of subdomains for ad arbitrage. Major, reputable publishers tend to rely on organic traffic, whereas MFA publishers typically have little organic reach and may use clickbait and questionable tactics to attract visitors. Given that programmatic advertising is the primary monetization channel for most publishers, MFA and AI-generated sites are likely to persist. MIT Technology Review found almost 400 ads from major brands placed on AI-generated websites flagged by NewsGuard. The average cost for 1,000 impressions on these sites was just $1.21. Completely banning such ad services would fundamentally change the digital advertising ecosystem, so alternative solutions are needed: • Supply Path Optimization (SPO): Jounce Media notes that there’s no simple way to distinguish premium from MFA inventory, making effective SPO vital for eliminating unnecessary auctions and choosing the best media paths. • Fair Competition: Enabling a fair and competitive marketplace, such as through header-bidding, allows multiple demand partners to bid, increasing impression values and reducing reliance on multiple technology vendors. • Adherence to IAB Standards: Standards like sellers.json, ads.txt, and ads.cert help verify auction participants and clarify inventory ownership, promoting transparency. • Programmatic Direct: Direct programmatic deals grant buyers more control over ad placement, improving transparency and helping deter MFA exposure. • Choosing Reliable Partners: Advertisers should carefully vet platforms and technologies, which can provide essential analytics and tools for filtering out unwanted traffic and prioritizing quality placements. In summary, as AI-driven content production increases, media buyers face higher risks of low-quality inventory. While programmatic advertising streamlines the process, it’s vital to protect ad budgets with a mix of best practices—fair competition, IAB standards, SPO, and selective partnerships—to foster a healthier advertising ecosystem. Forbes Technology Council is an invitation-only community for senior technology executives. (The article ends with this advertisement/promotion.)

I tillegg har rundt 11 teknologileverandører vanligvis tilgang til å videreselge utgivernes annonseplass i sanntidsbudrunder (RTB-auksjoner). Denne fragmenteringen skaper et gunstig miljø for MFA-nettsteder (laget kun for annonsering) til å blomstre, og det gir dessuten grobunn for annonsebedrageri og tvilsomme annonseringspraksiser. For tiden skaper minst 49 'nyhets'-nettsteder innhold ved hjelp av kunstig intelligens, og over 140 merkevarer betaler for å vise annonser på slike sider. Ofte er ikke merkevarene klar over at annonsebudsjettene deres går til slike nettsider—spesielt dem som anses som MFA. I dagens digitale landskap må mediekjøpere være forsiktige og oppmerksomme på gråsonene innen digital annonsering for å sikre at de kun kjøper annonseplass av høy kvalitet. Programmatisk annonsering—automatisert annonsekjøp—utgjør nå 90 % av den totale annonsebruken. Denne prosessen lar annonsører sette kampanjekriterier og automatisk kjøpe passende plasseringer i sanntidsauksjoner, optimalisere kostnad per visning og treffe relevante målgrupper. Men annonsører vet kanskje ikke nøyaktig hvilken annonseplass de får, noe som øker risikoen for å havne på MFA-nettsteder eller innholdsgårder drevet av kunstig intelligens kun for annonseinntekter. The Association of National Advertisers rapporterer at bare i USA kommer 21 % av annonsevisningene fra MFA-kilder, noe som tilsvarer 13 milliarder dollar i bortkastet globalt forbruk årlig. MFA-nettsteder har ofte dårlig design og lavkvalitets, nøkkelordstungt innhold, men har blitt mer avanserte med bruk av AI. NewsGuard har nylig identifisert 537 AI-genererte nettsteder som opererer med minimal menneskelig overvåkning. Jounce Medias rapport beskriver fire vanlige signaler for å identifisere MFA-innhold, som svært varierende budforespørsler og bruk av underdomener for annonsearbitrasje. Store, anerkjente utgivere er vanligvis avhengige av organisk trafikk, mens MFA-utgivere ofte har lite organisk rekkevidde og bruker klikkagn og tvilsomme taktikker for å tiltrekke besøkende. Siden programmatiske annonser er hovedinntektskilden for de fleste utgivere, vil MFA- og AI-genererte nettsteder trolig bestå. MIT Technology Review fant nesten 400 annonser fra kjente merkevarer plassert på AI-genererte nettsider flagget av NewsGuard. Gjennomsnittsprisen for 1000 visninger på disse sidene var kun 1,21 dollar. Et totalforbud mot slike annonsetjenester ville fundamentalt endret det digitale annonseringslandskapet, så alternative løsninger er nødvendige: • Supply Path Optimization (SPO): Jounce Media påpeker at det ikke finnes en enkel måte å skille premium fra MFA-innhold på, noe som gjør effektiv SPO svært viktig for å eliminere unødvendige auksjoner og velge de beste kanalene. • Rettferdig konkurranse: Å etablere et rettferdig og konkurransedyktig marked, for eksempel via header-bidding, lar flere tilbydere by om annonseplass, øker verdien og reduserer behovet for mange ulike teknologileverandører. • Overholdelse av IAB-standarder: Standarder som sellers.json, ads.txt og ads.cert hjelper med å verifisere auksjonsdeltagere og tydeliggjøre eierskap til annonseplasseringer, noe som fremmer åpenhet. • Programmatisk direktekjøp: Direkte avtaler gir kjøpere større kontroll over hvor annonsene deres blir vist, øker åpenheten og hindrer eksponering for MFA. • Velge pålitelige partnere: Annonsører bør være nøye med å velge sine plattformer og teknologier, som kan tilby verktøy og analyser for å filtrere bort uønsket trafikk og prioritere kvalitetsplasseringer. Oppsummert: Når AI-generert innholdsproduksjon øker, møter mediekjøpere større risiko for lavkvalitets inventar. Selv om programmatiske annonser gir effektivitet, er det avgjørende å sikre annonsebudsjetter ved bruk av flere beste praksiser—rettferdig konkurranse, IAB-standarder, SPO og selektive partnere—for å skape et sunnere annonsemarked. Forbes Technology Council er et eksklusivt fagmiljø for ledende teknologisjefer. (Artikkelen avsluttes med denne reklamen/presentasjonen.)

article_content: A sixth person has been confirmed dead following a house fire in Channel Close, Hounslow, which claimed the lives of three children and two adults. Neighbors stated that Aroen Kishen and his wife Seema lived in the home with their three children. It is believed Mr. Kishen is in hospital, but his wife and children, Riyan, Shanaya, and Arohi, died in the blaze on Sunday night, along with another adult. The Metropolitan Police have confirmed the discovery of a sixth body at the scene. According to the BBC, two unnamed adults were visiting the family for Diwali, a festival celebrated by Hindu, Sikh, and Jain communities. Detective Chief Inspector Garth Hall expressed condolences to the affected families, describing the event as heart-breaking and pledging a thorough investigation into the incident. He noted that the scene was initially too dangerous to examine until structural safety measures were taken. Investigators are committed to following the evidence and providing updates if there are any developments. The cause of the fire is currently unexplained. Post-mortem examinations and formal identification procedures will be carried out in due course. The families have been informed and are receiving support from authorities.

article_content: Brazilian fans experienced a scare when star forward Neymar twisted his ankle during training ahead of the World Cup, sparking concerns about his readiness for the tournament. The Barcelona striker rolled his ankle during a training session near Rio de Janeiro and received treatment on the field. After spending some time on the ground, Neymar managed to get up and walk carefully from the pitch. He was soon able to resume the session and is expected to be fit for Brazil’s opening match against Croatia on Thursday. Meanwhile, the team has been focusing on strengthening their defense. Coach Luiz Felipe Scolari used part of Monday’s practice to make defensive adjustments, pausing play to reposition players until satisfied. Despite Brazil keeping clean sheets in their last two warm-up games, Scolari expressed some dissatisfaction with the defensive performance. Right back Daniel Alves acknowledged defensive shortcomings and said the team is working to improve before facing Croatia. Croatia striker Ivica Olic has identified gaps in Brazil’s defense during recent friendlies. Brazil’s last conceded goal came in a 2-1 win over Chile last November. They beat Panama 4-0 and Serbia 1-0 in warm-ups ahead of the World Cup. Scolari stated the team is physically ready but still needs tactical adjustments, especially regarding set pieces. Brazil plans another training session near Rio de Janeiro before traveling to São Paulo for the World Cup opener.

article_content:
Barcelona and Arsenal have agreed to a £15 million transfer fee for defender Thomas Vermaelen, putting Barcelona ahead in the race over Manchester United. The completion of the transfer currently hinges on personal contract negotiations between Vermaelen and Barcelona. 

Earlier this week, Barcelona’s transfer negotiator Raul Sanllehi traveled to London, where he offered Vermaelen a four-year contract worth £80,000 a week, with the option for an additional year. In these negotiations, Arsenal preferred a swap deal involving Manchester United’s Chris Smalling; however, United refused to include Smalling in any arrangement. Manager Arsene Wenger has valued Smalling for years and previously attempted to bring him to Arsenal from Fulham in 2010, but the player joined United instead and is now seen as an important part of their defense under manager Louis van Gaal.

Although Manchester United were willing to offer more money than Barcelona, Arsenal insisted upon receiving Smalling in exchange and would not agree to a cash-only deal. The lack of progress has made it likely that Barcelona will finalize the transfer. The situation is disappointing for Vermaelen, who reportedly preferred to remain in England, in part to be closer to his partner, English model Polly Parsons, and their son. Vermaelen was also interested in reuniting with friend Robin van Persie at Old Trafford.

With Arsenal refusing to sell to United on any terms but their own and United unwilling to lose a key defender, Barcelona is now on the verge of completing the signing, with only personal terms left to conclude.

Tidligere denne uken reiste Barcelonas overgangssjef Raul Sanllehi til London, hvor han tilbød Vermaelen en fireårskontrakt til 80 000 pund i uken, med mulighet for ett år ekstra. Selv om Manchester United var villige til å tilby mer penger enn Barcelona, sto Arsenal på kravet om Smalling i bytte og godtok ikke et pengetilbud alene. Dette gjør det sannsynlig at Barcelona fullfører overgangen. Siden Arsenal nekter å selge uten sine egne betingelser, og United ikke ønsker å kvitte seg med Smalling, ser det ut til at Barcelona nå snart sikrer seg Vermaelen, med kun de personlige detaljene igjen å bli enige om.

article_content: Meta has recently launched AI-generated personas across platforms like Instagram and Facebook. These virtual personalities are modeled after celebrities and influencers, including 'Billie,' inspired by model and socialite Kendall Jenner. Billie’s Instagram profile calls her 'your local ride or die' from New York City. A gray disclaimer confirms the account is managed by Meta's AI, not by Jenner herself. Billie's feed features AI-created images of photo shoots, food, and lifestyle scenes. Her introductory Reel says, 'chatting with me is like having an older sister you can talk to, but who can’t steal your clothes.' Meta says their goal is to create AIs with distinct personalities and interests, making interactions more enjoyable. The company collaborated with various cultural figures to help embody these AI personas. Billie is one of 28 AI influencers Meta has introduced on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp. Each persona is inspired by the likeness of a celebrity or public figure. The AI influencers began posting content in late September. Users can message them directly or explore their AI-generated feeds. Sometimes, the profiles include videos or selfies from the actual celebrities involved. Meta’s initiative aims to make AI interactions more engaging and relatable. The article points out that virtual influencers like Lil Miquela existed before, so Meta is continuing rather than starting this trend. Meta hopes these AI personas will attract more users and increase chatbot engagement. Whether users interact with the AIs seriously or playfully, engagement is anticipated, at least in the near term. The article expresses skepticism about the long-term success of AI personas, suggesting the trend may have already peaked. Recently, Meta introduced AI-generated stickers for Instagram and Facebook, some of which have generated controversy online.

article_content: In the second quarter of this financial year, Bank of Maharashtra (BoM) led Indian public sector banks in the percentage growth of both loans and deposits. From July to September 2023, the bank’s deposits and advances each rose by more than 20%, representing the strongest proportional increase among its peers. BoM’s domestic advances grew by 23.55%, reaching Rs 1,83,122 crore at September’s close. Indian Overseas Bank saw a 20.29% increase, Central Bank of India grew advances by 17.26%, and UCO Bank by 16.53%. State Bank of India (SBI) posted a 13.21% increase in domestic advances, ranking seventh in growth rate, but retained its status as the nation’s largest lender with loans totaling Rs 28,84,007 crore—far surpassing BoM in scale. With deposits climbing 22.18% to Rs 2,39,298 crore, BoM topped other public lenders. Bank of Baroda achieved 12% deposit growth, while SBI saw an 11.8% rise. BoM maintained the highest share of low-cost Current Account and Savings Account (CASA) deposits at 50.71%, closely followed by Central Bank of India. Overall, BoM’s total business—combining advances and deposits—expanded by 22.77% to Rs 4,22,420 crore, leading public sector banks again. Bank of Baroda ranked second in this measurement. BoM also held the top spot for growth among public sector lenders in the previous quarter. Elsewhere in the financial sector: India has cleared its first full foreign direct investment in the defense industry, allowing Swedish company Saab to set up a rocket manufacturing plant. SBI reported 8% net profit growth for the quarter on steady credit demand and reduced provisions. Edtech firm Byju’s announced Rs 3,569 crore in revenue and a lower Ebitda loss for FY22.

Med innskudd som økte med 22,18 % til 2 39 298 crore ledet BoM også i innskuddsvekst. Bank of Baroda fikk 12 % innskuddsvekst, mens SBI oppnådde 11,8 %. article_content: After more than sixty years, Sir Jay Tidmarsh, a former Taunton School student, returned a library book he borrowed in 1950. The 82-year-old found the overdue copy of 'Ashenden' by W. Somerset Maugham, with the school's stamp inside, while sorting his shelves. Instead of paying the calculated £2,847 fine, he sent the book back together with a £1,500 donation to the school's library. Rather than insisting on the full fine, Taunton School welcomed Sir Jay and his wife, Lady Virginia, with a special lunch hosted by Jane Barrie, Chair of Governors. Neil Longstreet, the Foundation Director, praised Sir Jay as a valued supporter and took the chance to urge other alumni to return overdue library books, hinting such gestures could aid further enhancements to the library. 'Ashenden' is a spy story collection believed to have influenced Ian Fleming’s James Bond series.

I stedet for å betale den beregnede boten på £2 847, sendte han boken tilbake sammen med en gave på £1 500 til skolens bibliotek. I stedet for å kreve hele boten, ønsket Taunton School Sir Jay og hans kone Lady Virginia velkommen med en spesiell lunsj arrangert av styreleder Jane Barrie. Neil Longstreet, stiftelsesdirektøren, roste Sir Jay som en verdsatt støttespiller og benyttet anledningen til å oppfordre andre tidligere elever til å levere inn glemte biblioteksbøker, og antydet at slike bidrag kan bidra til videreutvikling av biblioteket. 'Ashenden' er en samling spionhistorier som antas å ha inspirert Ian Flemings James Bond-serie.
