article_content: Maximus, a hefty feline tipping the scales at 10 kilograms, ranks among the world's largest cats—but you wouldn't guess it from how active he is. Owned by Leon and Eugenia Korovin of Petrozavodsk, Russia, Maximus joined their family as a special wedding present in 2009. This Maine Coon and Siberian mix is surprisingly agile, effortlessly leaping and dashing around like a much smaller kitty. ‘We’re both lovers of cats—especially big ones,’ Eugenia said. ‘After meeting Max, there was no question he had to come home with us. Though he looks huge, he’s incredibly spry at home and a real character when chasing after mice.’ To keep fit, the five-year-old cat takes daily strolls outdoors. Due to his size, typical cat harnesses didn't fit, so the couple turned to dog harnesses instead. Maximus also has refined tastes, preferring only fresh meals and eating hefty portions. ‘He eats a lot and won’t settle for less than the freshest, but we wouldn’t have it any other way,’ Eugenia added.

Denne katten, en blanding mellom Maine Coon og sibirkatt, er overraskende lettbeint og hopper rundt som en liten kattunge. ‘Vi elsker begge katter—særlig store katter,’ sier Eugenia. ‘Da vi møtte Max, visste vi at han måtte bli med oss hjem. Han ser stor ut, men er utrolig sprek og en skikkelig luring når han jager mus.’ For å holde seg i form får fem år gamle Maximus daglige lufteturer. Fordi han er så stor, passet ikke vanlige katteseler, så paret måtte bruke en hundesele i stedet. Maximus er også kresen på mat, foretrekker bare ferske måltider og spiser store porsjoner. ‘Han spiser oss nesten ut av huset og nekter alt som ikke er ferskt, men vi ville ikke hatt det på noen annen måte,’ legger Eugenia til.

article_content: Robert Fico, head of Slovakia’s SMER-SSD party and former three-term prime minister, now has two weeks to attempt forming a government after leading his party to victory in the latest election. Fico’s campaign promises included ending Slovakia’s military assistance to Ukraine, moving national policy closer to Hungary’s approach, and questioning the EU’s collective support for Ukraine’s fight against Russia. SMER-SSD won nearly 23% of votes, outpacing the liberal rival Progresivne Slovensko, which received 18%, but will still need coalition partners to secure a parliamentary majority. Fico is expected to reach out to HLAS (Voice)—a party with pro-European leanings formed by a SMER split in 2020 under Peter Pellegrini—and to the Slovak National Party (SNS), which is pro-Russian and earned 5.6% of votes. Analysts caution that SNS may struggle to keep its members unified, potentially destabilizing any coalition. HLAS, led by Pellegrini, plays a pivotal role in coalition talks and could moderate policy direction if brought into government. Pellegrini has indicated that participation by HLAS should alleviate fears of drastic foreign policy changes. HLAS may push SMER to negotiate with the Christian Democrats or, if needed, could support a Progresivne Slovensko-led coalition instead. Despite recent anti-Western rhetoric, analysts note that Fico has previously shown pragmatic leadership, exemplified by Slovakia’s adoption of the euro under his tenure. While he pledges to end military deliveries to Ukraine, Fico still supports aid for humanitarian relief and reconstruction. He advocates for peace talks—a stance aligned with Hungary’s Viktor Orban but rejected by Ukraine and Western allies, who argue it would benefit Russia. Fico’s campaign also pledged action on rising living expenses and tougher policies on illegal migration. After a brief meeting with President Zuzana Caputova, he acknowledged the formation process would be difficult but confirmed his two-week deadline. Caputova, described as a liberal with a history of disagreements with Fico, plans to consult with other party leaders and remain involved in the process.

Fico gikk til valg på å stoppe Slovakias militære støtte til Ukraina, føre politikken nærmere Ungarns linje, og utfordre EUs felles støtte til Ukraina i konflikten med Russland. SMER-SSD fikk nesten 23 % av stemmene og slo den liberale utfordreren Progresivne Slovensko (PS) med 18 %, men trenger fortsatt koalisjonspartnere for å få flertall i parlamentet. Fico ventes å kontakte HLAS (Stemme) – et mer pro-europeisk parti som ble dannet av en utbrytergruppe fra SMER i 2020, ledet av Peter Pellegrini – samt det prorusssiske Slovakiske Nasjonalpartiet (SNS), som fikk 5,6 % av stemmene. Analytikere mener SNS kan få problemer med å holde gruppen samlet, noe som kan svekke en fremtidig koalisjon. HLAS med Pellegrini i spissen har en nøkkelrolle og kan bidra til å dempe store politiske endringer hvis de blir med i regjeringen. Pellegrini har sagt at HLAS' deltagelse vil redusere frykt for store utenrikspolitiske omveltninger. HLAS kan også presse SMER til å forhandle med Kristendemokratene, eller eventuelt gi sin støtte til en PS-ledet koalisjon dersom dialogen med SMER ikke fører frem. Selv om Fico har uttrykt mer anti-vestlige holdninger i opposisjon, har han tidligere vist pragmatisme; blant annet fikk han innført euroen i Slovakia. Han lover å stoppe militære leveranser til Ukraina, men støtter fortsatt humanitær og gjenoppbyggingsbistand. Han ønsker fredssamtaler mellom partene, på linje med Ungarns leder Viktor Orban, men dette avvises av Ukraina og vestlige allierte, som mener det bare vil gagne Russland. Ficos valgkamp fokuserte også på tiltak mot økte levekostnader og å stramme inn på ulovlig innvandring. Etter et kort møte med president Zuzana Caputova har Fico bekreftet at regjeringsforhandlingene blir krevende, men at han har fått en frist på to uker. Caputova, omtalt som liberal, har hatt flere uenigheter med Fico tidligere og har varslet at hun vil fortsette å ha dialog med andre partiledere i prosessen.

article_content: Although electric vehicles (EVs) frequently dominate headlines and new models are regularly introduced, most Americans remain hesitant to move away from gasoline-powered cars. In a recent Yahoo Finance and Ipsos poll, 57% of respondents said they were not likely to choose an EV for their next vehicle purchase. The survey defined EVs as both fully electric cars and plug-in hybrids, which have larger batteries and more electric range compared to traditional hybrids. Within that group, 36% stated they were 'not at all likely' to go electric, while 21% reported they were 'not too likely.' Meanwhile, 31% of those surveyed expressed that they would likely purchase an EV. The main factors discouraging potential buyers are consistent with previous findings: high vehicle prices, limited driving range, and insufficient charging infrastructure remain top concerns. The study also highlights an evident political divide. While 41% of Democrats are open to buying an EV, only 17% of Republicans share that sentiment. Adopting an EV doesn't guarantee permanent loyalty. A recent analysis from S&P Global Mobility found that many households owning an EV later purchase a gasoline-powered vehicle. In the mainstream market, excluding Tesla’s high loyalty rates, 52.1% of EV households choose another EV for their next car—meaning almost half do not. That 'next vehicle' can either replace a previous car or add to the household’s garage. For practical reasons, some owners keep both an EV for daily short trips and a gas vehicle for long-distance travel. Automakers, according to Tom Libby, associate director for loyalty solutions and industry analysis at S&P Global Mobility, are heavily investing in EV development and are keen to keep EV owners from returning to internal combustion engines. Tesla households show the highest loyalty—76.7% buy another EV, boosting the luxury EV segment’s average loyalty to 72.6%. In contrast, Porsche and BMW have lower EV loyalty rates at 36.8% and 45.9% respectively. Despite these obstacles, EV sales in the US have been on the rise for 13 consecutive quarters, as reported by Cox Automotive. The US is poised to exceed 1 million EVs sold in a single year for the first time. Do you plan to stick with gasoline, switch between EV and ICE vehicles, or are you a dedicated EV fan? Share your story with us! Contact the reporter at tlevin@insider.com.
translated_content: Selv om elektriske kjøretøy (EV) ofte dominerer overskriftene og nye modeller stadig introduseres, er de fleste amerikanere fortsatt motvillige til å gå bort fra bensinbiler. I en fersk undersøkelse fra Yahoo Finance og Ipsos svarte 57 % at de ikke var sannsynlig å velge en elbil som neste bil. Undersøkelsen definerte elbiler som både helelektriske biler og ladbare hybrider, som har større batterier og lengre elektrisk rekkevidde enn tradisjonelle hybrider. Av de spurte svarte 36 % at de 'ikke i det hele tatt' var tilbøyelige til å gå over til elbil, mens 21 % svarte at de 'ikke særlig sannsynlig' ville velge det. Samtidig oppga 31 % at de med stor sannsynlighet kom til å kjøpe en elbil. Hovedgrunnene som avskrekker potensielle kjøpere, er de samme som før: høye bilpriser, begrenset rekkevidde og utilstrekkelig ladenettverk. Studien viser også en tydelig politisk skillelinje. Mens 41 % av demokrater vurderer å kjøpe elbil, gjelder det kun 17 % av republikanerne. Å velge elbil gir ikke nødvendigvis varig lojalitet. En fersk analyse fra S&P Global Mobility fant at mange husholdninger som eier elbil, senere kjøper en bensinbil. I det brede markedet, ekskludert Teslas høye lojalitetstall, velger 52,1 % av elbilhusholdningene en ny elbil som neste bil–det betyr at nesten halvparten ikke gjør det. Det 'neste kjøretøyet' kan både være en erstatning eller et tillegg i garasjen. Av praktiske grunner velger noen å ha både elbil til korte dagsturer og en bensinbil til lengre reiser. Bilprodusenter, ifølge Tom Libby, assisterende direktør for lojalitetsløsninger og bransjeanalyse i S&P Global Mobility, investerer tungt i utviklingen av elbiler og ønsker å beholde elbileiere i elektrisk segment. Tesla-eiere er mest lojale–76,7 % kjøper elbil igjen, noe som løfter snittet for luksussegmentet til 72,6 %. Til sammenligning er lojaliteten lavere for Porsche (36,8 %) og BMW (45,9 %). Til tross for utfordringene fortsetter elbilsalget i USA å stige. Ifølge Cox Automotive har salget økt i 13 kvartaler på rad, og landet ligger an til å passere én million solgte elbiler på ett år for aller første gang. article_content: The Google Pixel 8 series is reportedly capable of supporting display output, but Google appears to have hidden the feature in software. A video by Mishaal Rahman demonstrates display output working on the Pixel 8 Pro via its USB-C port. Rahman highlights that, while the hardware supports display output, the software currently disables it. Rahman notes that using the feature may require rooting the device. He also shared his process for enabling it, which did not work for him but did work for his tester. The exact reason for this inconsistency is unclear, but Rahman suggests it may relate to the type of cable used—comparing USB-C to HDMI and USB-C to USB-C connections. Another tester successfully connected a Pixel 8 device to a DisplayPort-compatible monitor using a different cable. According to Rahman, version 2.0 of USB Gadget HAL, introduced in Android 14, helps detect suitable cables for DisplayPort Alternate mode. Additionally, a Pixel 8 Pro with Android 14 QPR1 supported display output when connected to a different monitor using a USB-C to HDMI cable. Currently, the feature allows only screen mirroring and is not a complete desktop experience. These findings confirm the Pixel 8 series can support display output, which is welcomed by users who have requested the feature—including reviewer Nicholas Sutrich, who previously expressed disappointment at its absence. Rahman believes this hidden feature signals Google's intentions to improve Android desktop mode, potentially making it official with Android 15. It is understood that this capability is still under development.

Han nevner at funksjonen kan kreve rooting av enheten, og han delte prosessen for å aktivere funksjonen, noe som ikke fungerte for ham selv, men fungerte for en tester. Den nøyaktige årsaken til denne forskjellen er uklar, men Rahman tror det kan ha sammenheng med hvilken type kabel som brukes—som forskjellen mellom USB-C til HDMI og USB-C til USB-C. En annen tester lyktes med å koble en Pixel 8 til en DisplayPort-kompatibel skjerm med en annen kabel. Ifølge Rahman hjelper versjon 2.0 av USB Gadget HAL, introdusert i Android 14, med å finne riktig kabel for DisplayPort Alternate-modus. I tillegg viste en Pixel 8 Pro med Android 14 QPR1 at skjermutgang fungerte med USB-C til HDMI-kabel mot en annen skjerm. Foreløpig tillater funksjonen kun skjermspeiling og ikke full skrivebordsopplevelse. Disse funnene bekrefter at Pixel 8-serien støtter skjermutgang, noe som er gode nyheter for brukere som har ønsket denne funksjonen—inkludert anmelderen Nicholas Sutrich, som tidligere har uttrykt skuffelse over fraværet. Rahman mener at denne skjulte funksjonen indikerer Googles planer om å forbedre Androids skrivebordsmodus, noe som kanskje blir offisielt med Android 15. Funksjonen forstås fortsatt å være under utvikling.

article_content: The Google Pixel 8 Pro underwent rigorous durability tests on the JerryRigEverything YouTube channel, known for challenging smartphones. While the device demonstrated high durability, it was not immune to certain types of damage. During testing, the Pixel 8 Pro's camera bar, display, and metal frame showed some vulnerability. For example, a few seconds of exposure to a cigarette lighter resulted in a permanent burn mark on the OLED display—though this is unlikely to happen during regular use. The metal frame and camera bar were also scratched by a sharp blade, leaving visible marks. Zack Nelson, the channel's host, used Mohs hardness picks and found that the screen scratched at level six, with deeper marks at level seven. This means the display can resist scratches from everyday objects like keys or coins, but sharper items could leave marks. Despite severe scratching on the fingerprint sensor area, the scanner continued to function perfectly. The Pixel 8 Pro also underwent a bend test, a standard for Nelson's reviews that has previously broken other models like the Pixel 7 Pro. However, the new model did not crack or break under pressure, although it made some noises when bent. The glass back and antenna lines also remained intact. Google has promised seven years of software updates and spare parts for the Pixel 8 series, making it an appealing option for long-term use. These durability tests reinforce confidence in the phone's longevity. Alongside improved durability, the Pixel 8 Pro boasts enhanced camera hardware, an advanced face unlock feature, a brighter OLED display, a larger battery, and robust AI capabilities. Combined with extended software support, the Pixel 8 Pro is positioned as a leading flagship device built to last.

article_content: Over the last twenty years, more than 36 million pieces of litter have been spotted along Britain’s coast—averaging 3,200 bits per mile. During this period, plastic pollution on the shorelines has spiked, more than doubling in volume. Not all discoveries among the debris have been worthless, though. Cleanup volunteers have uncovered intriguing historical artifacts, like a sea-themed glass bottle found in Wales estimated to be worth £250-350, a Victorian-era tea strainer valued at £650 near Greenwich Pier, and several 16th-century clay tobacco pipes pulled from the Thames, valued between £35 and £150 apiece. These findings come from beach clean-up drives organized by the Barefoot Wine Project, which works with Surfers Against Sewage to target waste at 14 UK coastal sites every year. The next events for 2014 will take place in Grimsby, Saltburn, Southport, Cumbria, and Cardiff. While some beachcombers stumble upon hidden treasures, the mounting litter is a serious threat to local wildlife. Each year, plastic waste is responsible for killing more than 100,000 marine mammals and turtles, as well as about a million seabirds, either through ingestion or by becoming trapped. Yona Ellis, who manages the Barefoot Wine Beach Rescue Project, said the team was both stunned and excited by the items recovered during cleanups, and looked forward to future finds. She added that eight years ago, no one expected British beaches to hold so much hidden treasure. Hugo Tagholm, Chief Executive of Surfers Against Sewage, emphasized the persistent challenge that marine litter presents—not only for beaches but also for the vulnerable wildlife living in UK waters. He highlighted the importance of community projects in maintaining cleaner, safer coastlines.

Frivillige søppelryddere har oppdaget spennende historiske gjenstander, slik som en sjøinspirert glassflaske funnet i Wales verdsatt til £250–350, et viktoriansk tesil til £650 ved Greenwich Pier, og flere leirpipetobakksrør fra 1500-tallet som ble funnet i Themsen, verdt mellom £35 og £150 hver. Disse funnene stammer fra strandryddingene arrangert av Barefoot Wine Project, som samarbeider med Surfers Against Sewage for å fjerne søppel på 14 britiske kyststeder hvert år. Neste aksjoner i 2014 finner sted i Grimsby, Saltburn, Southport, Cumbria og Cardiff. Selv om noen strandjegere finner skjulte skatter, utgjør det økende søppelproblemet en alvorlig trussel for dyrelivet. Hugo Tagholm, administrerende direktør for Surfers Against Sewage, påpeker de vedvarende utfordringene med marint søppel—for både strendene og det sårbare dyrelivet i britiske farvann. Han understreker viktigheten av slike lokalsamfunnsprosjekter for å holde kysten ren og trygg.

article_content: Nicknamed 'The Gazelle' for her elegant running style and speed, Marie-José Pérec is among the most outstanding female sprinters in modern history—and also one of the most enigmatic. Born on the French-governed island of Guadeloupe, Pérec was introduced to sprinting by her school gym teacher, who, witnessing her speed over 100 meters, initially believed the stopwatch was faulty and asked her to run again. By the age of 13, Pérec was already 5'10" (1.78 meters) tall, making her ideally suited for the 200- and 400-meter events. After moving to Paris at 16 in 1984, her talent was soon recognized. Although her competitive career began with a setback—disqualification from her first major tournament, the French Inter-School Championships, for stepping out of her lane—her progress thereafter was rapid. At her first Olympic appearance in 1988 in Seoul, she reached the quarterfinals in the 200 meters. Four years later in Barcelona, Pérec won the 400-meter gold, beating defending champion Olha Bryzhina by two meters with a time of 48.83 seconds. She successfully defended her title at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics, prevailing over Australia’s Cathy Freeman in an exciting final to win in 48.25 seconds—setting an Olympic record and marking the third fastest women’s 400-meters time ever. Pérec became the first person, male or female, to retain the Olympic 400-meter title. Three nights later, she made history again by winning the 200 meters in 22.12 seconds. No other athlete in a non-boycotted Olympics had previously won both the 200- and 400-meter titles in the same Games—though Michael Johnson matched her accomplishment 20 minutes later. Despite her remarkable success, Pérec’s career was marred by controversy and illness. She had several high-profile disputes with French athletics authorities and became known for fiercely protecting her privacy, earning her the nickname 'the Greta Garbo of athletics.' In 1998, Pérec was diagnosed with Epstein-Barr disease (Chronic Fatigue Syndrome). At Sydney 2000, she withdrew from the Olympics amid much attention, missing a highly anticipated race against Cathy Freeman, who subsequently won the title. Pérec did not compete again after Sydney. Plans for a comeback at the 2003 World Championships in Paris were abandoned due to injury. She ended speculation about returning in Athens by announcing her retirement in a 2003 interview on French television. "I have finally decided to hang up my spikes," Pérec said. "I am now going to discover a real, everyday kind of life. I feel euphoric and very excited."
translated_content: Kallenavnet «Gasellen» på grunn av hennes elegante løpestil og fart, gjør Marie-José Pérec til en av historiens mest fremragende kvinnelige sprintere—og også en av de mest gåtefulle. Pérec ble født på den fransk-styrte øya Guadeloupe og ble introdusert for sprint av sin gymnastikklærer, som etter å ha sett henne løpe 100 meter først trodde stoppeklokken var feil og ba henne løpe på nytt. Allerede som 13-åring var Pérec 1,78 meter høy, noe som gjorde henne ideell for 200- og 400-meter. Etter å ha flyttet til Paris som 16-åring i 1984, ble talentet hennes raskt oppdaget. Karrieren hennes startet med et tilbakeslag—diskvalifisering fra hennes første store konkurranse, det franske skolemesterskapet, for å ha gått utenfor banen—men fremdriften deretter var rask. Ved sin OL-debut i Seoul i 1988 nådde hun kvartfinalen på 200 meter. Fire år senere i Barcelona tok Pérec gull på 400 meter, to meter foran den regjerende mesteren Olha Bryzhina, med tiden 48,83 sekunder. Hun forsvarte tittelen sin ved OL i Atlanta i 1996, hvor hun slo Australias Cathy Freeman i en spennende finale og vant med tiden 48,25 sekunder—ny olympisk rekord og den tredje raskeste tiden på 400 meter for kvinner noensinne. Pérec ble den første personen, uansett kjønn, til å forsvare OL-tittelen på 400 meter. Tre kvelder senere skrev hun igjen historie da hun vant 200 meter på 22,12 sekunder. Ingen andre utøvere i et ikke-boikottet OL hadde tidligere vunnet både 200- og 400-meter i samme lekene—selv om Michael Johnson matchet bedriften hennes 20 minutter senere. Til tross for de bemerkelsesverdige prestasjonene var Pérec sin karriere preget av kontroverser og sykdom. Hun hadde flere høyprofilerte konflikter med franske friidrettsmyndigheter og ble kjent for å beskytte sitt privatliv, noe som gav henne kallenavnet «friidrettens Greta Garbo». I 1998 fikk Pérec diagnosen Epstein-Barr-virus (kronisk utmattelsessyndrom). Under OL i Sydney 2000 trakk hun seg fra konkurransen til stor oppmerksomhet og gikk glipp av det mye omtalte oppgjøret mot Cathy Freeman, som senere tok tittelen. Pérec konkurrerte ikke etter Sydney. Planer om comeback til VM i Paris i 2003 ble skrinlagt grunnet skade. Hun avsluttet spekulasjonene rundt et comeback i Athen ved å kunngjøre sin avgang i et intervju på fransk TV i 2003. «Jeg har endelig bestemt meg for å legge piggskoene på hylla,» sa Pérec. «Nå skal jeg endelig oppleve et virkelig, hverdagslig liv. Jeg føler meg euforisk og veldig spent.»

article_content: Axl Rose has officially declined the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame’s invitation to induct Guns N’ Roses during the upcoming ceremony in Cleveland. His decision is primarily rooted in ongoing conflicts with members of the band’s original 1985 lineup. Rose, the band’s frontman, explained that although he made efforts to resolve things amicably, he doesn’t feel welcomed or respected at the event. He described the ceremony as an uncomfortable setting for him and noted that he no longer performs with anyone from the original group. Expressing his frustration, Rose accused his former bandmates of distorting the band’s history for personal gain, especially pointing to earlier reunion rumors spread by original drummer Steven Adler. Rose stressed that unless old issues within the earlier lineups are addressed, there’s no possibility of discussions—let alone a reunion. He also asked the Rock Hall not to induct him in his absence or let anyone receive the honor on his behalf. Rose insisted that neither past members, record label representatives, nor the Hall itself should imply, in any way, that he is part of the induction. Rock and Roll Hall of Fame spokeswoman Lauren Bishop expressed disappointment over Rose’s choice but confirmed the ceremony would proceed. Meanwhile, original guitarist Slash and bassist Duff McKagen have announced their plans to participate. Rose ended his letter by sincerely thanking the board for the nomination and votes.

Rose, bandets frontfigur, forklarte at han selv om han har forsøkt å finne en vennlig løsning, ikke føler seg ønsket eller respektert under arrangementet. Han beskrev seremonien som ukomfortabel for seg selv og påpekte at han ikke lenger spiller med noen fra den opprinnelige gruppen. I sin frustrasjon anklaget Rose sine tidligere bandkamerater for å forvrenge bandets historie for egen vinning, spesielt ved å fremheve tidligere rykter om gjenforening spredt av den originale trommeslageren Steven Adler. Rose understreket at det ikke finnes rom for diskusjon – langt mindre en gjenforening – før gamle problemer innad i de tidligere besetningene blir håndtert. Han ba også Hall of Fame om ikke å innlemme ham i hans fravær eller la noen motta æren på hans vegne. Talskvinne Lauren Bishop i Rock and Roll Hall of Fame uttrykte skuffelse over Roses valg, men bekreftet at seremonien vil gjennomføres. Samtidig har originalgitarist Slash og bassist Duff McKagen annonsert at de vil delta. Rose avsluttet brevet sitt med å oppriktig takke styret for nominasjonen og stemmene.

article_content: Chelsea fans were given the chance to learn more about summer signing Filipe Luis during a Q&A session at Stamford Bridge on Wednesday night. The Brazilian defender was joined on stage by club legend Didier Drogba and experienced goalkeeper Mark Schwarzer as supporters fired questions at the trio. Luis, 29, was signed from La Liga champions Atletico Madrid for a fee of around £16 million in the summer. Since arriving, he has made just two Premier League starts amidst Chelsea's unbeaten run. On Tuesday, he featured for Brazil in their 2-1 victory over Austria. During the Q&A, fans got a glimpse of Luis's personality. He spoke fluent English, attributed to watching thousands of movies—he owns about 2,000 films and credits them for helping him learn the language. Luis also admitted that cooking is not his strength, adding a lighthearted touch to the evening. article_content: Wayne Kevin Beard, 34, crashed a stolen car into the luxury Mercedes of Deputy Chief Constable Michael Banks. Beard had recently been released on bail for allegedly harassing his partner. On his way home from court, he grew tired of walking and decided to steal a car. He entered a village pub and took a customer’s car keys and mobile phone from an unattended jacket on a coat stand. Using the keys, Beard stole a Fiat Punto and reversed it directly into the Deputy Chief Constable's Mercedes, which was parked nearby. Deputy Chief Constable Banks, alerted at his nearby home, went to confront Beard, who attempted to headbutt and threaten him, saying, 'Today is the day you die.' Banks dodged the attack but received a minor injury to his upper lip. Damages to both cars exceeded £5,000. Beard was arrested at the scene. Although he complied with a breath test, he refused to give a blood sample for alcohol testing. Beard admitted aggravated vehicle taking, assaulting a police officer, theft of a mobile phone, and failing to provide a blood specimen. At Durham Crown Court, Beard’s defense lawyer stated that his client had settled down in recent years but relapsed due to stress and began ordering Valium. Judge Peter Kelson sentenced Beard to two years in prison, noting his 'appalling record' despite some recent improvements.

WASHINGTON — The recent cancellation of two major offshore wind projects in New Jersey marks another significant setback for the emerging U.S. offshore wind industry. This development threatens the Biden administration’s goal of generating enough offshore wind energy to power 10 million homes by 2030, and to create a carbon-free electric grid by 2035.

Danish wind energy company Ørsted announced this week it is canceling its Ocean Wind I and II projects off southern New Jersey, citing supply chain issues, higher interest rates, and insufficient tax credits. Combined, the two projects were intended to deliver over 2.2 gigawatts (GW) of power.

Cancellations have also occurred in New England, where developers withdrew from contracts for three projects that would have supplied another 3.2 GW of wind power to Massachusetts and Connecticut, saying the projects had become financially unviable. Together, these setbacks represent almost a fifth of President Joe Biden’s goal of 30 GW of offshore wind power by 2030.

Despite these challenges, federal and state governments are pressing forward. The White House highlighted recent investments by New York State and approval by the Department of the Interior for what will be the country's largest planned offshore wind farm in Virginia. The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management recently announced new offshore wind lease areas in the Gulf of Mexico.

The White House acknowledged broad economic challenges facing the sector, but insisted momentum continues, noting offshore wind creates well-paying union jobs in industries like manufacturing and construction, helps strengthen the power grid, and adds clean energy resources for American families and businesses.

Industry experts now expect the U.S. will likely reach 20–22 GW of offshore wind by 2030, short of the original target, but still much higher than today’s levels. Currently, just two small demonstration projects operate in the U.S., producing only a tiny fraction of one gigawatt of power.

Large ocean-based wind farms are key to national renewable energy strategies, particularly in densely populated East Coast states with limited space for traditional wind or solar projects. Eight East Coast states have set legislative or executive mandates for offshore wind, totaling over 45 GW in planned capacity, according to the research firm ClearView Energy Partners.

Timothy Fox, vice president at ClearView, noted that few believe the 30 GW target will be met by 2030, but he remains optimistic it will eventually be achieved and even surpassed.

Developers have voiced challenges such as high inflation, ongoing supply chain disruptions, and rising costs for capital and materials. Ørsted is taking a $4 billion write-off mainly due to the canceled New Jersey projects. David Hardy, Ørsted’s group executive vice president and CEO for the Americas, emphasized the importance of reducing the cost of offshore wind so Americans aren’t forced to choose between affordability and clean energy. He suggested the U.S. industry must adapt, learning from Europe’s experience of higher prices and gradual scaling at first.

Experts, like Walt Musial of the National Renewable Energy Laboratory, explained that delays between negotiating supply contracts and receiving project approval allowed cost increases to make many projects unfeasible. Musial sees Ørsted’s cancellation as a notable setback, but not a fatal one for the industry.

Positive developments continue. On Tuesday, the Biden administration approved the Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project—a 2.6 GW wind farm off Virginia Beach, expected to power 900,000 homes. Ørsted and utility Eversource are also moving ahead with construction of Revolution Wind, a 704-megawatt wind farm serving Rhode Island and Connecticut.

S&P Global Commodity Insights projects 22 GW of U.S. offshore wind by 2030, though this outlook may change after recent announcements. New York recently awarded contracts for an additional 4 GW of offshore wind capacity, as part of its plan to source 70% of electricity from renewables by 2030 and reach 9 GW of offshore wind by 2035. However, New York regulators have also denied requests for higher payments for four projects, totaling 4.2 GW, as developers reconsider their viability.

Environmental advocates warn that delays in deploying offshore wind will prolong reliance on fossil fuels. Conor Bambrick of Environmental Advocates NY argued that faster implementation will lead to quicker improvements in air quality.

New Jersey, under Democratic Governor Phil Murphy, recently moved its clean energy target from 100% by 2050 to 100% by 2035. Murphy strongly criticized Ørsted’s cancellation, labeling it as reneging on commitments, but said the state remains committed to offshore wind, with more projects pending approval.

Major offshore wind farms are now under construction, including Vineyard Wind in Massachusetts and South Fork Wind for Rhode Island and New York. Catherine Bowes, senior director at advocacy group Turn Forward, believes that despite current challenges, the U.S. offshore wind industry has strong long-term prospects due to excellent wind resources and increasing demand for clean energy. The group is now arguing for a goal of 100 GW of U.S. offshore wind.

Bowes stated that current turbulence does not suggest offshore wind won’t have a major role in the U.S. energy grid. Some canceled contracts may be rebid at higher rates to account for costs. Industry representatives are calling on the federal government to ensure projects can benefit from clean energy tax credits under the Inflation Reduction Act.

Michael Brown, CEO of Ocean Winds North America, told a recent industry conference that while U.S. offshore wind will succeed, progress may be slower than many hope.

Reporting by McDermott (Providence, Rhode Island), Hill (Albany, New York), and Catalini (Trenton, New Jersey). AP’s climate coverage is funded by private foundations; AP retains sole editorial responsibility.

WASHINGTON — Den nylige kanselleringen av to store havvindprosjekter i New Jersey markerer et nytt alvorlig tilbakeslag for USAs spirende havvindindustri. Utviklingen truer Biden-administrasjonens mål om å produsere nok havvindenergi til å forsyne 10 millioner hjem innen 2030 og skape et karbonfritt strømnett innen 2035.

Det danske vindkraftselskapet Ørsted kunngjorde denne uken at de skroter Ocean Wind I og II utenfor det sørlige New Jersey på grunn av problemer med forsyningskjeder, økte renter og manglende skatteinsentiver. Tilsammen var prosjektene ment å levere over 2,2 gigawatt (GW) strøm.

Flere kanselleringer har rammet New England, der leverandører trakk seg fra kontrakter for tre prosjekter som skulle levert ytterligere 3,2 GW vindkraft til Massachusetts og Connecticut. Disse prosjektene ble ansett som økonomisk ulønnsomme. Totalt utgjør kanselleringene nesten en femtedel av president Joe Bidens mål om 30 GW havvind innen 2030.

Likevel fortsetter både føderale og delstatlige myndigheter å satse på havvind. Det hvite hus viser til nylige investeringer fra New York og godkjennelsen fra amerikanske myndigheter av det kommende største havvindprosjektet utenfor Virginia. Bureau of Ocean Energy Management har også kunngjort nye områder for havvind i Mexicogulfen.

Det hvite hus erkjenner at bransjen møter betydelige økonomiske utfordringer, men hevder at fremdriften fortsetter. Havvind gir godt betalte fagforeningsjobber innen produksjon og bygg, styrker strømnettet og gir familier og næringsliv ny, ren energi.

Eksperter mener nå at USA trolig vil nå mellom 20 og 22 GW havvind innen 2030 – under målsetningen, men langt over dagens nivå. Foreløpig har landet kun to små demonstrasjonsprosjekter, med til sammen en liten brøkdel av én gigawatt i produksjon.

Store havvindparker er avgjørende for USAs samarbeid for fornybar energi, spesielt i befolkningstette stater på østkysten med lite plass til tradisjonell vind eller sol. Åtte østlige delstater har satt egne mål for havvind, tilsammen over 45 GW i planene, ifølge analysene fra ClearView Energy Partners.

Timothy Fox, visepresident i ClearView, sier at få regner med å nå 30 GW innen 2030, men at dette trolig vil nås – og senere overgås.

Utbyggere peker på utfordringer som høy inflasjon, forsinkede leveranser og dyrere kapital og materiale. Ørsted regner med et tap på 4 milliarder dollar grunnet kanselleringene i New Jersey. David Hardy, konserndirektør og regionssjef for Ørsted i Amerika, understreker at kostnadene må ned for at amerikanere ikke må velge mellom rimelig strøm og ren energi. Han påpeker at USA må lære av Europas erfaringer, der utviklingen startet dyrere og saktere.

Eksperter, inkludert Walt Musial fra National Renewable Energy Laboratory, mener forsinkelser mellom kontraktsinngåelse og endelig godkjenning gav rom for uforutsette kostnadsøkninger – noe som gjorde flere prosjekter ulønnsomme. Musial kaller Ørsteds beslutning et betydelig tilbakeslag, men ikke dødsstøtet for bransjen.

Positive nyheter fortsetter allikevel: Biden-administrasjonen har godkjent Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind, et prosjekt på 2,6 GW som skal forsyne 900 000 hjem. Ørsted og Eversource fortsetter dessuten byggingen av Revolution Wind, den første større havvindparken for Rhode Island og Connecticut (704 MW).

S&P Global Commodity Insights anslår 22 GW amerikansk havvind innen 2030, selv om estimatet kan justeres. New York har nylig tildelt kontrakter for 4 GW havvind og sikter mot 9 GW innen 2035. Samtidig nektet reguleringsmyndighetene økte priser for fire prosjekter på 4,2 GW, og utbyggere vurderer nå prosjektenes lønnsomhet.

Miljøforkjempere advarer om at enhver forsinkelse gir forlenget bruk av fossil energi. Conor Bambrick fra Environmental Advocates NY mener rask utbygging vil gi bedre luftkvalitet tidligere.

New Jersey, ledet av demokraten Phil Murphy, har skjerpet sitt mål fra 100 % ren energi innen 2050 til 2035. Murphy kritiserer Ørsteds kansellering og påpeker at staten vil fortsette satsingen på havvind – flere prosjekter venter beslutning.

Store prosjekter som Vineyard Wind i Massachusetts og South Fork Wind mellom Rhode Island og New York er i bygging. Catherine Bowes (Turn Forward) påpeker at vindressursene og behovet for ren kraft gir bransjen gode langsiktige muligheter. Organisasjonen foreslår 100 GW amerikansk havvind.

Bowes sier dagens utfordringer ikke truer havvindens betydning for nettet. Noen kontrakter kan reforhandles til høyere pris. Bransjen ber myndighetene sikre skattefordeler gjennom Inflation Reduction Act.

Michael Brown i Ocean Winds North America påpekte under en bransjekonferanse at havvind vil lykkes i USA, men det kan ta litt lenger tid enn man ønsker.

Rapportering: McDermott (Providence), Hill (Albany), Catalini (Trenton). APs klimajournalistikk støttes av private stiftelser; AP har redaksjonelt ansvar.

article_content: A new paper highlights how ancient Maya reservoirs, which used aquatic plants and sophisticated engineering to filter and clean water, can inspire sustainable water systems for the future. University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign anthropology professor Lisa Lucero, writing in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, describes reservoirs built and maintained by the Maya that provided clean drinking water for thousands—even tens of thousands—of people for over a millennium. Most major southern lowland Maya cities arose in areas with poor surface water but fertile soils. To address water scarcity, the Maya constructed reservoir systems that gradually increased in size and complexity. They developed canals, dams, sluices, and berms for water management, and used quartz sand for filtration, sometimes importing it from distant locations to major cities like Tikal in present-day northern Guatemala. Sediment cores from Tikal’s reservoirs also show the use of zeolite sand, a volcanic mineral known for filtering contaminants and microbes. Tikal's reservoirs had a capacity of more than 900,000 cubic meters, supporting an estimated population of up to 80,000 during the Late Classic period (ca. 600–800 C.E.). The reservoirs provided water for people and agriculture during dry seasons. According to Lucero, clean water was closely tied to political power, with the largest reservoirs situated near Maya royal palaces and temples. Kings performed ceremonies to honor ancestors and the rain god Chahk to maintain rain and water supplies. A persistent challenge was the risk of standing reservoir water becoming stagnant and unsafe. The Maya addressed this by utilizing aquatic plants—such as cattails, sedges, reeds, and especially water lilies—that are still common in Central American wetlands. These plants filtered the water, improved clarity, and absorbed excess nutrients. To maintain reservoir quality, the Maya dredged periodically and replenished aquatic plants. The nutrient-rich soil and vegetation removed during this process were repurposed as fertilizer for urban agriculture. The water lily (Nymphaea ampla), thriving only in clean water, became an icon of Maya kingship and is depicted in Maya art. Its pollen has been found in multiple reservoir sediment cores. Water lilies are sensitive to acidity, high levels of calcium (as from limestone), and certain minerals. Reservoir managers lined basins with clay and sediment to support lily growth and planted shade trees along the banks to cool the water and inhibit algal blooms. Maya people generally did not settle right on the reservoir banks, reducing the risk of contamination from runoff. Archaeological and sediment evidence indicates Maya reservoirs provided potable water for over 1,000 years, ceasing to function mainly during the most severe droughts between 800 and 900 C.E. Lucero suggests modern climate change challenges could benefit from re-applying Maya strategies, such as the use of constructed wetlands and aquatic plants for natural water purification. Constructed wetlands offer many advantages: they are cost-effective, energy saving, and foster supportive habitats for aquatic wildlife while replenishing soils with nutrients. Lucero encourages combining ancient knowledge with modern expertise to develop resilient water systems for the future.

article_content: Kenya Smith has only positive memories of her 14-year career in the U.S. Navy, which she left in 2009. 'I love the Navy,' she said in a recent interview in Maryland. Smith, a former lieutenant and medical service corps officer, joined the Navy after college. By the time she left, she had earned two master’s degrees, served in Iraq, and gained extensive experience in healthcare and administration—skills she hoped would impress civilian employers. Despite her accomplishments, Smith has been unemployed for two years since transitioning out of the military. As a single mother of two teenagers, she lost her home to foreclosure in September and now lives in transitional housing. ‘I’m a female homeless vet with children, and that’s horrible,’ Smith said. 'You go from being self-supporting and serving your country to being unable to find a job, and now I’m homeless.' Smith is not alone. In September, the unemployment rate for post-9/11 veterans was 11.7%, higher than the national average of 9.1%, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. The rate for female veterans was even higher, at 14.7%. The reasons for the higher unemployment rate among female veterans are not entirely clear. Advocates point to challenges such as securing child care and navigating a Veterans Affairs system and a civilian workforce that may not fully recognize the scope of women’s military service. 'Fifteen percent of returning veterans are women. They’re on the front lines and leading tough missions,' said Paul Rieckhoff, executive director of Iraq and Afghanistan Veterans of America. 'They need the same training and support as their male counterparts.' Smith found it difficult to create a resume and translate her military experience into terms that civilian employers could understand. She has worked with professional resume writers, attended job fairs, and sent out dozens of resumes, but has received few responses and only two interviews, including one for a position at Macy’s. Smith believes she may be considered overqualified for many positions. The challenges of unemployment and overqualification have contributed to feelings of depression and instability. 'It’s difficult when you live in a place that isn’t a military town. People don’t always value your service when you’re looking for a job and trying to keep your home,' Smith said. Smith left the Navy for health reasons and is unsure if reenlistment is possible. Recently, she has shifted her approach, taking advice to apply for more senior positions that match her skills. Through it all, she remains optimistic: 'My faith gets me through a lot. I believe something better will come along.' Her children, she says, are a source of strength and understanding. However, Smith is facing a deadline. She and her children must leave their temporary housing in two weeks, on November 11—Veterans Day. CNN’s Jonathan Helman contributed to this report.

I september var arbeidsledigheten blant post-9/11-veteraner 11,7 %, høyere enn det nasjonale gjennomsnittet på 9,1 %, ifølge Bureau of Labor Statistics. For kvinnelige veteraner var tallet enda høyere, med 14,7 %.  Årsakene til den høyere arbeidsledigheten blant kvinnelige veteraner er ikke helt klare. Talsmenn peker på utfordringer som barnepass og et Veterans Affairs-system, samt en sivil arbeidsstyrke, som kanskje ikke fullt ut forstår omfanget av kvinners militærtjeneste. 'De trenger den samme opplæringen og støtten som sine mannlige kolleger.' Smith syntes det var vanskelig å lage en CV og oversette sin militære erfaring til termer sivile arbeidsgivere forstår. Hun har jobbet med profesjonelle CV-skribenter, deltatt på jobbmesser og sendt ut dusinvis av søknader, men har fått få svar og bare to intervjuer, inkludert en på Macy’s. Smith tror hun ofte blir vurdert som overkvalifisert. Utfordringene med arbeidsledighet og overkvalifisering har bidratt til følelser av depresjon og ustabilitet. 'Det er vanskelig når du bor på et sted som ikke er en militærby. Folk setter ikke alltid pris på tjenesten din når du prøver å finne jobb og beholde hjemmet ditt,' sa Smith. Smith forlot marinen av helseårsaker og er usikker på om hun kan verve seg igjen. I det siste har hun valgt å søke på mer seniorstillinger som samsvarer med kompetansen hennes. Gjennom det hele forblir hun optimistisk: 'Troen min hjelper meg mye. Jeg tror noe bedre vil komme.' Barna hennes, sier hun, er en styrke og gir forståelse. Likevel står Smith overfor en tidsfrist. Hun og barna må forlate det midlertidige botilbudet sitt om to uker, den 11. november—Veterans Day. CNNs Jonathan Helman bidro til denne rapporten.

article_content: Speaker John Bercow, two Commons officials, and two MPs traveled to Seoul, South Korea, last weekend to attend the World E-Parliament Conference 2014. The trip, which is believed to have cost more than £10,000, included business class flights and accommodation at a four-star hotel. Bercow’s office stated that he had a packed schedule and delivered a well-received keynote speech at the conference, which focused on digital engagement between MPs and voters. Bercow has made digital engagement a key goal, establishing a Speaker’s Commission on Digital Engagement, which includes MPs such as Robert Halfon (Conservative) and Meg Hillier (Labour), both of whom also attended. However, Conservative MP Rob Wilson questioned the justification for sending five people, pointing out the expense during financially tight times, while the TaxPayers’ Alliance also criticized the perceived lack of value for taxpayers. A spokesman for Bercow explained that he and one aide flew business class at £2,600 each, opting for the most affordable business option available. Halfon and Hillier said they were invited by the Inter-Parliamentary Union, which covered their costs, and stressed the conference was a working trip. Hillier said the event required hard work, and Halfon described spending three days in meetings at the South Korean parliament.

On Sunday, India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar paid tribute to the victims of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks on the 15th anniversary of the tragedy. Through his official X (formerly Twitter) account, Jaishankar reaffirmed India's commitment to pursuing justice for those who planned and carried out these attacks.

The 26/11 attacks occurred on November 26, 2008, when ten heavily armed terrorists from the Pakistan-based group Lashkar-e-Taiba carried out a series of coordinated assaults on Mumbai. For four days, the attackers held India's financial capital under siege, targeting prominent locations like the Taj and Oberoi Hotels, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Chabad House (a Jewish community center), Nariman House, and the Leopold Cafe. A total of 166 people, including foreign nationals, were killed during the attacks.

The attackers strategically chose high-profile locations, many popular with both locals and foreign visitors. Of the ten terrorists, only Mohammad Ajmal Amir Qasab was captured alive at the Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus. He was sentenced to death in 2010 and executed two years later in Pune. The attacks left a lasting emotional impact on the country, and the memory of those days continues to haunt many.

article_content: Actor Steven Berkoff has been banned from driving for six months after running a red light in Central London last year. The 75-year-old, known for playing General Orlov in the James Bond film Octopussy, claimed he only ran the light to move out of the way of a police car. In a letter read at City of London Magistrates' Court, Berkoff explained he heard a siren and turned to avoid it, but still pleaded guilty by post to failing to comply with traffic signals on October 25. With prior convictions for speeding and running a red light, Berkoff already had nine points on his UK licence. Receiving three more points led to an automatic six-month driving ban. Prosecutor Varinder Hayre stated Berkoff drove his Volkswagen Beetle through a red light at Upper Thames Street and Queen Street Place after it had been red for 1.5 seconds, traveling at 27mph. The police did not offer a conditional offer because of the length of time the light had been red. Checks revealed he holds a UK licence, though he initially provided a Californian licence number. Magistrates fined Berkoff £300, with £85 in court costs and a £30 victim surcharge.

article_content: Once primarily known as a hydration drink for children, Pedialyte is now gaining traction among college and graduate students in Chicago as a potential hangover remedy. Local demand has been so strong that the delivery service Foxtrot is considering adding Pedialyte to its menu due to frequent requests for the product. Although historically steady, Pedialyte’s sales have recently seen a sharp increase. Market research from IRI reveals that in August, sales of Pedialyte in Chicago jumped by 16% compared to the same month in the previous year. Some users liken the drink to Gatorade, but highlight that Pedialyte contains less sugar. Musician Jason Isbell described it as ‘like 10 Gatorades in a bottle’ in The New York Times Magazine. Despite its growing popularity among students seeking post-party relief, the effectiveness of Pedialyte as a hangover cure remains debated. A team from Sun Yat-Sen University in Guangzhou, for instance, suggests that Sprite may actually be the most effective remedy, while Dr. Stanley Goldfarb, a professor at the University of Pennsylvania, argues that there is no true shortcut: 'There's nothing you can do to remove the alcohol byproducts—they must be metabolized by the liver, which takes time.' Pedialyte’s manufacturer, Abbot Laboratories, has not commented on the beverage’s use as a hangover aid. Officially, Pedialyte is marketed as the top oral electrolyte solution recommended by pediatricians.

article_content: Jitan Ram Manjhi, leader of the Hindustani Awam Morcha and former chief minister of Bihar, claimed on Friday that certain individuals may be deliberately contaminating Chief Minister Nitish Kumar’s food, aiming to displace him from his position. He suggested this could explain Kumar’s recent public outbursts and behavior, which Manjhi characterized as signs of deteriorating mental health. Manjhi announced plans to meet Bihar Governor Rajendra Arlekar to discuss the seriousness of the situation and called for a thorough investigation into the safety of the chief minister’s meals. Standing alongside his current allies from the BJP, Manjhi withheld specific details but insisted that some people near Nitish Kumar are seeking his removal. Nitish attributed Manjhi’s past appointment as CM to his own ‘error’, while Manjhi countered by alleging that Nitish had lost mental balance and underestimated him. article_content: Less than 24 hours after winning the third season of 'The Voice,' Cassadee Pope is still catching her breath. 'I don't think it's really settled in yet,' she tells Rolling Stone. 'It's just unreal. I can't believe it. I haven't had a chance to sit down and soak it up. But it's just crazy. I'm very excited.' In addition to winning the show, 23-year-old Pope is still amazed that she performed 'I'm With You'—one of her all-time favorite songs—with the original singer, Avril Lavigne, whom she has long admired. 'She's always had that thing about her that spoke to me, which is being herself and not apologizing for it,' Pope says. 'That's something I struggle with, honestly. I care what people think about me sometimes, and sometimes it affects me. Her music reminds me to be myself.' A native of West Palm Beach, Florida, and the former lead singer of Hey Monday, Pope admits she was hesitant at first to audition for 'The Voice.' While still with her band last year, she turned down an opportunity to audition for season two. After moving to Los Angeles for her solo career, struggling financially and running out of contacts, Pope reconsidered when 'The Voice' invited her again. 'I almost passed on it again,' she admits. 'I don't know why... just being in the band world, you get a little proud. Part of me wanted to do it from the ground up, the old-fashioned way, but that's almost impossible nowadays.' Now, Pope has no regrets. 'Doing the show was the best career decision I've ever made,' she says. 'It got people to really listen. It's not going to be Hey Monday; it's something new.' Throughout the season, Pope faced criticism online for her previous music experience, with some saying it gave her an unfair advantage. 'That was discouraging,' she says. 'But I had to prove myself. I think if you have the heart and passion, you deserve it no matter your background.' Under the mentorship of Blake Shelton, Pope embraced country music, moving away from her pop-punk roots. Her standout performance was Shelton's ballad 'Over You,' which was the only song this season to reach number one on the iTunes charts. After her victory, Pope signed with Universal Republic and will soon begin recording her debut solo album. 'It will have more of a Nineties, early 2000s feel,' she says. 'Pop-rock with a country twist. There’s still a lot to figure out, but I want it to cover both genres.' Original story at RollingStone.com.

Men det er bare sprøtt. Jeg er veldig spent.' I tillegg til å vinne programmet, er 23 år gamle Pope fortsatt overveldet over at hun fikk synge 'I'm With You'—en av hennes absolutte favorittsanger—med den originale artisten, Avril Lavigne, som hun har beundret lenge. 'Hun har alltid hatt noe ved seg som har fascinert meg, det å være seg selv og ikke unnskylde seg for det,' sier Pope. 'Det er noe jeg selv sliter litt med. Jeg bryr meg om hva folk synes om meg, og noen ganger påvirker det meg. Musikken hennes minner meg på å være meg selv.' Som opprinnelig fra West Palm Beach, Florida, og tidligere vokalist i Hey Monday, innrømmer Pope at hun var usikker på å melde seg på 'The Voice' i starten. article_content: A fraternity chapter at the University of Mississippi has been indefinitely suspended, and three of its members expelled, following allegations they placed a noose on the statue of James Meredith, the university’s first Black student. Sigma Phi Epsilon, the fraternity involved, stated it may provide authorities with the identities of the members believed responsible for the act. The fraternity’s Alpha Chapter voted to expel all three men involved. The incident sparked protests among University of Mississippi students beside the James Meredith statue. On Sunday, police discovered both a noose around the statue’s neck and a Georgia state flag featuring the Confederate battle emblem. James Meredith, who integrated Ole Miss in 1962 despite violent opposition led by the state’s governor, ultimately earned a political science degree under federal protection. On Friday, the FBI announced it was expanding its investigation of the vandalism to consider potential violations of federal law. Sigma Phi Epsilon’s national chief executive, Brian C. Warren Jr., expressed regret that the expelled members had ever been associated with the organization, emphasizing the fraternity’s long-standing commitment to racial equality and diversity since it began welcoming members of all backgrounds in 1959. The university attempted to interview the three students linked to the act on Friday, but their attorneys prevented questioning without arrest warrants. Their identities have not been made public. University spokesperson Danny Blanton confirmed that findings have been referred to the district attorney, and internal disciplinary action will proceed through a panel of faculty and students. Blanton said the university is confident that the three students under investigation are responsible. The Ole Miss Alumni Association has offered a $25,000 reward for information leading to arrests. Police chief Calvin Sellers noted the reward has resulted in promising leads, though it is unclear who will ultimately receive it. District Attorney Ben Creekmore told local media that filing criminal charges may be challenging, as the statue was not physically damaged and the suspects did not appear to trespass. However, he noted that federal authorities could pursue charges if warranted. Creekmore added the case could be revisited if new information emerges. Blanton emphasized the university’s desire to set a clear example that acts like this will not be tolerated. Disciplinary measures could include dismissal and banning the responsible students from campus. Blanton also invited those involved to come forward and share their perspective so the motivations behind the incident could be understood.

Sigma Phi Epsilon, det involverte brorskapet, uttalte at de kan gi myndighetene identiteten til medlemmene som antas å være ansvarlige for handlingen. Alpha-kapittelet i brorskapet stemte for å utvise alle tre involverte menn. Hendelsen utløste protester blant University of Mississippi-studenter ved James Meredith-statuen. Søndag oppdaget politiet både en løkke rundt statuens hals og et Georgia-delstatsflagg med Confederate battle-emblemet. Universitetet forsøkte å avhøre de tre studentene som er knyttet til handlingen på fredag, men advokatene deres nektet dette uten arrestordre. Identiteten deres er ikke gjort offentlig kjent. Disiplinære tiltak kan inkludere utvisning og utestengelse fra campus. Blanton inviterte også de involverte til å stå fram og dele sitt perspektiv, slik at man kan forstå motivasjonen bak hendelsen.

article_content: An international think-tank reports that, since the 2007 financial crisis, men born abroad have been more likely to have jobs in the UK than those born in Britain. Although overall employment fell during the economic downturn, male migrants in the UK have experienced higher employment levels than British-born men. Prior to 2007, foreign-born men were less likely to be employed than UK-born men. The OECD's International Migration Outlook 2013 shows that since 2007, foreign-born men have surpassed British-born men in employment rates. The report notes that employment rates for British-born men have declined since 2001, while for foreign-born men, they have increased. In 2006, 76.9% of British-born men were employed compared to 76.3% of foreign-born men. By 2008, these rates flipped to 76.8% for British-born and 77.8% for foreign-born men. By 2012, the gap further widened, with 74.3% employment for men born in the UK and 76.9% for foreign-born men. For women, UK-born women continue to have higher employment rates than foreign-born women. Sir Andrew Green, chairman of MigrationWatch UK, has called for a thorough assessment of the impact of immigration on UK workers. The unemployment rate is currently 7.8%, according to the Office for National Statistics. The OECD found that the UK and Germany have become the largest recipients of migrants from countries most affected by the financial crisis, especially in southern Europe, with migrant numbers from these areas nearly doubling in recent years. The report also notes that uptake of social benefits by immigrants in the UK is lower than the OECD average. Don Flynn, director of the Migrants' Rights Network, pointed out that rising participation and earnings among male migrants highlight how migration is a positive feature for modern economies. ONS figures show that between February and April 2013, 2.51 million people were unemployed. The OECD report points out that the employment rate for British-born men dropped from 78.14% in 2001 to 74.73% in 2012, while for male migrants it increased from 72.3% to 76.9%. A Home Office spokesperson said that half of foreign-born UK residents are now British citizens and that recent employment growth has primarily benefited British citizens, though skilled migrants remain important for the UK economy. The OECD also highlights uncertainty over future migration from Romania and Bulgaria due to limited data, but some studies indicate that many young people from these countries are interested in coming to the UK for work when restrictions are lifted. Furthermore, the report states that international students are over-represented in UK universities compared to the proportion of the foreign-born population. Overall, the uptake of social benefits by immigrants in the UK remains below the OECD average.

Før 2007 var menn født i utlandet mindre sannsynlig å være i arbeid enn menn født i Storbritannia. Rapporten peker på at sysselsettingsraten for britiskfødte menn har gått ned siden 2001, mens for menn født i utlandet har den økt. I 2006 var 76,9 % av britiskfødte menn sysselsatt, sammenlignet med 76,3 % av menn født i utlandet. I 2008 hadde tallene snudd til 76,8 % for britiskfødte og 77,8 % for utenlandsfødte menn. I 2012 økte forskjellen ytterligere, med 74,3 % sysselsetting for menn født i Storbritannia og 76,9 % for menn født i utlandet. For kvinner har britiskfødte fortsatt høyere sysselsettingsrate enn utenlandsfødte kvinner. Sir Andrew Green, leder for MigrationWatch UK, har bedt om en grundig vurdering av innvandringens påvirkning på britiske arbeidere. Arbeidsledigheten er nå på 7,8 %, ifølge Office for National Statistics. OECD fant at Storbritannia og Tyskland har blitt de største mottakerlandene for migranter fra land som er hardest rammet av finanskrisen, spesielt i Sør-Europa, hvor antall migranter fra disse områdene nesten har doblet seg de siste årene. Rapporten peker også på at bruk av sosiale ytelser blant innvandrere i Storbritannia er lavere enn OECD-gjennomsnittet. Don Flynn, direktør for Migrants' Rights Network, påpeker at økende deltakelse og inntjening blant mannlige migranter understreker at migrasjon er et positivt trekk ved moderne økonomier. Tall fra ONS viser at mellom februar og april 2013 var 2,51 millioner mennesker arbeidsledige. OECD-rapporten fremhever at sysselsettingsraten for britiskfødte menn falt fra 78,14 % i 2001 til 74,73 % i 2012, mens den for mannlige migranter økte fra 72,3 % til 76,9 %.  En talsperson for Home Office sa at halvparten av Storbritannias utenlandsfødte innbyggere nå er britiske statsborgere, og den nylige veksten i sysselsetting har primært kommet britiske statsborgere til gode, selv om kvalifiserte migranter fortsatt er viktige for britisk næringsliv. OECD påpeker også usikkerhet rundt fremtidig migrasjon fra Romania og Bulgaria på grunn av begrensede data, men noen studier antyder at mange unge fra disse landene ønsker å komme til Storbritannia for å jobbe når restriksjonene oppheves. Videre slår rapporten fast at internasjonale studenter er overrepresentert ved britiske universiteter sammenlignet med andelen av utenlandsfødte i befolkningen. Totalt sett ligger bruken av sosiale ytelser blant innvandrere i Storbritannia under OECD-gjennomsnittet.

article_content: Michigan is set to roll out tough new regulations targeting artificial intelligence and manipulated media in political advertising, as federal authorities continue to debate broader measures ahead of the 2024 elections. The new law, expected to be signed soon by Governor Gretchen Whitmer, requires all state and federal campaigns running ads in Michigan to clearly disclose if AI was used in creating the material. It also bans using AI-generated deepfakes within 90 days of an election unless there is a clear warning identifying the content as manipulated. Deepfakes are fake media crafted by AI tools that can convincingly make people appear to do or say things they never did. Generative AI now easily produces realistic images, videos, and audio. There are growing concerns that these technologies could be exploited in the presidential election, enabling rapid and large-scale voter deception, candidate impersonation, and election interference. Political entities already use these tools—for example, the Republican National Committee produced a fully AI-powered ad in April, depicting an apocalyptic scenario if President Joe Biden is reelected. Despite a small disclaimer, the ad showed fabricated scenes of chaos and mass immigration. In July, Never Back Down, a super PAC backing Florida Governor Ron DeSantis, used AI voice cloning to imitate Donald Trump, falsely making it seem as if he spoke words he never did. Experts say these incidents may just be the beginning of AI misuse. Other states such as California, Minnesota, Texas, and Washington have enacted similar laws regulating political deepfakes, and more states are considering them. Michigan’s law mandates anyone distributing political ads for a candidate to specify if generative AI was used. Print ads must show the disclosure in the main text size, and video ads need a clear notice for at least four seconds in matching font size. Deepfakes aired within 90 days of an election must carry a visible warning throughout that the content is manipulated. Violating these rules could result in up to 93 days in jail, a $1,000 fine, or both for a first offense. The attorney general or anyone harmed may seek legal remedies. Federal lawmakers continue to debate AI deepfake regulation, but nothing has passed yet. A bipartisan Senate bill, the Deceptive AI Act, introduced by Amy Klobuchar and Josh Hawley, aims to ban materially misleading deepfakes in federal races, except in cases of obvious parody or satire. Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson recently advocated in D.C. for both federal and state-level action, highlighting the need for funding so states can confront the challenges of political AI and educate voters on spotting deepfakes. In August, the Federal Election Commission opened consideration of regulating AI-generated political ads, but no new rule has yet emerged. Meanwhile, Meta and Google are updating their ad policies to require labels on political ads involving AI.

Den nye loven, som snart ventes signert av guvernør Gretchen Whitmer, krever at alle statlige og føderale kampanjer som kjører reklame i Michigan tydelig må opplyse om AI er brukt i innholdet. Generativ AI produserer nå lett bilder, videoer og lyd som virker ekte. Bekymringen øker for at teknologiene kan brukes i presidentvalget til å lure velgere, etterligne kandidater og forstyrre valget i større skala enn før. Politiske aktører har allerede begynt å bruke slike verktøy – for eksempel laget Republican National Committee en helt AI-basert reklame i april, som beskrev et dystert scenario dersom president Joe Biden blir gjenvalgt. Michigans utenriksminister Jocelyn Benson har nylig tatt til orde i Washington, D.C. for handling både nasjonalt og lokalt, og mener mer støtte trengs om delstatene skal møte utfordringene fra AI i politikken og lære opp velgere til å avsløre deepfakes. I august åpnet Federal Election Commission debatt om å regulere AI-genererte politiske reklamer, men ingen nye regler er innført ennå. Meta og Google oppdaterer samtidig sine annonsepolitikker, slik at politiske annonser som bruker AI må merkes tydelig.

article_content: Yogi Omar, a 30-year-old living in Vancouver, was low on cash when he was approached by a man asking for spare change. Although at first hesitant, Omar decided to offer the man a meal. To his astonishment, the man declined and instead wanted to help Omar. It was then revealed that this man was not actually homeless, but a generous benefactor involved in a family tradition. Each year during the Christmas season, he and his family go out at night to reward strangers who show compassion to those in need. Omar, who was going to an ATM and coping with his own financial struggles, told the man that he recently bought expensive tickets to visit his father in China, who has terminal cancer. Moved by Omar's gesture and honesty, the benefactor pulled out $469 from his fanny pack to pay Omar's January rent. Though Omar declined help with the flight cost, he gratefully accepted the rent money. The benefactor chose to stay anonymous, stating it's part of his tradition, and encouraged Omar to keep helping others. Omar, co-founder of the InspirationALL Talent and Modelling Group, shared the story on Facebook, where it received much attention and inspired others. He said he hopes people will follow the example and 'share the love' through kind actions.

Det viste seg at mannen egentlig ikke var hjemløs, men en sjenerøs velgjører som deltok i en familietradisjon. Hvert år i juletiden går han og familien ut om kvelden for å belønne fremmede som viser omsorg for de som trenger det. Omar, som var på vei til en minibank og selv slet økonomisk, fortalte mannen at han nylig hadde kjøpt dyre billetter for å besøke sin far i Kina, som har uhelbredelig kreft. Rørt av Omars ærlighet og generøsitet, tok velgjøreren fram 469 dollar fra rumpetasken og tilbød å betale Omars husleie for januar. Selv om Omar takket nei til hjelp med flybilletten, tok han takknemlig imot bidraget til husleien. Velgjøreren ønsket å være anonym og forklarte at det er en del av tradisjonen, og oppfordret Omar til å fortsette å hjelpe andre. Omar, medgründer av InspirationALL Talent and Modelling Group, delte historien på Facebook, hvor den fikk mye oppmerksomhet og inspirerte andre. Han håper folk vil følge eksempelet og 'dele kjærligheten' gjennom gode handlinger.

The Food and Drug Administration is currently examining flibanserin, which could become the first approved medication aimed at treating low sexual desire in premenopausal women. Though sometimes called the 'female Viagra,' the FDA’s analysis shows only slight improvement over a placebo, with benefits described as limited. This Friday, a panel of reproductive health experts is set to vote on whether flibanserin is safe and effective for women with low sexual desire—a condition affecting up to 40% of women in the U.S., based on some estimates. Currently, there are no approved treatments for hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD).

Boehringer Ingelheim, the German manufacturer of flibanserin, remains confident about the drug. Peter Piliero, a leader on the company’s U.S. medical team, claims their studies show flibanserin increases satisfying sexual events, boosts sexual desire, and reduces distress. Even with only moderate benefits, some doctors believe the approval would be a landmark for women facing HSDD. Dr. Irwin Goldstein, who has served as an advisor to the pharmaceutical company, states that recognizing and treating HSDD through medication would represent a crucial and overdue advance for women.

Fredag skal et panel av eksperter innen reproduktiv helse stemme over om flibanserin er trygt og effektivt for kvinner med lav sexlyst – en tilstand som rammer opptil 40 prosent av kvinner i USA, ifølge noen anslag. article_content: Angry Birds, the popular online game enjoyed by over 200 million people—including figures such as David Cameron, Dick Cheney, and Justin Bieber—has now received royal endorsement. The Duke of Cambridge (Prince William) has partnered with Rovio Entertainment, the studio behind Angry Birds, to raise global awareness about the plight of the pangolin. As part of this collaboration, pangolins will appear in a special Angry Birds tournament for the next seven days. Prince William is encouraging efforts to save these unique and endangered animals. In a video message accompanying the tournament’s launch, Prince William highlighted that pangolins, often referred to as scaly anteaters, are among the most endangered creatures in the world due to extensive poaching. He warned that pangolins risk becoming extinct before many people have even learned about them. Pangolins are the world’s only fully scaly mammals, but their numbers have sharply declined in recent years, largely as a result of poaching. Indigenous to regions in China and Southeast Asia, pangolins are considered a delicacy and are used both in traditional medicine and home decor. Due to these factors, they are now regarded as one of the most trafficked animals globally, with the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) estimating that approximately one million pangolins have been taken from the wild in the past decade. Because of this dramatic decline, all eight pangolin species were added to the IUCN Red List over the summer, marking them as at imminent risk of extinction. According to Professor Jonathan Baillie, Co-Chair of the IUCN SSC Pangolin Specialist Group, "All eight pangolin species are now listed as threatened with extinction, largely because of illegal trade to China and Vietnam. In the 21st century, we should not be eating species to extinction—there is no justification for allowing this illegal trade to continue." As president of United for Wildlife, Prince William collaborates with conservation organizations to fight the illegal wildlife trade. He emphasized that such criminal activities are responsible for the deaths of tens of thousands of animals—especially elephants, rhinos, and pangolins—every year. These species are being pushed to the brink of extinction and could disappear from the wild within this generation unless action is taken. Prince William expressed hope that the Angry Birds tournament would help more people become involved in conservation and raise awareness about the pangolin crisis, following a similar partnership with the game RuneScape focused on rhino protection. He called on the public to help spread the message, noting that while poaching might seem minor compared to global issues, it is a significant part of the larger problem—and one that everyone can help address. He also pointed out that poaching funds criminal gangs and sometimes even terrorist organizations, robbing ancient communities of their cultural heritage and livelihoods. William encouraged people to join a movement against poached animal products, including ivory and rhino horn, by sharing information about the impact of poaching.

Han påpekte også at krypskyting finansierer kriminelle gjenger og noen ganger til og med terrororganisasjoner, og tar fra gamle samfunn deres arv og levebrød. William oppfordret folk til å bli med i en bevegelse mot ulovlige dyreprodukter, inkludert elfenben og neshornhorn, ved å spre informasjon om konsekvensene av krypskyting.

As U.S. troops completed their withdrawal from Iraq on Sunday, questions and uncertainties about the country's future remain, analysts told CNN's 'State of the Union.'

Retired Gen. James Cartwright, former vice-chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, remarked, 'There are a lot of things here that are not finished. There are activities in the region that are still sitting on the edge of potential conflict.' Paul Bremer, former U.S. envoy to Iraq under President George W. Bush, noted that President Barack Obama had 'placed a very big bet' by pulling out troops. 'The definition of victory actually was given by the president when he announced we were pulling out. He said a democratic Iraq can be a model for the region. That's right. That's what President Bush also said. And the question is, can a democratic Iraq survive if America pulls out before the job is done?' Bremer questioned.

Analysts are closely watching neighboring Iran's next moves. Robin Wright, a joint fellow at the U.S. Institute of Peace and the Woodrow Wilson Center, said, 'Iran's clearly one of the strategic winners out of this. The United States managed to eliminate one of the two arch-rivals that Iran faced, and so Iran has gained a much stronger position.' She further explained that although Iran will likely have significant influence with many top leaders in Iraq, historic tensions between Arabs and Persians could resurface after the U.S. withdrawal, and Iraq is not necessarily destined to become a province of Iran.

The departure of the last U.S. troops on Sunday ended an almost nine-year war. The U.S. Department of Defense reports 4,487 service members killed and more than 30,000 wounded. While the exact number of Iraqi casualties is unclear, the independent Iraq Body Count database has compiled reports of more than 150,000 deaths between 2003 and October 2010, with civilians making up roughly 80% of those killed.

President Obama stated Monday that the end of the Iraq war marks a 'new chapter' in U.S.-Iraq relations, focusing now on a 'normal relationship between sovereign nations.' In talks with Iraqi Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki, Obama emphasized their plans to build a comprehensive partnership, including trade relations, support for Iraq's democratic institutions, and military-to-military ties, especially as Iraq seeks to rebuild its air force, destroyed during the war against Saddam Hussein’s regime. 'Our goal is simply to make sure Iraq succeeds,' Obama said.

Meanwhile, political tensions in Iraq escalated on Sunday as the Iraqiya bloc, which draws support mainly from Sunnis and secular Iraqis, announced a boycott of parliament, threatening the country's fragile power-sharing system. The bloc alleges that Prime Minister al-Maliki is attempting to consolidate dictatorial power, and some believe he had awaited the U.S. withdrawal before taking such steps.

Wright pointed out, 'These old sectarian divides are in many ways deeper than they were even under Saddam Hussein, and the United States can play a certain kind of role in that,' emphasizing ongoing diplomatic engagement even after U.S. troops depart. Gen. Cartwright suggested that U.S. troops might return to Iraq to help train local forces: 'It will be interesting to see. I think the opportunity is there for us to bring forces back in.'

CNN’s Moni Basu, Arwa Damon, and Mohammed Tawfeeq contributed to this report.
