Da amerikanske styrker trakk seg helt ut av Irak søndag, står det fortsatt mange spørsmål og usikkerhet rundt landets fremtid, fortalte analytikere til CNNs «State of the Union».

Generalløytnant (p) James Cartwright, tidligere nestleder for Joint Chiefs of Staff, uttalte: «Det er mye her som ikke er ferdig. Det skjer fortsatt aktiviteter i regionen som kan utløse konflikt.» Paul Bremer, tidligere amerikansk spesialutsending til Irak under president George W. Bush, påpekte at president Barack Obama hadde «satset stort» ved å trekke ut styrkene. «Definisjonen på seier kom egentlig fra presidenten da han annonserte uttrekningen. Han sa at et demokratisk Irak kan bli et forbilde for regionen. Det er riktig. Det sa også president Bush. Spørsmålet er om et demokratisk Irak kan overleve hvis amerikanerne drar før jobben er gjort?» spurte Bremer.

Analytikere følger nøye med på hva nabolandet Iran vil gjøre videre. Robin Wright, stipendiat ved U.S. Institute of Peace og Woodrow Wilson Center, sa: «Iran er utvilsomt en av de strategiske vinnerne her. USA klarte å eliminere en av Irans to hovedfiender, og dermed står Iran mye sterkere.» Hun forklarte også at selv om Iran sannsynligvis får større innflytelse over ledere i Irak, kan gamle spenninger mellom arabere og persere blusse opp etter USAs tilbaketrekning. Irak blir ikke nødvendigvis en provins av Iran.

Uttrekningen av de siste amerikanske troppene markerte slutten på nesten ni år med krig. Ifølge det amerikanske forsvarsdepartementet har 4 487 tjenestepersoner blitt drept og over 30 000 såret. Det finnes ingen sikre tall på antall drepte irakere, men Iraq Body Count anslår over 150 000 døde mellom 2003 og oktober 2010, hvor rundt 80 % var sivile.

President Obama uttalte mandag at slutten på Irak-krigen markerer et «nytt kapittel» i samarbeidet mellom USA og Irak, med vekt på et «normalt forhold mellom suverene nasjoner». I samtaler med Iraks statsminister Nuri al-Maliki fremhevet Obama planer om et omfattende partnerskap, inkludert handelsforbindelser, støtte til demokratiske institusjoner og militært samarbeid, særlig når Irak nå skal bygge opp luftforsvaret sitt etter krigen mot Saddam Hussein. «Vårt mål er rett og slett at Irak skal lykkes,» sa Obama.

Samtidig tiltok den politiske krisen i Irak søndag, da den innflytelsesrike Irakiyablokken med mye støtte fra sunnimuslimske og sekulære grupper, kunngjorde at de ville boikotte parlamentet. Dette truer landets skjøre maktbalanse. Blokken mener statsminister al-Maliki forsøker å samle mer makt, og flere tror han ventet til amerikanerne dro. 

Wright bemerket: «Disse gamle sekteriske skillene er på mange måter dypere enn under Saddam Hussein, og USA kan fortsatt spille en viss rolle», og understreket viktigheten av diplomatisk engasjement også etter USAs uttrekning. Cartwright antydet at amerikanske styrker kan vende tilbake for å trene irakiske styrker: «Det blir interessant å se. Jeg mener muligheten er der for å bringe styrker tilbake.»

CNNs Moni Basu, Arwa Damon og Mohammed Tawfeeq bidro til denne rapporten.

article_content: SALERNO, Italy – Less than 24 hours after arriving at a southern Italian port, 60 migrants who survived a dangerous journey from Libya were served expulsion orders. These individuals came from Bangladesh, Syria, and Egypt. After spending 10 hours at sea on two overcrowded boats with 258 people in total, they were rescued by a Doctors Without Borders (MSF) vessel approximately 30 miles (50 kilometers) from the Libyan coast on October 6. Upon arrival in Salerno, just south of Naples, they were taken to a processing center and asked to sign documents. Later, many gathered at the train station, appearing tired and confused. Volunteers from the Catholic charity Caritas questioned whether the migrants understood the papers they had signed or if they were offered a chance to apply for international protection. The migrants replied 'no' to both. Such scenarios are common for new arrivals in Europe. Migrants are often given poor advice by acquaintances, or lack crucial official information and translation services. As a result, many make hasty and sometimes irreversible decisions, which could leave them in legal limbo for years, often without government assistance. According to the International Organization for Migration, over 236,000 people have entered the European Union irregularly this year, marking a 60% increase from last year, with most arriving in Italy by boat. Europe’s asylum system remains complicated and frequently ineffective. Public sentiment toward migrants and refugees is becoming less welcoming, as governments try to balance border security and human rights. Mohammed, a 23-year-old Syrian who received an expulsion order stating in several languages that he did not apply for asylum, is one example. While Syrians often are granted asylum, Mohammed chose not to apply in Italy as he wants to reach his siblings in Germany. Italy allowed his rescue ship to dock in Salerno after several days at sea. The migrants were processed, photographed, and fingerprinted, but there were no Bengali or Arabic translators present, according to official documents and authorities. A study by the International Rescue Committee indicated that just 17% of migrants arriving in Italy receive sufficient information about their rights. Caritas volunteers and lawyers rushed to help some migrants file appeals against expulsion orders. Most Syrians, however, quickly took trains to Northern Europe, fearing they might be tracked and forced to remain in Italy. A 33-year-old Syrian woman from Damascus recounted multiple failed attempts to reach Europe, including surviving a shipwreck and experiencing detention in Libya. She said she was determined to join her brother in Germany after another sibling died in Syrian detention. This account could not be independently verified. European rules, known as the Dublin Regulation, require asylum-seekers to apply in the first EU country entered. However, since December 2022, Italy has suspended transfers of migrants back to its territory. This means someone like Mohammed, if found in Germany, cannot be returned to Italy, but must submit a new asylum application there. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, head of a far-right government, has described migration as her administration’s greatest challenge. In April, her government introduced a fast-track process intending to process most cases in 28 days. Asylum applicants are detained until decisions are made; those denied or not applying receive expulsion orders and seven days to leave. The current backlog stands at 82,000 asylum cases. In theory, overstayers may face up to 18 months in a detention center, but as centers are full and Italy lacks repatriation agreements with many countries, some migrants remain without documents or face repeated detentions. Gabindo, a 35-year-old Bangladeshi man, was rescued with Mohammed and received a deportation order stating that repatriation centers were full, allowing him to go free. The system thus relies on voluntary return, which rarely happens. Italy’s new procedures have raised concerns that applications are evaluated based on nationality. Migrants from countries listed as 'safe,' such as Morocco, Ivory Coast, or Nigeria, are more likely to have requests denied. The UNHCR supports faster border procedures but stresses that all individuals should be able to present their personal security risks. Maurizio Veglio, a legal expert, describes the procedures as 'an attack on the right to asylum,' warning that shorter evaluations may reduce screening quality. Despite these obstacles, some migrants choose to remain. Alei Wuch Alei, 21, from South Sudan, arrived on the MSF ship, has applied for asylum, and hopes to study medicine after years of hardship and violence. The EU continues to build partnerships with African and Middle Eastern countries to curb migration, with countries not accepting returned citizens facing potential visa restrictions. Italy recently agreed with Albania to temporarily house up to 36,000 asylum-seekers annually while their claims are considered, raising human rights concerns from UNHCR. Despite these challenges, some migrants experience family reunification. Jahdh al-Ali, a 58-year-old Syrian, was rescued by MSF, applied for asylum in Italy, and was later reunited with her daughter in France after years apart.
translated_content: SALERNO, Italia – Mindre enn 24 timer etter å ha ankommet en havn i Sør-Italia, ble 60 migranter som overlevde en farlig reise fra Libya, utstedt utvisningsordre. Disse personene kom fra Bangladesh, Syria og Egypt. Etter å ha vært 10 timer til sjøs på to overfylte båter med totalt 258 personer, ble de reddet av et Doctors Without Borders (MSF)-skip omtrent 50 kilometer fra den libyske kysten 6. oktober. Ved ankomst i Salerno, rett sør for Napoli, ble de tatt til et mottakssenter og bedt om å signere dokumenter. Senere samlet mange seg på togstasjonen, slitne og forvirrede. Frivillige fra den katolske hjelpeorganisasjonen Caritas spurte om migrantene forsto papirene de hadde signert, eller om de fikk tilbud om å søke internasjonal beskyttelse. Migrantene svarte 'nei' på begge spørsmål. Slike situasjoner er vanlige for nyankomne i Europa. Migranter får ofte dårlige råd fra kjente eller mangler viktig offisiell informasjon og tolketjenester. Resultatet er at mange tar forhastede, noen ganger irreversible valg, noe som kan føre til flere år i juridisk limbo uten statlig støtte. Ifølge International Organization for Migration har over 236 000 personer kommet inn i EU på irregulær måte i år, en økning på 60 % fra i fjor, hvorav de fleste kom til Italia med båt. Asylsystemet i Europa er fortsatt komplisert og ofte ineffektivt. Holdninger til migranter og flyktninger blir stadig mer negative, ettersom myndighetene prøver å balansere grensekontroll og menneskerettigheter. Mohammed, en 23 år gammel syrer som fikk en utvisningsordre på flere språk som sier at han ikke har søkt om asyl, er ett eksempel. Syrere får ofte innvilget asyl, men Mohammed valgte å ikke søke i Italia fordi han håper å nå søsknene sine i Tyskland. Italia tillot redningsskipet hans å legge til kai i Salerno etter flere dager til sjøs. Migrantene ble registrert, fotografert og fikk tatt fingeravtrykk, men det var ingen bengali- eller arabisktalende tolker til stede, ifølge offisielle dokumenter og myndigheter. En studie fra International Rescue Committee viste at kun 17 % av migrantene som ankommer Italia får tilstrekkelig informasjon om sine rettigheter. Frivillige og advokater fra Caritas hjalp noen migranter med å anke utvisningsordrene. De fleste syrerne tok imidlertid toget raskt til Nord-Europa, i frykt for å bli sporet og tvunget til å forbli i Italia. En 33 år gammel kvinne fra Damaskus fortalte om flere mislykkede forsøk på å komme til Europa, inkludert å overleve et skipsforlis og fengsling i Libya. Hun sier hun er bestemt på å finne broren sin i Tyskland etter at en annen bror døde i syrisk varetekt. Denne fortellingen er ikke uavhengig bekreftet. Europeiske regler, kjent som Dublin-forordningen, krever at asylsøkere fremmer søknad i det første EU-landet de ankommer. Men siden desember 2022 har Italia suspendert retur av migranter til sitt territorium. Dette innebærer at noen som Mohammed, om han blir funnet i Tyskland, ikke kan sendes tilbake til Italia, men må søke asyl på nytt der. Statsminister Giorgia Meloni, leder for en ytre høyre-regjering, har omtalt migrasjon som den største utfordringen hun står overfor som leder. I april innførte regjeringen en hurtigprosess for å avgjøre de fleste saker i løpet av 28 dager. Asylsøkere blir holdt i forvaringssentre til deres saker er behandlet; de som får avslag eller ikke søker, får utvisningsordre og har syv dager på å forlate landet. Det er nå 82 000 asylsaker i kø. I teorien kan overtredere få opptil 18 måneder i forvaringssenter, men sentrene er ofte fulle og Italia mangler hjemsendingsavtaler med mange land, så noen migranter blir værende uten dokumenter eller blir utsatt for gjentatte pågripelser. Gabindo, en 35-årig mann fra Bangladesh som ble reddet sammen med Mohammed, fikk et utvisningsvedtak med beskjed om at hjemsendelsessentrene var fulle og fikk derfor gå fri. Systemet baserer seg dermed på frivillig retur, noe som sjelden skjer. Italias nye prosedyrer har skapt bekymring for at asylsøknader vurderes ut fra nasjonalitet. Migranter fra såkalte 'trygge' land, som Marokko, Elfenbenskysten eller Nigeria, får oftere avslag. UNHCR støtter raskere prosesser ved grensene, men understreker at alle bør få anledning til å fremlegge personlige risikoer. Juridisk ekspert Maurizio Veglio mener de nye reglene er 'et angrep på retten til asyl', og advarer mot at kortere behandlingstid kan svekke kvaliteten på saksbehandlingen. Til tross for disse utfordringene velger noen å bli. Alei Wuch Alei, 21 år gammel fra Sør-Sudan, ankom med MSF-skipet, har søkt asyl, og håper å studere medisin etter flere år med vanskeligheter og vold. EU fortsetter å samarbeide med afrikanske og mellomøstlige land for å redusere migrasjon, hvor land som ikke tar imot hjemvendte borgere kan møte visumrestriksjoner. Italia har nylig inngått en avtale med Albania om å huse opptil 36 000 asylsøkere årlig mens søknader blir behandling, noe som har utløst bekymring om menneskerettighetene fra UNHCR. Til tross for utfordringene opplever noen migranter familiegjenforening. Jahdh al-Ali, en 58 år gammel syrisk kvinne, ble reddet av MSF, søkte asyl i Italia, og ble senere gjenforent med datteren sin i Frankrike etter flere år fra hverandre.

article_content: Almost two months have passed since 19-year-old Tucker Hipps was found dead after an early morning fraternity activity, and his parents, Gary and Cindy Hipps, still seek answers about his untimely and mysterious death. The Clemson University freshman’s body was discovered submerged in the Seneca River on September 22, hours after members of the Sigma Phi Epsilon fraternity reported him missing. It is believed Tucker, who served as pledge class president, fell from a 20-foot bridge into the water during a pre-dawn run with his fraternity brothers. According to them, Tucker began to lag behind on the run and was not noticed missing until he failed to show up for breakfast. Now, his parents have spoken publicly, convinced that someone has information about what happened to their only son but has yet to come forward. Cindy Hipps told Fox Carolina that withholding the truth could have a lifelong impact, urging anyone with information to reveal it for their own peace of mind. The South Carolina Law Enforcement Division and the Oconee County Sheriff's Office continue to investigate the case and will release a final report, which includes toxicology findings, when completed. Authorities are not commenting further until the investigation concludes. Tucker’s parents had cautioned him about joining a fraternity, preferring he focus on his studies, but ultimately allowed it since he was social and Greek Life members often maintain higher GPAs. Tucker paid for his own fraternity fees. After his death, Clemson University suspended all Greek Life activities, though it is unclear if the suspension is ongoing or was directly due to this incident. Gary and Cindy Hipps hope that their son’s passing leads to meaningful change in fraternity pledge processes, pointing to perceived systemic problems in how pledges are treated. Mr. Hipps also expressed condolences to the family of West Virginia University student Nolan Burch, who died in a separate fraternity incident. As the Hipps family faces their first Christmas since Tucker’s death, they plan to continue their traditions and honor his memory, decorating the home and placing his special ornaments on the tree.
translated_content: Det har nå gått nesten to måneder siden 19 år gamle Tucker Hipps ble funnet død etter en tidlig morgenaktivitet med studentforeningen, og foreldrene hans, Gary og Cindy Hipps, leter fortsatt etter svar om hans uventede og mystiske dødsfall. Kroppen til Clemson University-studenten ble funnet under vann i Seneca-elven 22. september, noen timer etter at medlemmer av Sigma Phi Epsilon-foreningen meldte ham savnet. Det antas at Tucker, som var president for pledgerekken, falt fra en seks meter høy bro ut i vannet under løpeturen tidlig om morgenen sammen med sine studentforeningsbrødre. Ifølge dem begynte Tucker å bli hengende etter under løpet, og det ble ikke oppdaget at han var borte før han ikke kom til frokost. Nå har foreldrene hans stått frem offentlig—overbevist om at noen har informasjon om hva som skjedde med deres eneste sønn, men som ennå ikke har kommet frem. Cindy Hipps sa til Fox Carolina at det å holde på sannheten kan gi livslange konsekvenser, og hun oppfordrer alle som vet noe til å stå frem for sin egen del. South Carolina Law Enforcement Division og Oconee County Sheriff's Office etterforsker fortsatt saken, og vil publisere en endelig rapport med toksikologiske funn når etterforskningen er avsluttet. Myndighetene har ikke kommentert saken ytterligere. Tuckers foreldre hadde advart ham mot å bli med i en forening, og foretrakk at han fokusere på studiene, men godtok det til slutt fordi han var utadvendt og fordi medlemmer av Greek Life ofte har høyere karaktersnitt. Tucker betalte selv kontingenten til foreningen. Etter hans død suspenderte Clemson University alle Greek Life-aktiviteter, men det er uklart om denne suspensjonen fortsatt gjelder eller om den var direkte knyttet til denne hendelsen. Gary og Cindy Hipps håper sønnens bortgang fører til viktige endringer i pledging-prosessen i studentforeninger, og peker på det de mener er systematiske problemer med behandlingen av pledges. Mr. Hipps uttrykte også medfølelse for familien til West Virginia University-studenten Nolan Burch, som døde i en egen foreningsrelatert hendelse. Når familien Hipps nå skal feire sin første jul uten Tucker, har de bestemt seg for å fortsette tradisjonene og hedre minnet hans—blant annet ved å pynte huset og henge opp Tuckers spesielle julepynt på treet.

Everton have been docked 10 points after breaching Premier League financial rules, according to an announcement on Friday by the English top flight. The Premier League referred Everton to an independent commission in March for allegedly violating the league’s Profitability and Sustainability Rules (PSRs). Under these rules, clubs may lose up to £105 million ($130 million) over a three-year period before facing penalties.

The commission found Everton’s losses for the relevant period totaled £124.5 million, exceeding the allowed threshold. This resulted in the largest sporting sanction in Premier League history, dropping Everton to 19th place in the league table. The commission ruled that a 10-point deduction should be imposed, effective immediately.

Everton acknowledged breaching the PSRs for the period ending in the 2021/22 season but disputed the scale of the violation. The club issued a statement expressing shock and disappointment at the ruling and announced its intention to appeal the decision.

Premier League henviste Everton til en uavhengig kommisjon i mars for angivelig brudd på ligaens regler for lønnsomhet og bærekraft (PSR). Ifølge disse reglene kan klubber ha et underskudd på opptil 105 millioner pund (130 millioner dollar) over en treårsperiode før de risikerer straff.

Kommisjonen konkluderte med at Evertons tap i den aktuelle perioden var på 124,5 millioner pund, noe som oversteg det tillatte beløpet. Dette resulterte i den største sportslige straffen i Premier Leagues historie og senket Everton til 19. plass på tabellen. Kommisjonen bestemte at ti poeng skulle trekkes fra lagets poengsum med umiddelbar virkning.

Everton innrømmet å ha brutt PSR-reglene for perioden som endte med 2021/22-sesongen, men bestrider omfanget av overtredelsen. Klubben uttalte at de er sjokkerte og skuffede over avgjørelsen og har varslet sin intensjon om å anke.

New Zealand is gearing up for a high-stakes semi-final against India, who remain unbeaten in this year’s ICC Men's Cricket World Cup. The upcoming match brings back memories of the dramatic 2019 semi-final, when New Zealand halted India’s campaign. Former New Zealand batter Ross Taylor, who played in that game, recalls how India entered as favorites while the Kiwis just managed to reach the top four. Taylor suggests India could be under pressure this time, too, especially given their strong form at home.

Taylor believes New Zealand thrives in an underdog role, warning that India may be nervous about facing them again. The semi-final at Mumbai’s Wankhede Stadium will be influenced by early momentum. According to Taylor, removing one or two of India’s star batters—Shubman Gill, Rohit Sharma, and Virat Kohli—in the first 10 overs could unsettle the home team. Conversely, New Zealand must keep wickets in hand when batting, particularly to counter India’s dangerous bowlers like Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Siraj, and Mohammed Shami, as well as the spinners who can build pressure quickly.

Taylor also highlighted the extraordinary World Cup debut of Rachin Ravindra, who has scored heavily for New Zealand, including three centuries. Ravindra’s calm demeanor and effective batting have impressed Taylor, who noted the stroke of luck that saw Ravindra included after Michael Bracewell missed the tournament. These timely changes, according to Taylor, can play a crucial role in high-pressure matches.

Den kommende kampen vekker minner om den dramatiske semifinalen i 2019, da New Zealand satte en stopper for Indias turnering. Tidligere newzealandske stjernespiller Ross Taylor, som deltok i den kampen, husker hvordan India var favoritter, mens Kiwiene så vidt kom seg til topp fire. Taylor antyder at India kan føle press også denne gangen, spesielt siden de spiller på hjemmebane med god form.

Taylor mener New Zealand trives best i underdog-rollen og advarer om at India kan være nervøse for å møte dem igjen. Semifinalen på Wankhede Stadium i Mumbai vil bli avgjort av hvem som får best åpning. Taylor mener at hvis New Zealand klarer å ta én eller to av Indias stjernespillere—Shubman Gill, Rohit Sharma og Virat Kohli—i løpet av de ti første overs, kan det skape problemer for hjemmelaget. På den andre siden må New Zealand unngå tidlige wicket-tap mot Indias kraftfulle bowlere som Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Siraj og Mohammed Shami, samt spinnerne som raskt kan bygge opp press.

Taylor fremhevet også Rachin Ravindra, som har fått sitt gjennombrudd i VM-debuten og allerede har tre hundre poeng. Ravindras rolige spillestil og solide batting har imponert Taylor, som også påpekte det heldige sammentreffet som gjorde at Ravindra fikk plass etter at Michael Bracewell ble ute av turneringen. Slike tilfeldigheter kan ifølge Taylor være avgjørende i kamper med høyt press.

article_content: On Wednesday, Thomas Cook Ltd announced that its main shareholder, Fairbridge Capital (Mauritius) Ltd, intends to sell up to an 8.5% stake in the company through an offer for sale (OFS). This involves selling up to 32 million shares at a floor price of Rs 125 per share—about 21% below the current market price. On the same day, Thomas Cook's shares closed 4.5% lower at Rs 158.40 on the National Stock Exchange. This base offer amounts to about 6.8% of the company's equity. If demand exceeds the base amount, Fairbridge may offer an additional 8 million shares, bringing the total potential sale to 8.5% of the company. As of September's end, Fairbridge Capital held a 72.34% stake in Thomas Cook. Institutional investors can bid in the OFS on Thursday, while retail investors can participate on Friday. Ten percent of the offer is reserved for retail buyers, who can invest up to Rs 200,000 each. Institutional investors can also opt to carry forward any unallocated bids to Friday. In June last year, Fairbridge raised its shareholding in Thomas Cook from 70.58% to 72.34% by converting preference shares. In 2023, Thomas Cook shares have delivered strong results, rising more than 122% year to date. The company achieved record profits in the recent quarter, with consolidated EBITDA growing 2.4 times to Rs 131 crore, and profit before tax surging from Rs 4.9 crore last year to Rs 76.6 crore. Additional content in the article covered general market updates, stock advice, and brief mentions of other companies and trends, all presented in a neutral and factual style with some positive emphasis on Thomas Cook’s growth.

Dette innebærer salg av inntil 32 millioner aksjer til en minstepris på 125 Rs per aksje — omtrent 21 % under dagens markedspris. Thomas Cook-aksjen endte samme dag 4,5 % lavere på 158,40 Rs på National Stock Exchange. Grunnlaget for tilbudet utgjør rundt 6,8 % av selskapets egenkapital. Dersom etterspørselen er høy, kan Fairbridge tilby ytterligere 8 millioner aksjer, noe som øker det totale salget til 8,5 %. Ved utgangen av september eide Fairbridge Capital 72,34 % av Thomas Cook. Institusjonelle investorer kan delta i OFS på torsdag, mens privatpersoner får sjansen på fredag. article_content: As families gather around the Thanksgiving dinner table to express gratitude for the year's blessings, you can use this opportunity to reflect on your own financial well-being by asking yourself a few essential questions.  1. Are You Living Within Your Means? Living within your means means balancing your earnings and spending, ensuring your lifestyle does not exceed your income. Effective financial management starts with understanding your income and expenses. By tracking your cash flow, you can identify ways to optimize spending and discover opportunities to increase your income. Creating and following a budget is fundamental, as it sets spending limits, prevents impulsive purchases, reduces stress, and helps you achieve financial goals.  2. Do You Have An Emergency Fund? An emergency fund acts as your financial safety net in times of crisis, such as medical emergencies, job loss, or major repairs. Knowing you’re prepared for unexpected events brings peace of mind. Aim to save at least three to six months’ worth of living expenses, or start with a smaller target and build up over time. Use your budget to find areas to cut back and set aside about 10% of your income each month. Automate savings with direct deposits or recurring transfers, and consider using a high-yield savings account for better returns. Extra funds from tax refunds or bonuses can also boost your emergency savings. Consistently contributing builds a cushion to help you through financial setbacks.  3. Are Your Investments Aligned With Your Goals? Approach investing with intention, making sure your choices support your financial objectives—like saving for retirement, buying a home, or funding education. Aligning investments with your goals increases the chances of reaching them within your desired timeframe. It also helps maintain a balanced, diversified portfolio suited to your risk tolerance and enables you to manage both short- and long-term needs. Review your investment strategy regularly and adjust as your goals or circumstances change.  4. How Healthy Is Your Debt? Debt can be beneficial when managed sensibly. Good debt often involves investments in appreciating assets, like real estate or education, which can bring long-term benefits. Bad debt, such as high-interest credit cards, can undermine your finances if not managed. Pay attention to your debt-to-income ratio—a high ratio may signal financial strain. Prioritize paying off high-interest debts, explore consolidation or refinancing, and use good debt wisely to support your financial growth.  5. Do You Have a Retirement Plan? A retirement plan provides a roadmap for financial security in your later years. Without one, you risk outliving your savings or needing to rely on others. Consider factors like retirement age, lifestyle, expected expenses, and sources of income. Contributing to accounts such as 401(k)s, IRAs, or other employer-sponsored plans can help your money grow over time with interest and investment returns. Starting early takes advantage of compounding and allows you to better navigate market ups and downs. Consistent contributions, even small ones, make a big difference over time.  Final Thoughts If you answered yes to these questions, you’re in great financial shape and demonstrate strong saving, spending, investing, and debt management habits. If not, don't be discouraged. Financial health is a continuous journey that involves learning, adapting, and seeking guidance from professionals if needed. Start where you are and take steady steps—small changes can lead to big improvements. Even asking these important questions shows you’re on the right path.
translated_content: Når familier samles rundt middagsbordet på Thanksgiving for å uttrykke takknemlighet for årets velsignelser, kan du bruke denne anledningen til å reflektere over din egen økonomiske helse ved å stille deg selv noen viktige spørsmål.  1. Lever du innenfor dine midler? Å leve innenfor dine midler handler om å balansere inntekter og utgifter, slik at livsstilen din ikke overstiger det du tjener. God økonomistyring starter med å forstå inntektene og utgiftene dine. Ved å følge med på økonomien kan du finne muligheter til å optimalisere forbruket og øke inntekten. Å lage og holde seg til et budsjett er grunnleggende, siden det setter grenser for pengebruken, forhindrer impulskjøp, reduserer stress og hjelper deg å oppnå økonomiske mål.  2. Har du en nødfond? Et nødfond er din økonomiske sikkerhet ved kriser som medisinske nødsituasjoner, arbeidsledighet eller store uforutsette utgifter. Det gir trygghet å vite at du er forberedt på det uventede. Prøv å spare opp til tre til seks måneders levekostnader, eller start mindre og bygg opp etter hvert. Bruk budsjettet ditt for å finne steder å kutte utgifter, og sett av cirka 10 % av inntekten hver måned. Automatiser sparingen med faste trekk, og vurder en høyrentekonto. Ekstra penger fra skatte- eller feriepenger kan også styrke nødfondet. Fast sparing gir deg en økonomisk buffer ved behov.  3. Er investeringene dine tilpasset målene dine? Invester med hensikt, og sørg for at valgene dine støtter målene dine—som pensjonssparing, boligkjøp eller utdannelse. Når investeringene passer til målene, øker sjansen for å nå dem i tide. Det bidrar også til en balansert og diversifisert portefølje etter din risikovilje, og hjelper deg å håndtere både kortsiktige og langsiktige behov. Gjennomgå investeringsstrategien regelmessig og juster etter endringer i mål eller situasjon.  4. Hvordan står det til med gjelden din? Gjeld kan være gunstig hvis den brukes fornuftig. God gjeld gjelder investeringer i verdier som stiger, som bolig eller utdanning, og kan gi langsiktige fordeler. Dårlig gjeld, som kredittkort med høy rente, kan svekke økonomien hvis den ikke håndteres. Hold øye med forholdet mellom gjeld og inntekt—høy gjeldsgrad kan bety økonomisk press. Prioriter nedbetaling av dyr gjeld, vurder samling eller refinansiering, og bruk god gjeld til din fordel.  5. Har du en pensjonsplan? En pensjonsplan gir deg trygghet og forutsigbarhet når du blir eldre. Uten en kan du risikere å gå tom for midler og måtte stole på andre. Ta hensyn til pensjonsalder, ønsket livsstil, utgifter og mulige inntekter. Sparing i løsninger som pensjonskonto, IPS eller arbeidsgiverordninger gir pengene dine mulighet til å vokse med tiden. Å starte tidlig gir høyere avkastning og bedre evne til å håndtere markedsendringer. Jevnlige innskudd, uansett størrelse, har stor effekt over tid.  Avsluttende tanker Hvis du svarte ja på spørsmålene over, har du god økonomisk helse og solide vaner rundt sparing, forbruk, investering og gjeld. Hvis ikke, ikke bli motløs. Økonomisk helse er en pågående prosess som krever læring, tilpasning og kanskje råd fra fagfolk. Begynn der du er og ta små steg – små endringer kan gi store resultater. At du stiller deg disse spørsmålene, viser allerede at du er på vei.

article_content: Ministers are preparing to ban imports of sweet chestnut trees in an effort to prevent a crisis similar to ash dieback, which has threatened to devastate Britain’s countryside. The planned embargo, targeting imports from countries affected by a harmful fungal blight, aims to protect the UK's 44 million sweet chestnut trees. This disease has already wiped out most of North America’s sweet chestnuts and is prevalent throughout much of Europe. Environment Secretary Owen Paterson announced the decision following recommendations from an independent task force focused on tree and plant health. Paterson also intends to introduce a national plant health risk register, which would help authorities identify new threats from pests and diseases early, allowing preventative action. Sweet chestnut trees are especially common in south-east England. Officials hope to impose the import ban before the autumn planting season, reducing the risk of repeating the catastrophic ash dieback situation. Britain’s 80 million ash trees—among the country’s most common species—are endangered by a deadly fungus spread through wind-borne spores, making it almost impossible to eradicate. National Trust plant health specialist Ian Wright stressed the importance of protecting native sweet chestnut stocks, given their role as potential replacements for declining ash trees. Wright cautioned, however, that if domestic supplies cannot meet demand, people may look to import from Europe, where sweet chestnut blight is widespread, risking a second crisis. Paterson emphasized the seriousness of the new threat, noting the government’s commitment to treating plant disease with the same attention as animal disease. Ian Boyd, Chief Scientific Adviser at DEFRA, said that lessons learned from the ash dieback episode have prompted faster action this time, putting Britain ahead in combating sweet chestnut blight. Although there have been isolated infections in the UK, they have so far been contained, unlike ash dieback, where the main hope now lies in developing resistant trees. Task force head Professor Chris Gilligan highlighted the economic value of trees—estimated at £3.5 billion a year to the British economy—and called for appointing a chief plant health officer to coordinate efforts. He stressed the need to prioritize threats based on likelihood, impact, and potential mitigation strategies in order to minimize future outbreaks.

Storbritannias 80 millioner asketrær – blant de vanligste treslagene i landet – trues av en dødelig sopp som spres med vinden og nærmest er umulig å utrydde. Spesialist på plantehelse i National Trust, Ian Wright, understreket viktigheten av å beskytte hjemlige kastanjebestander, siden de kan erstatte asketrærne som forsvinner. Han understreket behovet for å prioritere trusler ut fra sannsynlighet, konsekvenser og mulige begrensningstiltak for å unngå fremtidige epidemier.

Shami later shared a photo with the Prime Minister, expressing confidence that the team would bounce back stronger. PM Modi also posted a message on social media, commending the team's efforts and spirit after the narrow defeat.

article_content: Colorado Republican Representative Lauren Boebert is facing a tough reelection campaign as her likely Democratic rival, Adam Frisch, has gained a significant fundraising advantage ahead of their probable rematch. According to recent filings, Frisch raised $3.39 million from July through September, while Boebert brought in $853,840. During that quarter, Boebert spent more than she took in, leaving her with about $1.4 million in campaign funds, compared to Frisch’s $4.3 million cash on hand. Boebert thanked her grassroots supporters and emphasized her campaign’s connection to working-class families in rural Colorado. She said, 'I’m incredibly grateful to the thousands of voters across the 3rd District and beyond who continue to stand with us. While outside organizations may spend heavily in this race, I’m confident we will have the resources we need to succeed in 2024.' Reports show that nearly 60% of Boebert’s donations and 65% of Frisch’s came from small individual contributions under $200. While Republicans have sometimes won despite funding disadvantages, the magnitude of Frisch’s lead could prompt national Republican involvement. Boebert narrowly defeated Frisch in 2022 by only 546 votes. Political analysts currently consider the district a toss-up, despite its partisan voting index of seven points more Republican than the national average. Boebert has continued to maintain a staunchly conservative profile and is a member of the House Freedom Caucus. She did not back Rep. Matt Gaetz’s move to oust Kevin McCarthy as Speaker, but was among those who initially withheld their support for McCarthy’s bid. Boebert has stayed in the news, notably being removed from a performance of the 'Beetlejuice' musical in Denver, where video showed her engaging in inappropriate conduct with her date. Her campaign also reportedly spent money at a bar owned by her date from that evening. Frisch’s campaign declined immediate comment. Both Boebert and Frisch face primary opponents, though a general election rematch appears likely.

article_content: The BBC has spent over £1.3 million on return flights between London and Manchester since moving many programmes to MediaCityUK in Salford, which opened in May 2011. Since the move, the corporation has incurred significant travel expenses, with around 2,300 staff working at the Salford Quays site, producing shows like Match Of The Day, BBC Breakfast, Radio 5 Live, Blue Peter, and CBBC. Formerly, these programmes were produced at the BBC's Television Centre in White City, west London, which closed in March 2013. The site was sold in July 2012 for £200 million to Stanhope PLC, which plans to redevelop it as a modern studio centre, hotel, apartments, and for the BBC’s commercial headquarters. A Freedom of Information request showed the BBC spent £377,000 on flights from May 2011 to March 2012. Between April 2012 and March 2013, this rose to £605,000, with another £312,000 spent between April and September 2013, totaling £1,294,000 over 29 months, averaging around £44,620 per month. The actual total could be higher, as the data only includes flights booked through the BBC’s central booking system. Many staff also book flights themselves and reclaim expenses. A BBC source stated, 'We all knew the travel costs would increase when Salford opened.' A BBC Procurement spokesperson said, 'Spending on flights is closely monitored, and staff are encouraged to use alternatives like video conferencing where possible. However, when travel is necessary, staff must use the most cost-effective options.' ‘The BBC is a national broadcaster and travel is a core part of our costs in delivering quality programmes. Much of these costs are programme-related. BBC North at MediaCityUK is the organisation’s largest creative hub outside London, home to 24 BBC departments including Children’s, Sport, Radio 5 Live, and BBC Breakfast.’ Matthew Sinclair, chief executive of the TaxPayers’ Alliance, said the BBC should ensure licence fee payers get value for money. 'The move to Salford inevitably raised travel costs for BBC staff and guests. Still, the broadcaster must secure value for licence fee payers, and staff must always book the cheapest options. Flying should only occur in exceptional circumstances, when it offers the best deal for licence fee payers.' The BBC previously faced criticism for paying about £24 million in staff allowances following the move to Salford. An October report from the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) labelled many allowances as ‘excessive’ and ‘difficult to justify’ to licence fee payers. In total, the BBC spent £942 million establishing its northern base to address concerns over London-centric coverage. Around 900 staff were offered an average of £28,000 each to relocate, with additional perks like guaranteed home sale prices, a two-year remote location allowance of £1,900 per month, and one-off payments or help with household goods. Despite these costs, the BBC rents—rather than owns—its Salford offices and studios from the Peel Group under a 10-year contract. The PAC expressed concern that the BBC may be locked into long-term payments for spaces it may not always use.

article_content: A Russian ship, the MV Alaed, was intercepted by the British government off the Scottish coast amid suspicions it was transporting helicopters and missiles to Syria. The decision followed government intervention warning the ship’s insurer that maintaining coverage could violate an EU arms embargo. In response, British marine insurer Standard Club withdrew insurance from the ship, owned by Russian company Femco. Under EU sanctions, member states are prohibited from exporting arms to Syria or providing related services, including insurance. It is suspected that the MV Alaed is carrying Mi-25 helicopters, similar to those used by the Assad regime in attacks against rebel-held towns. British officials reportedly informed the insurer that coverage could constitute a breach of sanctions. Standard Club stated: 'We were made aware of allegations that the Alaed was carrying munitions destined for Syria. We have informed the ship owner that their insurance coverage ceased automatically due to the voyage’s nature.' The MV Alaed received international attention after US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton claimed the vessel was carrying weapons for the Assad regime. The issue coincided with Russia—an ally of President Bashar al-Assad—announcing plans to deploy two warships and elite marines to Syria. Tensions between Moscow and Washington have been high over continued Russian support for Assad amid ongoing violence. The Russian deployment is intended to protect personnel and evacuate equipment from its naval facility in Tartous if needed. Major General Vladimir Gradusov, a deputy Russian air force chief, said, 'We must protect our citizens,' indicating readiness to evacuate Russians from the conflict zone if necessary. Western analysts interpret the move as a message that Moscow opposes foreign military intervention in Syria. At the G20 summit in Los Cabos, Mexico, President Barack Obama and President Vladimir Putin discussed the crisis, expressing commitment to a political solution to end the bloodshed. In a joint statement, the leaders called for an immediate halt to violence and expressed support for UN-Arab League envoy Kofi Annan’s efforts. They emphasized that Syrians should have the opportunity to choose their own government democratically and independently.

Beslutningen kom etter at myndighetene advarte skipets forsikringsselskap om at å opprettholde forsikringen kunne bryte EUs våpenembargo. Som følge av dette trakk det britiske sjøforsikringsselskapet Standard Club tilbake forsikringen fra skipet, som eies av det russiske selskapet Femco. I henhold til EUs sanksjoner er medlemsland forbudt å eksportere våpen til Syria eller tilby relaterte tjenester, inkludert forsikring. Det er mistanke om at MV Alaed frakter Mi-25 helikoptre, lik de Assad-regimet har brukt i angrep mot opprørsholdte byer. Britiske myndigheter skal ha informert forsikringsselskapet om at slik dekning kunne utgjøre et brudd på sanksjonene. Standard Club uttalte: 'Vi ble gjort oppmerksomme på påstander om at Alaed fraktet ammunisjon tiltenkt Syria. Vi har informert skipets eier om at deres forsikringsdekning automatisk opphørte på grunn av reisens karakter.' MV Alaed fikk internasjonal oppmerksomhet etter at USAs utenriksminister Hillary Clinton hevdet at skipet fraktet våpen til Assad-regimet. Saken falt sammen med at Russland — en alliert av president Bashar al-Assad — annonserte planer om å sende to krigsskip og elitesoldater til Syria. Spenningene mellom Moskva og Washington har økt på grunn av Russlands fortsatte støtte til Assad mens volden fortsetter. Den russiske utplasseringen er ment å beskytte personell og evakuere utstyr fra deres marinebase i Tartous om nødvendig. Generalmajor Vladimir Gradusov, visesjef for det russiske flyvåpenet, uttalte: 'Vi må beskytte våre borgere,' og antydet at Russland er klare til å evakuere russere fra konfliktsonen hvis det blir nødvendig. Vestlige analytikere tolker dette som et signal om at Moskva motsetter seg utenlandsk militær intervensjon i Syria. På G20-toppmøtet i Los Cabos, Mexico, diskuterte president Barack Obama og president Vladimir Putin krisen, og uttrykte støtte til en politisk løsning for å få slutt på blodsutgytelsen. I en felles uttalelse ba lederne om umiddelbar stans i volden og uttrykte støtte til FNs og Den arabiske ligas utsending Kofi Annans innsats. De understreket at det syriske folk skal ha mulighet til å velge sin egen fremtid demokratisk og uavhengig.

article_content: Mount Ulawun, one of Papua New Guinea's most active volcanoes, erupted Monday afternoon, sending an ash plume as high as 15,000 meters (50,000 feet) into the atmosphere. The Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), citing information from the Volcanic Ash Advisory Center in Darwin, Australia, is closely monitoring any potential tsunami risks that could affect Japanese shores. According to the JMA, if a tsunami were to occur as a result of the eruption, the first waves might reach the Izu and Ogasawara islands in about three hours. Currently, no tsunami warnings or advisories have been issued, and sea level readings at observation sites in Japan and surrounding regions have shown no significant changes. Papua New Guinea’s Geohazards Management Division reported that Ulawun began erupting on Monday afternoon and has elevated its hazard status to the maximum level (stage four), with expectations that the eruption may continue for an indefinite period. Situated on the Pacific 'Ring of Fire'—a region well known for volcanic and earthquake activity—Mount Ulawun has a documented history of eruptions going back to the 1700s. Its last major eruption occurred in 2019. Geoscience Australia and the Hawaii-based Pacific Tsunami Warning Center have both indicated there is no current tsunami threat for their respective areas. Nevertheless, the JMA advises residents along the Japanese coastline to remain vigilant for any possible delayed tsunami activity, noting that the potential size of waves is still uncertain.
translated_content: Mount Ulawun, en av Papua Ny-Guineas mest aktive vulkaner, hadde et utbrudd mandag ettermiddag og sendte en askesky så høyt som 15 000 meter (50 000 fot) opp i atmosfæren. Det japanske meteorologiske byrået (JMA), som bygger på informasjon fra Volcanic Ash Advisory Center i Darwin, Australia, overvåker nøye potensielle tsunamirisikoer som kan påvirke japanske kyster. Ifølge JMA, dersom det skulle oppstå en tsunami på grunn av utbruddet, kunne de første bølgene nå Izu- og Ogasawara-øyene etter omtrent tre timer. For øyeblikket er det ikke utstedt noen tsunamivarsler eller advarsler, og målinger av havnivået ved observasjonssteder i Japan og nærliggende områder har ikke vist noen vesentlige endringer. Papua Ny-Guineas avdeling for geofarer rapporterte at Ulawun begynte utbruddet mandag ettermiddag, og har hevet faregraden til det høyeste nivået (nivå fire), med forventning om at utbruddet kan fortsette på ubestemt tid. Plassert på Stillehavets 'Ildring' – et område kjent for hyppig vulkan- og jordskjelvaktivitet – har Mount Ulawun en dokumentert utbruddshistorie helt tilbake til 1700-tallet. Dens siste større utbrudd var i 2019. Geoscience Australia og det Hawaii-baserte Pacific Tsunami Warning Center har begge meldt at det for tiden ikke er noen tsunamirisiko i deres områder. Likevel oppfordrer JMA kystbeboere i Japan til å være årvåkne for mulige forsinkede tsunamibølger, da bølgehøyden fortsatt er ukjent.

article_content: Nicholas Hoult has been cast as Lex Luthor in James Gunn's upcoming DC Universe film, 'Superman: Legacy', according to a recent report by Deadline. David Corenswet will portray Superman, setting the stage for a highly anticipated conflict between the hero and his iconic adversary. The film, scheduled for a summer 2025 release, signals the beginning of a fresh era in the DC Universe under the direction of Gunn and producer Peter Safran. The story will focus on Clark Kent's early years, highlighting his challenges in balancing his responsibilities as Krypton's last son and his work as a journalist. Rachel Brosnahan will play Lois Lane, Superman's long-time love interest, with Nathan Fillion and Isabela Merced also joining the cast in heroic roles. Corenswet takes over from Henry Cavill, donning the cape and defending Metropolis as the new Superman. 'Superman: Legacy' will follow 'Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom', which concludes the current DC Extended Universe, and is positioned as a new beginning for the franchise on the big screen. Fans are eager for this reboot, particularly the classic rivalry between Lex Luthor and Superman that has been depicted across comics, animation, and film for decades. With 'Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom' wrapping up the previous continuity, 'Superman: Legacy' starts the 'Gods and Monsters' chapter. Warner Bros. is shifting focus with upcoming projects like 'Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow' and 'The Brave and the Bold', as well as the 'Creature Commandos' animated series slated for next year. 'Creature Commandos' will precede 'Superman: Legacy', laying the groundwork for the clash between Corenswet's Superman and Hoult's Lex Luthor. 'Superman: Legacy' is set to hit theaters on July 11, 2025, and is expected to define a new chapter for DC movies. Directed by James Gunn, the film aims to explore the complexities of Clark Kent's dual identity—with the challenge of balancing heroism and integrity as a journalist.  Superman: Legacy Release Date: July 11, 2025 Director: James Gunn Cast: David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan, Nathan Fillion, Isabela Merced Rating: PG-13 Genres: Superhero

article_content: While most dogs are happy with an extra treat or a new chew toy at Christmas, some owners go a step further by dressing their pets in elaborate outfits. For these fashion-forward pet owners, there are designers who specialize in canine attire. Anthony Rubio, known as an animal couturier, creates crystal-embellished dresses, sequined jackets, and miniature hats for dogs. His fashionable creations are sold worldwide. At special pet fashion shows, small dogs model Rubio's couture, with some outfits costing up to $1,000. Over the past decade, Rubio, 45, has filled pet owners’ closets with high-fashion outfits made from satin, taffeta, and boucle fabrics. Rubio’s own Chihuahuas, Bogie and Kimba, frequently model his designs. ‘The clothing shows that our pets are family,’ Rubio says. ‘If I’d dress a child, I’d do the same for my dogs. I’m particular about how we appear in public, and I think they are, too. They never go outside until I’ve checked their look.’ Rubio began designing clothes after rescuing a mistreated dog who needed something warm to wear. ‘That experience encouraged me to start experimenting and develop more fashion for pets.’ Depending on the dog's size, it takes Rubio from two days to a few weeks to complete an outfit. He meets with clients and their pets first, ensuring each dog is comfortable before creating a custom outfit. Most of Rubio’s clients want outfits for holidays, parties, and special events. ‘I make sure pets are comfortable—nothing is forced on them,’ Rubio adds. Client Grace Forster says, ‘We love working with Anthony. He’s so creative and has ideas for every occasion.’ Rubio’s holiday events in New York bring together clients and their pets, all dressed in his latest designs, from tweed coats and feathered hats to punk-inspired jackets. He follows each client’s wishes, always considering the animal’s comfort. As the saying goes, sometimes dogs and their owners look alike—especially when both are sporting fashion-forward styles.
translated_content: Mens de fleste hunder er fornøyde med en ekstra godbit eller et nytt tyggeleketøy til jul, tar noen eiere det et steg videre ved å kle opp kjæledyrene sine i forseggjorte antrekk. For disse moteinteresserte hundeeierne finnes det designere som spesialiserer seg på klær til hunder. Anthony Rubio, kjent som en dyre-couturist, lager kjoler pyntet med krystaller, paljett-jakker og små hatter for hunder. Hans moteriktige kreasjoner selges over hele verden. På spesielle moteshow for kjæledyr viser små hunder frem Rubios couture, og noen antrekk kan koste opptil 10 000 kroner. I løpet av det siste tiåret har Rubio, som er 45 år, fylt hundeeieres garderober med moteantrekk laget av sateng, taft og bouclé-stoffer. Rubios egne chihuahuaer, Bogie og Kimba, er ofte modeller for hans design. ‘Klærne viser at kjæledyrene våre er familie’, sier Rubio. ‘Hvis jeg ville kledd opp et barn, ville jeg gjort det samme for hundene mine. Jeg er nøye med hvordan vi ser ut offentlig, og jeg tror de er det også. De går aldri ut før jeg har sjekket at alt ser bra ut.’ Rubio begynte å lage klær etter at han reddet en mishandlet hund som trengte noe varmt å ha på seg. ‘Den opplevelsen fikk meg til å eksperimentere og lage mer mote for kjæledyr.’ Avhengig av hundens størrelse tar det Rubio fra to dager til noen uker å lage et antrekk ferdig. Han møter både kunder og kjæledyr først, og sørger for at hver hund er komfortabel før han lager et spesialtilpasset antrekk. De fleste av Rubios kunder ønsker antrekk til høytider, fester og spesielle anledninger. ‘Jeg passer på at hundene har det bra—ingenting blir tvunget på dem’, legger Rubio til. Kunden Grace Forster sier: ‘Vi elsker å jobbe med Anthony. Han er så kreativ og har ideer til enhver anledning.’ Rubios julearrangementer i New York samler kunder og kjæledyr, alle iført hans siste design, fra tweedjakker og fjærhatter til punk-inspirerte jakker. Han følger kundenes ønsker, men tenker alltid på dyrets komfort. Som man sier: Noen ganger ligner hunder og eiere på hverandre—spesielt når begge går for moteriktig stil.

article_content:
Malaysian police have charged two individuals with allegedly stealing about $35,000 from the accounts of passengers from missing Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370. The suspects, Nur Shila Kanan, a 33-year-old HSBC bank staff member, and her husband, Basheer Ahmad Maula Sahul Hameed, 33, are accused of transferring funds and using stolen debit cards tied to the victims. Nur Shila faces 12 charges, mainly for unauthorized account transfers, while her husband faces four charges linked to ATM withdrawals with stolen cards.

Investigators also point to another individual, Pakistani national Ali Faran Khan, who reportedly received some of the transferred money and is currently sought by authorities. The suspected fraud took place between May 14 and July 8, a few months after MH370 went missing in March 2014. The officer purportedly used forged documents to issue a new debit card in a victim's name and initiated transfers from the accounts of additional passengers.

Both defendants were arrested after a tip from HSBC officials. They pleaded not guilty and were released on bail, on the condition they surrender their passports. Their next court date is set for August 25. 

MH370 vanished during a flight from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing with 227 passengers and 12 crew on board. Extensive searches have yielded no trace of the aircraft. Authorities are preparing to reopen the search in September, led by Dutch company Fugro Survey, which will deploy ships equipped with deep-sea scanning technology to examine a 60,000-square-kilometer area in the southern Indian Ocean.

Nur Shila er siktet på tolv punkter, hovedsakelig for uautoriserte kontobevegelser, mens ektemannen hennes er tiltalt på fire punkter for minibankuttak med stjålne kort.

I tillegg peker etterforskerne på en pakistansk statsborger, Ali Faran Khan, som angivelig har mottatt deler av pengene og nå etterlyses av politiet. Det mistenkte bedrageriet skal ha foregått mellom 14. mai og 8. juli, noen måneder etter at MH370 forsvant i mars 2014. Bankfunksjonæren skal ha brukt falske dokumenter for å skaffe nytt debetkort i en av ofrenes navn og gjennomført overføringer fra andre passasjerers kontoer.

De to ble pågrepet etter tips fra HSBC-ansatte, har erklært seg ikke skyldige, og er løslatt mot kausjon – mot at de har levert inn passene sine. Neste rettsmøte er satt til 25. august.

article_content: Arsenal is grappling with a major injury crisis as midfielder Jack Wilshere is set to miss up to four months following ankle ligament surgery. He sustained the injury during Arsenal’s 2-1 defeat to Manchester United at the Emirates Stadium. Manager Arsene Wenger may receive an increased transfer budget in January to reinforce the squad, which has been weakened by injuries. Wilshere’s operation was performed by James Calder, and Wilshere posted a reassuring photo online, informing fans the procedure went well. Club captain Mikel Arteta is facing his own lengthy absence after a calf tear suffered in the 2-0 win over Borussia Dortmund, likely keeping him out for the remainder of the year. This leaves Wenger with just three experienced midfielders: Aaron Ramsey, Mathieu Flamini, and Tomas Rosicky. Wilshere’s injury record is extensive, causing him to miss an accumulated 119 weeks of play since 2009. His latest setback came after a strong challenge from Manchester United’s Paddy McNair. On Instagram, Wilshere expressed gratitude to his surgeon and shared an encouraging message, vowing to return stronger. In response to the situation, Arsenal are exploring January transfers, with Lars Bender of Bayer Leverkusen as a top target and Sevilla’s Grzegorz Krychowiak also considered. Wilshere may be able to start training again by February, but a full return to match fitness will likely take additional time. Until then, Arsenal faces a challenging run with a thin midfield lineup.

article_content: The Jamaica women's national football team, known as the Reggae Girlz, announced on Saturday that they will withdraw from two upcoming Women's Gold Cup qualifiers next week. The decision, according to a statement shared on social media by the players, is due to 'constant mistreatment' by their national governing body, the Jamaica Football Federation (JFF). The squad claims they have not received full and correct payments for their performance at this year's World Cup, nor have they received bonuses for qualifying for the tournament. They also allege poor communication regarding coaching, medical, and equipment staff appointments, receiving information in an untimely and unprofessional manner. Players said they only learned who their head coach would be three days before their report date, and that this was communicated via social media rather than through direct contact, despite repeated requests for direct communication with the JFF. "While this has been one of the hardest decisions we have had to make, we feel it is necessary to take such a drastic stance to put an end to the constant mistreatment we receive from the Jamaica Football Federation," the team said in their statement. In a memo sent to the team on Friday, seen by Reuters, the JFF stated that the players would be suspended from selection for any national side until the issues are resolved. The JFF added that the way the players communicated their unavailability did not follow the required contract procedures. According to the JFF, each player must individually state their reason for being unavailable, although one email was received from a player representing all players. The memo also expressed the JFF’s disappointment with the absence of player representatives at a scheduled meeting on Friday. Jamaica are scheduled to face Panama in Panama City on October 25, followed by Guatemala in Kingston on October 29. In August, Jamaica reached the knockout phase of the Women's World Cup for the first time, in only their second appearance at the tournament, after losing all matches during their debut in France four years ago. "We have repeatedly faced issues with poor communication, lack of organization, inadequate management, and delayed payments from the JFF," the team said. "For these reasons, we have taken this stand in solidarity, hoping to end this ongoing cycle of mistreatment."

De påpeker også dårlig kommunikasjon angående trenere, medisinsk personell og utstyrsansvarlige, og sier at de får informasjonen sent og på en uprofesjonell måte. Notatet uttrykte også JFFs skuffelse over at ingen spillerrepresentanter møtte til et planlagt møte fredag. Jamaica skal etter planen møte Panama i Panama City 25. oktober og deretter Guatemala i Kingston 29. oktober. I august nådde Jamaica utslagsrunden i VM for første gang, på bare sitt andre forsøk i turneringen, etter å ha tapt alle kampene i sin debut i Frankrike for fire år siden. "Vi har gjentatte ganger opplevd dårlig kommunikasjon, manglende organisering, utilstrekkelig ledelse og forsinkede utbetalinger fra JFF," sa laget. "Dette er årsakene til at vi står sammen og håper å få en slutt på denne vedvarende syklusen av mislighold."

article_content: A 65-year-old NRI visiting his son in Bengaluru experienced a traumatic incident Thursday evening when he was attacked by a Rottweiler in Malleswaram, west Bengaluru. The attack occurred as he was returning from celebrating a friend's birthday. Within minutes, the same dog attacked a 60-year-old man who was walking nearby. Police registered a case against the dog’s owner, Chandrashekar, a Malleswaram resident, under IPC section 289 for negligent conduct with respect to animals. Authorities withheld additional information about the owner. Suresh Kumar (name changed), the NRI, told police he was heading to a store with a friend to buy a gift. "As we were returning on 4th Main at 8pm, the Rottweiler attacked me without any provocation. It bit me on my abdomen and tore my shirt," he reported. A Hoysala police patrol arrived promptly to address his complaint. While officers attended to Suresh Kumar, the dog attacked a second man, age 60, injuring him. Suresh Kumar stated the dog owner showed no remorse and shouted at them for using the area. "I was saved from major injuries because of the thick belt I was wearing. Nevertheless, I was given 10 injections within three hours and was left emotionally disturbed," he shared. He later told police that both he and the other man were bitten due to Chandrashekar’s gross negligence, as the owner had not taken necessary precautions to prevent the dog from endangering others. Police commented that Chandrashekar could have at least used a muzzle for safety. Initially, police registered a non-cognizable offence against Chandrashekar, but later filed a First Information Report (FIR). "We have summoned Chandrashekar to appear before the investigating officer for further questioning. A chargesheet will be filed once the investigation is completed," a senior police officer said.

Angrepet skjedde da han var på vei hjem etter å ha feiret en venns bursdag. Bare minutter senere angrep den samme hunden en 60 år gammel mann som gikk i nærheten. Politiet har ikke gitt ut ytterligere informasjon om eieren. Suresh Kumar (navn endret), NRI-en, fortalte politiet at han var på vei til en butikk med en venn for å kjøpe en gave. "Da vi returnerte på 4th Main klokken 20:00, angrep Rottweileren meg helt uprovosert. Den bet meg i magen og rev i stykker skjorten min," fortalte han til politiet. En Hoysala politipatrulje kom raskt til stedet for å håndtere klagen hans. Mens politiet hjalp Suresh Kumar, angrep hunden en annen mann på 60 år og skadet ham. Suresh Kumar sa at hundeeieren ikke viste noen anger og ropte til dem for at de gikk i området. "Jeg ble spart for større skader fordi jeg hadde på meg et tykt belte. Uansett fikk jeg ti sprøyter i løpet av tre timer og ble emosjonelt preget," fortalte han. Senere informerte han politiet om at både han og den andre mannen ble bitt på grunn av grov uaktsomhet fra Chandrashekar, da han ikke hadde tatt nødvendige forholdsregler for å hindre hunden i å utgjøre en fare for andre. Politiet uttalte at Chandrashekar i det minste kunne brukt munnkurv som sikkerhetstiltak. Politiet registrerte først en ikke-erstatningspliktig lovovertredelse mot Chandrashekar, men leverte senere en anmeldelse (FIR). "Vi har innkalt Chandrashekar til avhør foran etterforskeren. article_content: Colman Domingo delivers an outstanding performance in the civil rights biopic 'Rustin,' and Dolly Parton's rock album 'Rockstar' are among the new entertainment releases available this week. The Associated Press’ entertainment journalists highlight several offerings, including a series in which Godzilla and King Kong are real, the fifth Persona video game, and the return of 'The Crown.' ‘Rustin,' a Netflix drama premiering Friday, Nov. 17, stars Colman Domingo as Bayard Rustin, a pivotal civil rights leader and architect of the March on Washington. Directed by George C. Wolfe, the film covers the events leading up to the landmark 1963 march where Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. delivered his 'I Have a Dream' speech. It is the first narrative feature from Higher Ground, Barack and Michelle Obama’s production company. Domingo’s performance has received high praise for its charisma and depth. The comedy trio Please Don’t Destroy (Ben Marshall, John Higgins, Martin Herlihy) brings their signature humor to their first feature film, 'Please Don't Destroy: The Treasure of Foggy Mountain,' streaming on Peacock starting Nov. 17. The film, directed by Paul Briganti and produced by Judd Apatow, also features appearances by Conan O'Brien and Bowen Yang. In November, the Criterion Channel highlights film noir classics and a 'Women of the West' series, while TCM features noir staples like 'Detour' (1945) and 'The Narrow Margin' (1952) on Nov. 17. The Criterion Channel's lineup showcases strong female characters led by stars such as Marlene Dietrich and Joan Crawford. Dolly Parton, previously hesitant about her Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction, releases her first rock album, 'Rockstar,' on Nov. 17. The album features collaborations with Paul McCartney, Ringo Starr, Linda Perry, and Lizzo, along with nine original tracks. Parton's legendary status in music is affirmed with this genre-crossing project. Rapper Danny Brown returns with his sixth studio album 'Quaranta.' Inspired by his personal journey, including his time in rehab, the album is described as his most personal work yet and serves as a spiritual sequel to his notable album 'XXX.' Evanescence’s debut album 'Fallen' celebrates its twentieth anniversary with a remastered edition, featuring hits such as 'Bring Me to Life' and 'My Immortal.' While fans await 'NCIS' Season 21, the franchise launches its first international spin-off, 'NCIS: Sydney,' premiering Nov. 14 on CBS and streaming on Paramount+. The new series focuses on a joint U.S.-Australian task force tackling naval crimes in the Indo-Pacific region. The limited series 'A Murder at the End of the World' debuts on FX on Hulu, featuring Emma Corrin as a detective investigating a murder at a retreat hosted by a reclusive billionaire, played by Clive Owen. The series was co-created by Brit Marling and Zal Batmanglij. The sixth and final season of 'The Crown' premieres its first half on Netflix, beginning with Princess Diana’s relationship with Dodi Fayed and the evolving dynamics involving Prince Charles and Queen Elizabeth. Producer Swizz Beatz and his son Nasir Dean explore global car cultures in the new docuseries 'Drive with Swizz Beatz,' debuting Nov. 16 on Hulu. The Max series 'Julia' returns for a second season with Sarah Lancashire as Julia Child, focusing on her career and personal challenges as she relaunches 'The French Chef.' Kurt and Wyatt Russell star in 'Monarch: Legacy of Monsters' on Apple TV+, playing the same character at different ages in the MonsterVerse universe, where monsters like Godzilla and King Kong exist and are tracked by a secret government agency. The anime series 'Scott Pilgrim Takes Off,' based on the 2010 film, arrives on Netflix Nov. 17, with the original cast reprising their voice roles. 'Persona 5 Tactica,' a new strategy-focused video game, releases Nov. 17 on multiple platforms, continuing the adventures of the popular Persona 5 characters.

article_content: On November 3, in the aftermath of an Israeli airstrike outside al-Shifa hospital in Gaza City, an injured Palestinian boy was carried away. Israel stated it targeted Hamas members allegedly using an ambulance to leave the hospital, a claim Hamas denied. Hospital officials reported 13 people killed and dozens injured. Hospitals in Gaza have sustained repeated damage during the Israel-Hamas conflict. Their protected status under international law is a source of ongoing dispute: Palestinians maintain that hospitals must never be attacked, while Israel asserts Hamas uses tunnels beneath hospitals to shield its operations. Wesam Ahmad of Palestinian human rights group Al-Haq (West Bank) highlights that hospitals are explicitly protected under international law. In contrast, Rear Adm. Daniel Hagari, Israel's chief military spokesperson, claims Hamas uses hospitals as shields. Israel regularly raises concerns about Hamas’ activities, arguing this behavior can compromise hospital protections. This debate is central to issues surrounding civilian casualties in Gaza. Since fighting began on October 7, more than 11,000 people in Gaza have been killed—mostly civilians—according to the Gaza Health Ministry. Israeli officials report about 1,400 deaths, mainly civilians, from the October 7 attack by Hamas. Israel contends Hamas embeds itself in densely populated neighborhoods. Pnina Sharvit Baruch, former Israeli military legal adviser, describes this as a 'win-win' for Hamas: if Israel refrains from attacking, Hamas' infrastructure remains; if it attacks, civilian casualties rise and international pressure mounts. Sari Bashi, head of global research at Human Rights Watch, argues Israeli use of explosive weapons in crowded areas leads to predictable and significant civilian harm. The 1949 Geneva Conventions specifically protect civilian hospitals from attack, but protection can be lost if a hospital is used for hostile acts. Legal experts note that clear evidence, warnings, and proportionality are necessary in such instances. Bashi expresses concern about potential indiscriminate attacks by Israel. Sharvit Baruch acknowledges that reviewing every potential target is not always feasible during conflict, and admits that even lawful military actions can be met with international criticism, given the extent of destruction. Palestinian officials report over 100 healthcare facilities and more than 40 ambulances damaged in Israeli attacks over the past month. Following the October 18 al-Ahli Arab Hospital explosion, Palestinians blamed an Israeli airstrike, but Israel—supported by U.S. and Western intelligence agencies—attributed it to a misfired Palestinian rocket. Two incidents have drawn special scrutiny: the October 17 explosion at al-Ahli Arab Hospital and the November 3 strike near al-Shifa Hospital. Israel maintains it targeted a Hamas-operated ambulance, but Hamas and hospital staff say bystanders were among the casualties. Many Palestinians have sought refuge around hospital compounds, viewing them as relatively safer amid ongoing bombardment. Human Rights Watch is investigating the November 3 event. Bashi notes that, per Israel’s own statements, Hamas fighters were leaving, not attacking from, the hospital, and that Israel did not issue a warning ahead of the strike. International law forbids medical facilities from being used to shield military objectives, applying to all parties. Hamas denies hosting its headquarters under al-Shifa Hospital but acknowledges a vast tunnel network, widely believed to exist under or near sensitive sites. Hamas has previously targeted Israeli civilians in attacks, including the October 7 assault. Currently, Hamas holds about 240 hostages, mostly civilians, and continues to launch rocket attacks into Israel. Sharvit Baruch concludes that no easy solution exists for neutralizing Hamas while safeguarding Gaza’s civilian population.
translated_content: Den 3. november, i etterkant av et israelsk luftangrep utenfor al-Shifa-sykehuset i Gaza by, ble en skadet palestinsk gutt båret bort. Israel uttalte at de rettet angrepet mot Hamas-medlemmer som angivelig brukte en ambulanse for å forlate sykehuset, en påstand Hamas avviser. Sykehusansatte rapporterte om 13 drepte og dusinvis av skadde. Sykehusene i Gaza har gjentatte ganger blitt skadet under konflikten mellom Israel og Hamas. Deres verneverdige status etter internasjonal lov er et vedvarende stridsspørsmål: Palestinere mener sykehus aldri må angripes, mens Israel hevder at Hamas bruker tunneler under sykehusene for å skjerme sine operasjoner. Wesam Ahmad fra den palestinske menneskerettighetsgruppen Al-Haq (Vestbredden) påpeker at sykehus er eksplisitt beskyttet etter internasjonal lov. I motsetning hevder kontreadmiral Daniel Hagari, Israels sjefsmilitære talsperson, at Hamas bruker sykehus som skjold. Israel tar jevnlig opp bekymringer om Hamas’ aktiviteter og hevder at dette kan undergrave sykehusenes beskyttelse. Denne debatten står sentralt i spørsmål om sivile tap i Gaza. Siden kamphandlingene startet 7. oktober, har mer enn 11 000 personer i Gaza blitt drept—de fleste sivile—ifølge Gazas helsedepartement. Israelske myndigheter rapporterer omkring 1 400 døde, hovedsakelig sivile, etter Hamas-angrepet 7. oktober. Israel hevder at Hamas bevisst plasserer seg i tett befolkede områder. Pnina Sharvit Baruch, tidligere juridisk rådgiver i det israelske forsvaret, beskriver dette som en ‘vinn-vinn’-situasjon for Hamas: Hvis Israel avstår fra å angripe, forblir Hamas’ infrastruktur uforstyrret; hvis de angriper, øker sivile tap og det internasjonale presset mot Israel vokser. Sari Bashi, global forskningsleder i Human Rights Watch, mener Israels bruk av eksplosive våpen i tettbebygde områder fører til forutsigbare og store sivile tap. Genève-konvensjonen fra 1949 gir sivile sykehus spesielt vern, men beskyttelsen kan gå tapt dersom et sykehus brukes til fiendtlige handlinger. Juridiske eksperter fremhever at tydelig bevis, advarsler og proporsjonalitet er nødvendig i slike tilfeller. Bashi uttrykker bekymring for potensielt vilkårlige angrep fra Israel. Sharvit Baruch erkjenner at det ikke alltid er mulig å vurdere hvert eneste mål under konflikt, og innrømmer at selv lovlige militære handlinger kan møtes med internasjonal kritikk på grunn av ødeleggelsens omfang. Palestinske myndigheter rapporterer at over 100 helseinstitusjoner og mer enn 40 ambulanser er skadet av israelske angrep den siste måneden. Etter eksplosjonen ved al-Ahli Arab-sykehuset 18. oktober, gav palestinere Israel skylden, men Israel—støttet av amerikansk og vestlig etterretning—hevdet at det skyldtes en avfyrt, feilslått rakett fra palestinsk side. To hendelser har fått særlig oppmerksomhet: eksplosjonen 17. oktober ved al-Ahli Arab-sykehuset og angrepet 3. november ved al-Shifa-sykehuset. Israel hevder de angrep en Hamas-operert ambulanse, men Hamas og sykehuspersonell sier at forbipasserende var blant ofrene. Mange palestinere har søkt tilflukt på sykehusområdene da disse oppleves som sikrere under pågående bombardement. Human Rights Watch etterforsker hendelsen 3. november. Bashi påpeker at Israels egne uttalelser tilsier at Hamas-krigere forlot sykehuset, ikke at de angrep fra det, og at Israel ikke ga noe forvarsel før angrepet. Internasjonal lov forbyr bruk av medisinske fasiliteter som skjold for militære mål, og dette gjelder alle parter. Hamas benekter å ha sitt hovedkvarter under al-Shifa-sykehuset, men innrømmer et utstrakt tunnelnettverk som antas å gå under eller ved sensitive områder. Hamas har tidligere angrepet israelske sivile, blant annet i angrepet 7. oktober. Per nå holder Hamas rundt 240 gisler, hovedsakelig sivile, og fortsetter å skyte raketter mot Israel. Sharvit Baruch konkluderer med at det ikke finnes en enkel løsning for å nøytralisere Hamas og samtidig beskytte befolkningen i Gaza.

article_content: Russian doctors have reported a remarkable case involving an 80-year-old woman who has unknowingly carried a needle in her brain since infancy. The needle, measuring three centimeters in length, was found during a routine CT scan unrelated to neurological issues in Sakhalin, a remote island in Russia's far east. According to local health officials, it is believed the needle was inserted shortly after the woman was born in 1943, possibly as a result of an attempted infanticide—a tragedy not uncommon in areas suffering severe food shortages during World War II. In such circumstances, parents sometimes resorted to inserting needles into a baby's fontanelle (soft spot), which would then close up, concealing any evidence. Astonishingly, the woman has suffered no major health complications from the needle, not even headaches, despite its position in the brain's parietal lobe. Her current doctors have decided against removing the needle, as the operation could be riskier than leaving it in place. They will continue to monitor her health. This unusual case highlights the brain's potential resilience, especially in young children. The brain can sometimes compensate for physical injuries, even those sustained early in life, by forming new connections.
translated_content: Russiske leger har rapportert om et bemerkelsesverdig tilfelle der en 80 år gammel kvinne uvitende har hatt en nål i hjernen siden spedbarnsalderen. Nålen, som er tre centimeter lang, ble oppdaget under en rutinemessig CT-skanning som ikke var relatert til nevrologiske problemer, på Sakhalin, en avsidesliggende øy øst i Russland. Ifølge lokale helsemyndigheter antas det at nålen ble satt inn like etter at kvinnen ble født i 1943, muligens som følge av et mislykket spedbarnsdrap – en tragedie som dessverre ikke var uvanlig i områder rammet av matmangel under andre verdenskrig. I slike situasjoner kunne foreldre stikke nåler inn i barnets fontanelle (den myke flekken), som deretter grodde sammen og skjulte sporene. Utrolig nok har kvinnen ikke hatt store helseproblemer av nålen – ikke engang hodepine – til tross for dens plassering i hjernens parietallapp. Legene har valgt å ikke fjerne nålen, da en operasjon kan være farligere enn å la den være. Helsen hennes vil fortsatt følges opp. Denne uvanlige saken fremhever hjernens evne til å tilpasse seg, spesielt hos barn. Hjernen kan noen ganger kompensere for fysiske skader, selv de som oppstår tidlig i livet, ved å danne nye forbindelser.
