article_content: This week, animal liberation group Direct Action Everywhere (DxE) released a manual recommending the use of high-tech equipment such as drones, hidden cameras, and thermal vision scopes in their rescue operations. According to the manual, reviewed by WIRED, these technologies are deployed in bold efforts to save animals like pigs, goats, ducks, and chickens from factory farms. Meanwhile, researchers at Tech Against Terrorism have reported that extremist groups are experimenting with generative AI to flood social media with propaganda and misinformation. Their new report describes recent instances where terrorist organizations used artificial intelligence to manipulate images and evade content moderation. In response to the surge of extremist content online, Tech Against Terrorism and Google have developed a tool called Altitude. The tool aggregates verified terrorist content to help social media platforms more effectively vet posts. The ongoing conflict in Gaza has been intensified by Israeli-imposed internet blackouts, further worsening the region's humanitarian crisis. Last week, reports indicated Israel shut down internet access in Gaza as its troops advanced, with subsequent recurring blackouts, including a 15-hour outage on Sunday while an operation was underway to cut northern Gaza off from the south. A new report from cybersecurity firm Mandiant states that last year, Russian military intelligence (Sandworm) launched a cyberattack against a Ukrainian electric utility, causing blackouts for civilians. This cyberattack coincided with missile strikes targeting Ukrainian critical infrastructure. Elsewhere, the third GOP presidential primary debate was livestreamed on Rumble, a YouTube alternative that, according to the Southern Poverty Law Center, hosts prominent white nationalist Nick Fuentes. Since the Israel-Hamas conflict began last month, Fuentes has used Rumble to spread antisemitic hate speech and Holocaust denial conspiracies, amassing hundreds of thousands of views. YouTube terminated Fuentes’ account in 2020 after Google demonetized it. In other news, many experienced issues accessing ChatGPT on Wednesday after developer OpenAI was hit by what appears to have been a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack. For almost two hours, users were met with a message saying 'ChatGPT is at capacity right now.' Initially, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman attributed the outage to increased demand for new features, but the company later clarified that the outages were due to abnormal traffic patterns indicative of a DDoS attack.

article_content: US President Joe Biden has signed an executive order focusing on artificial intelligence (AI) that aims to enhance the safety and security of AI systems while also fostering their development in the United States. The order requires companies to report potential risks from their AI technologies that could be exploited by foreign actors or terrorists for the creation of weapons of mass destruction. Beyond security requirements, the executive order introduces measures to attract international talent to US companies and research laboratories, strengthening American AI capabilities. The Biden administration intends to make it easier for highly skilled immigrants and nonimmigrants in key sectors to study, work, and remain in the US, with streamlined visa interview and review processes aimed at reducing wait times and costs. STEM students are set to benefit significantly. The directive will shorten visa processing times and lower related expenses, allowing students to avoid returning home for visa interviews. These changes also enable easier attendance at international conferences and make travel less cumbersome without ongoing visa renewal worries. The executive order is expected to positively affect more than 500,000 H-1B visa holders. The Department of Homeland Security has proposed regulatory changes to facilitate job transitions for H-1B holders, provide greater certainty in visa renewals, and allow more flexibility for utilizing their skills. Entrepreneurs will also have better access to the H-1B program. At present, about 900,000 international students are enrolled in US schools, nearly half pursuing STEM fields. The updated policy could impact roughly 450,000 students, including those taking part in optional practical training (OPT). Many of these international students are pursuing advanced degrees; nearly half of US STEM PhDs are awarded to international students. The executive order also brings advantages to students and professionals from India and China. Updates to the recognized skills list are being implemented to match evolving global labor demand. These changes expand opportunities for J-1 visa holders—including professors and research scholars from China and India—by enabling quicker transitions to other visas without a two-year home residency requirement. Altogether, the executive order underlines the US commitment to AI safety and development while creating better opportunities for STEM professionals and simplifying the visa process. In related business news, Apple Inc. achieved a record revenue quarter in India, with notable year-on-year growth reported by CEO Tim Cook. The luxury car market in India is attracting younger buyers, with Audi, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW seeing decreasing average customer ages. Meanwhile, leadership of the proposed Sony-ZEEL merger is in question due to ongoing regulatory investigations.

article_content: Australian scientists have tagged whale sharks, which can reach 30 feet in length, to study their annual migrations using satellite technology visualized on Google Maps. Despite being among the largest animals in the world, weighing up to 30 tons, whale shark movements remain not fully understood. Researchers from the Australian Institute of Marine Science have attached satellite tags to several whale sharks to monitor their migrations from north-west Australia to Asia, with journeys spanning hundreds or thousands of miles within weeks. Images show marine scientists tagging these massive fish to track their 8,000-mile journeys across the ocean at depths up to 3,000 feet. Underwater photographer Peter Verhoog from the Netherlands teamed up with Dr. Mark Meekan of the Institute to document research at Ningaloo Reef, located 800 miles off Western Australia's coast. Mr. Verhoog explained that tags are embedded into the whale shark’s thick skin, about 10 cm deep, using specially designed harpoons. Whale sharks are slow-moving filter feeders and are the largest living non-mammalian vertebrates, with weight similar to the largest dinosaurs. The species originated around 60 million years ago. They are found in tropical and warm oceans, usually living in open water, with an estimated lifespan of about 70 years. Data from satellite tags reveal that whale sharks can undertake multi-year, long-distance migrations, sometimes covering over 12,000 miles from north-west Australia toward Asia, or hundreds of miles in only a few weeks. Despite their size, whale sharks are gentle, feeding mainly on plankton and tiny marine creatures rather than hunting prey. The species is listed as vulnerable, with declining populations of concern. Researchers like Mr. Verhoog and Dr. Meekan are striving to learn more about whale sharks' behavior and migration before numbers decline further. Mr. Verhoog said, 'My mission is to show people the beauty of sharks, but also to share knowledge about their migration and feeding patterns.' Populations have decreased, partly due to fishing such as harpoon fisheries in Southeast Asia. Whale shark meat is eaten, but their large fins are especially valuable, with one fin selling for over $15,000 and a single shark valued over $60,000 in some Asian markets. Scientists, including PhD student Lara Marcus, are studying the sharks’ feeding patterns by analyzing plankton samples. As the ocean’s largest fish, the whale shark’s declining numbers highlight the urgent need for conservation.

Forskere fra Australian Institute of Marine Science har festet satellittsendere på flere hvalhaier for å overvåke migrasjoner fra nordvest-Australia til Asia – reiser som kan strekke seg over hundrevis eller tusenvis av kilometer på noen uker. Bilder viser at marineforskere merker disse enorme fiskene for å spore deres 13.000 kilometers reise over havet på dyp ned til 900 meter. Undervannsfotograf Peter Verhoog fra Nederland samarbeidet med Dr. Mark Meekan fra instituttet for å dokumentere forskningsprosjektet ved Ningaloo Reef, 1.300 kilometer utenfor kysten av Vest-Australia. Verhoog forklarer at senderne festes i hvalhaienes tykke hud, ca. 10 cm inn, med spesialdesignede harpuner. Hvalhaier er saktegående planktonspisere og de største nålevende virveldyrene utenom pattedyr – deres vekt kan sammenlignes med de største dinosaurene. Arten oppsto for rundt 60 millioner år siden. De lever i tropiske og varme hav, vanligvis i åpent hav, og kan bli rundt 70 år gamle. Data fra satellittmerkingen viser at hvalhaier kan foreta flerårige og langdistansemigrasjoner, noen ganger over 19.000 kilometer fra nordvest-Australia mot Asia, eller hundrevis av kilometer på bare noen uker. Selv om de er enorme, er hvalhaier milde kjemper som spiser plankton og små sjødyr fremfor å jakte på større bytte. Arten er klassifisert som sårbar, og bestanden er synkende. Forskere som Peter Verhoog og Dr. Meekan jobber for å lære mer om hvalhaienes atferd og migrasjonsmønster før bestandene blir ytterligere redusert. Verhoog sier: «Mitt oppdrag er å vise folk hvor vakre haier er, men også å spre kunnskap om deres migrasjon og spisevaner.» Bestandene har gått ned, delvis på grunn av fiske med harpun i Sørøst-Asia. Hvalhaikjøtt blir spist, men de store finnene er spesielt verdifulle — én finne kan selges for over 150 000 kroner, og en enkelt hai kan være verdt over 600 000 kroner i noen asiatiske markeder. Forskere, inkludert PhD-student Lara Marcus, studerer haiens spisevaner ved å analysere planktonprøver. Som verdens største fisk understreker den fallende bestanden av hvalhai behovet for bevaringsarbeid.

article_content: Google’s Magic Eraser, originally launched for photo editing, quickly became popular worldwide. The tool allowed Pixel users to remove unwanted people and objects from images, with AI seamlessly filling in the gaps. Now, Magic Eraser has expanded to include Audio Magic Eraser, an audio editing tool available exclusively on the Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro. Audio Magic Eraser lets users edit the audio in any video on their Pixel 8 series device, using AI to separate and identify different sound components. This feature enables you to remove or adjust specific sounds, improving your recordings’ audio quality. Audio Magic Eraser is almost as easy to use as the photo-editing version. Here’s how to use Audio Magic Eraser on the Pixel 8: 1. Open Google Photos on your Pixel 8 or Pixel 8 Pro. 2. Select a video. 3. Tap 'Edit.' 4. Tap ‘Audio’ at the bottom. 5. Select ‘Audio Eraser.’ 6. After analyzing the audio, sounds are displayed as separate tracks with labels like 'Nature' or 'Noise.' 7. Tap a track to adjust it. 8. Use the slider to enhance or reduce the selected track. 9. Tap ‘Done’ when you’re finished. 10. Choose ‘Save a copy’ to keep the edited video separately. For an example, Android Central’s Nick Sutrich demonstrated how loud appliances like a washer and dryer were removed entirely after editing with Audio Magic Eraser. The tool works well, letting you filter, increase, or reduce particular sounds within any video, regardless of the recording device. Note: Only Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro users have access to this feature for now. Meanwhile, Magic Eraser for images is now available for all Android users in Google Photos. The tool is free for Pixel owners, but others need a Google One subscription for access on their Android devices. If you have Magic Eraser, it’s worth learning how to use it—guides are available for both Pixel and non-Pixel devices. The Pixel 8 is widely regarded as one of Google’s best Android phones so far, powered by the Tensor G3 chipset and offering standout features like Audio Magic Eraser and on-device translation.

article_content: Associated British Foods (ABF) shares rose by 6.3% on Tuesday as the company reported robust annual results and announced a new share buyback program alongside a special dividend. Shares were trading at £22.38, leading the FTSE 100 higher. For the 12 months ending 16 September, ABF’s revenue surged 16% to £19.8 billion. Across all business divisions, sales grew, with Primark standing out as the key driver. The fashion retailer’s turnover climbed 17% to £9 billion, thanks to carefully managed price increases to offset volatile costs, the popularity of its product lines, and an influx of new customers. The increase was also supported by successful new Primark stores and improvements to its website. The Grocery division grew 12% to £4.2 billion, while Sugar jumped 26% to £2.55 billion through higher prices and production. Ingredients and Agriculture revenues rose 18% to £2.16 billion and 7% to £1.84 billion, respectively. Adjusted pre-tax profit reached £1.47 billion, up 9% from last year. ABF’s net debt increased to £2.27 billion, largely because of significant investments, including 27 new Primark stores and digital upgrades. Despite the extra investment, financial leverage stayed just below one times. This helped ABF announce a £500 million share buyback and a special dividend of 12.7p per share. The total dividend for the year increased to 60p per share, up from 43.7p the previous year. CEO George Weston said the group had tackled major economic challenges, partly linked to geopolitical events, and is now well prepared for the next year. He pointed out that selective price rises have worked well, with Primark maintaining strong customer interest. Looking ahead, ABF remains optimistic. The company noted that while conditions are still tough for consumers, inflationary pressures have eased, and markets are less volatile than they were a year ago. Overall, management believes ABF is in a strong position. Analyst Mark Crouch of eToro praised ABF’s handling of inflation and shifting consumer demand. He highlighted that Primark’s targeted price increases lifted revenues without discouraging shoppers and that collaborations with celebrities such as Stacey Solomon and Rita Ora have resonated with customers.

Aksjekursen lå på £22,38, og sendte FTSE 100-indeksen oppover. For de 12 månedene som endte 16. september, vokste ABFs omsetning med 16 % til 19,8 milliarder pund. article_content: King Richard's Faire is the largest Renaissance Faire in New England, originally founded in 1972 by concert producer Dick Shapiro. The Shapiro family still operates the Faire today. Recently, a viral Reddit post has brought attention to alleged labor exploitation at the Faire, which reportedly generates over $400,000 daily. The post claims that much of the Faire's profitability comes from employing workers classified as contractors rather than temporary employees, which limits their pay and benefits. Many entertainment and operations workers are allegedly unpaid and only receive free admission, without additional perks like food. Additionally, if the Faire is closed due to rain, workers are reportedly not compensated, though the Shapiros offer rain checks for visitors instead of refunds, retaining the revenue from unused tickets. According to available contracts referenced in the discussion, entertainment and operations staff typically earn around $70 per day, which equates to less than six dollars an hour based on their work hours. These claims, however, remain unverified beyond the original Reddit post. The article's author, who has a background in theater and personal experience with the Faire, notes that actors often speak negatively about working conditions there. The Reddit post closes with a call to action, encouraging workers to organize for better treatment.

Mange av de som jobber med underholdning og drift er ifølge innlegget ubetalt og får kun gratis inngang, uten ekstra goder som mat. Hvis festivalen må stenge på grunn av regn, rapporteres det at ansatte ikke får betalt, mens Shapiro-familien tilbyr regnbilletter til besøkende i stedet for refusjoner og beholder inntektene fra ubrukte billetter. Ifølge kontrakter vist til i diskusjonen, tjener ansatte innen underholdning og drift vanligvis rundt 70 dollar dagen, noe som tilsvarer mindre enn seks dollar i timen basert på arbeidstiden. Artikkelforfatteren, som har bakgrunn fra teater og personlig erfaring med festivalen, påpeker at skuespillere ofte uttaler seg negativt om arbeidsforholdene der. Reddit-innlegget avsluttes med en oppfordring til de ansatte om å organisere seg for bedre behandling.

article_content: A recent scientific investigation suggests that Venus, long believed to be a barren and lifeless planet, once experienced tectonic plate movement similar to that of early Earth. This new theory, published in Nature Astronomy by a group led by researchers at Brown University, uses current data on Venus’s atmosphere alongside computer modeling. Their analysis indicates that the unique mix of nitrogen and carbon dioxide found in the planet’s dense atmosphere could only be explained if Venus underwent some form of tectonic activity billions of years ago. On our own planet, the shifting and interaction of plates over immense timespans has shaped continents, created mountains, and triggered essential chemical reactions to stabilize the climate—factors that have supported the growth of life. Venus, although similar in size and composition to Earth, is now a sizzling world with surface temperatures capable of melting lead. For years, scientists believed Venus had always featured a 'stagnant lid,' meaning its outer shell never experienced significant movement. However, the latest study challenges this assumption. By running simulations based on Venus’s current atmospheric composition, the team discovered that the presence of so much nitrogen and CO2 couldn’t be explained without some tectonic movement occurring between 4.5 and 3.5 billion years ago. According to the research, both Venus and Earth might have exhibited active tectonic processes around the same period shortly after they were formed, although the plate movements on Venus were likely fewer and less dramatic. "One of the broader implications is the possibility that two planets in our solar system were once operating in plate tectonic mode simultaneously—the very mode believed to make life possible on Earth," said lead author Matt Weller. This raises the tantalizing possibility that Venus, too, might have supported microbial life in the distant past, especially considering how similar the two planets once were. The researchers emphasize that planets aren’t necessarily locked into one tectonic state forever. According to co-author Alexander Evans, planets can shift between different tectonic regimes, which in turn affects habitability over time. This idea might also help interpret the potential for life on other worlds, including Jupiter’s moon Europa and distant exoplanets. To test their theory, the scientists modeled Venus’s atmospheric evolution, beginning with the traditional assumption of an ever-present stagnant crust. Their results failed to align with observed levels of nitrogen and carbon dioxide until they incorporated a period of limited tectonic movement in Venus’s early history, followed by a return to a stable, inactive crust. The team believes this research demonstrates the power of atmospheric analysis in uncovering ancient planetary processes, sometimes offering more clues than studying the surface. Upcoming NASA missions, specifically the DAVINCI project, are expected to gather more atmospheric data from Venus that could affirm these findings. Looking ahead, the team intends to explore why Venus eventually lost its tectonic activity. Their hypothesis is that the planet became too hot and its atmosphere too thick, depriving it of the ingredients necessary for plate movement. Understanding how and why Venus changed course could offer vital insights about Earth’s long-term destiny and what keeps a planet habitable.

Analysen deres viser at kombinasjonen av nitrogen og karbondioksid i Venus’ tette atmosfære bare kan forklares hvis planeten gjennomgikk en form for platetektonisk aktivitet for milliarder av år siden. På Jorden har bevegelsene mellom jordplatene gjennom enorme tidsrom formet kontinenter, skapt fjell og utløst essensielle kjemiske reaksjoner som har stabilisert klimaet—noe som har støttet utviklingen av liv. Venus, selv om den ligner Jorden i størrelse og sammensetning, er nå en glovarm verden med overflatetemperaturer som kan smelte bly. I mange år trodde forskere at Venus alltid hadde hatt et ‘stagnant lokk’, altså at overflaten aldri har beveget seg særlig. Den nye studien utfordrer imidlertid denne antakelsen. Gjennom simuleringer med utgangspunkt i Venus’ nåværende atmosfæresammensetning oppdaget teamet at mengdene nitrogen og CO2 ikke kunne forklares uten platetektonisk bevegelse for mellom 4,5 og 3,5 milliarder år siden. Dette vekker tanken om at også Venus kan ha hatt mikrobielt liv i fjern fortid, særlig ettersom planetene var så like. Forskerne understreker at planeter ikke nødvendigvis forblir i én tektonisk tilstand. Ifølge medforfatter Alexander Evans kan planeter veksle mellom ulike tektoniske regimer, noe som igjen påvirker beboeligheten gjennom tidene. Dette kan også bidra til å tolke livspotensialet på andre verdener, som Jupiters måne Europa og fjerne eksoplaneter. For å teste teorien sin modellerte forskerne atmosfæreutviklingen på Venus, ut fra antakelsen om et fast, uforanderlig skall. Resultatene stemte ikke overens med observerte mengder nitrogen og CO2 før de inkluderte en periode med begrenset platetektonikk i Venus’ tidlige historie, etterfulgt av en overgang til en stabil, inaktiv overflate. Teamet mener denne forskningen viser hvor mye atmosfæriske analyser kan avsløre om eldgamle planetprosesser, noen ganger mer enn overflatemålinger. Kommende NASA-oppdrag, spesielt DAVINCI-prosjektet, vil innhente mer data fra Venus’ atmosfære som kan bekrefte funnene. Fremover planlegger forskergruppen å undersøke hvorfor Venus mistet sin platetektoniske aktivitet. De antar at planeten ble for varm og atmosfæren for tykk, slik at nødvendige forutsetninger for platebevegelse forsvant. Å forstå hvordan og hvorfor Venus endret seg kan gi viktige svar om Jordens fremtid og hva som gjør en planet beboelig.

article_content: Britain's first completely solar-powered home is now for sale in Great Glen, Leicestershire, priced at £1.2 million. Built by Caplin Homes, this timber-framed house features a suite of systems designed to do away with energy bills, including rooftop solar panels for generating electricity and heat, triple-glazed windows, and rainwater harvesting technology. Warmth is provided through water-filled pipes buried underground, which absorb solar heat from the panels above. This heat is stored in an Earth Energy Bank (EEB) beneath the foundation, ready to be released during the winter months to keep the home comfortable. Set over two acres and offering five bedrooms along with two garages, the property also includes a sophisticated controls system that monitors both indoor and outdoor temperatures, manages heat levels, and tracks energy captured by the solar panels. Director Michael Goddard of Caplin Homes noted the use of low-carbon materials and sustainable construction practices, with the goal of demonstrating that zero-carbon homes—where carbon emissions are offset by energy generation—can be both practical and appealing to families and homebuilders. The house's hybrid solar panels generate both electricity and thermal energy. Other advanced features include south-facing triple-glazed windows for winter efficiency and solar walls that preheat incoming ventilation air. Dr. Andrew Wright, a building engineering expert at De Montfort University, is collaborating on studies of the system’s thermal retention capabilities. Thanks to its energy-efficient design, the home typically requires additional heating from the EEB for only about ten weeks each year. Estate agent Anthony Fox stated that the prospect of no traditional utility bills and self-sufficiency drew strong interest from buyers, especially those curious about cutting-edge home technologies. As Britain moves toward a 2016 target for all new homes to be zero-carbon, this property stands as an example that environmentally friendly, cost-effective living is within reach.

article_content: Pakistani teenager Malala Yousafzai is seen as a favorite to win the Nobel Peace Prize. However, bookmakers also highlight Denis Mukwege, a pioneering doctor from the Democratic Republic of Congo, as a top contender. Dr. Mukwege, 58, serves as the medical director of Panzi Hospital in eastern Congo, an area afflicted by conflict for almost two decades. Panzi Hospital, located in the hills above Bukavu, provides a refuge for women who have survived sexual violence. Many travel hundreds of miles to receive treatment for both physical and psychological injuries from Dr. Mukwege and his team. The use of rape as a weapon of war in the DRC has been widely reported. Although precise statistics are unavailable, the United Nations estimates that more than 200,000 Congolese women are survivors of sexual violence. Many of Dr. Mukwege’s patients have suffered severe injuries, including permanent internal damage. The hospital treats conditions such as vaginal fistula—an injury often resulting from violent attacks—and provides counseling for the psychological trauma. Describing the severity of fistula, Dr. Mukwege once told CNN, 'A fistula is dramatic for a woman. Everywhere she goes, people avoid her and reject her, so it becomes a disease worse than leprosy.' During his more than 20-year career, Dr. Mukwege has treated tens of thousands of women. Many patients at Panzi Hospital see him as a father figure. He has said, 'Sometimes it's important to support them emotionally and assure them: You are not destroyed. They tried to destroy you, but you remain a woman. You are strong.' In October 2012, armed men broke into Dr. Mukwege’s home, held his daughters at gunpoint, and waited for him to return. His security guard was killed while trying to intervene, and Mukwege narrowly escaped being shot. He took his family to safety in Brussels. When Dr. Mukwege returned to Bukavu the following January, the community welcomed him warmly. His patients and supporters had raised funds for his return by selling pineapples and onions. Born in 1955 as the third of nine children, Dr. Mukwege studied medicine in the DRC before specializing in gynecology in France. He was inspired by the maternal health challenges he witnessed in his home country. Dr. Mukwege has received multiple awards for his humanitarian work, including the United Nations Human Rights Prize in 2008. Mukwege has stated that he never considered moving abroad for higher pay or better conditions, saying, 'Work is not only about money. Earning money is not the purpose of life. Life is about what you can give to others.'

article_content: The second of NASA’s two new research probes successfully entered the Moon’s orbit on Sunday afternoon, a day after its companion, the agency announced. The unmanned Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory-B (GRAIL-B) fired its main engines at 5:05 p.m. and entered lunar orbit 39 minutes later, according to controllers at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, California. Its companion, GRAIL-A, arrived on Saturday. ‘Cheers in JPL mission control as everything is looking good for #GRAIL-B,’ the laboratory announced via Twitter. ‘It’s going to be a great 2012!’ NASA states that the twin orbiters will study the Moon ‘in unprecedented detail’ from a near pole-to-pole orbit about 34 miles (55 km) above the surface. For an expected 82 days, their instruments will map the lunar gravitational field, providing scientists with insights into the Moon’s interior—and potentially how Earth and its neighbors formed. Both probes were launched aboard the same rocket from Florida’s Cape Canaveral on September 10. While the Apollo missions in the 1960s and 1970s took only three days to cross the 250,000-mile distance from Earth to the Moon, the GRAIL probes spent more than three months traveling and covered over 2.5 million miles, reshaping their orbits for optimal positioning to study the Moon, NASA explained. Maria Zuber, principal investigator for GRAIL, said the Moon remains mysterious in many respects. Although scientists theorize the Moon formed after a Mars-sized object collided with Earth, it’s still unclear why its near side is so different from its far side. One side’s basins are flooded with volcanic material, while the other consists of highlands. ‘We think the answer is locked in the interior,’ Zuber said at a NASA news briefing Wednesday.

Den ubemannede Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory-B (GRAIL-B) fyrte av hovedmotorene sine klokken 17:05 og gikk inn i månebane 39 minutter senere, ifølge kontrollere ved NASAs Jet Propulsion Laboratory i Pasadena, California. Følgesvennen GRAIL-A ankom lørdag. ‘Jubel i JPLs kontrollrom – alt ser bra ut for #GRAIL-B,’ meldte laboratoriet på Twitter. ‘Dette blir et fantastisk 2012!’ NASA opplyser at de to sondene vil studere Månen ‘i enestående detalj’ fra en nær pol-til-pol-bane omtrent 55 km over overflaten. I løpet av forventede 82 dager vil instrumentene deres kartlegge Månens gravitasjonsfelt og gi forskere innsikt i Månens indre—og kanskje i hvordan Jorden og dens naboplaneter ble dannet. Begge sondene ble skutt opp med samme rakett fra Cape Canaveral i Florida 10. september. Mens Apollo-ferdene på 1960- og 70-tallet kun brukte tre dager på å krysse de 400 000 kilometerne fra Jorden til Månen, brukte GRAIL-sondene over tre måneder på ferden og tilbakela over 4 millioner kilometer, for å tilpasse banene best mulig for månestudiene, ifølge NASA. Maria Zuber, hovedforsker for GRAIL, sier at Månen fortsatt er mystisk på mange måter. Selv om forskere antar at Månen ble til etter at en Mars-stor gjenstand kolliderte med Jorden, er det fortsatt uklart hvorfor dens forside er så forskjellig fra baksiden. På den ene siden er bassenger fylt med vulkansk materiale, mens den andre siden består av høyland. ‘Vi tror svaret ligger i det indre,’ sa Zuber på en NASA-pressekonferanse onsdag.

article_content: Geert Wilders achieved a surprising victory in Wednesday’s Dutch elections after a late surge propelled his anti-EU Freedom Party to a strong win over mainstream rivals. As people in the Netherlands—and across Europe—come to terms with the result, several key issues stand out. Wilders, 60, has been active in Dutch politics for decades. He began his career with former Prime Minister Mark Rutte’s liberal party but later became an independent lawmaker before founding the anti-immigration Freedom Party (PVV). He has received death threats due to his anti-Islamic positions and has lived under police protection since 2004. In 2020, Wilders was found guilty of insult charges related to comments about Moroccan immigrants but was not given a penalty. He is viewed as the Dutch equivalent of populist leaders like Donald Trump and Argentina’s new president, Javier Milei. Initially, few saw Wilders as a serious contender in this campaign. However, Dilan Yesilgoz-Zegerius, Rutte’s successor as head of the liberal group, indicated she might consider joining a coalition with the Freedom Party. Another front-runner, Pieter Omtzigt, lost support after hesitating over his own prime ministerial ambitions. Wilders, by contrast, took a pragmatic approach, softening some controversial positions and presenting himself as ready to participate in government. He performed confidently in the final debates. Among his notable proposals are a binding referendum on leaving the European Union, withdrawing the Netherlands from international climate commitments, and significantly reducing immigration. According to the party manifesto, the Netherlands has been 'seriously weakened due to ongoing asylum pressures and mass immigration.' Wilders has also pledged to stop sending aid to Ukraine, ban the Koran, and close mosques. However, in his election-night speech, he indicated willingness to compromise for the sake of forming a coalition, leaving open how many of these policies might become reality. The Freedom Party is projected to win 35 seats, far short of the 76 needed for a parliamentary majority. After the exit polls, Wilders suggested a center-right coalition that could include Rutte’s former party, the newly formed New Social Contract, and the Farmer Citizens’ Movement. Together these parties would have 86 seats. Before the election, Yesilgoz-Zegerius suggested openness to working with Wilders, but she backtracked on election night. The Farmer Citizens’ Movement expressed interest in coalition talks. Despite his party’s win, Wilders’ ability to become prime minister remains uncertain, as shown by Dutch political history where the party winning most seats did not always secure the premiership.

Mens folk i Nederland—og resten av Europa—forsøker å forstå utfallet, peker flere viktige saker seg ut. Wilders, 60, har vært aktiv i nederlandsk politikk i flere tiår. Han startet sin karriere i tidligere statsminister Mark Rutte sitt liberale parti, men ble senere en uavhengig politiker før han grunnla det innvandringskritiske Frihetspartiet (PVV). Han har mottatt drapstrusler på grunn av sine anti-islamske standpunkter og har levd under politibeskyttelse siden 2004. I 2020 ble Wilders funnet skyldig i å ha fornærmet marokkanske innvandrere, men fikk ingen straff. Han blir sett på som Nederlands svar på populistiske ledere som Donald Trump og Argentinas nye president, Javier Milei. Få betraktet opprinnelig Wilders som en seriøs kandidat i denne valgkampen. Dilan Yesilgoz-Zegerius, Ruttes etterfølger som leder for det liberale partiet, antydet likevel at hun kunne vurdere samarbeid med Frihetspartiet. En annen ledende kandidat, Pieter Omtzigt, mistet støtte etter å ha nølt rundt egne statsministerambisjoner. Wilders på sin side inntok en mer pragmatisk linje, tonet ned noen kontroversielle standpunkter og gjorde det klart at han ønsker regjeringsdeltakelse. Han gjorde det bra i de siste valgdebattene. Blant hans mest kjente forslag finner vi folkeavstemning om EU-medlemskap, at Nederland skal trekke seg fra internasjonale klimaforpliktelser, samt en kraftig reduksjon i innvandringen. Ifølge partiets program har Nederland blitt 'alvorlig svekket på grunn av vedvarende asylpress og masseinnvandring'. Wilders har også lovet å stoppe økonomisk støtte til Ukraina, forby Koranen og stenge moskeer. I sin tale valgkvelden uttrykte han imidlertid vilje til å inngå kompromisser for å etablere en koalisjon, så det er uklart hvor mange av disse forslagene som blir gjennomført. Frihetspartiet er forventet å få 35 seter, langt fra de 76 som kreves for rent flertall. Etter valgdagsmålingen foreslo Wilders en sentrum-høyre-koalisjon som kan inkludere Ruttes tidligere parti, det nyetablerte Ny Sosial Kontrakt og Bondepartiet. Sammen ville de hatt 86 seter. Før valget antydet Yesilgoz-Zegerius at hun var åpen for samarbeid, men trakk seg noe på dette valgkvelden. Bondepartiet har meldt sin interesse for koalisjonssamtaler. Selv om Frihetspartiet vant, er det fortsatt usikkert om Wilders kan bli statsminister, slik nederlandske politiske tradisjoner har vist tidligere.

article_content: Jehovah's Witnesses, long recognized for their door-to-door ministry, are now increasingly taking to the streets across Britain. Instead of visiting homes, many members stand silently on busy city pavements, offering magazines such as The Watchtower and Awake! to those who approach them. This quieter outreach strategy, first adopted in New York and now seen in at least thirteen UK cities, is intended to be less intrusive and allows people to start conversations if they wish, similar to browsing in a shop. Mark O'Malley, spokesperson for the Jehovah's Witnesses' London headquarters, notes the group's history of innovative public engagement, ranging from 'sound cars' in the 1930s to placards and sandwich boards. 'The street method works well in larger cities with high foot traffic,' he explains. 'It gives individuals control over when to interact.' O'Malley adds that door-to-door outreach still happens but is often less effective as many people aren't at home. Some former members, including Scott Terry—author of 'The Truth: How a Gay Child Was Saved from Religion'—claim that members sometimes feel pressure to meet hourly outreach targets to maintain their standing. Those who don't may be admonished or considered inactive. The organization has announced plans to build a new British headquarters near Chelmsford, Essex, with facilities capable of printing up to 184,000 magazines per hour. Founded in the 1870s by Charles Taze Russell, Jehovah's Witnesses now number about 8 million worldwide. Leadership highlights that their distinct beliefs—such as declining military service and blood transfusions—set them apart from mainstream Christianity and occasionally lead to conflict with authorities. A major convention at Twickenham stadium, London, is expected to bring together about 50,000 attendees next month. The group is also focusing on media strategy, analyzing which magazine topics draw the most interest. For example, a recent issue on stress saw unusually high distribution, leading to a follow-up issue on burnout. Jehovah's Witnesses count public figures like the late musician Prince and tennis stars Serena and Venus Williams among their members. Although they face criticism from some former members and are often parodied in popular culture, the movement remains sizable and well resourced.

Mark O'Malley, talsperson for Jehovas vitners hovedkontor i London, understreker bevegelsens historie med innovative måter å nå ut til folk på, fra «lydbiler» på 1930-tallet til plakater og sandwich-tavler. En stor stevne på Twickenham stadion i London ventes å samle rundt 50 000 deltagere neste måned. Gruppen har også fokus på mediestrategi og analyserer hvilke bladtemaer som engasjerer mest. article_content: Athletic Bilbao delivered a strong attacking performance, defeating Schalke 4-2 in the first leg of the Europa League quarterfinals at the Veltins Arena. Fernando Llorente put Bilbao ahead in the 20th minute, scoring after Schalke's goalkeeper Timo Hildebrand mishandled the ball. Schalke equalized just two minutes later when Spain's Raul finished a cross from Japanese defender Atsuto Uchida. Raul then scored Schalke's second goal of the night in the 60th minute with a spectacular 20-yard volley. The open game continued with Llorente heading in his second goal in the 73rd minute. Oscar De Marcos then fired Athletic ahead with nine minutes remaining. In injury time, Markel Susaeta set up Iker Muniain, who finished past substitute goalkeeper Mathias Schober, securing Bilbao's fourth goal. Elsewhere, Atletico Madrid won 2-1 against Hannover at the Estadio Vicente Calderon. Colombian striker Falcao opened the scoring in the ninth minute with a header from Gabi's free-kick. Hannover equalized seven minutes before halftime when Mame Diouf slid in to meet a cross from Lars Stindl. Falcao helped set up the winner, heading the ball down for substitute Eduardo Salvio, who curled his shot past goalkeeper Ron-Robert Zieler. Valencia, Spain's third representative in the quarterfinals, lost 2-1 away to Dutch side AZ Alkmaar. Brett Holman put AZ ahead just before halftime with a side-foot volley from a corner. Valencia responded with an away goal six minutes after the break, as Turkish international Mehmet Topal scored with a header from close range. AZ retook the lead when Maarten Martens finished neatly following a pass from Holman. In another quarterfinal, Sporting Lisbon beat Metalist Kharkiv 2-1, with Marat Izmailov scoring in the 51st minute and Emiliano Insua adding a free kick in the 64th. Metalist Kharkiv pulled one back in injury time as Cleiton Xavier converted a penalty. The second legs of all quarterfinal matches will be played on April 5.

article_content: American whistleblower Edward Snowden has been elected rector of one of the UK's oldest universities, the University of Glasgow. The computer analyst was nominated by a group of students, who stated they had received Snowden's approval through his lawyer. The ballot, which opened to students on Monday, concluded with Snowden's victory announced in Glasgow today. National Security Agency (NSA) whistleblower Edward Snowden, currently in Russia under temporary asylum, was elected rector of Glasgow University. Prominent historical figures such as philosopher Adam Smith (rector from 1787 to 1789) and political theorist Edmund Burke (rector from 1783 to 1785) have previously held the position. Snowden defeated former champion cyclist Graeme Obree, author Alan Bissett, and the Very Rev Kelvin Holdsworth, a supporter of LGBTQ+ rights. Snowden, 30, became internationally known after leaking classified documents exposing widespread US government surveillance. Since then, he has been residing in Russia. In a statement to The Guardian, Snowden said he was 'humbled and honoured' by the vote, calling it a bold and historic decision supporting academic freedom. He emphasized that mass surveillance affects not just privacy but also human liberty and academic independence. The group that nominated Snowden expressed delight at his election, stating, 'We have once again demonstrated our commitment to defending democratic rights through our choice of rector.' They added, 'Our stance against intrusive state monitoring has been recorded. We show our support for Snowden and other whistleblowers, wherever they may be.' The university has a tradition of electing rectors as political statements. Past rectors include former Prime Minister Andrew Bonar Law, TV personality Johnny Ball, statesman Stanley Baldwin, and actors such as Ross Kemp and Richard Wilson. The election was held using the Single Transferable Vote (STV) system. Snowden received 3,124 votes in the first round and 3,347 in the second. The closest runner-up was Kelvin Holdsworth, provost of St Mary's Cathedral in Glasgow, with 1,563 votes. Chris Cassells, a PhD student and member of Snowden's nominating group, said, 'We are thrilled that so many students recognized the importance of this issue.' Cassells added that Snowden's election reflects the university's tradition of appointing rectors as statements of principle, similar to the elections of Vanunu and Mandela. They hope Snowden will deliver his inaugural address via video link. Snowden's nomination stirred debate on campus. Supporters of his candidacy reported that some campaign posters were removed, and some student groups called for an active rector who could physically serve the student body. Over 6,500 students voted, more than double the previous record. Some students were disappointed with the outcome. Student Louise Wilson commented, 'I'm in favor of political statements, but in a time of cuts we need a present and active rector.' Hannah McNeill echoed, 'We need an active rector; perhaps we could have given Snowden an honorary degree instead.' Graeme Obree, runner-up in the election and a former university student, said, 'It was strange returning after 25 years. I didn't realize Snowden was a nominee at first. Clearly, students feel strongly about these issues.' A list of previous rectors includes: Reginald Bosanquet (1980–1984), Michael Kelly (1984–1987), Winnie Madikizela-Mandela (1987–1990), Pat Kane (1990–1993), Johnny Ball (1993–1996), Richard Wilson (1996–1999), Ross Kemp (1999–2000), Greg Hemphill (2001–2004), Mordechai Vanunu (2005–2008), Charles Kennedy (2008–2014), and Edward Snowden (2014–present).

Avstemningen, som åpnet for studentene på mandag, ble avsluttet med Snowdens seier annonsert i Glasgow i dag. Hannah McNeill sa også: 'Vi trenger en aktiv rektor; kanskje vi heller kunne gitt Snowden en æresgrad.' Graeme Obree, andremann i valget og tidligere student ved universitetet, sa: 'Det var rart å komme tilbake etter 25 år. Jeg visste ikke at Snowden var kandidat først. Det er tydelig at studentene har sterke meninger om disse sakene.' article_content: A trio of Reinwardt's Flying Frogs, also known as the black webbed tree frog or green flying frog, were photographed playing in a tree near Sambas, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia. Photographer Hendy Mp, 25, observed the frogs for around two hours, capturing moments where one appeared to smile at the camera while another was seemingly disturbed when a butterfly landed nearby. Hendy said the frogs reminded him of three playful brothers, regularly climbing over each other and shifting positions, with their quick, graceful movements resembling those of dancers. He found their behavior both amusing and endearing. Reinwardt's Flying Frog is native to Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand, and is classified as a near threatened species by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). The frogs can be light or dark green and often have black spots on their backs and heads. In a separate encounter in Palangkaraya, Indonesia, photographer Muhammad Berkati, 30, from Kelua, South Kalimantan, witnessed a butterfly, identified as a blue pansy, sitting atop a green tree frog's head. He described the event as rare and delightful, noting the frog seemed unbothered by the butterfly’s presence as it settled comfortably. Berkati observed the two together for about three minutes. The green tree frog, also called the dumpy frog, is native to northern and eastern Australia and southern New Guinea, can reach up to 10 cm in length, and mainly feeds on insects and spiders, though it may at times eat smaller frogs and mammals. Berkati said that people often find the photos humorous, sometimes commenting that the frog looks like it's wearing a tiny bow. He initially set out to photograph frogs but was pleasantly surprised by the unusual interaction.
translated_content: Et trio av Reinwardts flygepadder, også kjent som svartnettet trepadde eller grønn flygepadde, ble fotografert lekende i et tre nær Sambas, Kalimantan Barat, Indonesia. Fotografen Hendy Mp, 25 år, observerte paddene i omtrent to timer og fanget øyeblikk hvor en av dem så ut til å smile til kameraet, mens en annen virket litt forstyrret da en sommerfugl landet i nærheten. Hendy sa at paddene minnet ham om tre lekne brødre som stadig klatret over hverandre og byttet posisjoner, med raske og grasiøse bevegelser som minnet om dansere. Han syntes atferden deres var både morsom og sjarmerende. Reinwardts flygepadde er hjemmehørende i Indonesia, Malaysia og Thailand, og er klassifisert som nær truet av International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). Padderne kan være lyse eller mørkegrønne og har ofte svarte flekker på rygg og hode. I et annet møte i Palangkaraya, Indonesia, oppdaget fotograf Muhammad Berkati, 30 år, fra Kelua i Sør-Kalimantan, en blå pansy-sommerfugl som satt på hodet til en grønn trepadde. Han beskrev hendelsen som sjelden og gledelig, og påpekte at padden virket uberørt av sommerfuglens tilstedeværelse mens den gjorde seg komfortabel. Berkati observerte de to sammen i omtrent tre minutter. Den grønne trepadden, også kalt dumpy frog, finnes i Nord- og Øst-Australia og sør i Ny-Guinea, kan bli opptil 10 cm lang og lever hovedsakelig av insekter og edderkopper, men kan av og til spise mindre padder og små pattedyr. Berkati sier at folk ofte synes bildene er morsomme, og noen kommenterer at det ser ut som padden har på seg en liten sløyfe. Han dro ut for å fotografere padder, men ble positivt overrasket over den unike hendelsen.

article_content:
During a recent Al Jazeera interview, Spain’s Social Rights Minister Ione Belarra, who leads the Podemos party, strongly condemned Israel's ongoing military campaign in Gaza. She has urged the global community to impose sanctions, alleging that Israel is conducting a deliberate genocide against Palestinians. Belarra criticized the inconsistent response from world leaders, especially the European Union, pointing out how rapidly sanctions were imposed on Russia after the Ukraine invasion versus the muted reaction to Israel’s actions in Gaza.

Belarra advocated for Spain and other countries to cut diplomatic ties with Israel as a form of protest. She referenced the October 7 Hamas attack on Israel, which resulted in more than 1,000 deaths and hundreds of kidnappings, and noted that Israel's ensuing airstrikes in the crowded Gaza Strip have killed over 10,000 people, many of them children.

Spanish citizens have been directly involved, with one, Ivan Illarramendi, killed in the Hamas attack, while Spain continues efforts to evacuate its nationals from Gaza. The government, led by Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, has called for both a release of hostages and a ceasefire, as well as ramped up humanitarian aid to Gaza, pledging to increase support to $43 million.

Belarra contends that Israel’s leaders, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, should be prosecuted at the International Criminal Court for ordering attacks on civilians. She believes that breaking diplomatic relations would clearly signal rejection of these alleged war crimes.

While Spain has permitted large pro-Palestinian demonstrations, neighboring countries such as France, Germany, and the UK have imposed stricter controls on such activism. Although Spain’s official policy is relatively sympathetic to Palestine, experts note Belarra’s stance is more assertive than the government’s. Additionally, Spain maintains diplomatic relations and historical connections with both Jewish and Muslim communities. In a symbolic move, Spain recently honored UN Secretary-General António Guterres despite Israeli objections to his remarks regarding the Gaza war.

article_content: On Friday, U.S. ocean, atmospheric, and space agencies announced that 2014 was the hottest year on record since temperature tracking began in 1880. According to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), global average land and sea temperatures have never been higher in modern times. The data shows that the 16 hottest years on record have all occurred since 1997. This warming trend has been linked to environmental impacts, such as expanding deserts, rising sea levels, severe droughts, more intense storms, extreme heatwaves, and other effects of climate change that are being felt worldwide. In the United States, states like Arizona, Nevada, Alaska, and California reported their hottest years ever. California is currently in its third consecutive year of severe drought, its worst in centuries. The Northeast continues to recover from Hurricane Sandy, which was one of several climate-related disasters that cost the U.S. about $139 billion in damages in 2012. Beyond economic damage, climate change has created a growing humanitarian crisis recognized by global spiritual leaders. Pope Francis is expected to release an encyclical calling attention to climate change as a critical global challenge, encouraging people of all faiths to help protect future generations. President Obama has launched significant efforts to combat climate change by reducing carbon pollution, especially from power plants, which account for around 40% of U.S. carbon emissions. The President’s Clean Power Plan aims to cut power plant carbon emissions by 26% by 2020 and 30% by 2030. The EPA is working closely with state officials, commissions, energy companies, and other stakeholders to develop effective and customized strategies to meet these reduction targets. Many power companies are already investing in energy efficiency, cleaner energy sources like wind and solar, and upgrading older plants. Despite this progress, some coal, gas, and oil companies, together with certain political leaders, are working to hinder the EPA’s authority to reduce carbon emissions. Republican leaders in Congress have pledged to block such efforts, without proposing alternative solutions to address the problem. Ultimately, the article emphasizes that Americans have a choice: continue relying on fossil fuels and risk further climate damage, or invest in clean energy for a safer, more sustainable future.

Artikkelen understreker til slutt at amerikanerne står overfor et valg: Å fortsette å basere energifremtiden på fossile brensler og risikere større klimaskader, eller å investere i rene energiløsninger for en tryggere, mer bærekraftig fremtid.

article_content: Natalie Bogwalker grew up amidst the forests of rural Washington state. Though she initially pursued genetic engineering at college, a car accident at 19 led her to reevaluate her life goals. Yearning for greater purpose and a connection to nature, she left university, traveled widely—including in Spain and Guatemala—and eventually settled in Western North Carolina. Seeking stability after living with a boyfriend and then separating, Bogwalker purchased 16 acres of land with two friends, ensuring both affordability and a supportive community. Her share was $47,000 for seven acres, though the exact figure is unverified. Bogwalker constructed her cabin primarily from pine trees harvested on her property, thinning overcrowded areas for forest health. Recognizing that a single-story cabin was too small, she built a two-story home, supplementing local materials with purchased items such as windows, doors, and plumbing supplies. Much of her furniture came from Habitat for Humanity and online secondhand sources. She organized 'work parties'—communal events where friends, acquaintances, and those in the off-grid community helped with building tasks in exchange for food and camaraderie. This network provided both practical and emotional support throughout the physically demanding process. It took about 18 months from tree cutting to moving into the unfinished cabin, during which Bogwalker lived in a small shed she built nearby. The home was fully completed around 2013. As her family grew, Bogwalker expanded the cabin—building a covered porch and transforming part of it into a parlor that served as a birthing room when her daughter Hazel was born in 2016. By 2019, the porch became Hazel's bedroom, all thanks to the help of work traders, apprentices, and community friends. Bogwalker reflects on the challenges of building as a single woman, noting it required her to turn to her wider community for help and deepened those connections. Inspired by her experiences, she established Wild Abundance, a school with six staff and over 20 rotating instructors. The school teaches sustainable living skills, including woodworking and tiny house construction, and is particularly welcoming to women. Courses employ a sliding-scale fee structure driven by self-reported income to ensure accessibility. Gut empowerment for women in hands-on skills is at the heart of Bogwalker's mission. She advises newcomers to start with small-scale projects and grow over time, emphasizing adaptability and community support in overcoming obstacles.
translated_content: Natalie Bogwalker vokste opp blant skogene i landlige Washington. Selv om hun først studerte genteknologi på universitetet, førte en bilulykke som 19-åring til at hun revurderte livsmålene sine. Lengselen etter mening og nærhet til naturen fikk henne til å forlate universitetet, reise mye—blant annet til Spania og Guatemala—og til slutt slå seg ned i Vest-Nord-Carolina. For å sikre stabilitet etter samboerskap og brudd kjøpte Bogwalker 16 mål land sammen med to venner. Dette ga både rimelighet og et støttende fellesskap. Hennes andel var 47 000 dollar for syv mål, selv om summen ikke er bekreftet. Bogwalker bygde hytta si hovedsakelig av furutrær hun hogde på egen eiendom for å tynne ut tettvokste områder og støtte skogens helse. Da hun innså at en ettetasjes hytte ble for liten, lagde hun et toetasjes hjem, supplert med kjøpte vinduer, dører og rørleggerutstyr. Mye av møblene fant hun via Habitat for Humanity og bruktmarkeder på nett. Hun arrangerte arbeidsdugnader—sosiale samlinger der venner, bekjente og folk fra off-grid-miljøet hjalp til med byggingen mot mat og fellesskap. Dette nettverket ga praktisk og emosjonell støtte gjennom den krevende prosessen. Fra de første trærne ble felt til hun flyttet inn i den uferdige hytta, tok det ca. 18 måneder. I denne tiden bodde Bogwalker i et lite skur hun selv hadde bygget. Hytta stod helt ferdig rundt 2013. Da familien vokste, utvidet Bogwalker hytta—først med en overbygd terrasse, deretter med et rom som ble brukt som føderom da datteren Hazel ble født i 2016. Innen 2019 ble terrassen gjort om til Hazels soverom, alt med hjelp fra arbeidsbyttinger, lærlinger og venner i nærmiljøet. Bogwalker forteller at det å bygge som aleneboende kvinne var krevende, men det tvang henne til å be om hjelp og skapte sterke relasjoner. Med bakgrunn i egne erfaringer startet hun Wild Abundance—en skole med seks ansatte og over 20 ulike instruktører. Skolen tilbyr kurs i bærekraftige ferdigheter, trearbeid og bygging av små hus, med særlig fokus på kvinner. Kursavgiftene bestemmes via selvrapportert inntekt, slik at alle kan delta. Å styrke kvinner i praktiske ferdigheter er kjernen i Bogwalkers arbeid. Hun anbefaler å starte smått og bygge seg opp over tid, og fremhever betydningen av tilpasningsevne og fellesskap for å møte utfordringer.

From solo construction to empowering women with Wild Abundance, her journey proves anything's possible with community spirit! 🌲🛠️ #DIY #WomenEmpowerment #TinyHouse #WildAbundance

article_content: The White House confirmed on Monday that Hamas is still holding nine American hostages. This confirmation came a day after a four-year-old girl, Abigail Edan, became the first American hostage taken during the October 7 attack in Israel to be released. Abigail was reunited with her extended family on Sunday as one of 17 hostages freed that day. Her parents were killed in front of her at their home in Kibbutz Kfar Azza during the Hamas attack. White House National Security Council spokesperson John Kirby stated that President Biden wants the remaining American hostages included in an expected new round of releases over the next few days. This statement came soon after Israel and Hamas agreed to extend a ceasefire by two more days. Initially, Israel agreed to pause its bombardment of Gaza for four days and to release 150 Palestinian prisoners held in the West Bank, in exchange for 50 hostages returning home from Gaza. President Biden spent the holiday weekend leading negotiations regarding the ceasefire from Nantucket Island, Massachusetts, where he stayed at investor David Rubenstein's waterfront house. On Saturday, Biden spoke with Qatar’s Emir Sheik Tamim bin Hamad al-Thani at a crucial moment to help resolve issues concerning the selection of hostages for release, according to Kirby. On Sunday, Biden also spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss terms for extending the ceasefire by two days. The initial pause in fighting allowed the largest single convoy of humanitarian aid to enter Gaza since the October 7 attacks. Kirby reported that 200 trucks were sent to the Rafah border crossing between Gaza and Egypt on Sunday, and 137 trucks of supplies were unloaded by the United Nations within Gaza. In recent weeks, the US government has helped more than 840 American citizens and their families leave Gaza and enter Egypt, Kirby said. According to the Hamas-run health ministry, more than 15,000 people have been killed in Gaza as Israel continues its campaign against Hamas military leaders and tunnel infrastructure. Some Democrats have criticized President Biden for not increasing pressure on Israel to prevent civilian casualties. Kirby suggested on Monday that Biden’s approach has been key to recent fragile progress toward peace. "The president understands there are strong feelings on many sides," Kirby said. "He also believes, right down to his core, that the approach we've been taking has been getting results."

Abigail ble gjenforent med sin utvidede familie på søndag som en av 17 gisler som ble frigitt den dagen. Foreldrene hennes ble drept foran henne i hjemmet deres på Kibbutz Kfar Azza under Hamas-angrepet. Talsmann for Det hvite hus’ nasjonale sikkerhetsråd, John Kirby, uttalte at president Biden ønsker at de gjenværende amerikanske gislene skal inkluderes i en ny runde med løslatelser som forventes de neste dagene. Søndag snakket Biden også med Israels statsminister Benjamin Netanyahu om vilkår for å utvide våpenhvilen med to dager. Kirby opplyste at 200 lastebiler ble sendt til Rafah-grenseovergangen mellom Gaza og Egypt søndag, og 137 lastebiler med forsyninger ble losset av FN inne i Gaza. De siste ukene har amerikanske myndigheter hjulpet over 840 amerikanske borgere og deres familier med å forlate Gaza og komme inn i Egypt, sier Kirby. Kirby antydet mandag at Bidens tilnærming har vært avgjørende for den siste fremgangen mot fred. "Presidenten forstår at det er sterke følelser på mange kanter," sa Kirby. "Han mener også, helt til kjernen, at tilnærmingen vi har brukt har gitt resultater."

article_content: Nigel Farage has praised Vladimir Putin's handling of the Syrian civil war as 'brilliant', despite Russia's support for Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, who has been accused of using chemical weapons against civilians, including children, last year. Farage named Vladimir Putin as a political hero in an interview with GQ magazine, noting he admired Putin as an operator, but not as a human being. He stated: 'The way he played the whole Syria thing. Brilliant. Not that I approve of him politically. How many journalists in jail now?' Farage's remarks renewed debate about the UK Independence Party leader's views on foreign policy. Last week, he claimed the European Union had 'blood on its hands' for provoking Russia over Ukraine, although he said he did not approve of Russia's annexation of Crimea. Farage referred to EU leaders as 'weak and vain,' saying, 'If you poke the Russian bear with a stick he will respond.' Russian state television reported that Farage had 'directly accused the EU of a coup d’état in Ukraine' and suggested that opinion polls showed many British people agree with him. Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg, who is scheduled to debate Farage again on Europe, called Farage's comments 'perverse,' saying, 'It shows quite how extreme people can be when their loathing of the EU becomes so all-consuming that they even end up siding with Vladimir Putin to make their point.' Farage’s praise for Russia’s actions in Syria is controversial due to Moscow’s support for the Assad regime. Russia has also been accused of helping supply chemical weapons used by Assad's forces against civilians. However, Russia later played a significant diplomatic role to prevent Western retaliatory strikes against Syria. Farage's positive comments about Putin were contrasted with his critical description of German Chancellor Angela Merkel, who he described as 'incredibly cold.' He said: 'Whatever you think of Merkel publicly, in private she is even more miserable. I warm to more extrovert people.' When asked to say something nice about the three major UK party leaders, Farage simply described them as 'nice,' calling David Cameron a 'perfectly nice fellow who stands four-square for nothing,' Ed Miliband a 'nice chap, not very worldly,' and Nick Clegg a 'very nice guy, just wrong.' Farage expressed indifference to the outcome of the upcoming election, saying: 'I don’t care... If I was back in the London Metal Exchange I’d not give a toss, because 100 percent of the legislation affecting me is made in Brussels.' In the same interview, he suggested he might like to become a US-style radio 'shock jock' after his political career.

Farage kalte Vladimir Putin en politisk helt i et intervju med magasinet GQ, og bemerket at han beundret Putin som en operatør, men ikke som menneske. Han uttalte: 'Måten han håndterte hele Syria-greia på. Briljant. Ikke at jeg godkjenner ham politisk. Hvor mange journalister sitter nå i fengsel?' Farages kommentarer gjenopplivet debatten om UK Independence Party-lederens syn på utenrikspolitikk. Forrige uke hevdet han at EU hadde 'blod på hendene' for å ha provosert Russland over Ukraina, selv om han sa at han ikke godkjente Russlands annektering av Krim. Farage beskrev EU-ledere som 'svake og forfengelige', og sa: 'Hvis du pirker den russiske bjørnen med en pinne, vil den svare.' Russisk statlig fjernsyn rapporterte at Farage hadde 'direkte anklaget EU for et statskupp i Ukraina' og foreslo at meningsmålinger viste at mange briter er enige med ham. Visestatsminister Nick Clegg, som skal debattere Europa med Farage igjen, kalte Farages kommentarer 'perverse', og sa: 'Det viser hvor ekstreme folk kan bli når deres motvilje mot EU blir så altoppslukende at de til og med ender opp med å støtte Vladimir Putin for å få frem sitt poeng.' Farages ros for Russlands handlinger i Syria er kontroversiell på grunn av Moskvas støtte til Assad-regimet. Russland har også blitt anklaget for å ha hjulpet til med å levere kjemiske våpen som ble brukt av Assads styrker mot sivile. Russland spilte senere en viktig diplomatisk rolle for å forhindre vestlige gjengjeldelsesangrep mot Syria. Farages positive kommentarer om Putin ble satt i kontrast til hans kritiske beskrivelse av Tysklands forbundskansler Angela Merkel, som han beskrev som 'utrolig kald.' Han sa: 'Uansett hva du synes om Merkels offentlige image, er hun enda mer miserabel privat. Jeg liker mer utadvendte folk.' Da han ble bedt om å si noe fint om de tre store britiske partilederne, beskrev Farage dem bare som 'hyggelige', og kalte David Cameron en 'helt grei fyr som står for ingenting,' Ed Miliband en 'hyggelig kar, ikke særlig verdensvant', og Nick Clegg en 'veldig hyggelig fyr, bare feil.' Farage uttrykte likegyldighet til utfallet av det kommende valget, og sa: 'Jeg bryr meg ikke ... Hvis jeg var tilbake på London Metal Exchange, hadde jeg ikke brydd meg, for hundre prosent av lovgivningen som påvirker meg lages i Brussel.' I det samme intervjuet antydet han at han kunne tenke seg å bli en amerikansk radioprogramleder etter sin politiske karriere.

article_content: The Super Eagles, Nigeria’s national football team, arrived in Kigali, Rwanda on Saturday ahead of their 2026 FIFA World Cup qualifying match against Zimbabwe’s Warriors, scheduled for Sunday. According to PUNCH Sports Extra, the squad and officials traveled to East Africa aboard a chartered aircraft that departed Victor Attah International Airport on Friday night, landing in Kigali by dawn. They will then make a two-hour road journey to Butare, the city where Huye Stadium—the match venue—is located. The stadium seats 20,000 spectators and has an artificial turf. Unfazed by concerns about the playing surface, the Super Eagles are focused on securing all three points. Following a 1-1 draw with Lesotho’s Crocodiles in Uyo on Thursday evening, head coach Jose Peseiro stressed the need for a stronger mentality, declaring that only victories in the remaining nine qualification matches will suffice.

Deretter venter en to timers biltur til Butare, byen hvor kamparenaen Huye Stadium ligger. Stadion har plass til 20 000 tilskuere og har kunstgress. Til tross for bekymringer om underlaget, er Super Eagles fullt fokusert på å sikre alle tre poengene. Etter 1–1 mot Lesothos Crocodiles i Uyo torsdag kveld, understreket hovedtrener Jose Peseiro behovet for en sterkere mentalitet, og presiserte at bare seier i de ni gjenværende kvalifiseringskampene er akseptabelt.

article_content: Mayuresh Joshi, Head of Equity Research for India at William O'Neil, stated that Maruti’s margin stability should persist into the second half of the next financial year. He noted that foot traffic and Maruti’s order book remain strong across their product lines, and the transition from internal combustion engines to electric mobility is progressing smoothly. On Airtel, Joshi believes it is currently a clear buy, due to the expectation that average revenue per user (ARPU) will continue to rise, as there is unlikely to be a monopolistic scenario with Jio. This ARPU increase is expected to improve Airtel’s operating performance and cash flows, helping the company manage its debt obligations from spectrum and leverage payouts. He added that Bharti Africa’s business has improved and is expected to steadily perform better in the upcoming quarters, contributing positively to Bharti’s consolidated financial results. Overall, the analyst remains optimistic about Airtel’s prospects within the telecom sector. Within the automotive sector, Maruti stands out on the buy watch list, having reported a solid set of financial results. Growth in Maruti’s SUV portfolio is projected to significantly boost volume, and market share gains are anticipated over the next few quarters. Maruti’s transition towards electric mobility, supported by calibrated capital expenditures and new product launches, is expected to continue smoothly. In the two-wheeler segment, TVS Motors has consistently reported strong results, maintaining margins in the 10.5% to 11% range. The company’s expanding product portfolio, broader distribution network, and growing export component are expected to contribute significantly to results. TVS Motors is considered a hold within two-wheelers. Apple Inc. achieved record revenue in India during the September quarter, with CEO Tim Cook highlighting the country as a key market for growth, even though Apple’s market share remains relatively low. India’s luxury car segment is attracting younger buyers, with Audi, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW all reporting that customers under 40 years old are a significant share of their client base. Sony and Zee Entertainment’s planned merger faces uncertainty, as Zee’s CEO Punit Goenka is under investigation by India’s securities regulator, SEBI, regarding alleged fund diversion.
translated_content: Mayuresh Joshi, leder for aksjeforskning i India hos William O'Neil, sa at Marutis marginstabilitet forventes å fortsette inn i andre halvdel av neste regnskapsår. Han bemerket at kundetilstrømmingen og Marutis ordrebok fortsatt er sterke på tvers av produktsortimentet, og overgangen fra forbrenningsmotorer til elektrisk mobilitet går jevnt. Når det gjelder Airtel, mener Joshi at aksjen er et klart kjøp nå, fordi han forventer at gjennomsnittlig inntekt per bruker (ARPU) vil fortsette å øke, ettersom det ikke vil bli en monopol-situasjon med bare Jio. Den økte ARPU-en forventes å styrke Airtels driftsresultat og kontantstrømmer, noe som gjør det lettere for selskapet å håndtere gjeld knyttet til spektrum og lån. Han la til at Bharti Africas virksomhet har forbedret seg, og man forventer at den vil fortsette å prestere bedre i de neste kvartalene, noe som bidrar positivt til Bhartis samlede finansielle resultater. Analytikeren er generelt optimistisk til Airtels fremtid i telekomsektoren. Innen bilsektoren skiller Maruti seg ut som et investeringsvalg etter å ha levert solide resultater. Vekst innen SUV-segmentet forventes å øke volumer betydelig, og markedsandelen ventes å vokse de kommende kvartalene. Overgangen til elektrisk mobilitet, kombinert med målrettede investeringer og nye produktlanseringer, er ventet å gå smidig. I segmentet for tohjulinger har TVS Motors vist sterke resultater med marginer på 10,5–11 %. Det utvidede produkttilbudet, større distribusjonsnett og økt eksportandel forventes å gi betydelige bidrag. TVS Motors anses som en aksje man kan holde på i tohjuling-sektoren. Apple Inc. leverte rekordomsetning i India for septemberkvartalet. CEO Tim Cook trakk fram landet som et viktig vekstmarked, selv om Apples markedsandel fortsatt er relativt lav. Luksusbilmarkedet i India får stadig yngre kjøpere. Audi, Mercedes-Benz og BMW melder at kunder under 40 år utgjør en betydelig del av salget. Sony og Zee Entertainments planlagte fusjon er fortsatt usikker, ettersom Zees CEO Punit Goenka er under etterforskning av det indiske finanstilsynet SEBI for mulig pengediversjon.

article_content: Fortnite OG, a special season by Epic Games, brought players back to the original map featuring classic locations, items, and weapons—while keeping new movement and graphics updates. The nostalgic move was a major success: after Fortnite OG launched, Fortnite reached a record 44.7 million players in one day, an impressive milestone for a six-year-old game. The OG season began on November 3rd and, despite its high popularity, will end on December 2nd with the 'Big Bang / Eminem' live event. This duration is unusually short, as most Fortnite seasons last between 2.5 and 3 months. Previously, the longest season was 128 days, and the shortest season before OG was 50 days. Fortnite OG will last less than 30 days, leaving players with limited time to finish the Battle Pass and experience the classic content. Epic Games announced that the live event will introduce 'a new beginning for Fortnite.' After the event, the game will enter downtime before launching the next chapter and season. Players have only a few days left to complete their Battle Pass and enjoy OG content, which might not return.

Dette nostalgiske trekket var en stor suksess: Etter lanseringen av Fortnite OG nådde Fortnite rekordhøye 44,7 millioner spillere på én dag, en imponerende milepæl for et seks år gammelt spill. OG-sesongen startet 3. november og, til tross for sin enorme popularitet, avsluttes allerede 2. desember med det direktesendte 'Big Bang / Eminem'-arrangementet. Dette er uvanlig kort, fordi de fleste Fortnite-sesonger varer mellom 2,5 og 3 måneder. Tidligere var den lengste sesongen 128 dager, mens den korteste før OG var 50 dager. Fortnite OG varer under 30 dager, så spillerne har begrenset tid til å fullføre Battle Passet og oppleve det klassiske innholdet. Epic Games har kunngjort at live-arrangementet vil introdusere 'en ny start for Fortnite.' Etter arrangementet vil spillet gå ned for vedlikehold før neste kapittel og sesong lanseres. Spillerne har kun noen få dager igjen til å fullføre Battle Passet og nyte OG-innholdet, som kanskje aldri kommer tilbake.

Authorities in Georgia are seeking the public’s assistance after four male inmates escaped from the Bibb County Detention Center early Monday morning. According to the Bibb County Sheriff’s Office, the escape happened around 3 a.m. when the men broke out through a damaged window in the day room and cut through a fence. Surveillance footage shows a blue Dodge Challenger arriving at the jail to pick up the escapees before quickly leaving the area.

The fugitives have been identified as Joey Fournier, 52, who was being held for murder; Marc Kerry Anderson, 24, held on aggravated assault charges; Dernard Barnwell, 37, who was in custody for unknown reasons under the U.S. Marshals; and Chavis Demaryo Stokes, 29, who faced charges including firearm possession and drug trafficking. The authorities have stated that the investigation remains ongoing.

The Bibb County Detention Center is located about 85 miles southeast of Atlanta. Officials urge anyone who may have information about the whereabouts of the escapees or the blue Dodge Challenger to contact the Bibb County Sheriff’s Office at 478-751-7500 or Macon Regional Crime Stoppers at 1-877-68CRIME.
