article_content: After three weeks of internal conflict, congressional Republicans have agreed on a new Speaker of the House. Now, Congress faces the same amount of time to find a solution to avoid a looming government shutdown. On Wednesday, the House elected GOP Representative Mike Johnson as Speaker, ending weeks of party infighting and following several failed candidates for the role. With the vacancy resolved, the House can resume legislative work, such as passing funding measures before the government runs out of money after November 17. Johnson has outlined his plan for the House’s upcoming year, with funding legislation as a top priority. He proposed passing a short-term funding measure expiring on either January 15 or April 15, depending on what achieves consensus within the conference. He also aims to advance some remaining appropriations bills from the House Appropriations Committee in the next week. "This is an ambitious schedule, but if our Speaker can unify our members and build consensus, we can accomplish our goals," Johnson wrote. Congressional debates about funding are familiar. The House faced a similar situation just last month, reaching a deal mere hours before a shutdown on September 30. Then-Speaker Kevin McCarthy struggled to bring his party together over government funding, as some Republicans demanded steep spending cuts that Democrats opposed. A short-term 45-day funding bill ultimately prevented pay delays for troops and kept agencies like the Federal Aviation Administration and National Flood Insurance Program operating. Now, the House is preparing for another round of debate over government funding. In September, party members clashed over issues such as increased border security spending and whether to include aid for Ukraine. Similar disputes are expected this time. President Joe Biden has requested billions for Israel and Ukraine, as well as separate funding for domestic needs like childcare and disaster response. It is still uncertain whether Johnson can successfully prevent a government shutdown or if he will face challenges similar to McCarthy’s in uniting his party. The stakes are high for Americans. A shutdown would furlough thousands of federal workers, leaving them without pay until funding resumes. While Social Security benefits would still be disbursed, customer service shortages could delay benefit verification, potentially affecting eligibility for loans and housing assistance. Secretary of Agriculture Tom Vilsack has previously stated that SNAP benefits would continue during a shutdown, but low-income mothers and children could lose assistance from the Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) program. “We need to move swiftly to address our national security needs and avoid a shutdown in 22 days,” President Biden said Wednesday. “Even though we have real disagreements about important issues, there should be a mutual effort to find common ground wherever we can.”
translated_content: Etter tre uker med indre konflikt har republikanske kongressmedlemmer blitt enige om en ny speaker i Representantenes hus. Nå har Kongressen like mye tid igjen til å finne en løsning for å unngå en forestående regjeringsnedstengning. Onsdag valgte Huset den republikanske representanten Mike Johnson til Speaker, og avsluttet uker med partikamper etter flere mislykkede kandidater til rollen. Med dette er stillingen besatt, og Huset kan igjen begynne sitt lovgivende arbeid, som å vedta budsjettforslag før staten går tom for penger etter 17. november. Johnson har presentert sin plan for Husets kommende år, med finansieringslovgivning som høyeste prioritet. Han har foreslått å vedta en midlertidig budsjettavtale som utløper enten 15. januar eller 15. april, avhengig av hva det er mulig å oppnå enighet om i partigruppen. Han ønsker også å føre noen av de gjenværende budsjettforslagene ut av House Appropriations Committee i løpet av neste uke. "Dette er en ambisiøs tidsplan, men hvis vår Speaker kan samle våre medlemmer og bygge enighet, kan vi nå våre mål," skrev Johnson. Diskusjoner om statsbudsjett er ikke ukjent på Kongressen. Huset sto overfor en lignende situasjon så sent som forrige måned, der de kom til enighet bare timer før en nedstengning 30. september. Da slet daværende Speaker Kevin McCarthy med å samle sitt parti rundt en løsning på statsbudsjettet, ettersom noen republikanere krevde kraftige kutt som demokratene ikke ville støtte. En midlertidig 45-dagers budsjettavtale forhindret i siste liten forsinkelser i lønnsutbetalinger til soldater og holdt etater som Luftfartsverket og det nasjonale flomforsikringsprogrammet i drift. Nå gjør Huset seg klar for en ny runde med debatt om statsbudsjettet. I september var det splittelse om saker som økt grensekontroll og hvorvidt støtte til Ukraina skulle inngå. Tilsvarende uenigheter ventes nå. President Joe Biden har bedt om milliarder til Israel og Ukraina, samt separate bevilgninger til nasjonale formål som barnepass og katastrofeberedskap. Det er fortsatt usikkert om Johnson klarer å forhindre en regjeringsstans, eller om han møter lignende utfordringer som McCarthy med å samle partiet. Mye står på spill for amerikanerne. En nedstengning vil tvinge tusenvis av offentlige ansatte i permisjon uten lønn til budsjettet er på plass igjen. Selv om trygdeytelser fortsatt vil bli utbetalt, kan mindre kundeservice føre til at det tar lenger tid å bekrefte trygdegrunnlag, noe som kan hindre folk i å søke lån og boligstøtte. Landbruksminister Tom Vilsack har tidligere uttalt at SNAP-ytelser vil bli utbetalt ved en nedstengning, men lavinntektsmødre og barn kan miste støtte fra bidragsordningen 'Women, Infants, and Children' (WIC). «Vi må handle raskt for å ivareta våre nasjonale sikkerhetsbehov og unngå en nedstengning om 22 dager», sa president Biden onsdag. «Selv om vi har reelle uenigheter om viktige saker, må vi prøve å komme til enighet der vi kan.»

article_content: Across Africa, street art is woven into daily life, turning public spaces into canvases for self-expression, activism, and cultural pride. From striking shopfront designs to thought-provoking political murals, these artworks give communities a powerful voice. Celebrating this artistic energy, CNN iReport collected submissions from across the continent, showcasing the many roles of street art—whether to inspire, provoke thought, or simply add beauty to city streets. Once an underground New York phenomenon, graffiti and mural art now brighten cities throughout Africa. In Mozambique’s capital, Maputo, rapper and artist Shot B turns walls into sketchbooks, using public art to share messages and build connections within his community. For him, graffiti merges his hip-hop roots with artistic passion. Discussions about graffiti’s place in society continue globally, especially following the rise of well-known figures like Banksy. Likewise, Capetonian artist FALKO1, active since 1988, uses graffiti to transform buildings, drawing from a strong hip-hop influence. He identifies primarily as a graffiti writer. While street art often overlaps with music and youth culture, it also facilitates civic engagement. In Morocco, political parties are assigned wall spaces to paint their symbols, helping even non-literate voters participate. This accessible, eco-friendly practice supports informed decision-making. In the Gambia’s Kubuneh village, the Wide Open Walls initiative invites artists to embellish communal spaces, boosting tourism and celebrating Gambian traditions. Brazilian iReporter Rimon Guimaraes, inspired by artist Noha’s mural, highlighted Africa’s global impact on the arts. Lagos, Nigeria, features a prominent mural by local artist Kimson at Orange Academy, a creative college. The piece, which honors prominent Nigerians including activist Fela Kuti, was commissioned to inspire students to pursue their dreams. These creative efforts reveal the vital and transformative role street artists play in storytelling and community uplift across Africa.
translated_content: Over hele Afrika har gatekunst blitt en del av hverdagen, der offentlige rom forvandles til lerreter for selvutfoldelse, aktivisme og kulturstolthet. Fra iøynefallende butikkfasader til tankevekkende politiske veggmalerier gir disse kunstverkene lokalsamfunnene en sterk stemme. For å feire denne kreative energien samlet CNN iReport inn bidrag fra hele kontinentet og viste frem de mange rollene gatekunst har—enten for å inspirere, få folk til å tenke, eller bare forskjønne bybildet. Det som en gang var et undergrunnsfenomen i New York, lyser nå opp byer over hele Afrika med graffiti og veggmalerier. I Maputo, hovedstaden i Mosambik, forvandler rapper og kunstner Shot B vegger til skissebøker, og bruker gatekunst for å dele budskap og styrke fellesskapet. For ham er graffiti en fusjon mellom hiphop-røtter og kunstnerisk lidenskap. Diskusjoner om graffitiens plass i samfunnet foregår fortsatt verden over, spesielt etter fremveksten av kjente navn som Banksy. På samme måte bruker FALKO1 fra Cape Town, som har vært aktiv siden 1988, graffiti til å forvandle bygninger med inspirasjon fra hiphop-kulturen. Han ser på seg selv først og fremst som en graffitiforfatter. Selv om gatekunst ofte er knyttet til musikk og ungdomskultur, bidrar den også til samfunnsdeltakelse. I Marokko får politiske partier tildelt veggplass for å male symbolene sine, noe som hjelper også de som ikke kan lese med å delta i valget. Denne tilgjengelige og miljøvennlige praksisen legger til rette for informerte valg. I landsbyen Kubuneh i Gambia inviterer Wide Open Walls-prosjektet kunstnere til å utsmykke fellesarealer, noe som både gir økt turisme og feirer gambiske tradisjoner. Den brasilianske iReporteren Rimon Guimaraes, inspirert av kunstneren Noahs veggmaleri, trakk frem Afrikas globale betydning for kunstverdenen. I Lagos, Nigeria, har den lokale kunstneren Kimson laget et iøynefallende veggmaleri på Orange Academy, en kreativ høyskole. Kunstverket, som hedrer kjente nigerianere som aktivisten Fela Kuti, ble bestilt for å inspirere studentene til å følge drømmene sine. Disse kreative tiltakene viser hvordan gatekunstnere spiller en avgjørende og forvandlende rolle innen historiefortelling og fellesskap i hele Afrika.

article_content: Kei Nishikori and Marin Cilic are preparing to clash in the US Open final at Arthur Ashe Stadium, with a Grand Slam title on the line for both. This contest is particularly notable because, for the first time since 1998, four different men and four different women have won the major tournaments in a single year. The 2014 tennis calendar has been full of surprises. Stan Wawrinka and Li Na opened the year by winning the Australian Open. Serena Williams captured the US Open women’s title, joining Maria Sharapova (French Open) and Petra Kvitova (Wimbledon) in a group of varied women's champions. In the men’s game, Wawrinka, Rafael Nadal, and Novak Djokovic secured the season's first three Grand Slam titles, while the US Open champion will be either Nishikori or Cilic. Nishikori, ranked eighth, caused an upset by defeating world number one Novak Djokovic in the semifinals. Cilic, meanwhile, delivered an impressive performance to beat five-time champion Roger Federer. Nishikori has already made history as the first Japanese player to reach a Grand Slam singles final, and a victory would make him the first male Asian Grand Slam winner. This US Open final is also the first major since the 2005 Australian Open that does not feature Federer, Nadal, or Djokovic. Before the match, Cilic acknowledged that Wawrinka’s breakthrough victory has boosted confidence among other players. Cilic’s coach, Goran Ivanisevic, pointed out that while both players might feel pressure as first-time finalists, the winner will achieve something extraordinary. Recap of 2014 Grand Slam results: - Australian Open: Stan Wawrinka (men), Li Na (women) - French Open: Rafael Nadal (men), Maria Sharapova (women) - Wimbledon: Novak Djokovic (men), Petra Kvitova (women) - US Open: Kei Nishikori or Marin Cilic (men), Serena Williams (women).
translated_content: Kei Nishikori og Marin Cilic gjør seg klare til å møtes i finalen i US Open på Arthur Ashe Stadium, der begge kjemper om sin første Grand Slam-tittel. article_content: In 2020, the Pantanal—the world's largest tropical freshwater wetland and a key biodiversity hotspot—was ravaged by severe fires that swept through 44,998 square kilometers, about 30% of the Brazilian section of the biome that spans approximately 150,000 km². This estimate, published in the journal Fire, is significantly greater than previous estimates ranging from 14,307 to 36,017 km². Scientists from Brazil's National Space Research Institute (INPE) led a study using images from the European Space Agency's SENTINEL-2 satellite, developing a model that measured burned areas with a high precision of 96% accuracy, exceeding previous satellite-based assessments for the region. The study's refined estimates are vital for more accurately calculating trace gas and aerosol emissions from biomass burning. The authors point out that most global inventories have regional biases, and their new method addresses this, especially important as climate phenomena like El Niño increase fire risk in the Pantanal. Forest engineer Andeise Cerqueira Dutra, an INPE Ph.D. candidate and study author, noted that while no single approach is universally superior, SENTINEL-2 offers two notable advantages: 20-meter spatial resolution for detail and a five-day revisit time for tracking fires, compared to up to 16 days for Landsat. Other key researchers included Yosio Edemir Shimabukuro and Guilherme Augusto Verola Mataveli from INPE. Mataveli underscored the importance of improved analysis for both accurately assessing burned regions and estimating fire-related greenhouse gas emissions, which have direct climate impacts. He stressed that with extreme droughts becoming more common, it is increasingly important to understand their effect on the Pantanal and inform fire management and mitigation decisions. Dutra mentioned that new remote sensing pilot projects are helping agencies and firefighters prioritize responses and manage fires more efficiently in the Pantanal. The Pantanal's rainy season typically lasts from October to May, guided by the South American Monsoon System; fires tend to peak in September during the dry season. However, 2019 brought early, persistent drought that intensified into 2020. Rainfall that year was 26% below the 1982–2020 average, making it the driest period in decades. As a result, the surface water area shrank by 34%, the burned region was 200% larger than usual, and 35% burned for the first time ever recorded. Restoration costs are estimated at $123 million. Scientists estimate the 2020 fires killed around 16 million small animals (under 2 kg) and 944,000 larger animals. Jaguars (Panthera onca) suffered heavily, losing 45% of their local population—450 individuals, with 87% in Brazil. Fires burned 79% of the jaguars' habitat and 54% of protected areas, seriously threatening this population, which had been among the world's largest. Human health also deteriorated. A Fiocruz study linked the fires to increased hospitalizations for respiratory problems in Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul. Researchers compared SENTINEL-2 data to other satellite sources like MODIS and Landsat, finding that while general burn patterns were similar, SENTINEL-2 detected more small fires, especially in the eastern Pantanal. The validated model and dataset have been made publicly available for future research and management use. With drought and fire events becoming more frequent, further collaboration and increased field data are expected to advance remote sensing-based fire monitoring. From January 1 to August 23, 2023, INPE recorded 381 fires in the Pantanal, compared to 8,127 during the same period in 2020—the highest number since 1998. Intensifying wildfires reflect a global trend linked to heat waves, causing widespread losses and destruction in affected communities.

Dette anslaget, publisert i tidsskriftet Fire, er betydelig høyere enn tidligere estimater, som var mellom 14 307 og 36 017 km². Forskere fra Brasils nasjonale institutt for romforskning (INPE) ledet en studie basert på bilder fra den europeiske romorganisasjonens satellitt SENTINEL-2. De utviklet en modell som målte brent areal med høy presisjon – hele 96 % nøyaktighet – og overgikk tidligere satellittbaserte vurderinger for regionen. Studiets mer nøyaktige estimater er avgjørende for å regne ut utslipp av sporgasser og aerosoler fra biomasseforbrenning. Forfatterne påpeker at globale beregninger ofte har regionale skjevheter, og den nye metoden bidrar til å rette opp dette, spesielt ettersom klimafenomener som El Niño øker brannrisikoen i Pantanal. Skogingeniør Andeise Cerqueira Dutra, stipendiat ved INPE og studiens medforfatter, nevnte at ingen enkelt metode er best, men SENTINEL-2 gir to viktige fordeler: 20 meters romlig oppløsning for detaljer og fem dagers revisittid sammenlignet med opptil 16 dager for Landsat. Andre sentrale forskere er Yosio Edemir Shimabukuro og Guilherme Augusto Verola Mataveli ved INPE. Mataveli understreket at forbedrede analyser er viktige både for å få nøyaktige tall på brannskader og for å estimere klimagassutslipp, noe som er direkte koblet til klimaendringer. Han påpekte at ekstrem tørke trolig blir vanligere, noe som gjør det enda viktigere å kjenne effektene på Pantanal og grunnlag for bedre beslutninger om brannhåndtering. Dutra trakk frem at nye fjernmålingsprosjekter hjelper miljømyndigheter og brannvesen å prioritere innsatsområder og styre brannhåndteringen mer effektivt i Pantanal. Pantanal har vanligvis regntid fra oktober til mai, styrt av det søramerikanske monsunssystemet, med branntopp i september under tørketiden. Men fra 2019 kom det tidlig og langvarig tørke, som forverret seg i 2020. Regnet det året var 26 % under snittet fra 1982–2020, noe som gjorde det til det tørreste på flere tiår. Som resultat krympet vannarealet med 34 %, det brente området var 200 % større enn normalt, og 35 % brant for aller første gang. Kostnadene for restaurering er anslått til 123 millioner dollar. Forskere anslår at brannene i 2020 drepte rundt 16 millioner smådyr (under 2 kg) og 944 000 større dyr. Jaguarer (Panthera onca) ble spesielt hardt rammet: Bestanden ble redusert med 45 % – omtrent 450 individer, 87 % av dem i Brasil. Brannene ødela 79 % av jaguarens leveområder og 54 % av verneområder, og satt en av verdens største jaguarpopulasjoner i fare. Folkehelsen ble også forverret. En studie fra Fiocruz knyttet økte sykehusinnleggelser for luftveisplager i Mato Grosso og Mato Grosso do Sul til brannene. Forskerne sammenlignet SENTINEL-2-data med andre satellitter som MODIS og Landsat, og fant at hovedmønstrene var like, men SENTINEL-2 oppdaget flere mindre branner – særlig i østre Pantanal. Den validerte modellen og datagrunnlaget er fritt tilgjengelig for videre forskning og forvaltning. Med mer hyppig tørke og branner ventes også mer samarbeid og bedre feltdata, slik at man kan styrke brannovervåkingen ved bruk av fjernmåling. Fra 1. januar til 23. august 2023 registrerte INPE 381 branner i Pantanal, sammenlignet med 8 127 i samme periode i 2020 – det høyeste antall siden 1998. Økende intensitet og hyppighet av branner gjenspeiler en global trend knyttet til hetebølger, med store tap og ødeleggelser i berørte samfunn.

Three Nobel Peace Prize laureates have criticized the decision to award this year’s prize to the European Union (EU). In an open letter, Archbishop Desmond Tutu, Northern Ireland’s Mairead Maguire, and Argentina’s Adolfo Perez Esquivel argue that the EU is 'clearly not one of the “champions of peace” Alfred Nobel had in mind' when the prize was established in 1895. The signatories insist that the 27-member bloc’s values do not align with those of the Peace Prize, suggesting that the £750,000 prize money should be withheld.

The letter, which calls on the Nobel committee to respect the original intentions of Nobel, accuses the EU of supporting 'security based on military force and waging wars rather than insisting on the need for an alternative approach.' They argue that the EU has failed to 'realize Nobel’s demilitarized global peace order.' The letter further asserts that the Norwegian Nobel Committee has 'redefined and remodeled the prize in a manner that is not consistent with the law.'

In addition to Archbishop Tutu (noted for his anti-apartheid activism and recipient of the 1984 Peace Prize), Mrs. Maguire (awarded in 1976 for her role in Northern Ireland’s peace movement), and Mr. Esquivel (1980 laureate for his human rights work in Argentina), the open letter was signed by the Geneva-based International Peace Bureau (winner in 1910) as well as various authors, lawyers, and peace activists.

The committee had announced the 2012 Peace Prize in October, commending the EU for transforming Europe 'from a continent of war to a continent of peace' since World War II. The decision was controversial, especially amid Europe’s ongoing economic crisis. While acknowledging Europe’s current financial and social difficulties, Nobel Committee president Thorbjoern Jagland said the prize recognized six decades of advancing 'peace and reconciliation, democracy, and human rights.'

EU President Herman Van Rompuy called on all member states, along with soon-to-join Croatia, to send representatives to the award ceremony. German Chancellor Angela Merkel and French President Francois Hollande confirmed they would attend, while British Prime Minister David Cameron was among leaders declining the invitation. According to the Nobel Institute, eighteen European leaders accepted invitations, while six declined.

The Nobel Peace Prize has often been a source of debate. US President Barack Obama received the award in 2009, though the US was involved in two wars at the time. Alfred Nobel, the prize's founder, provided few specifics but envisioned honoring efforts to promote fraternity between nations, the abolition or reduction of standing armies, and the advancement of peace congresses. Critic Fredrik Heffermehl, who also signed the letter, has previously accused the Norwegian jury of persistently broadening the prize’s scope. His criticism prompted a formal inquiry, which was later dropped.

article_content: Lance Armstrong has declared that it is impossible to win the Tour de France without doping. Armstrong, who won the race seven consecutive times between 1999 and 2005, was later disqualified for life after admitting to using performance-enhancing drugs. He told Le Monde that the Tour is an endurance event where oxygen is critical, and that substances like EPO make a significant difference for endurance athletes. Armstrong made these comments in response to news that 1998 Tour winner Laurent Jalabert tested positive for EPO, although Jalabert has denied these allegations. Armstrong said he respects Jalabert but believes he is not telling the truth about doping. Speaking before the start of this year's race, Armstrong added that doping has always existed in cycling, saying, 'I didn't invent doping; I just participated in a system.' Armstrong was banned from professional cycling in October 2012 when the US Anti-Doping Agency accused him of leading a sophisticated and successful doping program. He initially denied all allegations but eventually admitted to doping during an interview with Oprah Winfrey. His remarks about doping in the Tour de France have been criticized, particularly by British cyclist Sir Bradley Wiggins, who in 2012 became the first Englishman to win the race and has always maintained a clean record. After the scandal, Armstrong resigned from the Livestrong Foundation, his cancer charity. Nike ended its partnership with Livestrong and stopped producing the foundation’s branded products but said it would honor its contract until it expired in 2014. Armstrong has stated that his family, including his ex-wife Kristin and current partner Anna Hansen, supported him during his public admission. He described the doping within his team as cautious and risk-averse, not as elaborate as some reports have suggested. Armstrong has expressed regret for not trying to stop the doping culture in cycling and acknowledged the consequences for the sport, describing his story as once ‘mythic’ and ‘perfect’ but ultimately untrue.

article_content: Consumer trust in businesses is at a record low, with only 27% of consumers expressing high trust in the companies they purchase from. article_content: Japan has ordered its missile defense forces to intercept any North Korean rocket entering Japanese airspace during a planned launch next month. North Korea intends to launch the Unha-3 rocket from its western coast between April 12 and 16, with its trajectory expected to fly near western Japan. This has led to concerns about public safety and property. Satellite images highlighting the launch pad in Tongchang-ri have prompted Japan to implement defensive measures. After a national security council meeting, Defense Minister Naoki Tanaka stated that Japan would respond as needed. Chief Cabinet Secretary Osamu Fujimura called for calm, emphasizing that military preparations are precautionary. The Defense Ministry has confirmed that destroyers with Aegis missile defense systems will be deployed to the Pacific Ocean and East China Sea, alongside mobile Patriot missile launchers in the Okinawa islands. Although Tokyo is not within the projected flight path, it may also host an interceptor missile unit for added precaution. North Korea asserts the launch is to place a satellite in orbit. BMW has unveiled its latest armored vehicle, the X5 Security Plus, claiming it can withstand gunfire from an AK-47. The German automaker introduced the model at this week's Moscow Motorshow. BMW describes the X5 Security Plus as the first armored SUV specifically designed to provide VR6-level ballistic protection against the world’s most widely used assault rifle, while offering everyday flexibility and comfort.

The X5 Security Plus features reinforced steel and shatterproof glass. It is rigorously tested to withstand attacks from blunt objects, handguns, and rifles. The vehicle comes equipped with an eight-cylinder, turbocharged engine producing 450 horsepower, giving drivers the power to escape dangerous situations if needed. Additional optional safety features include run-flat tires, a self-sealing fuel tank, an attack alarm, and an intercom system.

Despite its advanced protection, BMW says the X5 Security Plus drives like any other BMW SUV. While a standard X5 starts at £43,000, the armored version is expected to cost around £110,000. This new model joins BMW’s previous security vehicle, the 7 Series High Security, aimed at high-ranking officials and corporate executives.

Armored vehicles are in increasing demand across the U.S. and are also sought after by Eastern European oligarchs in Britain. Luxury car makers such as Jaguar Land Rover, Bentley, and Mercedes-Benz offer in-house divisions specializing in armored cars. Famous figures such as former Prime Minister Tony Blair, who used an armored BMW 7 Series, and David Cameron, with an armored Jaguar XJ, utilize such vehicles, while U.S. President Barack Obama travels in a custom, heavily-armored Cadillac limousine known as 'The Beast.'

article_content: Starting and growing a small business involves both excitement and challenges. With the right strategies, you can greatly increase your chances of success. Here are five essential strategies for small business entrepreneurs, drawn from personal experience and the insights of other successful business owners. 1. Reinvest every dollar back into your business. Early profits can be tempting to spend on luxuries, but investing them back into your business is vital for growth and sustainability. Many entrepreneurs, including myself, look back on early unnecessary expenditures with regret. The lesson: reinvest to help your business thrive. 2. Minimize overhead costs. In your initial years, keep costs low by avoiding large office spaces and full-time hires where possible. Work from home and outsource services as needed. I ran my business from home for three years and used virtual assistants for administrative tasks. Lower overhead allows more investment in core activities and flexibility in uncertain markets. 3. Focus on direct marketing rather than costly branding. Building a brand is important, but expensive campaigns like TV or billboards rarely offer quick results at the start. Emphasize direct marketing—door-to-door sales, targeted mail, email and social media. This approach generated significant early revenue for our company before we expanded into larger branding efforts. 4. Implement a pay-for-performance model. Pay employees based on their results, combining a base salary with commissions or bonuses for meeting goals. Bonuses can be given for selling key products or finding new leads. This method aligns employees' efforts with business growth and helps you manage costs. 5. Prioritize customer satisfaction and feedback. Happy customers are crucial to sustained success. Gather feedback via surveys, follow-up calls, and online reviews. Our aim is at least one referral for every three new customers—demonstrating the importance of excellent service and word-of-mouth growth. To sum up, using these five strategies—reinvesting in your business, minimizing overhead, emphasizing direct marketing, implementing pay-for-performance, and prioritizing customer feedback—positions your business for lasting growth and success. The decisions you make now will shape your business's future.

article_content: Amber Portwood, known for her role on MTV's 'Teen Mom,' has been ordered to serve at least two years in an Indiana prison following a violation of her drug court probation, authorities announced Tuesday. The sentencing comes after she dropped out of a court-mandated drug rehabilitation program that was part of a plea deal she had accepted earlier this year for a felony drug charge. Portwood, 22, was arrested on May 24 after failing a required urine test and providing misleading information about it, according to Madison County Prosecuting Attorney Rodney Cummings. Generally, probationers are given multiple chances before probation is revoked, but Portwood chose to opt out of the rehab program, which led to her prison sentence. Circuit Judge David Happe ruled that Portwood must serve the time initially imposed as part of her plea agreement. She is expected to spend about two-and-a-half years in prison, followed by parole for the remainder of her five-year sentence. Inmates in Indiana can reduce their sentences by a day for each day of good behavior, and possibly receive an additional 30-day reduction if they complete a drug rehabilitation program in prison, though placement in such a program is determined only after entering the state corrections system. It will likely take two weeks for Judge Happe’s commitment order to be finalized and for Portwood to be transferred from Madison County jail to state prison, Cummings added. Portwood’s legal troubles began in November 2010, when she was arrested on felony domestic violence charges after incidents depicted on 'Teen Mom,' including physical altercations with her former boyfriend and the father of her daughter, Gary Shirley. In December, she was rearrested when a probation search discovered multiple unprescribed prescription pills, according to authorities. After spending over a month in jail, she accepted a plea deal tied to the drug charge and the rehab program. Her three-year-old daughter is currently in Shirley’s custody. Jane Caffrey of CNN contributed to this report.

article_content: Malnutrition remains a significant global challenge, with over two billion people—more than 25% of the world's population—suffering from deficiencies in essential micronutrients such as calcium and potassium. This issue is particularly severe among those relying on crop-based diets with limited access to nutrient-rich food, a condition often termed 'hidden hunger.' While staples like rice, soy, and wheat are critical for nutrition, ensuring these crops are as nourishing as possible is increasingly important amid food security challenges caused by population growth and climate change. Traditional methods for measuring nutrient concentrations in crops require collecting samples at harvest and analyzing them in laboratories, which can be prohibitively expensive and time-consuming on a large scale. Moreover, since these measurements are taken post-harvest, there’s little opportunity for farmers to intervene during the growing season. To address this, researchers from the University of Twente in the Netherlands and the National Research Council of Italy explored the use of satellite data—including the Copernicus Sentinel-2 and Italian Prisma missions—to monitor nutrient content in crops across large areas. Such early monitoring could help farmers apply fertilizers or adjust practices in time to improve crop quality. Their study, conducted in Italy’s Po Valley, focused on corn, rice, soybean, and wheat, comparing satellite-based nutrient signals with laboratory results for elements like phosphorus, magnesium, zinc, and potassium. This research was part of the ESA-supported 'HyNutri Sensing Hidden Hunger with Sentinel-2 and Hyperspectral' project. Results published in the journal Remote Sensing of Environment suggest that some nutrient levels, such as potassium, phosphorus, magnesium, and iron, can be estimated from satellite data with encouraging accuracy. However, detecting other nutrients remains challenging and requires further investigation. A follow-up project called EO4Nutri is underway to advance this work. Espen Volden from ESA expressed hope that such advancements could allow farmers to improve grain nutrient content earlier in the season and assist governments or organizations in addressing malnutrition, particularly in regions like Africa, where deficiencies are common. Looking forward, ESA is developing the CHIME satellite for the Copernicus program, which will carry advanced hyperspectral instruments capable of assessing crop nutrient status and potentially aiding efforts to combat hidden hunger.

Dette problemet er spesielt alvorlig for de som er avhengige av plantebasert kosthold og har begrenset tilgang til næringsrik mat, en tilstand ofte kalt 'skjult sult'. Selv om basisvarer som ris, soya og hvete er avgjørende for ernæringen, blir det stadig viktigere å sikre at disse avlingene er så næringsrike som mulig, gitt utfordringer med matsikkerhet forårsaket av befolkningsvekst og klimaendringer. Tradisjonelle metoder for å måle næringskonsentrasjon i avlinger krever innsamling av prøver ved innhøsting og analyse på laboratorier, noe som kan være kostbart og tidkrevende i stor skala. I tillegg blir målingene gjort etter innhøsting, slik at bøndene har liten mulighet til å gripe inn mens avlingen vokser. For å løse dette har forskere fra Universitetet i Twente i Nederland og Italias nasjonale forskningsråd undersøkt bruk av satellittdata—inkludert Copernicus Sentinel-2 og den italienske Prisma-misjonen—for å overvåke næringsinnholdet i avlinger over store områder. Slik tidlig overvåking kan hjelpe bønder å gjødsle eller justere praksis i tide for å forbedre kvaliteten på avlingene. Studien, utført i Italias Po-dal, fokuserte på mais, ris, soyabønner og hvete og sammenlignet satellittbaserte næringssignaler med laboratorieresultater for elementer som fosfor, magnesium, sink og kalium. Denne forskningen var en del av det ESA-støttede prosjektet 'HyNutri Sensing Hidden Hunger with Sentinel-2 and Hyperspectral'. Resultatene, publisert i tidsskriftet Remote Sensing of Environment, indikerer at nivåer av næringsstoffer som kalium, fosfor, magnesium og jern kan estimeres fra satellittdata med oppmuntrende presisjon. Fremover utvikler ESA CHIME-satellitten for Copernicus-programmet, som vil ha avanserte hyperspektrale instrumenter som kan vurdere næringsstatusen i avlinger og potensielt bidra til å bekjempe skjult sult.

article_content: Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger has strongly criticized UEFA after being charged with improper conduct following Arsenal's Champions League defeat to Barcelona. Wenger clashed with referee Massimo Busacca after the English side lost 3-1 to the Spanish champions in the away leg of their last-16 tie. Wenger reacted angrily when striker Robin van Persie received a second yellow card and was controversially sent off in the 56th minute for shooting on goal after being flagged offside, at a time when the score was still 1-1. Wenger told reporters at a Thursday press conference, 'I completely deny any charge. I do not understand where this comes from. They (UEFA) do not punish me. It is Arsenal Football Club that has been punished.' Wenger continued, 'We are out of the Champions League and have lost one of our big ambitions, and on top of that we have to say sorry when we have done nothing wrong. It would be good for UEFA to show some humility, to apologize for what has happened, not charge people who have done nothing wrong.' France midfielder Samir Nasri was also charged with improper conduct after approaching Busacca in the tunnel at the end of the game. Van Persie insisted he did not hear the offside whistle because of the noise from the 95,000-strong crowd at the Nou Camp. Wenger was outspoken in his criticism of Busacca following the incident, accusing the Swiss official of 'killing the game.' Arsenal had won the home leg 2-1 in London and would have advanced to the quarterfinals if the score in Barcelona had stayed 1-1. 'It is a shame that the referee decided to send Robin van Persie off. It was the wrong decision,' Wenger said. 'This decision frustrated us and everyone who loves football. The first leg was a great advert for football, but the second match was destroyed. People will now only remember the sending-off.' This is the second consecutive game in which Wenger has criticized officiating, having previously expressed frustration with referees during Arsenal's 0-0 home draw with Sunderland. The Champions League exit came just nine days after Arsenal's loss to Birmingham in the English League Cup final. Adding to the team's troubles, Wenger confirmed that captain Cesc Fabregas has been ruled out of Saturday's FA Cup quarterfinal against Manchester United due to a recurring hamstring injury. 'He will be out for the next game, maybe the next two,' said Wenger. Goalkeeper Wojciech Szczesny will also miss the match against Manchester United after suffering a dislocated finger and tendon problem just 18 minutes into the Barcelona game. A scan has been done and the club is awaiting further specialist assessment. With Manuel Almunia as the only available goalkeeper — Lukasz Fabianski is also out injured — Wenger may need to seek an emergency loan signing.

article_content: Six years ago, hip-hop icon Wyclef Jean released the soulful track 'President,' imagining what it would be like to lead a nation. Now, that dream may become reality as the Haitian-American recording artist is expected to announce exclusively on CNN's 'Larry King Live' that he intends to run for president of Haiti. Jean, an outspoken advocate for his homeland through his Yele Foundation, told CNN on Tuesday he plans to make this important announcement on King's show Thursday night. Born in Haiti, Jean rose to fame in the mid-1990s as a member of The Fugees, a U.S.-based hip-hop and reggae group. He now performs as a solo artist. Jean was one of the first celebrities to provide aid after the devastating earthquake struck Haiti in January. He told CNN late last month that he has completed the necessary paperwork to run for the country's highest office. In February, Jean stated he has consistently addressed Haitian issues through his music. 'I've always promoted Haiti in my music, since my first album with the Fugees, where we spoke about Haitians' struggles and human rights for people worldwide,' Jean said. 'We entered the industry talking about topics that weren't popular in mainstream music.' Jean said he was born in a small village near Port-au-Prince and moved to Brooklyn, New York, at age nine. 'I'd never been on an airplane before — my brother and I looked out the window and saw a sea of lights,' recalled Jean. 'I told him, "We've arrived, it's the city of diamonds," because it was shining so brightly.' Jean grew up in Brooklyn's housing projects, which he described as 'one of the roughest areas at the time.' He rose from those humble beginnings to become a top recording artist, and now he aims to help rebuild his homeland. The earthquake on January 12 left more than 220,000 dead in Haiti, destroyed 60 percent of government infrastructure, and rendered more than 180,000 homes uninhabitable. While little is known about Jean's official political platform, some of the lyrics from 'President' suggest a focus on helping the poor: 'Instead of spending billions on the war, I can use that money to feed the poor.'

Jean var en av de første kjendisene som ga hjelp etter det ødeleggende jordskjelvet som rammet Haiti i januar. Han fortalte CNN sent i forrige måned at han har fylt ut det nødvendige papirarbeidet for å stille til landets høyeste embete. I februar uttalte Jean at han alltid har satt fokus på haitiske spørsmål gjennom musikken sin. «Jeg har alltid promotert Haiti i musikken min, siden det første albumet med The Fugees, der vi snakket om haitieres kamp og menneskerettigheter for folk over hele verden», sa Jean. «Vi kom inn i bransjen med temaer som ikke var populære i musikkverdenen.» Jean fortalte at han ble født i en liten landsby nær Port-au-Prince og flyttet til Brooklyn, New York, som niåring. «Jeg hadde aldri flydd før — broren min og jeg så ut av vinduet og så et hav av lys,» fortalte Jean. «Jeg sa til ham: ‘Vi er framme, det er diamantbyen’, fordi det skinte så mye.» Jean vokste opp i boligprosjekter i Brooklyn, som han beskrev som «et av de tøffeste områdene på den tiden». article_content: Scandinavian Airlines (SAS) has announced plans to join the SkyTeam alliance, marking a significant change in its strategic direction. The airline, currently facing financial challenges, revealed a proposed new ownership structure that includes several unexpected elements. Air France-KLM, a competitor and member of SkyTeam, will acquire a 19.9% stake in SAS, while Lind Invest and the Danish government will also invest new capital. According to a stock market filing, a total of 12.9 billion Swedish kronor ($1.16 billion) in new capital has been committed. As part of this deal, SAS will exit the Star Alliance—of which it was a founding member in 1997—to join SkyTeam. If the proposal is approved, Castlelake Investment Fund will become the largest shareholder with a 32% stake, while the Danish government will hold 25.8%, Air France-KLM 19.9%, and Lind Invest 8.6%. Remaining equity is expected to be allocated to certain creditors, according to a SAS statement. CEO Anko van der Werff called this a crucial milestone in the SAS Forward plan, saying the new investors demonstrate belief in SAS’s potential. SAS AB, the parent company, plans to restructure in Sweden in 2024, a move that will lead to the company’s shares being delisted and could wipe out current shareholder value. This will affect approximately 255,000 shareholders. SAS stated that only a modest recovery should be expected for holders of commercial hybrid bonds. The Danish and Swedish governments each currently own around 20% of SAS. Norway divested its ownership several years ago. After financial troubles, particularly since the pandemic, SAS spent recent months seeking new investors. In July 2022, SAS filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in New York, a day after hundreds of SAS pilots went on strike due to unresolved wage negotiations. Bankruptcy protection enabled SAS to formulate a plan to secure the 9.5 billion Swedish kronor ($855 million) it needed. With the latest investments, the airline has surpassed this goal. Notably absent from the new ownership group is Apollo, a U.S.-based capital fund previously anticipated to invest. SAS’s departure from Star Alliance raises questions about potential changes to both its short-haul and long-haul strategy, especially given the importance of Scandinavia, and Norway in particular, to KLM’s network. KLM offers several daily flights from Norwegian cities to Amsterdam, providing connections to its broader international network. With the intention for SAS to join SkyTeam, route adjustments among SAS, Air France, and KLM are likely. CEO Van der Werff said joining SkyTeam presents opportunities that will help build a bright future for SAS.

Flyselskapet, som for tiden opplever økonomiske utfordringer, har avslørt en foreslått ny eierstruktur med flere uventede elementer. Air France-KLM, en konkurrent og medlem av SkyTeam, vil kjøpe en eierandel på 19,9 % i SAS, mens Lind Invest og den danske staten også vil investere ny kapital. Ifølge en børsmelding er det totalt forpliktet 12,9 milliarder svenske kroner (1,16 milliarder dollar) i ny kapital. Som en del av denne avtalen vil SAS forlate Star Alliance—som de var med på å grunnlegge i 1997—for å bli med i SkyTeam. Hvis forslaget godkjennes, vil Castlelake Investment Fund bli største aksjonær med 32 %, mens den danske staten vil ha 25,8 %, Air France-KLM 19,9 % og Lind Invest 8,6 %.  Gjenværende egenkapital forventes å bli tildelt visse kreditorer i henhold til en uttalelse fra SAS. Administrerende direktør Anko van der Werff kalte dette et viktig milepæl i SAS Forward-planen og sa at de nye investorene viser tro på SAS’ potensial. SAS AB, morselskapet, planlegger å restrukturere seg i Sverige i 2024, noe som vil føre til at selskapets aksjer blir avnotert og kan utslette verdien for nåværende aksjonærer. Omtrent 255 000 aksjonærer vil bli berørt. SAS uttalte at man kun bør forvente en beskjeden tilbakebetaling til innehavere av kommersielle hybridobligasjoner. Den danske og svenske staten eier for øyeblikket rundt 20 % hver av SAS. Norge solgte sin eierandel for flere år siden. Etter økonomiske problemer, spesielt etter pandemien, har SAS brukt de siste månedene på å se etter nye investorer. I juli 2022 begjærte SAS konkursbeskyttelse under Chapter 11 i New York, dagen etter at hundrevis av SAS-piloter gikk ut i streik på grunn av uløste lønnsforhandlinger. Konkursbeskyttelsen gjorde det mulig for SAS å utarbeide en plan for å skaffe de 9,5 milliarder svenske kronene (855 millioner dollar) de trengte. Med de siste investeringene har selskapet overgått dette målet. Merkbart fraværende i den nye eiergruppen er Apollo, et amerikansk kapitalfond som tidligere var forventet å investere. At SAS forlater Star Alliance reiser spørsmål om mulige endringer i både kort- og langdistanserutene, spesielt med tanke på hvor viktig Skandinavia, og særlig Norge, er for KLM sitt nettverk. KLM tilbyr flere daglige avganger fra norske byer til Amsterdam, som gir passasjerer videreforbindelse til deres verdensomspennende nettverk. Med SAS sin intensjon om å slutte seg til SkyTeam, er det sannsynlig at rutenettene til SAS, Air France og KLM vil endres. Van der Werff uttalte at mulighetene ved å bli med i SkyTeam vil bidra til å bygge en lys fremtid for SAS.

article_content: Senior leaders at UK train companies are receiving substantial pay, even as the majority of passengers express dissatisfaction with rail services. Recent surveys reveal that more than half of train operators scored 50% or below in customer satisfaction. At East Coast, the state-run train line funded by taxpayers, eight directors reportedly earn over £100,000 annually. One executive, most likely managing director Karen Boswell, earns between £161,000 and £180,000, while additional directors fall within lower six-figure salary bands. Private rail companies largely declined to disclose details about executive salaries, maintaining they are not legally required to do so under the Freedom of Information Act. CrossCountry was the only private firm to provide any pay data, indicating that its top director, likely Andy Cooper, received £222,000 including pension in 2011. Meanwhile, Network Rail's top executives also earn significant amounts, with chief executive Sir David Higgins taking home a basic salary of £560,000 as of March 2012. Other executives, such as the finance and operations chiefs, earned in excess of £350,000. Passenger dissatisfaction is growing, fueled by steep increases in ticket prices. A Which? investigation found that just 22% of passengers feel service is improving, and 40% are considering cutting back their use of trains due to higher fares. Complaints also cite regular overcrowding and subpar service at companies like First Capital Connect, Northern, and others. While some company spokespeople challenged negative findings—suggesting surveys were limited or unrepresentative—regulators and unions criticized the lack of transparency and executive pay amidst ongoing customer frustration. Overall, the data underscores a stark contrast between high pay for industry leaders and the dissatisfaction experienced by everyday rail users, many of whom feel they have no choice but to pay more for deteriorating services.

På East Coast, statlig drevet og finansiert av skattebetalerne, har åtte direktører over £100 000 i årslønn. Én leder, trolig administrerende direktør Karen Boswell, har mellom £161 000 og £180 000, mens flere andre ligger i nedre sjikt av sekssifrede lønninger. De fleste private togselskaper nekter å oppgi lederlønninger, og viser til at offentlighetsloven ikke gjelder dem. CrossCountry var det eneste private selskapet som delte lønnstall, der toppsjefen – sannsynligvis Andy Cooper – fikk £222 000 inkludert pensjon i 2011. I Network Rail har også de øverste lederne svært gode betingelser, der administrerende direktør Sir David Higgins hadde en grunnlønn på £560 000 per mars 2012. Andre ledere, som økonomi- og driftsdirektører, tjente over £350 000. Misnøyen blant passasjerene vokser som følge av kraftige billettprisøkninger. En Which?-undersøkelse viste at bare 22 prosent mener tjenestene blir bedre, og 40 prosent vurderer å reise mindre grunnet prisene. Klager gjelder også overfylte tog og dårlig service hos blant annet First Capital Connect og Northern. Noen talspersoner utfordret de negative funnene – og mente undersøkelsen var for liten eller ikke representativ – mens både myndigheter og fagforeninger kritiserte manglende åpenhet og høye lederlønninger i en periode med utbredt misnøye. Funnene viser tydelig kontrasten mellom høye lederlønninger og misfornøyde togpassasjerer, hvor mange føler at de må betale mer for dårligere tjenester.

article_content: When President Joe Biden traveled to Vietnam last month, he was joined by leaders from major US technology companies. Alongside executives from Google, Intel, Boeing, and GlobalFoundries, Biden sought new partnerships to support the production of key American technologies. Although official statements did not explicitly mention it, a key objective was to reduce reliance on China. Vietnam is central to a 'friend-shoring' strategy aimed at finding alternatives to China for crucial raw materials and manufacturing expertise, especially in the semiconductor sector. As US-China tensions over technology and national security increase, the US has faced growing pressure to diversify its supply chain. Last month, the Biden administration further tightened chip-related sanctions on China. While Vietnam’s government and industry leaders are enthusiastic about closer collaboration with the US, supply chain experts from both countries caution that Vietnam cannot quickly match China’s manufacturing scale and capabilities. The US effort to develop Vietnam as a technology ally began with Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen’s visit in July. Hanoi responded by elevating its relationship with Washington to its highest diplomatic status, shared only with Moscow and Beijing. President Biden solidified the partnership by announcing $2 million in seed funding to help build Vietnam’s semiconductor workforce. A month after Biden’s visit, optimism remains high in Vietnam. In early October, Prime Minister Phạm Minh Chính met with representatives from Amkor, a US chip assembly company, to announce a $1.6 billion chip testing and assembly plant near Hanoi. Chính encouraged more investment to grow the country’s semiconductor workforce tenfold by 2030. The first class of Vietnamese university students majoring in chip design is set to begin in 2024. Despite the excitement, both countries may need to moderate their expectations. Many observers question how significant a role Vietnam can play in the US tech supply chain, and what concrete steps will be taken. Shifting away from China will not be easy, and neither the US nor Vietnam can completely sever ties with China.

Selv om det ikke ble nevnt direkte i offisielle uttalelser, var et sentralt mål å redusere avhengigheten av Kina. Vietnam er sentralt i en «venneshoring»-strategi som har som mål å finne alternativer til Kina for viktige råmaterialer og produksjonskompetanse, spesielt i halvledersektoren. Etter hvert som spenningene mellom USA og Kina om teknologi og nasjonal sikkerhet øker, har presset på USA vokst for å diversifisere forsyningskjeden. Forrige måned strammet Biden-administrasjonen ytterligere inn sanksjonene mot kinesiske brikker. Selv om vietnamesiske myndigheter og næringslivsledere er entusiastiske til nærmere samarbeid med USA, advarer forsyningskjedespesialister fra begge land om at Vietnam ikke raskt kan matche Kinas produksjonskapasitet og ekspertise. USAs innsats for å utvikle Vietnam som teknologialliert begynte med finansminister Janet Yellens besøk i juli. President Biden styrket partnerskapet ved å kunngjøre 2 millioner dollar i startkapital for å bygge opp Vietnams halvlederarbeidsstyrke. En måned etter Bidens besøk er optimismen fortsatt høy i Vietnam. I begynnelsen av oktober møtte statsminister Phạm Minh Chính representanter fra Amkor, et amerikansk brikkeselskap, for å kunngjøre en fabrikk for testing og sammenstilling av brikker til 1,6 milliarder dollar nær Hanoi. Chính oppmuntret til ytterligere investeringer for å tidoble landets halvlederarbeidsstyrke innen 2030. Å flytte bort fra Kina blir ikke enkelt, og verken USA eller Vietnam kan helt kutte båndene til Kina.

article_content: At a campaign event in New Hampshire, former President Donald Trump stated he would establish ideological screening for immigrants if elected. He explained that those who do not agree with 'our religion' would not be allowed to enter the U.S., saying, “If you don’t like our religion… then we don’t want you in our country, and you are not getting in.” This statement has drawn attention because the First Amendment to the U.S. Constitution ensures religious freedom and does not designate an official religion. Some critics believe such measures could threaten constitutional rights. (Source: C-SPAN video)

Noen kritikere mener slike tiltak kan true grunnlovsrettigheter. (Kilde: C-SPAN video)

article_content: Goldman Sachs predicts Brent crude oil will average $92 per barrel for 2024. The bank sees the oil market tightening gradually, driven by strong demand and limited supply from OPEC producers. Their recent report forecasts a global oil supply deficit of 0.7 million barrels per day and demand growth of 1.6 million barrels per day next year. Although the market is expected to become tighter, Goldman Sachs points out that there is still considerable spare production capacity available to manage sudden shocks. The bank also suggests that OPEC is likely to maintain Brent within a range of $80 to $100 per barrel—creating a floor at $80 through its actions and a cap at $100 due to the spare capacity. Additionally, Saudi Arabia and Russia, as major OPEC+ members, have confirmed they will extend voluntary oil output cuts until the end of this year. The move comes amid ongoing worries about demand and global economic growth, both of which are affecting oil prices. At present, Brent crude trades near $80 per barrel after a decline, marking a four-month low and the fourth consecutive week of falling prices.

I sin siste rapport anslår de et globalt underskudd i oljetilførselen på 0,7 millioner fat per dag, samtidig som etterspørselen ventes å øke med 1,6 millioner fat per dag det neste året. Selv om markedet antas å bli strammere, påpeker Goldman Sachs at det fremdeles finnes betydelig ledig produksjonskapasitet til å håndtere plutselige sjokk. Banken mener også at OPEC trolig vil holde Brent-prisen mellom 80 og 100 dollar fatet—med et gulv på 80 dollar gjennom sine tiltak, og et tak på 100 dollar på grunn av ekstra kapasitet. Videre har Saudi-Arabia og Russland, to sentrale medlemmer av OPEC+, bekreftet at de vil forlenge sine frivillige kutt i oljeproduksjonen ut året. Dette skjer på grunn av vedvarende bekymringer for etterspørsel og global økonomisk vekst, noe som påvirker oljeprisene. I øyeblikket handles Brent-råolje rundt 80 dollar fatet etter en nedgang, noe som markerer det laveste nivået på fire måneder og den fjerde uken på rad med fallende priser.

article_content: The United States currently assesses that Israel is not responsible for Tuesday's deadly explosion at a hospital in Gaza, a White House official said on Wednesday after an independent review. This assessment comes as President Joe Biden makes a high-profile visit to the region. "While we continue to gather information, our current assessment—based on analysis of overhead imagery, intercepted communications, and open-source information—is that Israel was not responsible for the hospital explosion in Gaza yesterday," said Adrienne Watson, spokesperson for the White House National Security Council, in an official statement posted on X (formerly Twitter). After the deadly blast at the Al-Ahli hospital in Gaza City on Tuesday, Hamas immediately accused Israeli forces of launching an airstrike on the facility. The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) denied the accusation, stating that their investigation indicated the explosion was caused by a failed rocket launch by the Palestinian Islamic Jihad group. Israel provided evidence including video footage, an alleged intercepted phone call, and satellite images. President Biden, who met with Israeli leaders including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, told reporters that the data presented to him by the Pentagon led him to believe Israel was not responsible for the incident. NBC and ABC News, citing US officials, reported that an independent US assessment also found that the blast was likely caused by a failed Palestinian rocket, not by an Israeli airstrike. "I was deeply saddened and outraged by the explosion at the hospital in Gaza yesterday. Based on what I have seen, it appears it was done by the other team, not by you. But there are many people who are not sure," President Biden said in Israel on Wednesday. Independent analysts shared on social media that photos of the damage at the hospital did not match what would be expected from an Israeli airstrike. The lack of a large crater and minor damage to nearby vehicles were cited as evidence. Reports indicate that hundreds were killed in the hospital explosion, which occurred hours before Biden was expected to leave for a trip to Israel and Jordan. The visit to Jordan was ultimately canceled. The incident, which was condemned by many countries in the Middle East, sparked widespread protests and led US embassies in Lebanon and Jordan to issue advisories. Tensions intensified on October 7 when Hamas launched attacks across southern Israel, resulting in around 1,300 deaths and over 4,000 injuries. Israel declared war on Hamas and began bombing Gaza, reportedly causing over 3,000 Palestinian deaths and more than 12,000 injuries, according to United Nations figures. Human rights groups state that ongoing airstrikes have worsened an already critical humanitarian situation in Gaza. Israeli officials say these operations are a precursor to a possible ground invasion. Concerned about the potential for the conflict to spread, the US has deployed military assets to the area, including two Navy carrier strike groups and Air Force units. The move signals US support for Israel and aims to deter groups like Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon from escalating the conflict.
translated_content: USA vurderer for øyeblikket at Israel ikke er ansvarlig for tirsdagens dødelige eksplosjon på et sykehus i Gaza, sa en tjenesteperson fra Det hvite hus onsdag etter en uavhengig gjennomgang. Denne vurderingen kommer mens president Joe Biden gjør et profilert besøk til regionen. «Mens vi fortsetter å innhente informasjon, er vår nåværende vurdering—basert på analyse av satellittbilder, avlyttede kommunikasjoner og åpne kilder—at Israel ikke var ansvarlig for eksplosjonen ved sykehuset i Gaza i går», sier Adrienne Watson, talsperson for Det hvite hus' nasjonale sikkerhetsråd, i en offisiell uttalelse publisert på X (tidligere Twitter). Etter den dødelige eksplosjonen ved Al-Ahli-sykehuset i Gaza by tirsdag, anklaget Hamas umiddelbart israelske styrker for å ha gjennomført et luftangrep mot sykehuset. Israels forsvarsstyrker (IDF) avviste anklagen og opplyste at deres etterforskning tydet på at eksplosjonen skyldtes en mislykket rakettoppskytning fra gruppen Palestinsk Islamsk Jihad. Israel la frem bevis, blant annet videoopptak, en påstått avlyttet telefonsamtale og satellittbilder. President Biden, som møtte israelske ledere inkludert statsminister Benjamin Netanyahu, sa til journalister at informasjonen han fikk fra Pentagon overbeviste ham om at Israel ikke var ansvarlig for hendelsen. Ifølge NBC og ABC News, som siterte amerikanske tjenestepersoner, viste en uavhengig amerikansk vurdering også at eksplosjonen sannsynligvis ble forårsaket av en feilslått palestinsk rakett, ikke av et israelsk luftangrep. «Jeg var dypt opprørt og trist over eksplosjonen ved sykehuset i Gaza i går. Basert på det jeg har sett, ser det ut til at det ble gjort av den andre gruppen, ikke dere. Men det er mange som ikke er sikre,» sa president Biden i Israel onsdag. Uavhengige analytikere delte i sosiale medier at bildene fra sykehuset ikke samsvarer med skadeomfanget man forventer fra et israelsk luftangrep. Mangelen på et stort krater og små skader på nærliggende biler ble brukt som argumenter. Rapporter tilsier at hundrevis ble drept i sykehuseksplosjonen, som fant sted bare timer før Biden skulle reise til Israel og Jordan. Turen til Jordan ble senere avlyst. Hendelsen, som ble fordømt av mange land i Midtøsten, førte til omfattende protester og at USAs ambassader i Libanon og Jordan utstedte advarsler. Spenningsnivået økte 7. oktober da Hamas igangsatte angrep over det sørlige Israel og drepte rundt 1 300 mennesker samt skadet over 4 000. Israel erklærte krig mot Hamas og startet bombinger av Gaza, med over 3 000 palestinske døde og mer enn 12 000 skadde, ifølge FN. Menneskerettighetsorganisasjoner sier at de pågående luftangrepene har gjort den allerede alvorlige humanitære situasjonen i Gaza enda verre. Israelske myndigheter sier at angrepene er et forspill til en eventuell bakkeinvasjon. Bekymret for at konflikten kan spre seg, har USA sendt militære styrker til området, inkludert to hangarskipsgrupper fra marinen og flyvåpenenheter. Dette viser amerikansk støtte til Israel og skal avskrekke grupper som den Iran-støttede Hizbollah i Libanon fra å eskalere konflikten.

According to an old joke, the chicken crossed the road to get to the other side. But could that also explain why a llama was spotted strolling across a motorway bridge in Surrey? Drivers traveling on the M25 were stunned to see the animal calmly making its way across a bridge near the junction with the M3.

A photographer managed to capture the moment as the llama lumbered along the bridge, with traffic speeding by below. Llamas are typically found in the Andes mountains and grasslands of South America, making the sight of one crossing a motorway bridge in southern England both unusual and comical.

Perhaps the llama was on a day trip from Surrey’s Chessington Zoo? Regardless of where it came from, its presence left drivers both surprised and amused.

Ifølge den gamle vitsen krysset høna veien for å komme til den andre siden. Kanskje det også forklarer hvorfor en lama ble sett spaserende over en motorveibro i Surrey? Sjåfører på M25 ble overrasket da de så dyret rolig gå over broen nær krysset med M3.

En fotograf klarte å fange øyeblikket da lamaen ruslet over broen, mens trafikken suste forbi nedenfor. Lamaer finnes vanligvis i Andesfjellene og på gresslettene i Sør-Amerika, så å se en krysse en motorveibro sør i England var både uvanlig og morsomt.

Kanskje lamaen var på dagstur fra Chessington Zoo i Surrey? Uansett hvor den kom fra, skapte tilstedeværelsen dens overraskelse og latter blant sjåførene.

article_content: Joey Barton sparked controversy during his first appearance on BBC's Question Time by making an awkward analogy about UKIP's success in the European elections. The QPR midfielder suggested that support for UKIP in the recent European Parliament elections was a protest vote. To illustrate his point, Barton compared choosing between political parties to picking the least unattractive option among 'four really ugly girls,' a comment that did not sit well with the audience or social media users. UKIP MEP Louise Bours criticized Barton's analogy, calling it offensive and remarking that it reinforced stereotypes about footballers. Barton later apologized, explaining that it was his first appearance and that nerves affected his choice of words. He admitted he 'couldn't think of a better one' and expressed regret for his metaphor. Barton appeared alongside Piers Morgan, Shadow Secretary of State for Scotland Margaret Curran, and Conservative MP David Willetts during the debate held at Heathrow Terminal 2. Host David Dimbleby introduced Barton as 'football's philosopher king.' After the show, Barton called the experience nerve-racking and noted on Twitter that he 'should have left it at best of a bad bunch.' He acknowledged that his comment may have upset some people and reiterated his inexperience in political discussions.

QPR-midtbanespilleren mente at støtten til UKIP i det nylige EU-parlamentsvalget var en proteststemme. For å illustrere poenget sammenlignet Barton det å velge mellom politiske partier med å velge det minst lite attraktive alternativet blant 'fire virkelig stygge jenter', en kommentar som ikke falt i god jord hos publikum eller på sosiale medier. UKIPs MEP Louise Bours kritiserte Bartons analogi, kalte den støtende og påpekte at den forsterker stereotypier om fotballspillere. Barton ba senere om unnskyldning, og forklarte at det var hans første opptreden og at nervøsiteten hans påvirket ordvalget. Han innrømmet at han 'ikke kunne komme på et bedre eksempel' og uttrykte beklagelse for metaforen. Barton deltok sammen med Piers Morgan, Arbeiderpartiets Margaret Curran og det konservative parlamentsmedlemmet David Willetts under debatten som fant sted på Terminal 2 ved Heathrow. Programleder David Dimbleby introduserte Barton som 'fotballens filosofkonge.' Etter sendingen beskrev Barton opplevelsen som nervepirrende og skrev på Twitter at han 'burde ha holdt seg til best av et dårlig utvalg.' Han innrømmet at kommentaren hans kunne ha fornærmet noen, og understreket sin mangel på erfaring med politiske diskusjoner.

U.S. Representative Joe Wilson of South Carolina, a Republican, shouted 'You lie!' at President Barack Obama during the President's speech to a joint session of Congress on health care reform. The incident, widely regarded by both Republicans and Democrats as a breach of political decorum, prompted Wilson to issue an apology. Following the outburst, Wilson asked supporters via an online video to help him fend off political attacks and announced that he remains firmly opposed to Democrat-led health care reform. News outlets report that Wilson has since raised over $1 million in campaign contributions.

Wilson's exclamation came after President Obama addressed and denied claims that his health care proposal would extend coverage to illegal immigrants, stating, 'The reforms I'm proposing would not apply to those who are here illegally.' The moment sparked intense reactions, with both Wilson's supporters and opponents mobilizing. Rob Miller, Wilson's Democratic challenger in the upcoming congressional race and his opponent in the previous election, also saw a substantial surge in donations, collecting more than $1 million in small contributions in under 48 hours—a significant increase compared to his earlier fundraising.

In a YouTube video released the day after the incident, Wilson asserted his resolve: 'On these issues, I will not be muzzled, I will speak up and speak loudly against this risky plan.' He also criticized supporters of the reform, alleging efforts to distract from what he termed the plan's shortcomings. The altercation has energized both political campaigns, with CNN’s Peter Hamby contributing to the reporting.

Hendelsen, som av både republikanere og demokrater ble sett på som et brudd på politisk etikette, førte til at Wilson kom med en offentlig unnskyldning. Etter utbruddet ba Wilson sine støttespillere via en video på nettet om støtte for å motstå politiske angrep, og han meddelte at han fortsatt sterkt motsetter seg demokratenes helsereform. Ifølge nyhetsrapporter har Wilson siden samlet inn over én million dollar i valgkampbidrag.

Wilsons utrop kom etter at president Obama tok opp og avviste påstander om at helsereformen ville gi dekning til ulovlige innvandrere, og sa: «Reformene jeg foreslår, vil ikke gjelde for dem som er her ulovlig.» Episoden utløste sterke reaksjoner, og både Wilsons støttespillere og motstandere mobiliserte. Rob Miller, Wilsons demokratiske utfordrer ved det kommende kongressvalget og motstander ved forrige valg, opplevde også en betydelig økning i donasjoner og samlet inn mer enn én million dollar i små bidrag på under 48 timer – en markant økning sammenlignet med tidligere innsamlinger.

I en YouTube-video som ble publisert dagen etter hendelsen, understreket Wilson sitt standpunkt: «I disse sakene vil jeg ikke bli kneblet, jeg vil tale høyt mot denne risikable planen.» Han kritiserte også reformens tilhengere, og hevdet at de forsøker å avlede oppmerksomheten fra det han mener er svakheter ved planen. Hendelsen har gitt energi til begge politiske kampanjer, og CNNs Peter Hamby har bidratt til rapporteringen.

article_content: Passengers on the Spirit of Discovery cruise ship described experiencing intense fear when the vessel was hit by a violent storm in the Bay of Biscay. Around 100 passengers suffered injuries on Saturday during a sudden safety maneuver, with most injuries being minor. However, five people had to be hospitalized when the ship returned to Portsmouth on Monday, according to the cruise operator, Saga. One passenger recounted how panic swept the ship, saying that some were so fearful they sent farewell messages to loved ones, worried the vessel might capsize. The passenger also noted the captain's worried tone and emotional crew members, which amplified the anxiety on board. The voyage, which began on 24 October as a 14-day cruise around the Canary Islands with roughly 1,000 people—many of them older adults—was cut short due to deteriorating weather. During the storm on Saturday, emergency safety systems led the ship to suddenly veer and stop, causing the majority of the reported injuries. The ship was held in place for around 15 hours while the weather remained severe. Seventy-five-year-old Jan Bendall shared that she and her husband stayed in their cabin throughout the ordeal. She said they clung to safety and followed the captain’s instructions to stay seated or lie down. Ms. Bendall described the situation as frightening and felt that vulnerable and older passengers, especially those alone in cabins, were particularly worried. Other passengers recalled waves knocking people over, furniture moving violently, and parts of the dining area being converted into a makeshift medical facility. Guests were instructed to remain in their cabins until conditions improved. Despite the frightening situation, Ms. Bendall praised the ship’s crew and captain for providing constant updates and assuring everyone of the ship’s safety. When passengers disembarked on Tuesday morning, they saw workers repairing glass doors, windows, and partitions that had been damaged during the storm. Saga said that only limited damage occurred and the ship remained safe throughout the ordeal. The company apologized sincerely to those affected and confirmed that all guests returned home safely in calmer seas.
translated_content: Passasjerene på cruiseskipet Spirit of Discovery beskrev stor frykt da skipet ble rammet av en voldsom storm i Biscayabukten. Rundt 100 passasjerer ble skadet lørdag under en brå sikkerhetsmanøver, de fleste med mindre skader. Fem personer måtte likevel til sykehus da skipet returnerte til Portsmouth mandag, ifølge cruiseoperatøren Saga. En passasjer fortalte om panikk om bord, og at enkelte sendte avskjedsbeskjeder til familiemedlemmer i frykt for at skipet skulle kantre. Passasjeren la til at kapteinens bekymrede stemme og følelsesladde besetning økte uroen om bord. Cruiset, som startet 24. oktober som en 14-dagers rundtur til Kanariøyene med omtrent 1 000 personer – mange eldre – ble avbrutt på grunn av dårligere vær. Under stormen lørdag førte nødsystemer til at skipet plutselig svingte brått og stoppet, noe som forårsaket de fleste av skadene. Skipet lå stille i omtrent 15 timer mens uværet raste. 75 år gamle Jan Bendall fortalte at hun og ektemannen ble på lugaren under hele hendelsen. Hun fortalte at de klamret seg fast og fulgte kapteinens råd om å sitte eller ligge ned. Bendall beskrev situasjonen som skremmende, og følte at spesielt eldre eller sårbare gjester alene på lugar hadde grunn til å være redde. Andre passasjerer fortalte om bølger som kastet folk over ende, flyttede møbler og deler av spisesalen som ble gjort om til midlertidig sykestue. Gjestene måtte holde seg på sine lugarer til været forbedret seg. Til tross for alt roste Bendall besetningen og kapteinen for å gi hyppige oppdateringer og beroligende beskjeder om at skipet var trygt. Da passasjerene gikk i land tirsdag morgen, så de ansatte som reparerte glassdører, vinduer og skillevegger som var blitt skadet. Saga sier skipet kun fikk begrenset skade og til enhver tid var trygt. Selskapet beklager oppriktig overfor de berørte, og bekrefter at alle gjestene kom trygt hjem i roligere farvann.

article_content: On Monday, Liverpool forward Mario Balotelli posted a playful selfie on Instagram with his brother Enoch. article_content: A coastal village in Wales is now home to what is believed to be the country's smallest parking space. The narrow gap, just nine inches wide and located between two sets of double yellow lines, is scarcely big enough to fit the wheels of a bicycle. Residents of Burry Port, Carmarthenshire, have poked fun at officials by parking toy cars and trucks in the space, highlighting the unusual oversight. Emyr Phillips, a 72-year-old bus tour manager who first noticed the gap two weeks ago, said: 'I couldn’t believe my eyes when I spotted it. You could just about fit a bike in there sideways – or maybe a pogo stick.' He added, 'But my favourite thing was to put a toy bus in there just to have a laugh.' Carmarthenshire Council explained that there was a practical reason for the tiny gap. One set of yellow lines is on a public road, while the other is on a private access road leading to the local GP surgery. A council spokesperson said, 'The section of double yellow lines leading to the surgery is on a private access road and the council would not have undertaken this work. The break in the lines is required, as it shows the termination of the traffic order on the public road.' Despite the explanation, some residents remain unimpressed. Martin Thomas, who humorously parked a toy truck in the spot, called the reasoning 'nonsense.' He said, 'We all think it makes a lot more sense to have joined-up thinking – and joined-up yellow lines. It really is bureaucratic nonsense.'
translated_content: En kystlandsby i Wales har nå det som antas å være landets minste parkeringsplass. Det smale gapet, kun ni tommer bredt og plassert mellom to sett med doble gule linjer, er knapt stort nok til å romme hjulene på en sykkel. Innbyggere i Burry Port, Carmarthenshire, har gjort narr av myndighetene ved å parkere lekebiler og lastebiler på plassen, noe som fremhever den spesielle feilen. Emyr Phillips, en 72 år gammel turbussjåfør som først oppdaget gapet for to uker siden, sa: 'Jeg kunne ikke tro mine egne øyne da jeg så det. Du kan så vidt få en sykkel inn der sidelengs – eller kanskje en hoppestokk.' Han la til: 'Det morsomste var å sette en lekebuss der bare for å le litt.' Carmarthenshire Council forklarte at det var en praktisk grunn til det lille gapet. Ett sett med gule linjer er på en offentlig vei, mens det andre er på en privat tilkomstvei til det lokale legekontoret. En talsperson for kommunen sa: 'Delen med doble gule linjer som fører til legekontoret er på en privat tilkomstvei, og kommunen ville ikke ha gjort dette arbeidet. Avbruddet i linjene er nødvendig, da det viser avslutningen på trafikkbestemmelsen for den offentlige veien.' Til tross for forklaringen er noen innbyggere fortsatt ikke imponert. Martin Thomas, som humoristisk parkerte en lekebil på plassen, kalte begrunnelsen 'tull'. Han sa: 'Vi synes alle det gir mye mer mening med helhetlig tenkning – og sammenhengende gule linjer. Det er virkelig byråkratisk tull.'

article_content: Australia captured their record sixth ODI World Cup title by defeating India in the final at the Narendra Modi Stadium, a result that was tough for Indian cricket fans. Cricket icon Sachin Tendulkar congratulated the Australian team for their impressive showing and shared encouraging words with Team India. Tendulkar noted that Australia performed better on the crucial day, but he also commended the Indian squad for their unwavering effort throughout the tournament. He empathized with the disappointment felt by both the players and the fans, pointing out that setbacks are part of sport and acknowledging the team's wholehearted commitment. Former India opener Virender Sehwag also extended his congratulations to Australia, specifically highlighting Travis Head's comeback from injury to play a decisive role in the final. Sehwag praised Australia's choice to keep Head in the lineup and celebrated the memorable moments India gave its fans across the World Cup, despite falling short in the last match. Jay Shah, Secretary of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), praised the resilience and determination of the Indian team, stating that their World Cup journey served as inspiration for the nation. He highlighted the team's undefeated streak leading up to the final and the tremendous support shown by Indian fans. Shah thanked every player for their dedication and noted that their passion and perseverance filled the country with pride. In the final game, India posted 240 runs in their allotted 50 overs. Australia, after an early setback at 47/3, was propelled to a six-wicket victory thanks to a superb 137 by Travis Head and a steady 58 from Marnus Labuschagne.
